Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes01/000: The underwater city, one of the Seven Wonders of Ancient Times, is located on the other side of this Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/001: Cyrano, it's been a long time coming.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/002: I want to know why you betrayed me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/003: Hehe... When I saw an old friend, I started chatting about the past. It's also nice to relive the memories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/004: But Cyrano, /40d, we have to wait until we decide the winner!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/005: Come on, Cyrano! Let you see my power!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/006: You can't stop me at this level, Iscariot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/007: As expected... normal power cannot defeat you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/008: But if I use the ultimate power I got, that's a different matter! /40d Wake up, Cyrano! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/009: Hehe... Cyrano... you have gained the strongest power. Much more powerful than I was given...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/010: Iscariot... Are you so eager for power that you would even turn into a monster?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/011: That's why I can betray you, isn't it...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/012: In the end, you are just like me, a monster...an alien who cannot coexist with others and is rejected by society...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/014: At least I...can still die in your hands like this...but you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/018: It is said that there is an underwater city on the other side of the Trixis Desert...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s04/019: So, Cesare went to the underwater city!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/003: Hmm... Sure enough, you haven't come yet...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/004: Same, how could the Meditch brother go to the appointment on time!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/005: However, what's going on with a sudden appointment at a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/006: Surrounded by beautiful flowers, your beauty is even more impressive, Kana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/007: Here we go again, Brother Meditch. /nSince I'm sorry enough to say nice things like this, don't be late!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/008: Say something nice? This is too hurtful. /nI have always been sincere to Kana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/009: If you keep joking, I will ignore you. /nStop making trouble and get down to business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/010: Since you never take my words seriously, okay. /30d Then I won't say it in a joking tone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/011: Now I also want to tell you clearly how I feel about you, Kana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/012: Accept my heart, Kana. i love...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/014: I pretended I didn't hear what you just said. If there was nothing else to do, I would go back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/015: Kana! /30dDon't you still understand what I mean? /10dI'm serious, Kana!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/016: I understand what Brother Meditch is thinking, and I.../20d I also like Brother,/10d respect you.../10d I rely on you like my own brother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/017: But...but we can't be lovers, can we? /30d Am I not qualified to get your love...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/018: That's not the case. /20d /nI... don't want to ruin the good relationship between us. /20dBetween all of us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/019: And.../20d I have fallen in love with someone else. /20dAlthough...he hasn't accepted me yet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/020: It's that guy.../30d /nCyrano.../30d Is it him you love?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/021: Brother Meditch, please stop talking. /30d Don't let this kind of thing create a gap between us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/022: That guy Cyrano...what is so good.../20d Yes, he is better than me.../10d No, better than anyone else.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/024: [Kana]/nBig brother is such an idiot! /30d /nI will never ignore Brother Meditch again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/031: You seem to like flowers./30dCome to my garden at this hour.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/036: Huh? /30dAh.../20d You mean we are here to help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/039: Actually, at this time every day, I come to the garden to look at these flowers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/040: It is precisely because of this habit that I have the opportunity to be alone with Mr. Meditch on nights like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/042: Oops, sorry. /nDid it make you unhappy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/043: Ah, no, how could I be unhappy. /30d This joke from Mr. Esther Dodd made me feel much better.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/048: I have always admired...admired you, Mr. Meditch...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/050: I know...you think I am a frivolous woman, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/052: Yes, it's inevitable that you would find this confession ridiculous to someone you just met for the first time today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/053: But, Mr. Meditch, /30d looking at you face to face like this, I really can't control myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s06/057: Would you like to...take me back to my room...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/000: Oh... Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement. Mercedes is indeed the perfect bride for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/001: However, even if you get married, you won't forget our club, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/002: Hahaha! How about having a drink next weekend for your engagement?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/003: Hmph! You actually left me and started a family? Really...forget it, there is nothing we can do. After all, the other party is Mercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/004: Although it is a pity that you have a master, but in this way, Mercedes will no longer be able to attract the attention of the men in Gesir...it is not too bad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/005: Hehehe... Who will succeed Mercedes and become the next socialite? I heard that a new beauty salon has opened in the city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/001_3: But after you get married, won't you be able to go to that place again? You can't be so stingy, can you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/002_3: Hahaha! How about a trip next weekend to celebrate your engagement? I heard there seems to be a new person coming...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/003_3: Hmph! You actually left me and got married first? Really...forget it, if the target is Mercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/004_3: Although it is a pity that you quit, it means that Mercedes will no longer be able to attract the attention of Gesil men... It is not a disadvantage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber09/005_3: Hehehe... Who will succeed Mercedes and become the next socialite? I heard that a new beauty salon has opened in the city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/000: To go to the Nicosia area, you need to pass through the Caracas Forest and continue southward through Gesir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/001: This is the eastern part of the region of Pretolia./nAnd east is the Caracas area.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/002: To get to the Libreville area, go north from the Caracas Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/003: The Caracas Forest is an important transportation hub, connecting Libreville, Ciudad Gesir, Paro and Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/004: Going to Memphis, Bordeaux, Rowan and other places in the southern part of the mainland, you have to pass through Gesil City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/002_3: This is the main base of our Zephyr Falcon. It looks like an ordinary cave from the outside, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy00/003_3: There are many strange rumors circulating in this forest near Pretoria, so almost no one approaches it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/000: Meditch brother? /20d Could it be Rhidelhard...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/004: [Esther Dodd]/nHehehe! /30d The first person to betray your companions is yourself. How stupid to put the blame on me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/005: Esther Dodd, it's not too late, go after him and ask for forgiveness. I will forgive you too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/007: Hehehe, something worse than a bug!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/009: Diablo...and Cesare Borgia! /40d My and Master's enemies are actually here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/010: However, as long as you hand over Christina obediently, I can spare your lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/011: How sad, Cyrano Bernstein. /nHe actually called his savior his enemy. When you were almost burned alive, didn't I just show mercy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/012: Also, how dare you speak rudely to Lord Diablo!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/013: Enough, Cardinal Cesare. If my feeling is correct, the aura exuding from that guy is the same as that of Deimos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/014: No wonder I can't feel the aura of Deimos since a few years ago. It turns out that I have become one with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/015: Hehehe, who do you think Christina is, how dare you order me to hand over my granddaughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/016: No need to say more. /20d Hand over Christina obediently, and I will make your death painless.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/017: Lord Diablo, that boy is poisoned and his life is short. He is worse than a bug. Ignore him and continue the ceremony...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/018: I'll see how long you're going to talk, Cesare!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/023: How dare you be so presumptuous!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/025: I can't just watch my savior die in front of me and remain indifferent, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/027: I wonder if you still remember the prisoner who escaped with you in Invernor three years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/029: Your eyes were shining then. But now, you are beguiled by that kind of witch, and the light in your eyes is disappearing. /60dLook at yourself, Meditch!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/032: Haha, Mr. Cyrano is stupid enough to stand up for that kind of coward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/033: There should be a limit to telling jokes, what? You want me to beg for mercy? /50d Hahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/034: Lord Diablo will protect me! It's you who should beg for forgiveness!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/037: It's too late! The God of Destruction...is being resurrected! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/038: Esmeralda saved Christina at the expense of herself...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/039: No more... Christina's breathing is getting weaker and weaker...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/041: The underwater city is collapsing, you must get out of here first!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/042: Christina will die before she escapes!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/043: But there is no other way now. I will take Miss Christina and escape as soon as possible!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/045: Deimos... It's only now that I finally seem to understand your mood.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/048: There is no other way! We must destroy the God of Destruction before it fully exerts its power!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/050: Deimos! ! Please give your life to that child! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/056: So you already know, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/058: He used his own life to save Miss Christina...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/060: The city seems to have begun to completely collapse, Kana! /50d /nLeave Miss Christina to me, let's escape quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/061: I want to stay with Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/063: All his life...he has always been chasing the shadow of the person he loves, and is a lonely person...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/064: It was only now that he finally found his resting place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/065: I want to stay with him. /15d forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/066: .../20d Got it. /20d Everyone has different standards for measuring happiness, and I have no right to stop you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/067: I hope you can find true happiness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/071: I have a favor to ask of you, Sharn Hoiste.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/073: I give Asura to you. /30d I hope you will take good care of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/074: Cyrano, I'm not qualified to take it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/075: The only person who can entrust this sword to you is you. /30d You use the same sword technique as my master, I believe you must be trustworthy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/076: .../30d Got it. /30d It seems that you already know my identity. I believe you entrusted it to me out of trust. /40d I will accept this sword and keep it well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s01/077: Also...Christina, I'd like to thank you too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/000: Is there still a while until dawn...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/001: As expected, you kept your promise.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/003: Ah, one more thing. /30d Now if I ask you why you proposed a duel, you won't answer, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/005: Then, there is no need to say more!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/006: Sure enough...it lives up to its reputation. The strongest swordsman in the empire...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/008: Don't you want my head? Come and get it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/010: Do you remember the man named Luke Bernstein who died in a duel with you fifteen years ago?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/012: I remember. /30d The crime should be worshiping the devil and suspected of treason.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/013: Have you ever regretted killing him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/014: I regret it.../30d The charges imposed on him were obviously framed, but I have never regretted what I have done. /40d That was not an ordinary duel, but a war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/015: The mastermind behind that war was none other than Luke Bernstein. /30dMy actions were undoubtedly justified to protect citizens.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/016: In other words, I don't regret that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/018: It turns out you want to use my life to pay for the death of Luke Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/020: Sorry, my mind will not change, come and take my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/022: Is there really anyone in the world who can face death without any worries? /40d Thinking that my wife and daughter will be sad, maybe I will become cowardly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/029: God gives love to the world, but /20d there are demons who are jealous of this love.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/031: You have no reason to pay for their sins. /40d Let's go down the mountain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/032: Before the duel, check your weapons first...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/033: ....../30d Before the duel, check your equipment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/037: Frederick is not an opponent that can be easily dealt with without preparation. /30d I need to check the equipment again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/038: Has the equipment inspection been completed?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/039: The equipment has not been fully checked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s02/041: No need to check your equipment anymore. /30d Come anytime, Frederick!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd01/000: << Invernor Recapture Operation >>/n/nRecapture Invernor occupied by the Bifrost Army!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd01/001: Inferno...has it been three years? /nThat's just north of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd01/002: On the orders of Mr. Clousewitz, I came to supply the weapons. Please choose what you need.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd01/005: On the orders of Mr. Clousewitz, I came to provide supplies. Please choose what you need.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/003: You are quite calm. /nMy daughter has been away from home for three months...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/004: Haha, at her age, I also traveled around to increase my knowledge. /nThis trip will also be a good experience for her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/005: Besides, don't you know very well that even I can't do anything to her? /nDon't worry too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/006: What are you talking about? /nShe has just turned fifteen. /nBesides, she is still a girl!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/007: But I can also understand her mood. /nAs you said, she is only fifteen years old, but she is going to be married to a stranger.../nEven if it is the order of her father-in-law, this is hard to accept.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/008: Then you can't run away from home.../nIt's all your fault for teaching her martial arts since she was a child and raising her like a boy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/009: Haha! Don't worry. /nAlthough the child is a girl, she has extraordinary character and talent. /nThe person who will make the Frederick family famous in the future may not be me, Alfred Frederick, but Christina Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/010: Don't just say this, please go find Christina. /15d /nYou can easily find her if you go out in person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/011: ...I didn't expect you to be so worried. /nThen I will take this opportunity to go out and look for her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/013: Actually, the church that my father-in-law established in Nicosia a few days ago seemed to have been destroyed by the Zephyr Falcon. /nAnother rebellion... Even I feel that my father-in-law has pushed the civilians too hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/014: Dear...he is the one who raised me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/015: Sorry./nYou alone, my father-in-law is enough for me./nIn any case, it's time for them to suffer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/016: So, you plan to go on an expedition?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/017: I will walk around first, deal with the Zephyr Falcon gang, and ask for news about Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/023: You are really calm. /15d /n It has been three months since my daughter left home...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/024: Haha, at her age, I also traveled around to increase my knowledge. /15d/nThis trip will also be a good experience for her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/025: Besides, I can't even do anything to her, don't you know very well? /15d /nDon't worry too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/026: What are you talking about? /15d /nShe has just turned fifteen. /15d /nNot to mention she is still a girl!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/027: But I can also understand her mood. /15d /nJust like you said, she is only fifteen years old, but she is going to be married to a stranger...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/028: Then you can't run away from home.../15d /nIt's all your fault for teaching her martial arts since she was a child and raising her as a boy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/029: Haha! Don't worry. /15d /nAlthough the child is a girl, she has extraordinary character and talent. /15d /nThe person who will make the Frederick family famous in the future may not be me, Alfred Frederick, but Christina Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/030: If even that child is no longer here.../15d I...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/031: ...I didn't expect you to be so worried. /15d /nThen I will take this opportunity to go out and look for her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/032: Actually, the church that my father-in-law established in Nicosia a few days ago seemed to have been destroyed by the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/034: Dear.../15d He is the one who raised me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/035: Another rebellion.../15d /nEven I feel that my father-in-law has pushed the common people too hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/036: Even if it is the order of my father-in-law, this is too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/037: Sorry. /15d /nJust because of you, my father-in-law is enough to make me grateful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/038: No matter what, the West Wind Falcon gang has been too unscrupulous recently, and it's time for them to suffer a little.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/039: So, you plan to go on an expedition?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/040: I will walk around first, deal with the Zephyr Falcon gang, and ask for news about Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/004: Hoo.../15d Hoo.../20d Before I die, I can say my last goodbye to you...it's really great...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/005: [Deimos]/nDon't say such depressing words, you won't die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/007: [Deimos]/nI will give you the last remaining power of my soul.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/009: [Deimos]/nI once gave all my power to the Black Prince. This body is no different from an empty shell, but there is still the last power of the soul left.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/011: [Deimos]/nWith this power, it shouldn't be a problem to save your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/013: [Deimos]/nDon't say that. /nIn the long years, /15d I have suffered from powerlessness and loneliness. /15d Only you are willing to be my friend, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/014: [Deimos]/nYou have inherited my blood and knowledge, and are no different from my biological children.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/015: [Deimos]/nI have created many lives in my life, but there are only two people among them that I can call my sons. /30d /nBlack Prince Steiner, and you, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/016: [Deimos]/nMy power is given to Steiner,/20d and my soul will be passed on to you, Cyrano. /20d Find the power left by Steiner and inherit it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/017: But.../20dIn order to maintain my insignificant life.../20dI cannot accept your life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/018: Please.../15dDon't say that.../20dPlease bless my soul to be liberated...Escape from this hell...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/019: [Deimos]/nDon't think about anything else, just listen to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/020: [Deimos]/nThat is the power this world needs. /20d However, where and how to use it is entirely up to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/023: [Deimos]/nMy soul will always be with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/024: The power left by Black Prince Steiner is buried on an island called Storm Island at the southern end of the continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/025: Asura of Storm Island! /15d Don't forget Asura!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/002: Avoid the center part where Christina is and attack the enemy's offensive part!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/003: Success! ! All its offensive parts have been destroyed!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nI pray with my life, wake up, Christina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/011: [Cyrano]/nHow...how could you do such a stupid thing...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy...why do you have to say sorry to me...Mercedes...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/023: Cyrano! ! The God of Destruction is on the move again! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/025: I will never fail you, Esmeralda!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/004: ...It seems that you are mercenaries hired by the fox in Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/005: Why kidnap villagers? /nWhy is the Bifrost Army in the Empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/006: A mere mercenary actually asked about so many irrelevant things.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/007: Looks like you have some skills...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/008: How about it?/nHow about I pay double to come and work for me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/009: Stop playing tricks. /nWe are the Falcon of the West Wind!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/011: Huh...Esther Dodd...that's stupid. /nHe actually attracted the West Wind Falcon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/014: We can't let them leave here alive. Do it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/016: Okay. /nThe lord has been executed, now go find the detained villagers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/017: Yes, I am the lord here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw06/000: The forest here is currently blocked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw06/001: Outskirts of the Demon Sword Forest
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/000: This...this is the God of Destruction...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/002: Avoid the center part where Christina is and attack the enemy's offensive part!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/003: Success! ! All its offensive parts have been destroyed!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nI pray with my life, wake up, Christina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr98/000: After hearing about the last incident, the basement was sealed off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr98/001: Okay, hurry up and save Esmeralda.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/000: Oops...Why is today's protagonist wandering around in a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/001: Have a good time with Mercedes. /15d Hehe... Among Gesil's famous disciples, there is probably no one who has not been attracted to her... You are so lucky.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/002: If you make her cry one day, I can't forgive you. Understand!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/003: Oh, Cyrano. I'm very interested in the kidnapping of your child named Sid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/004: Why did the kidnappers only hold the child for three days without taking any further action? And why did you give him medicine to keep him in a coma?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/005: This matter is full of doubts. The most suspicious thing is the motive. Why on earth...? There must be something behind it, but I still can't figure it out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/007: Turn the corner, maybe still waiting there,/nA new road, a secret door. /nEven though I have passed by you again and again,/nOne day in the future,/nI will eventually set foot on that hidden road,/nleading to the west of the moon and the east of the sun.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/008: /nAh! Elberis Giltoniel! /nSilevren Pena Miriel/nO Menel Agral Elenas/nGiltoniel, ah! Elberis! /nWe still remember,/nWe who live far away under the trees here,/nThe starlight reflecting on the western sea
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/009: That kid Sid...were you reading this book before?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/000_3: Oops... Why is today's protagonist wandering around in a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/001_3: Treat Mercedes well. Ha... Who among the famous sons of Gesil has not dreamed of her... You are so lucky.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/002_3: If you dare to make her cry, I can't forgive you. Did you hear that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/006_3: There is an unknown book on the bookshelf...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/007_3: /nTurn the corner, maybe still waiting,/nA new road, a secret door. /nAlthough I often pass them by,/nBut one day, the time comes,/nI will set foot on the hidden path,/nleading to the west of the moon and the east of the sun.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/008_3: /nAh! Elberis Giltoniel! /nSilevren, Pena Miriel,/nO Menel, Aglar Elenas,/nGiltoniel, ah! Elberis! /nWe still remember,/nThose of us who live under the trees far away,/nThe starlight reflecting on the western sea. /n/nAuthor: Frodo Baggins, excerpted from "The War of the Ring"
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/009_3: the book Sid reads...? A collection of poems I've never seen before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma01a/000: We have to catch up to Machiavelli.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma01a/003: Oops... I have to hurry up.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx04/000: Libreville is located north of the Caracas Forest to the east of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwri11/002: We need to meet the lord of Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga05/000: Is this the garden from back then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/001: What are you going to do next?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/002: First, let's understand what changes have taken place in the empire since I left.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/003: Remember this is the Caracas area.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/005: Hehehe, I've been waiting for you for a long time, Kana Milanovich!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/006: Turns out to be the commander of the Zephyr Falcon, and the harvest is greater than imagined! /30d Surrender now!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/007: Oh no, it really is a trap?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/008: However, the only way to the dukedom is here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/009: Ah! Hey, this way, this way! Attack them from the side!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/010: What, there are accomplices over there too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/011: Okay, don't let anyone go, catch them all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/012: What happened to that girl! /20d actually involves unrelated people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/013: Heh, that girl really dares to take risks.../20d However, since the soldiers are blocking the way, there is no need to avoid them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/015: Hmph, you might as well stab someone first and then say sorry!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/016: This will take care of all the soldiers, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/017: Thank you very much for your help, but I have something urgent and I have to leave first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/019:
What, what a rude girl!
What does
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/020: Forget it, just consider it a welcome from your hometown.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/021: Okay, there should be a small village nearby. /30d Rest there tonight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst12/000: Come here, practice is enough.../10d Go back and receive the guidance of the fifth stage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/002: What to do about the war with the Tur tribe... He actually sent Alondette here! Rasheed! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/003: It seems that the recent rumors are true.../30d The Tur Empire and Pendragon have temporarily reached a truce...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/004: At this time? /30d doesn't work...it's too early! /30d Our empire's territory has not been unified yet!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/005: Your Excellency, Cardinal, now is not the time to say this. Now that Pendragon has intervened, your plan.../40d must get out of here as soon as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/006: No, there is another way... As long as I am still alive, the empire must be unified by my own hands! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/007: Abandon your false ambitions, Cardinal Cesare. One should know when to give up.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/008: Grandpa...I can no longer allow you to kill innocent people for such ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/010: I can't do it. Do you think I will give up!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/011: Don't try to persuade me, Christina. That person is no longer your grandfather. He is a devil!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/012: Who dares to say that I am a devil! ! Talk to me! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/017: I am very happy that my grandpa can find real peace...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/018: Now...father and mother can finally rest in peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/020: Speaking of which, where did that guy named Machiavelli go?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/021: I'm here. I won't run away, don't worry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/023: Quite courageous. Were you watching from the beginning to the end?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/024: I was the one who let him go, Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/026: Who exactly are you? /30dIs Clausewitz really your name?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/029: I do have a lot to explain to you. But grandpa is waiting for us, so let's go together first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/030: His purpose is only to leave his evaluation of Cesare and us to future generations through his own thoughts, nothing more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/031: No, I don't care about that guy anymore. What I care more about is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/002_3: Pendragon unexpectedly intervened.../40d /nWhat to do in the war with the Tur tribe... He actually sent Alondette here! Rasheed! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s3t/000: [Iscariot]/nThis is the great power of Grima, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/000: Oops...I ended up in such a strange place...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/001: Damn...the smell of sulfur is so pungent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/004: The prisoners who died in the prison will be thrown here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/005: But, what do you want me to be careful about?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/007: ...I didn't expect such a monster to live here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/008: is more than that. The Sulfur Cave of Invernor is a paradise for monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/009: Speaking of which, where is the exit?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/010: There is no other choice but to go through the sulfur cave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/012: Better be careful in the sulfur cave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/013: Also, it's too dangerous for you to do this, so don't get involved in the fight. /nLeave everything to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst01/002: Is Lee Joo Hwan an idiot?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst01/005: At this point, you should be almost experienced.../15d Before going further, it is better to accept the second stage of guidance first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/000: /2cAlso, his name is Meditch.../20d Without his help, I would still be wandering in that hell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/002: /2c At this moment, I have embarked on a journey to obtain the power Deimos mentioned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/003: /2cWhen I woke up in the cell, I seemed to be still in a dream.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/004: /2cThe pain that had tortured my body for many years not only disappeared without a trace, but the smell of sulfur seemed to stimulate my body and give me more strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/005: /2c More importantly, I think that no matter where I am or what I am doing, Deimos' soul will protect me, and my spirit is greatly supported.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro04b/000: You have to escape from here quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga10a/000: East - Nicosia Village/n South - Memphis Village
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga10a/001: Memphis, one of the targets of the attack, is nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/001: Hehe...it turns out to be this guy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/002: It's him, the idiot caught after being betrayed by his lover.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/003: I heard that his lover married another man within a month?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/004: The target is still Lord Frederick. Hehe...that woman is really not simple.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/005: Shh! What woman. /nThat is the cardinal's daughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/007: It seems that this demon priest knows nothing. Hehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/008: Miss Mercedes has long been married to Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/009: After sending his fiance to the cell, less than a week later, he proposed to another man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/010: I heard that Lord Frederick is so handsome that people fall in love with him at first sight?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/012: Speaking of which, is this guy going to be sent to the Sulfur Cave?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/013: Instead of going to that hell, it would be better to bite your tongue and commit suicide now, which would be more pleasant.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/014: No one has survived there for more than five years... Hehe.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/015: Man, there's no time for small talk now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/017: You should seriously consider my advice. Hehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/019: Hehe...it turns out to be this guy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/020: It's him, the fool who was betrayed by his lover.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/021: I heard that his lover married another man within a month?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/022: The target is still Lord Frederick. Hehe...that woman is really not simple.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/023: Shh! What woman. /nThat is the cardinal's daughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/025: It seems that this demon priest knows nothing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/026: Miss Mercedes, the cardinal's daughter, has long been married to Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/027: After sending his fiance to the cell, less than a week later, he proposed to another man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/028: And I heard that Frederick was incredibly wealthy and powerful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/029: The cardinal's daughter is nothing more than that. Tsk tsk tsk.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/031: Speaking of which, is this guy going to be sent to the Sulfur Cave?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/032: I heard that's the case. /nInstead of going to that hell, it would be better to bite your tongue and commit suicide now, which would be happier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/034: Man, there's no time for small talk now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/036: You should seriously consider my advice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/040: This... must be a mistake somewhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/041: Mercedes.../10d.../10d It's impossible for her.../10d.../10d to do this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/043: [Cyrano] /nSomeone tell me that this is not true! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/000: Did you enjoy your meal? Don't know if the food tastes good.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/001: How can it be bad if you treat me personally? We were very satisfied with our meal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/002: It's great that I can make you feel a little satisfied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/003: I think now is not the time to take a leisurely stroll, so let's forget about the politeness and talk about business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/008: Mr. Cyrano's words were sudden and seemed to put you in a difficult position, but he also wants to help Mr. Esther Dodd as soon as possible, so please feel free to speak out your troubles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/009: No, although I am a little surprised, Mr. Cyrano is right.../nYou said that, but it made me feel more relaxed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/010: Well, let me explain the issue that you are invited to come to.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/012: I am ashamed to say that our Libreville is rated as the second most livable place in the Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/013: Of course! No, it is not an exaggeration to say that this is the best place in the empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/016: The ancestors of the lords and residents reclaimed the mountainous land and built roads on the barren land, finally making this place the center of trade with Beeffrost and Curtis in the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/017: This land is the result of our hard work with our blood and sweat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/018: But... it should have been a year ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/019: There is a road leading to Curtis on the east side of the village. /nThe plateau on the north side of the road was divided into new territories and villages were built.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/020: Are you saying that the division of your territory bothers you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/021: That doesn't matter. The problem is, that little village has taken the road that is pretty much our lifeline in Libreville as its own property, openly occupying it, and starting to collect a toll tax.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/022: What a bunch of shameless guys.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/023: However, there are countless territorial disputes of this magnitude within the empire. You wouldn't ask us for help just for this matter, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/024: She seems not to have finished speaking yet. Listen again, Miss Isabele.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/025: Yes, if it was just a matter of toll tax, I would have wanted to let the lords negotiate and resolve it, but not only did the lords there refuse to show up, we also got no reply when we sent letters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/028: The people who went out to work along that road began to stop coming back to Libreville one after another.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/031: You want to say that they were kidnapped?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/032: I don't want to think about that step, but I can't just stand by and watch the villagers disappear.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/033: But why not fight them directly? Libreville is more populous and more developed, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/034: This... Our lack of power is also one of the reasons, but their village is unusual.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/036: Ah.../30d Yes...it's not just firepower...they're also using monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/037: Monster...it seems there is indeed something wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/038: A lord who refuses to show his face and drives monsters to kidnap people.../40d seems to be a lord who loves reading novels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/039: What do you want us to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/040: Of course you want me to use this gun to clean up that guy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/041: We, the Falcons of the West Wind, will never let go of those who oppress innocent people. Even without your entrustment, lord, as long as we know this matter in advance, we will not sit idly by and ignore it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/042: So, are you willing to agree to my request?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/043: Wait, are you just borrowing our power without paying any compensation?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/044: Of course I won't ask for help empty-handed, so don't worry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/045: What are you talking about? How can you make the lord spend money...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/046: As the saying goes, hospitality is hard to deny. I want to know what you have prepared, Lord Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/047: Although it's not much, I want to give a little bit of my heart. Specifically,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/048: I am willing to fund one million Eld every year, allow you to use my mansion freely, and ensure the legal status of the cadres of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/050: As expected, it is the courage that only the most outstanding lord can possess. /nWe accepted it gratefully.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/051: Not just for this incident, I have always admired the justice practiced by the Falcon of the West Wind. As long as I can help, I will do my best.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/052: Now I will pay 500,000 as a deposit, please take advantage of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/053: Thank you so much, Lord Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/054: From now on, please call me Esther, Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/056: Although it is nothing, please accept it as a little bit of my thoughts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst24/000: In this way, I have mastered some sword skills. Now on to the last lesson.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/000: I didn't expect you guys to get here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/001: Hehehe... I hired Tu'er mercenaries specifically for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/004: ...Where are the prisoners of the Falcon of the West Wind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/006: Give you one hour to release the prisoners immediately and leave this territory!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka02a/000: North - Caracas Village/nEast - Trisis Desert/nSouth - Paro Region/nWest - Pretoria Region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka02a/001: It's still a long way to Pretoria. /nReplenish weapons and supplies in the nearby village of Caracas before setting off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/001: Hehe, the nerdy look of the past is gone and he has become quite strong. /nCyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/002: I never thought you could defeat General Irus, who was once one of the Four Heavenly Kings...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/004: Cyrano, since fifteen years ago, I intuitively knew that this day would come sooner or later...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/005: Why? /nWe are obviously brothers and sisters, why did you betray me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/006: Brother...Haha, if you were not my biological brother, I would never betray you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/008: Sorry, don't you have something to do before then? /nCyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/009: I have specially prepared some toys for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/010: Have you ever heard of a machine gun? /nIt came from the east, and it was quite powerful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/012: Show me the ability to kill the Dark God.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/013: How do you know that Irus is the Dark God...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/014: Oh, it turns out you have been looking down on me so much... How disappointing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/015: Oops, the opening line is a lot longer than expected. /nBe careful, this toy is more dangerous than you think.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/016: Even the immortal body can be blasted to pieces! ! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/019: This.../5d is the path I want to take.../5d Ever since fifteen years ago.../5d I have been waiting for this day.../5d Ever since I betrayed my brother...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/021: Hehe.../3d Sure enough, you still don't know.../nWe are half-brothers.../3d We both share the blood of our father, Luke Bernstein...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/022: But my father also...died because of me. /nOver the years.../4dI have been really lonely and in pain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/023: However, I was very happy in the end. /10d can at least die in the hands of his brother, /4d can be more or less...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/025: Brother, be careful about Cesare.../5d The one who makes you fall into the trap is Cesare. /10d /nIscariot and I are both his...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/027: Cesare Borgia.../10d /nThis bloody fate with you.../10d I will end it with my own hands.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/003: My child.../15dChristina put you in a lot of trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/005: That was... a long time ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/009: She has all the qualities a monarch should have. /nSwordsmanship...eloquence...leadership...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/010: She is indeed an amazing child.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/011: That child.../10d He taught everything. From start to finish...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/014: Are you still qualified to say his name, Cyrano Bernstein!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/017: Such a good person.../10d But you are cruel...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/019: You.../15d are no longer the Cyrano I know.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/020: It's not just your appearance that has changed... /10d You are just a beast swallowed by the madness of revenge... /10d/n You are not a human at all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/021: I.../5d is afraid of you. /15d is very scared...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/022: I thought at least you.../10d would believe me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/023: Give him.../15dGive Frederick back to me...oooooooo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/028: What on earth is going on with this.../10d?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/033: I have been waiting for fifteen years... just to drink this poisonous wine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/034: Forget it...that's fine. /10d If this is fate...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/035: No! Can't drink that glass of wine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/039: Everything that has happened so far.../10d was planned by your father Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/044: Who told you that I killed Frederick! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/049: I hope this...can make all my mistakes forgiven...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/050: Mercedes...Do you have that cup too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/053: [Mercedes] /nSorry...but this is the only way I can...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/054: [Mercedes] /nIn the past fifteen years... I have only been thinking about you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/058: [Mercedes] /nBut... when I heard that you killed him... after you killed Frederick...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/060: [Mercedes] /nHe truly loves me... He loves me who has only been waiting for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/061: [Mercedes] /nSorry...for fifteen years...I've been really lonely. So... now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/062: [Mercedes] /nI too.../10dI really fell in love with him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/072: [Mercedes] /nFifteen years ago, the day you were executed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/074: [Mercedes] /nAccording to his father's words... decided to marry Lord Frederick.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/001: /2c He not only analyzed the reasons for my injustice, but also taught me a lot of knowledge such as history and logical reasoning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/002: /2c The existence of Deimos, /15d and /10d's obsession with Mercedes. /20d It's these two that have allowed me to survive this hellish life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/003: /2c However, one day one year after I met Deimos, /20d my body finally couldn't hold on any longer, and death was close at hand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/011: [Prisoner] /n He was really able to endure it, and he actually lasted four full years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/012: [Warden] /nOpen the door and go in, and get rid of the body quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/014: [Prisoner] /nThis guy... still has one breath left... /10d/nWhat should I do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/015: [Warden]/nWhat else can we do. It's too much trouble, let's deal with it immediately. /nIsn't there a new hole created by last year's earthquake?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/016: [Prisoner] /nHmm... I don't care. /n/10d Then come and help me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx14/000: Humans can surpass other living beings,/nThe most important reason is to sacrifice for others./nEven if today's choice costs you everything, don't be sad or regretful./nHuman beings are meant to live by giving to each other and sacrificing each other./nEven if I disappear today, won't there still be new life?/nThe father's will continues through the children, and the mother's love never changes./nWith sacrifice and love, humans can also gain eternity...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/002: What? The senator wants to see the Grand Duke, how dare you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/007: The Grand Duke! We need to talk.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/013: Grand Duke, what do you think of our Senate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/014: You bypassed the Senate again and increased arms spending.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/015: Do you have the consciousness of being a Grand Duke?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/017: I should have explained it clearly. /10d /nThe reason for increasing military spending is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/018: Enough! Are you going to repeat that routine again like a parrot!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/019: The real reason is that you were manipulated by that woman to increase military spending.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/024: Drag these two old men out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/027: You guys.../15d How dare you do this? Do you know who I am?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/028: If you don't retreat, we will shoot. /nThis is the final warning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/030: The Grand Duke! /nYou are making a big mistake! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/032: Those useless old men in the Senate...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/033: Take advantage of this opportunity and simply shut down the Senate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/001: So, who are you all, and why are you making such a noise in the lord's mansion?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/002: We are looking for Miss Esmeralda, who was captured by Viscount Ramon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/003: This is Sharn Hoiste, a thief who specializes in teasing evil lords. /20d There were several times before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/004: Needless to say, how about cooperating with each other in this mansion? /30d Anyway, our situation seems to be similar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/006: I have opened this door, go down quickly. /nViscount Ramon's torture chamber is below.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/008: Are you making too much noise?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/009: Oh, isn't this Miss Kana Milanovich from Zephyr Falcon? /30dNice to meet you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/002: Why is Deimos, the leader of the Dark God, underground in Inverno.../10d /nIs there any human being who can cast a dark barrier technique that is enough to seal his power?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/003: ...Human? /10d /15d /nNo, maybe not humans.../15d /nSpeaking of which, weren't there gods who survived after the Creation War.../15d?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/005: Tsk, I can't remember any more. /15d /nHowever, fortunately the jailers did not know of his existence. /15d
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/006: I have to find a chance to see him again this time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/009: Damn it ... I don't seem to have much time left./15dNo matter what.../10dWell...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/010: Tomorrow.../10d I'll go see him again tomorrow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri03/000: The road is at your feet. /n Adventurer Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/001: ....../15dSome of the poison has been removed, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/002: This poison is really powerful. /nIn the future... I'm afraid it will put a lot of burden on his body.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/003: Ah.../10d How could it become like this.../15d /nAt that time.../5d I should have stopped him no matter what...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/004: The enemies seem to have been thrown away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/007: Then, I will take my leave now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/011: .../15d sure enough still refused to answer me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/001: Ah.../10d/nUsing 20,000 people to stop 130,000 people is too forced...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/002: It's just a diversion. /nNever engage in a head-on decisive battle with the enemy. Please use the terrain of Invernor to hold back the enemy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/003: Good! /nIf this is the case, I will try my best.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/004: Timing is very important. Please cooperate with Mr. Cyrano to attack and plunge the enemy into chaos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/005: Tsk...Everyone else is fighting, only I have to watch from behind...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/006: Not so. Once the supply line is cut off, the war situation will be extremely unfavorable to our army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/007: Please remember that Mr. Rhidelhard has assumed the most important responsibility for this operation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/010: This is an important battle related to the survival of the empire. Please go all out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/011: Detailed arrangements will be informed to you later.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/012: As expected of Clausewitz. /nCan actually come up with such a battle plan...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/013: ...? /nMiss Isabele seems to have something to say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/014: You have won the prize. /nThis is just me applying it after studying the Black Prince's diagonal formation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/016: General Frederick, your speech is ready.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/001: There are rumors that the rebel village sells strange items, that is not true.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/002: You can't go in here. Mom is giving birth to my younger brother and sister.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/003: What should I do when I have younger siblings... braid my hair and put on flowery hairpins...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/004: We were kicked out of the village, and we can still sell things here only because of the Zephyr Falcon. Welcome.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/005: Hello, what are you looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/008: Thank you for purchasing my item.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/010: Don't look at me like this, there are a lot of good things. Take your time choosing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/012: Walk slowly and please take more care of business next time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/013: Oops... welcome. We have everything here except what we don't have.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/014: Thank you so much and wish you good luck on your journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/015: May blessings accompany you on your journey...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/016: This place is very special, it is a spontaneously formed rebel village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/017: As you can see, the scale is small and not very eye-catching... Neither the West Wind Falcon nor the lord paid much attention to this place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/001: The purpose of this trial is to investigate and make a verdict on the defendant Cyrano Bernstein's alleged devil worship. It is now eight o'clock and the trial has officially begun.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/002: I declare the court to be open.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/003: The church received a report from an anonymous person accusing the defendant of worshiping the devil. /nDo you admit it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/005: It was alleged that the accused had sought to study the demon ban on one of the previous months. Do you admit it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/006: Devil's Book? I don't know anything about that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/008: Please calm down./30d/nThe accused himself may not be aware of his fault.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/009: Defendant, do you know anything about the book "Secret Records of the Creation War"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/010: Yes, I know. /30d/nThat is the book I am studying recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/011: Oh my god... He actually did such a thing...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/012: "The Secret Record of the Creation War" was written by the demon Jishnay of the old empire who calls himself a sage! /30d/n Sure enough, the defendant has been studying demons!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/014: Have you studied that demonic book?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/015: That book.../15d.../15d.../15d.../15d is not a book of devil...! /20d That belongs to the sage Jishnai...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/016: It seems that the defendant undoubtedly wants to accept the devil's thoughts!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/020: Reading banned books is certainly a serious crime, but based on this alone, it cannot be concluded that he worships the devil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/021: However, we do have a key witness regarding the defendant's devil-worshipping behavior.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/023: A request was made to subpoena witnesses.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/027: He recommended that book to me, /20d advised me to learn more about demons...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/029: It seems that you have a close relationship with the defendant.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/033: He was even in the academy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/034: Conduct a ritual to worship the devil...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/001: Meditch, who is usually late, is rarely on time today. On the contrary, today's protagonists are late.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/002: You can't be late today. /30d This may be the last time I see them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/006: Well, I plan to leave now.../30d I think it's better to keep the farewell short.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/008: I really can't bear to part with it, Kana. After getting along for a long time, we have feelings for each other even though we are noisy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/009: Cyrano, don't even think about leaving us and going anywhere alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/010: You don't even want to leave me behind, do you, Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/011: I appreciate your thoughts,/30d but I plan to go to a new place where no one knows me and settle there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/012: It may be in the eastern part of the continent, or it may be an isolated island, or it may even be the Eastern Continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/013: Your efforts are finally going to be rewarded, but you have to give up everything and follow me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/014: If I wanted to live a stable life, I would not follow you in the first place. /30d For me, Mr. Cyrano is the meaning of my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/015: I have never thought about the grand meaning of life. I just want to follow you because I like Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/016: I am no longer a member of the West Wind Falcon. You have no reason to leave me, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/017: Let's all go together, Cyrano. /30d Go to a strange place where no one knows us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/018: Okay, let's go together. /30d Bury the unfortunate past in this land, hide the good memories in your heart, and leave here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/021: Every effort I make is for Cyrano. /30d I have never expected to live a stable life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr01/001: Clausewitz's treasure map reads: North - Southeast - South - Northeast - North - North - Northwest - North - Northeast.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/000: Your Majesty, how are you doing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/001: Well, long time no see. /30d And Meditch, long time no see.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/004: The leader? His Majesty? What the hell is going on?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/005: This is my grandfather, the leader of the West Wind Falcon, and the king of Pendragon - Rashid Pendragon I.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/007: The leader is the legendary holy king, Rashid? !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/009: I'm really sorry for hiding my identity all this time. My real name is Rashid Clausewitz Pendragon III, the son of the First Prince Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/010: Oh my god, so you are from Pendragon...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/011: Clausewitz, Sharn Hoiste, and now Rashid III...which one is the real you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/013: Three lives, although you handled things better than expected, you still took too many risks. /30d The same thing happened with Arondette this time. If the war on our side drags on longer than expected, how do you plan to end it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/014: Also, everyone from the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/016: You may feel uncomfortable knowing that your leader is actually the king of another country, but you have led the West Wind Falcon very well with your own strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/018: ...However, please forgive me. /30d As the king of the most powerful country on the mainland, why do you want to form such an unofficial organization to interfere in the internal affairs of other countries?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/019: Haha, she is indeed a courageous girl as rumored. However, it is indeed a legitimate question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/020: The royal airship Lin Amadeo 3 is waiting nearby. Let's go to Pendragon together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/021: It seems that we have to start talking about it a long time ago. How about setting off to Pendragon Palace first and listening slowly on the way?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/005_3: [Clausewitz]/nThis is my grandfather, the leader of the Zephyr Falcon, and the king of Pendragon - Rashid Pendragon I.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/013_3: Sir, although you handled things better than expected, you still took too many risks. /30d The same thing happened with Arondette this time. If the war on our side does not enter a truce, how do you plan to end it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/018_3: ...However, please forgive me. /30d As the king of the most powerful country on the mainland, why do you want to form such an unofficial organization to interfere in the internal affairs of other countries?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/019_3: Haha, she is indeed a courageous girl as rumored. However, it is indeed a legitimate question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/000: What Ron is most proud of is of course the army commanded by Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/001: Ron is the best city in the old empire territory. Strong military, solid economy! We are the core of the future empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/002: I heard that Gesir's cathedral was built more than ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/003: Men are all grown up children. Always pestering people and acting willfully.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/005: My husband knows about gambling every day and has never thought about looking after the shop!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/009: I saw Lord Frederick draw his lightsaber once, just once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/010: That night, I was so excited that I couldn't sleep! It's so handsome----!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/011: Do you know the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/012: Who is the thief named Sharn Hoiste? Recently I heard that he also appeared around here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/013: Now only here and Libreville are relatively livable, while the situation in the entire empire territory is terrible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/014: No one should have heard it, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/015: But my wife wants to eat me all day long, how on earth can I live like this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/016: Do you think so? A husband like me can be good anywhere!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/017: Don't let me catch you if you can. I must correct his bad habits this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/018: Hehehe... Husband and wife quarrel, quarrel at the head of the bed and then at the end of the bed. It's inevitable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/019: Seeing them quarreling like this always reminds me of when I was young...My wife was pretty good back then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/020: Heh. In fact, although this village is a military town, the women are surprisingly strong. Most men are kept submissive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/023: Hehe... But they are cute sometimes, otherwise how could they live together?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/024: The lord here is so beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/027: Uh... I'm so angry! How amazing is he and deserves to be so proud!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/028: go again? Ahhh - I really don't know why I got married in the first place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/029: If you don't keep coaxing, things will get awkward. What a high maintenance bunch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/030: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome! Our store stocks the best firearms in the country!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/032: Thank you for patronizing the firearms store Phaethon. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/033: [Mrs. Harold]/nWelcome to our shop. Our store not only sells guns, but also high-end swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/035: Thanks for patronizing Ron's pride - Phaethon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/036: We have so many good guns in our store that even Lord Frederick occasionally comes to take a look.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/037: My father is also a firearms collector. He collects some good guns that are not sold to the public.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/038: [Miss Ellen]/nWelcome. How can I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/040: Thanks for your business August. Welcome again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/041: My father went into the forest not long ago, but strangely, he has not come back since.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/042: My mother asked everywhere about my father's whereabouts, but he still didn't come back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/043: We sincerely welcome you to Ron's famous store - "Explosive Tavern"!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/044: What our store is most proud of is the strongest wine "Rud" in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/045: The "Rudd" here is really strong. Want to try it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/046: Ron's men were all soldiers in Frederick's army. Each of us is an elite soldier worth one hundred.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/047: The most livable place in the world is not Libreville, but our Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/048: Have you ever entered the arena here? We often measure a person's courage by how long he can last in the arena.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/049: Cowards are a disgrace to Ron. We are all soldiers ready to die on the battlefield.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/050: [Mr. Jeff]/nWelcome, welcome to the proud Ron. The accommodation fee in this hotel is 110 Elder. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/051: Thank you for your patronage and wish you a restful night. May God bless your night!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/052: Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/053: Thank you for your patronage and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/054: I am a mercenary. However, I have had enough of the wandering life, so I want to settle here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/055: I think that by joining Ron's powerful army, I can give full play to the skills I have developed as a mercenary.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/056: Aren't the two most suitable places to live in Libreville and Ron? I also came here to settle here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/057: Gasir City? The danger there lurks in the shadows. On the contrary, it is more dangerous than other villages and towns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/058: In our arena, there are many instructors who are physically strong and powerful. Go in and give it a try!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/059: Men come to our arena to exercise strength, which is most helpful for actual combat. Of course.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/060: [Winnie]/nWelcome. My parents went out arguing again, but will be back soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/062: My parents are not here, so I am not sure about the price. sorry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/063: If you want to fulfill your responsibilities as a citizen, go and receive practical training!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/064: Sorry, guest. You can't come in from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/065: Sorry, guest. You cannot enter from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/066: Guests, you can't go in there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/067: Sorry, guest. You can't come in from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/068: Hey, come and catch me! If you catch me, I'll give you something good!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/069: Hmph! You want to catch me like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/070: Arena "Actual Assault Martial Arts Training Hall"
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/072: You have a membership card? Please come in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/073: The battlefield where Al is located is the most brutal place in all war zones. Awen had an ominous premonition in her heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/074: When Awen came to Al's unit, Al was not among the people who greeted her warmly. Awen asked: "Where is Al?" One of his comrades replied: "He was captured in the last battle."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/075: Since then, gems that have never been seen before occasionally appear in the lake. That's the Chaos Cube.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/076: Hearing that Al had fallen into the hands of a cruel enemy, Awen could not wait any longer. She sneaked into the enemy's castle and began to search for Al's whereabouts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/077: Awen learned that the captured prisoners were hung on the cliffs of Mount Creon until they died. She ran to the bottom of the cliff in one breath and knocked down the guard, but the guard had already destroyed the ladder leading to the top of the cliff. More enemy troops soon began to rush towards the cliff, but Awen could not find a way to climb onto the cliff.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/078: The story is almost over... The next part will be told to you by someone who lives in the west.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/079: Grandpa died fighting the Silver Arrow. I heard that he is a soldier in the army directly under the Black Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/080: When I grow up, I will also become a brave soldier and teach those who underestimate our empire a lesson. Just wait and see.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/081: The Empire must unite. The Silver Arrow's power has been greatly weakened by the war with the Tour Empire, and now is the best time to restore the empire to its former glory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/082: Moreover, if we are not united, once the Silver Arrow is eliminated by the Tour Empire, our territory will be ravaged next.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/083: The core of this alliance should of course be our Ron. We are the real strong ones in the empire, aren't we?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/084: Welcome. It seems like this is your first time coming to our tavern... The most famous thing we have here is "Rudd", the strongest liquor in the empire. Want to try it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/089: Uh...this wine is really strong.../20d head...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/090: This...is this...? Ah, after drinking that glass of wine, I lost consciousness?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/091: Don't you want to take a break?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/095: I am you. Another you in your heart. But...have you gone too far lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/097: Why are you running around like this? What is more important than me? Can't you take a break?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/098: Let things develop on their own, let's take a break. Okay? In a place as warm as a dream, as safe as a mother's arms, enjoy eternal peace as if you were dead...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/099:
? Isn't this my own voice...
What to do with
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/100: Follow the voice's advice and rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/101: No! I still have a lot of things to do!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/102: The most important thing for a man is to exercise first and secondly! Don't neglect training your body! I have a relative who is a soldier in Gesil City, and he is the best at running!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/103: Ron City. Prices are slightly higher and it was a stable city under the rule of the famous military lord Frederick. The symmetrical urban layout reflects the strictness of the military city; the defense line composed of bridges and moats has the best defense capabilities in the empire. The soldiers in the city are also known as the most elite troops in the empire. High-end firearms can be purchased here, and the north exit leads to Bordeaux. When heading to Bordeaux, you need to pass through the Magic Sword Forest where the magic sword is rumored to be hidden. A legendary sword is also said to be hidden in a cave in the nearby Ron Mountain. /n----The Imperial Geographical Society under the Geysir Academy----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/104: In order to survive in battle, you should prepare as many high-end weapons and equipment as possible. The principle of expensiveness has always been true at home and abroad. Having the best equipment and becoming the best warrior is the shortcut to surviving in troubled times. /n----Tactics Research Association under Geisir Academy----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/105: Next, you will enter an era of war. The surging destiny will no longer give you the time to look back at yourself. While you still have the opportunity to prepare, please make all arrangements for the coming day. /n----The last words left to someone by Ron's deceased prophet old woman----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/106: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThe underground labyrinth is too dangerous. It is an unknown place that our Geographical Society has never set foot in. If you want to survive there, you have to draw a map as you move forward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/107: [Member of the Geographical Society]/n If you walk along the edge, you will encounter fewer enemies. You don't know this eternal truth, right? If you enter the maze and draw a map, please give us a copy for posterity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/108: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nDon't forget, the safety of the entire Gesir Traveler is in your hands! The address is: "Director of the Cartography Bureau of the Geographic Research Society under the Geysir Imperial Academy, No. 23, Steiner Street, Geysir City, Geysir Territory", that's it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/109: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nAh, you...! You've been to Thunder Nightmare Cave in Libreville! Oh... that dangerous cave has claimed the lives of many of our members! You must have drawn a map? Please, tell me the terrain there!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/110: The terrain of the cave...? It's been a long time since I've been there, and my memory is a little fuzzy...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/111: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nProbably. Please, tell me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/113: Take the time to help map.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/115: Okay, I'll help you draw the map from memory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/116: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThank you, thank you so much!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/117: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThank you very much. All members of the Geographical Society will never forget this kindness!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/118: [Member of the Geographic Society]/nPlease... tell me the map of the cave. I will definitely thank you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/120: What should we do? We already accepted his Silver Gem. Should we tell him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/123: He has asked for this... just agree.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/124: Really, thank you so much! From now on, your name will forever be recorded in the history of our Imperial Geographical Society!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/125: Sigh... When Inverno collapsed, we all lost our jobs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/126: I can still do odd jobs in the arena, I wonder what happened to the other guys...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/127: Hehehe... Do you want to compete with me?
