Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/037_3: My father also collects firearms himself, and often collects some good guns that he doesn't usually sell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/050_3: [Mr. Jeff]/nWelcome, welcome to Ron we are proud of. Staying in our hotel costs 110 Gold. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/051_3: Thank you. Have a good night's sleep.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/053_3: Thank you for your patronage. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/058_3: There are many monsters in our arena.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/062_3: My parents are not here, so I am not sure about the price. sorry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/000: Are you, as this sentence says, confused by appearances and unable to see the truth? People always scold the church, but this is not the case.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the chief hero of the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/002: The ruins of the Bernstein family next to it have been unoccupied for ten years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/003: Learn to look at everything from a different perspective.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/005: A strange cloud hangs over you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/006: Hey, that uncle looks like a person I met ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/007: Thieves have been rampant in the desert recently. As a result, I almost died several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/008: People who live in hot places mostly have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/010: That was the place where the whole family was killed. Who dares to go in and live there?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/011: I heard that there are strange swords stuck in the forests and mountains near Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared in this area...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/013: You can enter Ron by walking south from Gesir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/014: I heard that the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe has temporarily subsided recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/015: In Nicosia, the church is very powerful. This has always been the case.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/016: I am on a secret mission.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/017: I can remember 10 years ago because of the ability acquired in the recent aftermath of a head impact.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/019: The people there have obviously suffered a lot, but they still follow the church. It is simply incredible. Why is this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/023: Do you know the musician Mr. Nikacha? He was popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/024: All that glitters is not gold. This quote is from one of my favorite books.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/026: My engagement was broken off not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/027: Just because someone among my relatives was falsely accused of being a witch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/029: The church seems to be making a lot of money by doing nothing. What did they create?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/030: I have a relative who lives in Caracas and I heard that life is very difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/031: No one can truly see the truth. What people see is only the truth in their own eyes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/032: Gasil City, the center of the church territory, is peaceful, and criticism of the church is relatively free, but is this really the truth?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/033: There is a strong sense of uneasiness and ominousness inside. What will happen...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/034: Let me tell you something. Even in this city of Gesir, the church has surveillance eyes everywhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/035: This place seems very free at first glance, but in fact you have to be careful about what you say and do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/036: The singer named Sharon seems to be very popular.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/037: My son is her fan. I saw her around here not long ago. She probably went south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/038: Sharon, Sharon. Ah, Sharon is my idol!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/039: Just seeing her not long ago, I...oooooo...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/041: No one knows that the power of the church has already secretly controlled this place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/042: Not long ago, a friend of mine suddenly disappeared.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/043: He often makes remarks against the church...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/044: I heard my mother talk about Cardinal Cesare's wife.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/045: It seems that she died unjustly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/046: My mother and Cardinal Cesare were once very close.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/047: They seemed to have known each other for a long time, but she never spoke in detail.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/048: I did have orders to kill someone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/049: But ever since I injured my head in that accident, I couldn't remember who to kill.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/051: Welcome. This is the best tavern in Gesil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/052: That strange assassin fell into the river a few days ago, and I rescued him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/053: For the glory of Gesir's prosperity!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/054: It's up to Lord Cesare to do that, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/055: However, there is something wrong with Ron's Lord Frederick's attitude...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/056: Wow...my friend actually stole my boyfriend...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/058: Hmph... He just liked me, so he chose me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/059: It makes no sense to say that I stole my friend's boyfriend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/060: Please... don't mention those two women. My head hurts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/061: They all said I was theirs...it made me upset.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/062: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/063: Bernstein Mansion - This building was once the residence of the Bernstein family, lords of Geysir City. The architecture combines classical style with modern flavor, is gorgeous and grand, and is a typical lord's residence. It is now uninhabited. It would have been eligible to be listed as a historic site, but when the Bernstein family fell, they were accused of colluding with the devil, so it was not allowed to be listed as a historical site, and it was completely unprotected.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/065: The son was tortured for worshiping the devil, and the father died in a duel with Lord Frederick... The ending of the Bernstein family was really tragic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/066: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nWhen fighting the enemy, pay special attention to the conflicting relationship between the enemy's attributes. Especially when we use weapons with attributes or cast magic, we must carefully observe the enemy's appearance, combine it with past experience, and remember the conflicting relationship between the enemy's attributes before launching an attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/067: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nWhen encountering a monster you have never seen before, understanding its characteristics first will help to advance the game smoothly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/001: [Falcon Archer of the West Wind]/nThe front has been confirmed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/003: Okay, now that we have successfully infiltrated, let's group them according to plan here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/004: Louis and Boles joined me while the others went upstairs to plant the explosives at the predetermined location.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/005: Well, I hope everyone can arrive at the meeting place safely.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/006: For the revival of the empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/007: I heard that our companions are imprisoned in the dungeon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/008: Come on, take this place quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/010: I didn't expect Bifrost to occupy Invernor...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/011: [Commander] /nThe reason is simple, because Invernor is the bridge connecting Bifrost and the Empire's territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/012: [Commander]/nThe Archduke plans to use Invernor as a forward base for attacking the Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/013: [Commander] /nSpeaking of which, I heard that you are stronger than Valkyrie Captain Katarina?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/014: [Commander] /nIt seems that the swordsmanship is very good, but what will happen when facing magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/017: [Commander] /nYour defeat of Catalina.../10d was not.../10d a fluke.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/018: ...The next step is just to deal with the remaining enemies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/020: I don't know if the other teams... also completed the mission successfully.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/022: Each team has completed its mission. /nInvernor has been occupied by Zephyr Falcon and Frederick's army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/023: Okay, now we just have to wait for Catalina's troops.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/000: This is... the fire dragon...? /n is sealed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/001: The sword light shakes the world,/nThe dragon flame purifies the soul. /n/nKars, seal the dragon here. /nThe year 1205 of the Esghar calendar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/002: Also.../10dWho would erect a stone monument in a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/006: The fire dragon is sealed here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme04/000: No civilians are allowed to enter here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme04/001: Leave while I can still talk!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/002: It's time to officially announce the engagement. /15d /nAre you all ready?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/003: At this time, where did Ruben go? /nI won't come to help you either...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/007: Looking at you now, I think of your mother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/009: Even though I haven't actually married my daughter off yet, I already feel so empty...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/010: Hehe... It seems that I am really old.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/012: Hehe, Lord Cardinal, you are really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/013: By order of the church group! /20dCyrano Bernstein is suspected of devil worship and has been prosecuted. Now in accordance with the summons, I am required to go to the court immediately!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/015: You, what did you just say? Who was prosecuted for alleged devil worship?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/016: Mr. Bernstein, your son is suspected of devil worship and has been prosecuted. The church group has issued a summons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmat01/001: According to intelligence, Machiavelli was preparing to pass through Antananarivo and climb over the Mantegoa Mountains.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst15/000: I have come all the way here, but I don't know if I have practiced enough. /15d However, before going further, it is better to accept the guidance of the third stage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/000: How long do you have to endure it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/002: I said, how long will our West Wind Falcon keep that kind of murderous maniac?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/003: Could you be... talking about Cyrano, brother Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/004: Who else could he be? Are there any other murderers among us? /20d If you continue to let that guy do whatever you want, the reputation of the West Wind Falcon will be ruined sooner or later!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/005: Mr. Cyrano is suspected of killing the lord and his wife who were loved by the citizens. This is indeed detrimental to us, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/006: Knowing that this is a frame-up, do you still want to hold him accountable, Mr. Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/007: is a frame-up, who knows! /20dAlso, I don't want Zephyr Falcon's reputation to be tarnished.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/008: Brother Meditch, /10d When did you start to care about this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/009: And.../30dCyrano.../25d Even Silver has been lost.../30d But.../20d You still...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/013: Meditch's idea, I completely understand. I can't stay in the Zephyr Falcon any longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/014: There is not much time left for me now. /40d Before the remaining time comes to an end, I want to completely settle all the grudges between me and Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/015: I must see him this time and put an end to everything.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/016: Mr. Meditch, I will lead the troops to Geysir Cathedral to support Mr. Cyrano. /50dWhat are you going to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/018: ....../20dI stay here. /30d Rather than act with that kind of person, I would rather quit the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/019: Sorry, Mr. Meditch. /20d I just hope you won't regret saying this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/021: What are you saying, Miss Kana? /20dWasn't Cyrano himself responsible for Captain Silver's death?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/022: Cyrano is our companion. /20d Brother, do you think reputation is more important than companions?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/024: Teacher Clausewitz has gone too far.../20d Isn't it just because of his power that you are so unwilling to lose Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/025: How can you scheme against people like this? /20d Do you think you are qualified to accuse Mr. Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/000: It seems to be locked here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/001: We must rescue Miss Esmeralda who is locked up in the dungeon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/003: Is this Ramon's mansion? The /n/15d structure is a bit strange.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/004: Okay, hurry up and find Esmeralda.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/000: /2c Falcon of the West Wind. War meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/001: Chris... No, Miss Christina inherited General Frederick's position and became the supreme commander, and,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/003: Just now, they declared war on our West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/004: It is said that they will invest in the first-level magical machine, Ascalon, which was successfully discovered not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/006: As you all know, the Frederick Army is the strongest elite force in the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/007: Besides, few people understand the Zephyr Falcon as well as Miss Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/008: Hmm... In other words, as long as Christina is determined, she can easily capture the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/009: Therefore, I plan to attack Gesir City, the base of the Lord God's Cult, the force behind Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/010: Directly attack the Lord God's Religion...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/011: As long as they capture their strongholds - the Imperial Academy and the Cathedral, they will be able to severely damage the forces of the Lord God and Christina at the same time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/013: Then, please go to Gesil City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/014: Everyone, this may be the last battle of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/015: The success or failure of this operation is related to the survival of Bifrost, the Church Alliance, and the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/016: Please fight with all your strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/017: After the death of General Frederick, the war situation changed dramatically.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/019: The content is very simple. /n"If you don't want the entire army to be annihilated, surrender unconditionally."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/023: Do you want to open the drawer?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/024: So curious. Sorry, please open it a little and take a look.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/031: ...Let's put it back where it belongs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/032: There seems to be something precious inside.../10d/nCan't just open it while he's not around.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/033: Hmm...? /nThere is something on the ground...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/036: I didn't expect to fight with Christina...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/037: There is a lot of interesting information in the Imperial Academy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/038: I don't want to fight a woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/040: I saw Kana's expression changed drastically and she ran out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/044: Everyone... seems to have something wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/001: Then, please ask Mr. Cyrano to go to Antananarivo and investigate the lord's mansion there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/002: Everyone else seems to have gone out? /20d Haven't seen them since morning...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/003: Ah, Mr. Rhidelhard and Miss Isabele went to scout the eastern road.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/004: Miss Kana said she felt unwell and never left the room. /30d I said I wanted to take a look for her, but she...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/005: Are you afraid of the lord who drives the monster? /20d What kind of illness are you pretending to be?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/006: Stop talking nonsense and head to your destination quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/008: Clausewitz, you said that the strange lord's territory is on the plateau behind the mountains in the northeast, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/009: Yes, it's a village just northeast of here, almost bordering Bifrost. /20d destination is Antananarivo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/010: According to my investigation, the entire territory has been fortified, so be careful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/000: This is Dhakama Port, the trading port of the Great Pendragon Kingdom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/001: Foreigners like you may not be able to enter the city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/002: I hope you won't encounter pirates or storms on this voyage...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/004: I heard that you can take a boat to Dhakama here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/006: [Captain]/nYes. However, the recent route to Dhakama has been very dangerous, so we have postponed our voyage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/008: [Captain]/nThat's right. Now even we ourselves don't know when we will be able to sail.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/000_2: This is Dhakama Port, the trading port of the Great Pendragon Kingdom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/000_3: This is Dhakama Port, the trading port of the Great Pendragon Kingdom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/001: It's not because he helped the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/002: Damn it, they can't handle the West Wind!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/003: Shh! What should I do if people can hear me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/004: Sigh... It would be great if the Falcon of the West Wind could also come to our village...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/005: The Falcon of the West Wind...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/006: The Falcon of the West Wind.../30d is a rebel group that started operating in the empire's territory a few years ago. It seems to have become more and more famous recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/007: I seem to have heard of it somewhere...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/008: Duke Reuben has arrived! Everyone is silent!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/014: Stupid guy, how dare you believe in the devil and collude with the rebels...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/015: This heinous crime cannot be condoned. The death penalty must be imposed to let you know the majesty of the national law.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/016: The preparations for the burning ceremony have been completed, Lord Duke Ruben.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/017: Okay, now, Silver. A frontal breakthrough!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/018: Not yet. /30d When the burning begins, the guy completely relaxes his vigilance before taking action.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/019: That guy is not that easy to deal with.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/022: The evil lord who oppresses innocent people, Duke Reuben! /10d/nThe Falcon of the West Wind is here to punish you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/023: is the Falcon of the West Wind!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/025: Falcon of the West Wind, save us! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/026: What are you still doing? ! Stop them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/027: Oh my God, it's that girl again?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/028: If you don't take action, Ruben will run away. Catch him quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/029: /2c the next day. The place of execution.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/000: It didn't take long for the frog to come to our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the chief hero of the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/002: Hehehe... I've been to Gesir before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/003: If you always bully frogs, you will be punished.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/005: I went to a friend's wedding.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/006: Occasionally, strange sounds can be heard in the nearby forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/010: Gasir City is indeed the capital of the past and is very beautiful. But the people there always give people a feeling of being repressed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/011: Do you/10d know the sword left by General Kars?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/013: Someone saw a strange sword in the forest near our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/014: I heard that the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe has recently reached a stalemate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/015: Since the death of His Majesty the Black Prince, the inheritance of the imperial family has actually been discontinued.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/016: I heard that the Tur people's science and technology are beyond imagination.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/017: The sound in the nearby forest was humming... and like the sound of wind passing through blades of grass.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/019: I remember it was very different from Ron... it was a weird place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/021: My friends and I have also been to the place where the sound came from in the forest, but the strange thing is that there is nothing there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/023: Do you know the musician Mr. Nikacha? He was popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/024: Most people in our village are devout believers in the Lord's Religion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/026: Hello, welcome to the Bordeaux Hotel. Accommodation costs are 100 Eld. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/027: Thank you very much, please have a good rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/028: Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/029: Thank you very much. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/030: Miss Lucia? What a weird family. How could a family be so alienated from each other? /20d I always feel something is not right...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/031: People have two opinions about Rukia's family. /20d One said they were just family members who had a bad relationship, and the other said they were not a real family at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/032: I don't think they are a real family. The most obvious thing is that I have never seen Lucia and his wife holding hands outside!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/033: Does the empire have no power to replace the royal family in the past? How can the empire rise again if this continues!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/034: Sorry, I seem to be too excited.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/035: See the talking frog in the corner of the tavern?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/036: When it first arrived, everyone in the village gathered around and tried to drive it away. /30d is a monster after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/037: But who would have thought that frogs can actually talk! It made its experience so miserable, so we didn't chase it away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/038: I agree with the other view that Rukia's family is just slightly abnormal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/039: People have a strange habit of either ignoring or rejecting things that they cannot understand. Rukia's family is just a little weird.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/040: It is said that as long as Master Kars pulls out that sword, even the monsters who know no fear will tremble with fear from the murderous aura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/041: Just having a good sword does not mean that you are a good swordsman, but Lord Kars's sword will definitely be of great help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/042: He is a man. I kept thinking about him, but to him, I was just an ordinary childhood sweetheart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/045: I am traveling for knight training. During the journey, I must get General Kars's hell-killing sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/046: I heard that the sword was nearby, so I hurried over. /30d Although the Asura of the Black Prince on Storm Island was taken away by a weirdo, /10d this one is not enough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/047: How about you come and help me too? /10d When I get the sword, I will be rewarded heavily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/048: Have you ever spoken to that kid who lives in there?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/049: Why do you talk like that at such a young age? /20d Oops.../10d So arrogant.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/050: I don't know what kind of remarkable family descendant he is... He actually asked me: "Are you a woman who serves people?" Ugh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/051: Heh, are you also planning on using General Kars's hell-killing sword?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/052: The sword is waiting for me. Only I, who inherits the blood of General Kars's family, am qualified to own it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/053: Even if you call it, I'm afraid it won't pay attention to you. /20d Hahaha! /10d Stop dreaming and go look elsewhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/055: The hot topics in the village recently are the new Lucia family and the sword of General Kars that is suddenly being sought by many people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/057: Are you also looking for the magic sword?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/058: Quack. There's a curse wrapped around that sword. Gua.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/060: I have been waiting for him for three years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/061: He said he would come back when the snow falls in the spring.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/062: We are the Rukia family that everyone is talking about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/063: We are not as weird as the rumors say. Just coming from a place with a different culture than here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/064: The people in this village are really strange. Why do you have so much to say about other people's lives?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/065: When we moved to the country, we had somewhat expected this kind of thing...but it was too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/066: What did our parents do to deserve being scolded like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/067: The people in this village are quite weird... Their devout belief in the Lord God's Religion is so abnormal that it makes people care.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/068: Is there any conspiracy hidden here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/069: What does this wine taste like? It's different from other wines!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/070: Is there something wrong with my sense of taste recently? It's really hard to eat anything...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/071: [Grandpa Jack]/nHehehe...Welcome to my store. Looking for something?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/073: Hehehe...walk slowly. Hope to see you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/077: It's so annoying, don't come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/088: The frog living in our village tavern always feels a little strange.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/091: [Benson]/nAh...I have collected a lot of weapons from everywhere...I have been short of money recently, so I took them out and sold some. Want to pick and choose?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/093: These are all fine products that I have spent decades collecting...you can rest assured of their quality.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga01a/001: << Gesil City >>/nStarting from here is Gesil, the largest city in the empire.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/000: Did you enjoy your meal? Don't know if the food tastes good.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/001: How can it be bad if you treat me personally? We were very satisfied with our meal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/002: It's great that I can make you feel a little satisfied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/003: I think now is not the time to take a leisurely stroll, so let's forget about the politeness and talk about business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/008: Mr. Cyrano's words were sudden and seemed to put you in a difficult position, but he also wants to help Mr. Esther Dodd as soon as possible, so please feel free to speak out your troubles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/009: No, although I am a little surprised, Mr. Cyrano is right.../nYou said that, but it made me feel more relaxed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/010: Well, let me explain the issue that you are invited to come to.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/012: I am ashamed to say that our Libreville is rated as the second most livable place in the Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/013: Of course! No, it is not an exaggeration to say that this is the best place in the empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/016: The ancestors of the lords and residents reclaimed the mountainous land and built roads on the barren land, finally making this place the center of trade with Beeffrost and Curtis in the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/017: This land is the result of our hard work with our blood and sweat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/018: But... it should have been a year ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/019: There is a road leading to Curtis on the east side of the village. /nThe plateau on the north side of the road was divided into new territories and villages were built.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/020: Are you saying that the division of your territory bothers you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/021: That doesn't matter. The problem is, that little village has taken the road that is pretty much our lifeline in Libreville as its own property, openly occupying it, and starting to collect a toll tax.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/022: What a bunch of shameless guys.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/023: However, there are countless territorial disputes of this magnitude within the empire. You wouldn't ask us for help just for this matter, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/024: She seems not to have finished speaking yet. Listen again, Miss Isabele.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/025: Yes, if it was just a matter of toll tax, I would have wanted to let the lords negotiate and resolve it, but not only did the lords there refuse to show up, we also got no reply when we sent letters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/028: The people who went out to work along that road began to stop coming back to Libreville one after another.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/031: You want to say that they were kidnapped?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/032: I don't want to think about that step, but I can't just stand by and watch the villagers disappear.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/033: But why not fight them directly? Libreville is more populous and more developed, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/034: This... Our lack of power is also one of the reasons, but their village is unusual.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/036: Ah.../30d Yes...it's not just firepower...they're also using monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/037: Monster...it seems there is indeed something wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/038: A lord who refuses to show his face and drives monsters to kidnap people.../40d seems to be a lord who loves reading novels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/039: What do you want us to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/040: Of course you want me to use this gun to clean up that guy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/041: We, the Falcons of the West Wind, will never let go of those who oppress innocent people. Even without your entrustment, lord, as long as we know this matter in advance, we will not sit idly by and ignore it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/042: So, are you willing to agree to my request?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/043: Wait, are you just borrowing our power without paying any compensation?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/044: Of course I won't ask for help empty-handed, so don't worry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/045: What are you talking about? How can you make the lord spend money...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/046: As the saying goes, hospitality is hard to deny. I want to know what you have prepared, Lord Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/047: Although it's not much, I want to give a little bit of my heart. Specifically,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/048: I am willing to fund one million Eld every year, allow you to use my mansion freely, and ensure the legal status of the cadres of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/050: As expected, it is the courage that only the most outstanding lord can possess. /nWe accepted it gratefully.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/051: Not just for this incident, I have always admired the justice practiced by the Falcon of the West Wind. As long as I can help, I will do my best.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/052: Now I will pay 500,000 as a deposit, please take advantage of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/053: Thank you so much, Lord Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/054: From now on, please call me Esther, Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/056: Although it is nothing, please accept it as a little bit of my thoughts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/060: Why did Frederick's messengers look for the Falcon of the West Wind...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/061: The Bifrost Army seems to have begun invading the Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/063: No way...the neutral country Bifrost actually...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/064: There was some foreshadowing of this, right? /nBifrost has been expanding its armaments for more than a day or two.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/065: Of course. /nHowever, the current situation is still a bit delicate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/066: It seems that Machiavelli, who went as an emissary, had a great influence on this matter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/067: If I had killed that guy then, this wouldn't have happened/10d... It's all your responsibility, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/068: What does this matter have to do with Frederick's messenger?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/069: Frederick plans to go to war with Bifrost. /nSo he asked the West Wind Falcon for cooperation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/070: is indeed an amazing person. /n actually asked the enemy to fight side by side...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/073: We cannot allow external forces to intervene. /nFrom the empire's standpoint, this is undoubtedly an act of aggression.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/074: What do you think? /nDoes anyone have a different opinion?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/076: We can't let Bifrost's gang take away the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/078: Who here would object? Come on, defeat the Bifrost gang! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/079: ...Then, it will be regarded as unanimous approval.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/080: How many troops does Bifrost's army have?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/081: It is said to be about two hundred thousand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/082: Two hundred thousand... What an astonishing number.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/083: Yes. Even if they join forces with Frederick's Army, the Imperial Army will only have about 130,000 troops and cannot compete with them in terms of scale.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/085: There is only defense and surprise.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/086: I plan to recapture Invernor, which is a natural fortress, and use it as a defensive fortress.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/088: General Frederick seemed to have the same idea.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/090: Okay, attack at dawn tomorrow. /nUntil then, please have a good rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/091: Ah, and we got a new batch of swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/092: PS-7 "Blitz", are you all familiar with it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/094: That's right. /nIt is one of Pendragon's standard swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/095: Pendragon's standard sword is strictly prohibited from exporting abroad... Besides, Blitz is one of the top models.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/096: Well...it's just a little bit better luck. /nAnyway, please let Mr. Cyrano and Mr. Meditch use this sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/097: Yes, it is the latest model of the Pendragon standard sword PS (Pendragon's Sword) series.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/098: Not to mention its power, the most important thing is that it is light and easy to repair, making it a very practical sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/000: This is the God of Destruction...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/002: Don't worry about Christina. Anyone standing in front of me will only die!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/003: Success! ! All its offensive parts have been destroyed!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/009: As expected...can't we destroy it without touching Christina at the core...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/010: It seems there is no other way.../40d The time spent with everyone.../30d I will never forget...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/000: If you want to advance to the next lesson, your practice is not enough. Let's go for a walk further afield.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/001: Go to a farther place to practice. The further away from here, the deeper the cultivation will be.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/002: /2c After that, I spent more than a year learning Pendragon swordsmanship from her. /30d Ioline Pendragon is an outstanding swordsman in the world. She taught me the swordsmanship of the kingdom, and I also learned many magic and skills.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/003: Are you tired? Come inside and rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/004: Sleep well, it's not good to push yourself too hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/007: I have already told the children in the house to go in and rest when they are tired.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/009: How do you use the rapier? Is it still comfortable?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/010: The attack power is indeed very strong, but it is too easy to damage and it broke after a short time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/011: Yes, that's precisely because of the "breakthrough".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/013: When an enemy attacks, the defender will instinctively want to block the attack. Of course, no one in the world can block all the enemy's attacks 100%, but let's assume this for now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/014: In this case, the enemy's attack is first blocked by the defender's weapon. In other words, weapons are the first barrier against enemy attacks. However, like everything in the world, which side is stronger here determines the outcome.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/015: So, is it the same reason that the sword will break?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/016: That's right. When the attack power is greater than the upper limit of the defender's weapon, the weapon will be damaged, and the defender will suffer damage equal to the attack power minus the defense power of his own weapon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/017: An enemy attack that crosses the line of defense of a defender's weapon is said to be "breached." When the weapon is breached, the weapon's HP will be reduced by 1. If the weapon's HP drops to 0, the weapon will be destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/018: The rapier maximizes the attack power, but the upper limit of the weapon's endurance is extremely low, and most weapons only have 1 or 2 HP. That's why it breaks so easily in battle. Of course, weapons can be repaired as long as they haven't been destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/019: So, the rapier has no use in actual combat?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/020: No, the rapier is mainly used for long-distance attacks and can effectively hit the enemy. Especially when multiple people are fighting side by side, it is very suitable as a weapon for division of labor. However, I don't think it's suitable when one person is facing multiple enemies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/021: Do you understand this concept? Then go into actual combat and experience the knowledge you just learned firsthand. This time we have to go further than before. Ah, the next lesson will cover the epee, the opposite of the rapier, and will also teach you more advanced defensive techniques.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/027: You have mastered swordsmanship above the intermediate level. Next, we will comprehensively organize the theory of epee and defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/028: When I just explained the concept of breakthrough, I assumed that "the defender can block the attacker's attack 100%." But in actual combat, it is impossible to block every enemy attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/029: Yeah, I couldn't block all the attacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/030: can block depends on the type of weapon used and the agility of the defender. The rapier itself is not suitable for blocking, so many attacks cannot be blocked; the characteristics of the heavy sword can increase the probability of blocking enemy attacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/031: In addition, there is the concept of defense power. When blocking an enemy's attack, the weapon's characteristics will reduce the enemy's attack power by a certain percentage. Rapiers have low defense, while heavy swords have high defense. Therefore, even if the upper limit of resistance is the same, when blocking the same attack, using a heavy sword will usually take a lot less damage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/032: So, is it wiser to use an epee?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/033: That's about it. Of course, swords are not just rapiers and heavy swords. However, when the swordsman has a lower level, must deal with multiple enemies alone, or fights in a narrow space, using a heavy sword can improve the chance of survival.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/034: Now explain the defensive stance. It is quite useful when the enemy is focused on attacking and needs to wait for friendly assistance or to attract the enemy's attention. By adopting a defensive stance, the chance of blocking an enemy attack is doubled. If you have an epee in your hand, a defensive stance may save your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/036: It's almost over. Shall we go to the cave this time? Think about what you just learned. Use this sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/038: This is the most basic heavy sword, but it is enough to block the attacks of those guys in the cave on the island. The next lesson will explain the tactics required when fighting alongside companions, as well as weapon switching.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/040: It seems that you have some confidence in fighting alone. However, war is a battle between many people. From now on, you will also fight side by side with your companions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/041: When fighting with companions, division of labor is important. First, let your companion with the heavy sword rush into the enemy's formation, block the enemy's attack while attracting their attention, and create attack opportunities for other friendly forces.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/042: At the same time, let companions holding rapiers or high-attack swords, as well as companions using magic, firearms and other weapons, attack the enemies attracted by the companions in front from the rear, killing them all in one fell swoop.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/043: Isn't it dangerous for the person rushing in front?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/044: In fact, the defensive power of the epee is quite high. As long as the enemy does not have overwhelming strength, it will not be too dangerous. However, it is difficult to damage the enemy with a heavy sword, so to "win" the battle, you need the help of your companions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/046: Next is the equipment switch. You should know that you can carry two pieces of assistive equipment in addition to your hands. In combat, hand-held weapons and auxiliary equipment are exchanged. It is usually intended as a "back-up" in the event of a weapon damage, but it is useful to use this as a tool for multi-person cooperation even when fighting alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/047: Does it mean using two or more weapons with different characteristics at the same time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/049: That's right. Normally, he carries both a heavy sword and a rapier. When there are few enemies or the distance is far enough, he uses the rapier. When he needs to get close to the enemy, he switches to the heavy sword. It is a very practical method to still be able to move and attack after changing swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/050: Especially the rapier, which is very suitable for finishing after the enemy has been suppressed to a certain extent. Don't forget, too, that when using a heavy sword, magic may be more effective than sword-swinging attacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/051: The explanation of general attacks has ended. In the end, only the ultimate skill of swordsmanship is left. Make good use of your special moves, and you will find that no matter how strong the enemy is, they are no match for you. Let's go deeper into the cave this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/053:
, are you ready to start learning?
How about
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/055: So, starting from today, I will explain the tactics to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/056: My teaching alone cannot solve all problems, but theory cannot be ignored.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/057: First briefly explain the classification of weapons such as swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/058: Swords can be divided into rapiers, heavy swords, long swords and broadswords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/059: The rapier is a light and sharp slender sword; the epee is relatively short and thick; the long sword is the most common long sword; the broadsword, as the name suggests, is a large sword that is long and wide.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/060: The easiest to use is naturally the ordinary long sword, but from a tactical point of view, the rapier and the heavy sword are more important.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/061: As long as the conditions for use are met, the great sword is the strongest sword. However, a good sword is not easy to come by.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/062: The reason why rapiers and epees are tactically important is that they each have their own strengths: /15d Rapiers are good at offense, and epees are good at defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/063: For the classification of swords, it is enough to master these basics first. I will explain the usage of rapier and epee in detail later. Now let's learn a few more things to pay attention to in actual combat. That's it for today's lesson.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/064: First, always pay attention to the distance and direction from the enemy. /15d This applies not only to swordsmanship, but to any fighting style.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/065: Always pay attention to the distance from your opponent and do not expose your back to the opponent. /20d If your opponent is not as strong as you, the attacks will be expected, and you may even be able to avoid attacks from behind. But a true swordsman should treat every confrontation as if he is facing an enemy stronger than himself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/066: A knight should not sneak up on the back of his opponent. But if survival is the key, the tactics behind the attack cannot be ignored.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/067: Second, understand the enemy's strengths and weaknesses. /20d sounds simple, but it is not easy to use it freely in combat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/068:
If you understand the enemy's strengths, you can defend in a targeted manner and increase your chances of blocking attacks; if you understand the enemy's weaknesses, you can increase your chances of succeeding in an attack.
The truth of the
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/069: For example, magicians are very resistant to magic. It is difficult to defeat them with ordinary magic attacks, but they are very vulnerable to swords and bullets. Gunmen use firearms with long range and strong attack power, but their defense power is almost the same as that of magicians, and they are even more vulnerable to magic attacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/070: In addition, there are various manifestations of weaknesses, which need to be combined with actual combat and studied more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/071: Remember these two points first. From next time, I will explain combat skills in more detail.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/072: Go and accumulate some practical experience first, and then come back. When the time comes, I will explain the magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/073: Don't be too greedy at the beginning, just accumulate experience slowly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/075: Lesson 1: Types of Swords and Combat Concepts
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/077: It seems that you already have some practical experience, now let's explain magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/078: I briefly talked about weaknesses before. Mastering a variety of attack methods is as important as mastering a skill.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/079: It seems that you can use some magic...what kind of magic can you use?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/080: I know some dark magic taught by Lord Deimos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/081: Then, it shouldn't be difficult to learn my magic. I will teach you cold magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/082: Ah, before teaching, let's briefly talk about the magic system in this land.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/083: Magic is roughly divided into six lines. /15d The three elements of fire, ice, and thunder are collectively called three-element magic; in addition, there are dark magic derived from the power of the Dark God, sacred magic derived from the power of the Lord God, and auxiliary magic said to be derived from sacred magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/084: The three elements of magic restrain each other: fire is afraid of ice, cold is afraid of thunder and lightning, and thunder and lightning are afraid of fire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/085: Dark and holy magic are independent of the three elements and restrain each other. In other words, the party that takes the initiative to attack will have an overwhelming advantage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/086: Auxiliary magic interferes with time and space and has no restraint relationship with other five series of magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/087: These properties are not only found in magic, but are sometimes given to other substances, so be sure to keep them in mind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/088: The most accessible example is the attributes of monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/089: For example, facing a monster with a fire attribute, attacking with a cold attribute magic or weapon can cause double the damage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/090: Conversely, if you use fire attacks of the same type, the damage will be absorbed and converted into physical recovery; if you use lightning attacks, it will not cause any damage at all, so be careful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/091: Okay, I will teach you ice-cold magic now. Put it to good use in actual combat. The next lesson is about rapiers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/094: This time, let's talk about sword attacks and rapiers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/095: Last time we briefly talked about rapier and epee, right? /15d Do you remember what I said about the characteristics of a rapier?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/096: You said that it is a light sword focused on attack, but not good at defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/097: That's right. It is light and easy to use and can accurately attack the enemy's vital points, so its attack power is excellent and it is easier to deliver a fatal blow. /30d But when used for defense, the sword body is too thin and too light. Often the sword is damaged but still fails to block the attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/098: So, it's better not to defend yourself?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/099: To the extreme, it is. /10d However, its attack power is very strong. As long as it strikes first, the battle may be ended before the enemy has time to attack effectively.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/100: While a bit risky, the rapier's attack power is excellent for the price. As long as you have enough money, it is also a good strategy to bring a few more to use as consumables.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/102: The method of changing weapons, I will explain in detail next time. /20d First use the assault sword I gave you to practice the basic tactics of the rapier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/105: The last lesson: the ultimate move
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/106: The swordsmanship in Antalya is mainly divided into two major schools: the swordsmanship centered on the Pendragon Kingdom, and the swordsmanship centered on the Gesir Empire, which are called kingdom swordsmanship and empire swordsmanship respectively. The Kingdom's swordsmanship focuses on speed, while the Empire's swordsmanship focuses on strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/107: The special move of the Imperial Sword Technique uses power to break through the enemy's defense and pursues a one-hit kill; the special move of the Kingdom Sword Technique uses unexpected rapid combos to suppress the enemy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/108: You are originally a scholar, and the kingdom's swordsmanship, which pays more attention to skills than strength, should be more suitable for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/109: First, let's take the basic special move of Kingdom Swordsmanship - Vacuum Shura Blade as an example.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/110: Using various special moves such as the Vacuum Shura Blade requires corresponding energy (/2cXP/5c).
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/111: Ki is somewhat like the magic required to cast a spell, but it gradually increases every time you attack, defend, or knock down an enemy, and your attack and defense power also increase. Using special moves does not consume energy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/112: However, when the energy is full, the body cannot bear it for a long time, so after a certain period of time, the energy will naturally dissipate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/113: Different levels of special moves require different levels of energy. Other special skills should be mastered slowly in actual combat. Also...this is the sword I used before, it should be able to help you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/116: At this point, you have learned all the theories I can teach you. The only thing left is to be tempered through actual combat... You must practice diligently to defeat Asura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/117: Also, there is a dagger here for you, don't forget to equip it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/001_2: If you want to defeat the sword, defeat yourself first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/002_2: For more than a year since then, I have been following her,/nlearning Pendragon's sword skills. /nThe world's famous swordsman, Ioline Pendragon, taught me the swordsmanship of the Kingdom, and also taught me many /nmagics and techniques.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/007_2: Instead of learning a wide range of skills, it is better to master one subject thoroughly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/001_3: If you want to defeat the sword, defeat yourself first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/002_3: For more than a year since then, I have been following her,/nlearning Pendragon's sword skills. /nThe world's famous swordsman, Ioline Pendragon, taught me the swordsmanship of the Kingdom, and also taught me many /nmagics and techniques.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/007_3: Instead of learning a wide range of skills, it is better to master one subject thoroughly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/000: This huge magical machine... is Asmode!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/002: The Black Prince...can actually control such a thing...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/007: That sword... Asura cannot be controlled by human strength!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/008: Once ordinary people are touched, their spirit and body will be unable to bear it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/009: I... no matter what, I need the power of this sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/010: This is my will, and it is also the will of the Dark God Deimos...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/001: [Deimos]/nWell, it's you. /20dI have been waiting for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/002: What you told me last time, /20d and your own experience.../20d I have some questions and want to ask for advice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/003: [Deimos]/nOkay, let's talk. /30d Let me hear your story first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/005: /2c I began to unravel the questions in my mind one by one: how he was sealed again, who led this matter, and the reasons behind it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/006: /2c I learned from this that the surviving Dark Gods after the Creation War, Eustasia of Destruction and Diablo of the Moon, sealed Deimos in order to advance a certain plan.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/007: /2c However, I still have no way of knowing what that plan is. /40d I can only guess that it will never be beneficial to mankind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/008: /2c He wanted to hear my story more than telling me about his past. But I wasn't happy. Whenever I think about the past, nameless anger surges up in my heart, and at the last moment, despair always hits me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/009: My past, only vague pain. The pain of not reminiscent...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/010: [Deimos]/nJust because you want to escape pain, are you afraid of knowing the truth? Didn't you say it yourself that you have nothing to lose? What are you still afraid of?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/011: [Deimos]/nLet's think about the past. Start with the best memory and trace it back bit by bit like you are looking for threads to unravel a tangled mess.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/000: Stay out of the way and go rescue the prisoners!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/001: Hurry, sneak into the mansion through the secret passage in the north corner of the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/002: The secret passage is to the north of the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/003: Open the cover to the water channel and sneak into the mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/000: There are some people wearing black glasses around here recently...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/001: North of here is the Antananarivo region, bordering Bifrost, so it's very confusing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/002: I heard that Gesir's cathedral was built more than ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/003: I heard that Lord Esther Dodd comes from a family with a long history...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/009: Have you ever seen Lord Irus wield a sword? That momentum is really amazing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/010: Huh? You guys are very unfamiliar...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/011: Do you know the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/013: Lord Esther Dodd and Josephine of Byfrost are known as the Twins of the North.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/014: No one should have heard it, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/015: It can be said that the inheritance of the imperial family has been discontinued since the Black Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/016: I heard that the science and technology of the Tur people are far beyond our imagination.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/017: Nikacha of Cyrepus, I know it too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/019: Elegance and romance are the real joys of living in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/020: I don't have the hobby of building secret paths everywhere like that guy Ruben.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/023: Do you know the musician Mr. Nikacha? He was popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/024: The lord here is so beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/027: I heard that Lord Kars's sword is hidden in the Demonic Sword Forest...but it's too dangerous there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/028: There is a village called Bordeaux north of our Ron. The scenery is very beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/029: When I went near Bordeaux recently, I saw some people wearing strange glasses hanging out there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/030: There is a deep forest on the road to Bordeaux, and weird legends have been circulated since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/031: Now it is being spread again, saying that Lord Kars's sword is hidden there... When I first heard about it, I thought: "Again?"
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/032: I heard that the conflicts between the West Wind Falcon and the local lords have become more and more intense recently across the country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/033: I heard that the Falcons of the West Wind are a group of thieves who only target wealthy people? It's really incredible...that such people are allowed to run rampant. Fortunately for us, Ron, we have Lord Frederick protecting us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/034: Mom has been away from home a lot lately. She used to cook delicious food and always smile...but now, she doesn't cook and doesn't smile.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/035: This has been the case since dad was shot and killed by the Pendragon Border Guard. Dad used to do business on the Pendragon border...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/036: I want to see my mother smile. I want to see dad again. I hate Pendragon. Really annoying.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/038: The clothes they wore, the glasses they wore, and their hairstyles were all things I had never seen before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/039: Looking at so many people looking for the sword like crazy, maybe the sword is really hidden there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/040: Those who will only hinder the reunification of our empire should be arrested and arrested!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/041: Hmph... The people here trust Lord Frederick too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/042: He is just a lord and a landowner. Why don't people face this fact?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/043: Although the situation here is better than elsewhere, the fact that the lords possess too many things has not changed. This situation must change!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/044: Young man, I've never seen you before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/045: Have you heard of Lord Kars?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/048: So you've heard of Lord Kars... What a nice young man. So, do you know what sword Lord Kars uses?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/049: Awen prayed to the sky again. "God who gave me the shining gem, if you really gave me the gem because you understood my feelings for him, please help me."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/050: So, she heard God's answer in her heart. "I understand your wish. However, if you want to save him, you must make a sacrifice."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/051: She closed her eyes and replied, "God, I would like to give my voice. Please lift me up to where He is."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/052: When she opened her eyes again, she found that she had risen into the air. The enemy who was chasing them stood frozen in shock, and she flew to Al's side.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/053: When she came to Al, Al said: "Ah, kind man. You seem to be from my motherland. There is really no need to take such a risk just to save me. Give up on me, and please save your precious life."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/054: Awen wanted to answer, but she could no longer make a sound. She just silently tried to untie him. However, the chains that bound Al were too strong and she couldn't untie them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/055: Awen saw the enemy below setting up a ladder and starting to climb up, feeling increasingly anxious. Finally, she pressed the knife against Al's arm. For there was no way to free him from his chains without cutting off his arms.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/056: Al nodded. "Cut it off. It seems like this is the only way." Awen cut off Al's arm with tears in her eyes. Al then fainted from the severe pain of his broken arm.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/057: Although Awen rescued Al, she had no way out. The enemy is climbing up the cliff along the ladder. She had to pray to the sky again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/058: "God, merciful God! I want to give this gem to him. Please protect him as you promised me in the first place. I am willing to give my life. This time, please let him escape from here."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/059: After saying that, she put the gem on Al's chest, ran towards the cliff, and jumped off! The moment she jumped down, Al was awakened by the cold touch of the gem on his chest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/060: At that moment, Al saw her hairband spread out, revealing hair as bright as morning light and skin as white as morning mist. He saw that Awen, whom he missed even in his dreams, was about to give his life for him... He shouted: "Awen!" But Awen didn't answer, she just fell down again and again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/061: At that time, everyone present heard the voice of God. "I already understand your feelings towards Al. I will accept your life and turn you into a new creature. Go and save Al."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/062: Al saw the gem on his chest emitting a dazzling light, which pierced him so hard that he couldn't open his eyes. When he opened his eyes again, a giant bird he had never seen before appeared in front of him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/063: Al stared into the bird's eyes and said: "Awen, Awen. Is it you?" The bird seemed to be answering him and leaned down. Al climbed on the bird's back, and the giant bird flew into the sky!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/064: The people in his hometown were very surprised to see Al losing an arm, but he also came back with a strange bird, which surprised them even more. After returning, Al became taciturn, built a hut in a remote place, lived with birds, and carved stones all day long.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/065: Al spent his whole life trying to recreate the gem he placed on his chest, and finally created a brand new gem. That's the Chaos Cube. Since Al returned to his hometown, birds as brave and huge as the bird that saved him have begun to appear across the country. People call them falcons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/066:
, is the story interesting? Thank you for listening to such a long story. Let me give you a reward.
What about

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/069: ----Rowan Branch of Geisier Academy----/nWe can answer all your questions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/070: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nAlthough the prices in Ron City are relatively high, people can live a very stable life here with the strong army and perfect public security.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/071: [Member of the Geographic Society]/n To the north of Ron is the Magic Sword Forest, and further north is Bordeaux Village. In fact, the Demon Sword Forest is not as scary as the name sounds. As long as you focus on heading to Bordeaux and keep walking straight north, it is not difficult to pass. But if you turn to the east where the magic sword is, you will enter a forest with very complicated terrain...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/072: [Member of the Tactics Research Association]/nThe situation is getting more and more tense now. When the situation changes suddenly, it's often too late to prepare weapons, so if conditions permit, it's best to stock up on as much equipment as possible, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/073: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nWe once had a member named Paz. He was an excellent swordsman, known as 'Paz the Swift'...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/074: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHowever, what makes him more famous is his ability as a sword master. No one can compare with him in maintaining or repairing swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/075: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHave you ever heard of Pendragon's standard sword? I heard that the SP-7 "Blitz" is very good... enough to be called a mass-produced holy sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/076: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/n There are two famous swordsmiths in Pendragon. One is the famous Chrysaor, and the other is Moglai, who is not very familiar to the imperial people. I heard that Moglai is secretly developing a standard sword to compete with Chrysaor's "Blitz".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/077: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nWhich one is better between "Blitz" and Mowglai? Unfortunately, according to the orders of the Pendragon royal family, these standard swords are very difficult to obtain. They kept it strictly confidential and did not allow outsiders to take it out of the country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/078: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nIt's just...he has a shortcoming, he is often too greedy for the sword itself. He was last seen near Antananarivo and has not been heard from since. I don't know what I'm doing now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/030_3: There is a deep forest on the road to Bordeaux, and weird legends have been circulated since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/031_3: It is now rumored that Lord Kars's sword is hidden there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/032_3: I heard that recently, our Lord Frederick launched an attack on the Zephyr Falcon across the country.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/035_3: I heard that my father went to heaven three years ago. Since then, my mother has never smiled again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/036_3: I want to see my mother smile.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/013: Many people say that the strongest swordsman in the empire is His Majesty the Black Prince, but to simply call His Majesty the Black Prince a swordsman seems.../30d If we only talk about swordsmen, he is General Kars anyway.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/016: However, I have yet to meet anyone who has actually seen that sword.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/018: Actually, Sharon's singing skills are very good. It's just that compared to her singing skills, her charm in other aspects is more dazzling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/019: Sharon has been traveling around...where she is now, I don't know.

? It's beautiful, isn't it? Not only is it beautiful, but the aroma is so good that I just can't bear to eat it. I wonder what Mr. Karger would do with it...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/041: Will you sell it to me? It should be good for replenishing the health of my grandson. I'll give you a good price.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/043: Sorry. This is something someone else asked me to do...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/060: Swords are roughly divided into four categories: rapier, long sword, heavy sword, and broadsword. Instead of classifying swords by "size" in the past, we classify swords based on their performance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/061: The characteristics of the rapier are its slender blade, extremely powerful attack power, low price, and high critical hit rate; however, its defense power and block rate are low, its endurance limit is extremely low, and the weapon's HP is only 1, so it is easily damaged. That said, maintenance costs are high.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/062: Raciles include rapiers, sabers, rapiers, armor-piercing swords, cassandras, and grams. People who value attack power can use these swords, but if the level is low, too low defense power may endanger their own lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/063: The epee is a large and wide sword with low attack power and hit rate, but high defense power, block rate, weapon HP and endurance limit, so it has a great advantage in defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/064: The role of a heavy sword will gain a high level of defense and resistance, and the sword will not be easily damaged and will save money. However, a low level of attack will prolong the fighting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/065: Epee includes Roman dagger, swordbreaker, epee, Chrysaor Gilliam, and hybrid sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/066: The long sword is an ordinary sword whose performance is between the heavy sword and the rapier. The balance is very good, but it lacks distinctive features, which makes it less popular among famous swordsmen. They pursue their own style more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/067: The Great Sword is also known as the "Holy Sword", including the Great Sword, Durandal, Claymore, etc., which are all legendary swords... They have high attack and defense, but they are also very expensive. And many of them are simply not available commercially.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/068: Our Sword Research Association collects and buys and sells swords from various places. Want to pick one? All proceeds will be used for research.
