Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/029: Did we meet a long time ago?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/030: This... I don't know how to describe it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/031: Sometimes, accompanied by the feeling that the blood in the body seems to be boiling...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/032: I don't know why...I often feel that I have seen you several times before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/033: I'm sorry I suddenly said something so strange.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/035: However,/nI can never forgive them. /20d /nNo matter what, they must pay for their crimes. /20d /nmust be/10d....../10d....../10d.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/036: No matter what, they must pay for their crimes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/038: I'm sorry I suddenly said something so strange.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/039: Thank you. /10d/nThanks to your help... I was able to get Asura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/040: Now that Asura has recognized you as its master, you should be able to use its power. However,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/041: You can only summon this sword when your power reaches its peak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/042: Even if summoned, the time it can be used is very short...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/043: And with your current ability, you are still unable to use the "Asura Sky-breaking Dance" used by the Black Prince back then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/044: I am afraid that I will need a lot of practice in the future.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/045: The Black Prince finally created a new realm beyond the "Ashura Breaking the Sky Dance". However,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/046: As for whether you can reach the same state, it is difficult to say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/000: Ah, Master Cyrano. Ah... that... is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/001: T-that...congratulations to Master Cyrano on his engagement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/002: Oh... Master Cyrano, congratulations on the engagement. You will get married soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/003: Hehe... When you get married, I will prepare special dishes for the newlyweds, so stay tuned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/004: I'll make you a special meal with very good food. Huh-uh.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/005: Ah! Master Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/006: It's time for Master Cyrano to exercise. You have to work on your physical strength, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/007: Shall I introduce you to a familiar club?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/008: Hehe... I heard you are getting engaged. What a great time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/009: You don't have to listen to your wife's nagging and you are immersed in the dream of your upcoming wedding...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/010: Yes, isn't this the happiest time in life? Just enjoy the moment. Once youth is gone, it can never come back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/004_3: I will use special ingredients to cook a special meal for you. Let you be as sweet as glue, hehehe.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/006_3: Hehe... Master Cyrano, it's time for you to exercise too. You have to build up some physical strength, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/007_3: Would you like me to introduce you to a familiar fitness club?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/009_3: You don't have to listen to your wife's nagging and you are immersed in the dream of your upcoming wedding...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/010_3: Yes, isn't this the happiest time in life? Just enjoy the moment. Once youth is gone, it can never come back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/000: Not good. They say beauties are destined to die... What if I don't live long?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/001: To go to Gesir City from here, you must cross the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/002: The desert is not good for the skin, so I can't go to Qasir anymore, hehehe.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/003: Hello, the weather is really nice, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/004: It would be nice if it rained occasionally...Why is the weather always the same?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/005: Ah... Look at the dazzling blue sky and the blooming clouds... The sky as clear as Ron's meteor sword makes me cry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/006: Celepus gathers all kinds of news from all over the empire and Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/007: The Granada Merchant Group, in particular, is famous for its wide variety of goods.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/008: occasionally brings some strange things, but they are not sold in the store, so you have to find another way to get them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/009: It's been a while since I've been to Serreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/010: is Granada, the largest store in the empire. So big.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/011: Although Granada has everything, this sentence actually means "all kinds".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/012: A few days ago, I met a very beautiful sister.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/013: Blue hair, blue eyes, fair skin...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/014: It's almost like looking at the photo of Miss Ruth when she was young in the tavern now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/015: Huh? There's a strange fog above you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/016: It seems that there is some bad luck.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/017: If you want to ward off bad luck, check out Ron. I heard that there is a strange fortune teller living there, and she will tell your fortune for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/018: Have you ever heard of the legend of Treasure Island? It is said that the treasure left by the legendary pirate "Kid" is hidden there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/019: I heard that the number of gems buried there is beyond imagination. As long as I can get there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/020: I hate this kind of port city. Vulgar, chaotic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/021: I have a friend who moved to Libreville and wrote that it's a great place to live.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/022: If Miss Ruth in the tavern becomes mayor, can our place become as livable as Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/023: I heard that in the mainland, there is a group of thieves called the West Wind Falcons who are causing a lot of trouble?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/024: Life has been difficult to begin with...it's really worrying.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/025: If Miss Ruth in the tavern becomes the mayor, will public security be better?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/026: My friend Jane now goes to an inland village called Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/027: Her mother is a hunter, so she is always alone. I wonder if she is doing well now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/029: I once went to a place called Ron with my father.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/030: That place is far away... On the way there, I entered a strange cave in the forest near Gesir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/031: You can only go to a certain point in that cave, and you can't go in any further. Next time you go, be sure to explore the rest of the place...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/032: I was sick last week and was unable to attend the outing to the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/033: I heard from the other kids that John was going to confess to me there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/035: It's so sunny. In this kind of weather, it would be no problem even to go to Storm Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/036: Have you heard of the legend of Storm Island? It is said that as long as you pull out the Asura sword inserted there, you can become the ruler of the empire...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/037: However, the water near Storm Island is fast and the weather is unpredictable, so it is not easy to get close.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/038: Going to Storm Island, instead of taking a private boat, you'll have to take Pandragan's contact boat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/039: Pendragon's liaison ship? That was of course the ship sent by King Rashid to deliver supplies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/040: It is said that if you sail beyond the Storm Island and sail further, you can find the route to the Treasure Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/041: I have a friend named Paz. If you find him, he will definitely be able to help you a lot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/042: He used to be a swordsman, but his ability to practice swords is better than using swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/043: Looking at you, you seem to be swordsmen too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/044: As long as the sea route is not smooth, the development of Cyreps will inevitably be restricted. What a difficult problem...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/046: This is the best tavern in Sereps!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/047: Our wine, even those guys from the Tuer tribe will never forget this place after drinking it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/048: None of those sailors are serious! Everyone is secretly glancing at me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/049: Hmph, but my vision is not bad...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/051: Welcome, this is the Seraps Inn.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/052: Thank you. Have a great rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/054: Thank you and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/055: I am planning to travel from Cerepos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/056: The female guest who lives next door to me really makes my heart flutter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/057: Here in Cyreps, all kinds of people will gather together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/058: The same is true for our hotel. There are all kinds of guests coming and going.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/059: This hotel is the property of my husband and me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/061: My father is out of town temporarily, and we are looking after the store for him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/062: We all remember the prices of the products clearly, please rest assured.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/063: Celepus has had a famous thieves guild since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/064: Everyone is having a hard time now, and it is difficult for the Thieves Guild to survive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/066: We are on a special mission for the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/067: We are pretending to be a couple in order to perform a special mission.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/069: Our husband and wife learned to do business early in the day, so we were able to rent space at the Amigo department store.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/070: Hmph... No matter how great they think they are, in the end this store was still opened with my wealth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/071: Hmph. No matter how great they think they are, in the end this store was still opened with my funding.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/072: We have spent a lot of effort to get to where we are today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/073: On the way, he accidentally met a strange man near the dragon's lair in Gesil Forest, and then he earned the capital to do business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/074: What special mission is it, you ask? That's a secret.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/075: After carrying out missions together for so long, I gradually fell in love with him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/076: We are performing a secret mission and cannot tell you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/077: After carrying out missions together for so long, I gradually fell in love with her. At the beginning, we really had no tacit understanding...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/078: We are doing detective work now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/079: If you have any trouble, just leave it to us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/080: You ask how we know so clearly? Because we are Tommy and Tuppence, private detectives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/081: My father and Mr. Tommy had a very good relationship.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/082: But to be honest, this hotel was almost entirely built by me. My stupid husband also knows how to open and close doors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/083: But he didn't realize it at all, and he still thought he was amazing. Forget it, I have nothing to lose by letting him think so.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/084: Our boss is really a weirdo. In fact, the hotel is entirely managed by the proprietress, but it is the boss who puts on airs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/085: It is also my first time to come to Cyreps, but I have never seen such a beautiful woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/086: If you miss this opportunity, you will never have it again, right? I want to bravely run towards the goddess in my heart and win her love! Wait for me, my love!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/087: The young man who lives next door is quite likable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/088: I plan to never return to this old empire territory after this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/089: How can we dampen their pride? money? reputation? Handsome face?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/090: In the final analysis, what can impress a woman is a little bit of your heart. How can I make my beloved feel my love for her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/091: It would be great if Ms. Ruth over there could become the mayor, and arrest all those guys with dirty thoughts!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/092: The secret to good wine is attentiveness. The heart to sacrifice everything in order to be the best!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/093: For the sake of the tranquility of the port, the current unrestricted free trade zone must be restricted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/094: Excessive freedom can make people stupid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/095: I am Charles, the current mayor of Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/096: I have no intention of giving up the position of mayor to a junior like Ruth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/097: Are you Charles de Benarize, the current mayor of Sylerpos?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/099: I have nothing else to do here. I just want to know when the ban on sailing to Dacama will be lifted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/100: [Mayor Charles]/nHmph...you ask when the flight ban will be lifted? That route is too dangerous and it looks like it will be closed to navigation for some time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/101: However, as long as you don't plan to completely close the route, navigation will have to be restored one day...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/102: [Mayor Charles]/n Route closed! That's a good idea! I heard that Da Cama Port is in the worst economic predicament after the war, and we can't get much benefit from trading there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/103: [Mayor Charles]/nGo back! I have nothing to say about that route!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/104: [Ruth]/nFor the revival of the Gesir Empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/105: Um... Excuse me, do you know someone named Ruth?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/108: [Ruth]/nHehehe... Is this your first time coming to Cyreps? People who meet me for the first time are surprised that I am a woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/109: [Ruth]/nSo, what do you want from me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/110: The route to Dhakama is blocked, you should know. I have to go to Dhakama for something. Is there any way to lift the ban on sailing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/111: [Ruth]/nOops...what are you talking about? I'm just a candidate for mayor, I don't have that power.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/112: No, I heard from people in the town that you can definitely help me. Please, please help me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/113: [Ruth]/nReally...But why do you want to go to Dacama so much? He doesn't look like a businessman either...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/118: Actually, I want to go to Storm Island to pull out the Asura Sword. To do this, I have to go to Dakama first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/119: [Ruth]/nAre you going to pull out the Asura Sword on Storm Island? Are you also the kind of person who wants to rely on the power of the sword to pursue false fame?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/120: No. I do need the power of that sword, but not for the pursuit of meaningless fame. Absolutely not!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/121: [Ruth]/nIf it's not for fame, then why do you do such a dangerous thing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/123: [Ruth]/nWhat a very interesting story. But it doesn't matter if you tell me even this kind of thing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/124: This... I received a letter saying that my mother in Dhakama is critically ill and asked me to go back quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/125: [Ruth]/nHahahaha! Your lies are too obvious! "I'm lying" is written all over your face, how can I trust you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/126: [Ruth]/nI don't like dishonest people. Sorry, could you please step aside?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/127: Ms. Ruth, please give me another chance. I have to go to Dhakama.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/128: [Ruth]/nSorry, I will never deal with scammers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/129: It's strange. Even though I want to confess everything to you, I also feel that I can trust you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/130: [Ruth]/nOkay...since you trust me, I should repay you. I will find a way for you. Please go to the dock.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/132: [Ruth]/nI will definitely take responsibility for what I said. So...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/133: I can't help it, I'll just tell the truth. I...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/134: [Ruth]/nI see... But, is it okay to tell me such a thing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/135: I think it's okay. Especially to you, I think I can say it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/136: [Ruth]/nBut it wasn't like this at the beginning, right? Haha...Okay, I will find a way for you, please come to the dock.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/138: [Ruth]/nI am not like a certain young master, I only tell the truth. So...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/139: I have to go to the port of Da Cama.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/142: Thank you for your patronage. Thank you so much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/143: Welcome. This is the Cyreps store.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/146: This house seems to be unoccupied...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/147: Can't give up yet, I have to go to Dhakama.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/148: It seems that finding the person named Ruth is the only solution.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/149: Is that the city's mayor's mansion... Mayor Charles should be there now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/150: Ms. Ruth, who often stayed in the tavern, also mentioned the treasure island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/151: Residence of the Mayor of Cyrepus

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/014_2: When I grow up, I want to become such a beauty.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/000: [Kana]/nThat's too much, Cyrano! How could you kill such a little Christina without hesitation...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/001: [Esmeralda]/nWhen you brutally killed Esther Dodd... I could still understand.../30d But Christina is the woman you love...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/002: [Silver]/nThat's unfair! Are you saying we should have hesitated back then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/003: [Silver]/nYou know we were facing the God of Destruction! We had no choice!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/004: [Clausewitz]/nMr. Cyrano, this incident has shaken everyone's trust in you. You actually killed the Frederick couple's only daughter with your own hands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/008: Since you are so dissatisfied, don't you just stop following me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/010: You have gone too far. Because of you, we gave up two captains. But you said such irresponsible words...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/011: I am clearly warning you that if anyone tries to criticize my actions again, I will get rid of them all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/014: It seems that Esmeralda also thinks I did something wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/015: Sorry, it seems we pushed you to this point. /50d It was my oversight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/016: But we have our own righteousness, and your behavior is inconsistent with the philosophy of West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/017: I hereby declare that from now on, the Falcon of the West Wind will operate separately from you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/018: Cyrano...now...there is really no way...I can't trust you anymore...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/019: I never counted on anyone's trust. Human trust will only become a stumbling block on my road to revenge.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/020: Listen carefully. We don't need dissenters. How about it? Is there anyone else willing to follow us?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/023: That's enough, Silver. We cannot delay any longer. We have to catch Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga21a/000: This leads to Ron. /nNicosia is in the southeast.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/001: As expected, it was Bifrost's first-level magical device, Ascalon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/002: Ascalon, could it be... that the legendary magical machine...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/003: Do we have to fight that kind of monster...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/004: Don't worry, Mr. Meditch. /30d No matter how amazing the magic machine is, as long as the driver is not capable enough, it will not be able to fully exert its power.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/005: The person driving that magic machine must be Miss Catalina, who is known as the strongest warrior in Bifrost, but she was originally a Valkyrie. /30d has never driven a magic machine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/006: On the contrary, it is an opponent we can resist. /30d and...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/007: Clausewitz, Ascalon is coming towards us...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/002_3: That is the legendary magical machine, Ascalon...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/000: Ruben's mother was always favored by the master...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/001: If you think about it carefully, the late Madam is really a generous person... She clearly knows those things...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/002: Oh, oh...look at my mouth. Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/003: You know Sid, right? Jean's son... I heard that the child went to the next village and was kidnapped on the way back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/004: Three days after he was kidnapped, he was found by the police and brought back. But strangely, there was no news from the kidnappers during those three days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/005: Don't you think it's strange? Sid was indeed kidnapped, but why didn't the kidnapper make any demands?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/005_3: Don't you think it's strange? Sid was indeed kidnapped, but why was there never any contact with the kidnapper?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka17a/000: This is not the direction to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka17a/003: << Gesil City >>/nFrom here it is Gesil City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka09a/000: Northeast - Libreville area/nNorthwest - Pretoria area/nSouth - Gesil City
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka09a/001: The Libreville area we are going to is northeast of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/000: Cyrano will be here soon. /40d You'd better avoid it as soon as possible...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/001: That doesn't matter anymore, my plan has been realized.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/002: You mean the unification of the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/003: That's right. /30d /nNow that the monster Cyrano is chasing here, the Bifrost court should also understand that he also poses a threat to Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/004: As long as you wait a little longer, all the lords in the empire, the Zephyr Falcon, and even Bifrost will join forces to get rid of Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/005: But Your Excellency Cardinal, even so, you should protect yourself, right? Only in this way can we lead a unified empire in the future...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/006: Haha, do you think that guy Cyrano can kill me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/007: Let my sword prove whether you are immortal or not.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/008: Haha, it is indeed an amazing obsession... In this aspect, you may be very similar to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/010: Haha, aren't you already more vicious than me? He even killed his former companions with his own hands. /40dAt least, I never got my hands dirty.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/011: I don't want to say any more. /30d All I want is your life. /30d is enough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/012: How dare you take my life, Cyrano! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/013: I am the hero who will unify the empire, and I am also a god!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/017: I am very happy that my grandpa can find real peace...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/018: Now...father and mother can finally rest in peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/020: Speaking of which, where did that guy named Machiavelli go?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/021: I'm here. I won't run away, don't worry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/023: Quite courageous. Were you watching from the beginning to the end?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/024: I was the one who let him go, Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/026: Who exactly are you? /30dIs Clausewitz really your name?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/029: I do have a lot to explain to you. But grandpa is waiting for us, so let's go together first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/030: His purpose is only to leave his evaluation of Cesare and us to future generations through his own thoughts, nothing more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/031: No, I don't care about that guy anymore. What I care more about is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/032: With the help of the power of the God of Destruction, I have obtained the body of a god. /30d In other words, I am the immortal god!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/002: Avoid the center part where Christina is and attack the enemy's offensive part!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/003: Success! ! All its offensive parts have been destroyed!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/008: [Mercedes]/nI pray with my life, wake up, Christina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/011: [Cyrano]/nHow...how could you do such a stupid thing...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy...why do you have to say sorry to me...Mercedes...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/023: Cyrano! ! The God of Destruction is on the move again! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/024: ...You are so tenacious...I will definitely finish you off this time!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/000: In the mountains to the north, there is the base of the famous West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/001: There is a famous female doctor named Miss Esmeralda living in our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/002: This is Pretoria, a mountain village in the western part of the empire's territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/006: Yes, that's right. /nMy hometown is near here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/007: I didn't expect Kana to be a southern girl. What a surprise.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/008: Girls in the south are generally very quiet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/010: Anyway, the church fortress is on the right side of the village. /nI'm afraid it's better to be careful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/014: I hate the days when the priest occasionally comes down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/015: Every time that day comes, my mother will shut me up tightly at home. He said he might be arrested if he went out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/017: I have been in poor health since I was a child and can only stay at home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/018: Every time my mother looks at me, she always shows a sad expression.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/020: We have obviously made an appointment to meet Mr. Rodriguez around here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/021: Our village belongs to the church territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/023: I have been to many places, but no matter how much I hate those priests, my hometown is the best.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/024: [Sharon]/nMy name is Sharon, I am a female singer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/025: [Sharon]/nI'm tired of it and don't want to sing anymore. Really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/026: [Mr. Edward]/nWelcome. The hotel charges 90 Eld per night. Want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/027: Thank you and have a comfortable night.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/028: Be sure to stay here next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/029: Thank you for your patronage. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/030: Our pub uses the best ingredients and only serves the best wine and snacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/031: Hehehe... The female boss here is not only kind, but also has good craftsmanship, so I come here often.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/032: [Sharon]/nSharon...that is indeed my name, but I am no longer a singer, you can no longer call me singer Sharon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/033: ...Can you please sign your name for us?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/034: [Sharon]/nAutograph... Why do people always want the signature of celebrities so persistently? I really don't understand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/035: Are you Miss Sharon the singer?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/036: [Uncle Shen] Is there anything you need?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/038: Thank you for visiting. See you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/039: Isn't it often said that there is no place like home?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/040: Did you know that it no longer snows or rains in Gesir?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/041: It snowed once fifteen years ago, and it hasn't snowed since.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/042: But the river kept flowing. Strange, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/044: Every time after an argument, they would ask me who was right and who was wrong. It's really hard...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/045: Guest, you can't come in from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/046: [Sharon]/nEverywhere I go, people see Sharon as the singer, not me... Same with the signature. All people want is Sharon singing and dancing on stage!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/047: ...Yeah, that's exactly what people want. /30d But, /20d But, people have expectations for you, how lucky you are, don't you understand?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/048: No matter where you go, you can meet people who need you and people who cherish you. Someone expects something from you, especially happiness from you. Isn't this a blessing from God?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/049: [Sharon]/n...People who need me...Yes, there are indeed such people...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/050: [Sharon]/nYes. I'm Sharon, Sharon Indricka. People's idols, elves on the stage. That's me, not anyone else.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/051: [Sharon]/nYou...just said you wanted an autograph, right? I'll sign it for you. Bring me the signature book...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/053: Thank you so much. The little girl who asked me for my autograph will be very happy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/054: [Sharon]/nYes... I need fans, and fans need me... I am the one who should say thank you. So, bye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/055: [Sharon]/nYes...I am Sharon, the "Sharon" called by people who love my songs. I'll work up some courage and give it a try.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/026_3: [Mr. Edward]/nWelcome. The hotel charges 90 Gold per night. Want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/032_3: [Sharon]/nSigned? Are you here to pester me too? Please leave me alone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/033_3: No. We just want to convey the wish of a young girl who is eager to get your autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/034_3: [Sharon]/n...Is that so...Then, let me sign it for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/035_3: Miss Sharon? Well, can you please sign it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/000: Father... please, at least let Christina go...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/001: This is all for the sake of justice, don't get in my way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/002: Moreover, it is too late to stop the ceremony to lift the seal. If she was interrupted forcibly, it would endanger Christina's life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/004: Cesare! Stay away from the seal!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/005: Well, isn't this the rebel leader Meditch and his men!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/006: Lord Diablo, I'll leave the rest to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/007: Hehehe, that's okay. Let's just pass the time before the God of Destruction is resurrected and play with you for a while, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/008: Mr. Meditch, you have to seize that seal first!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/010: No! ! If I touch Christina now...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/011: Who are you! Get out of the way! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/015: Meditch brother! ! ! What are you doing! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/017: Hmph, do you want to hinder Mr. Meditch again?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/024: I'm going to kill you! ! Cyrano! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/025: I'm going to kill you! ! Meditch! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/026: No, the God of Destruction has begun to resurrect!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/027: The God of Destruction is nothing...come if you can!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/028: But Christina is still there...! Cyrano...! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/029: Oh, Mr. Cyrano won? Sure enough, you are the strongest swordsman!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/031: You cannot be forgiven either! If you hadn't instigated Meditch, Mercedes wouldn't have died!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/037: Cesare! Cesare! ! /30d It's all your fault! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/038: Diablo, Cesare! ! I will destroy you all! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/039: Haha, it's getting crazier and crazier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/110: Okay, I have long wanted to compete with you! Brace yourselves, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/000: Congratulations, General Frederick. /30dIf it weren't for your careful planning, there would be no victory today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/001: Haha, I know very well that the victory in this battle is not just the result of the strategy of Clausewitz and I.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/002: It's the concerted efforts of everyone that can win today's victory, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/003: Our strategy is just to help from the side.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/004: You are right. However, this battle will definitely be recorded in the history of the empire as a victory. No matter from which angle you look at it, you have to celebrate it, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/005: Speaking of which, where are the heroes of this battle? I'm talking about the gray caped knight. I really want to have a drink with him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/006: You are talking about Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/007: The rear troops made a mistake, causing the front to collapse. Thanks to him successfully cutting off the enemy's supply line, we were able to save the situation, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/010: Can you leave me alone for a moment, Kana?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/012: Let him be, he has what he wants to do now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/014: Cyrano, thank you so much for today. /40d I want to raise a toast to the heroes of this battle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/015: ...That's not bad either. /20d However, before I raise a toast with you, I have one more thing to do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/017: General Alfred Frederick, I challenge you to a duel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/021: What did you suddenly say, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/022: Hahaha, don't do this. /30d /nHow can I fight against the number one swordsman in the empire if I don't have any swordsmanship?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/023: It seems you didn't understand me. /30d I don't want to compete with you in swordsmanship. What I want is your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/025: ...This is difficult to handle. /30d I don't know what resentment you have against me, but now we are at a banquet celebrating the victory of the coalition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/026: Even if I want to accept your duel, I can't do it here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/027: Before dawn tomorrow, on the peak behind this valley. Of course, come alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/028: I hope you won't be late.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/029: What a rude person! I cannot accept such a unilateral proposal for a duel!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/030: A unilaterally proposed duel? A guy who kills innocent people in the name of a duel, can't he accept it when it's his turn?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/032: Our general is not someone who would do such a thing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/034: Cyrano, please apologize to the general and withdraw your request for a duel!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/036: Since it comes to this point, fine, I accept your duel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/037: However, I accept this duel not because you are right.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/038: I accept your duel just to show that I have nothing to be ashamed of for what I have done so far!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/039: You will naturally know when the time comes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/040: Mr. Cyrano, what are you doing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/041: I'm sorry, military advisor. My matter may affect the cooperation of the coalition forces.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/042: No, I believe Mr. Cyrano must have your reasons for doing this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/043: There must be some hidden secret that is inconvenient to tell us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/044: That's how we believe in you. You won't live up to our expectations, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/047: No, please take me with you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/048: Frederick will definitely come alone. If I am defeated by his sword and my life is threatened, can you promise not to take action?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/050: Even if I die in a duel with him, it doesn't matter to me. There's one thing I have to figure out, though, so I hope this is a fair duel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw16/003: [Organization Member] /nHehehe, sorry, we have to take this sword away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw16/004: [Organization Member] /nThat is the magic sword of the legendary swordsman Kars! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw16/005: [Organization Member] /n is the sword that "that lord" is looking for.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/002: Sneak in through the secret passage as planned and rescue our prisoners.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/005: Everything went as Mr. Clausewitz expected.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/006: Okay! /10d Taking advantage of the enemy's confusion, sneak into the fortress and rescue our prisoners.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/007: The first unit of West Wind Falcon, start taking action!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/008: The impregnable fortress is also said to be a prison that no one can escape----/nInverno.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/000: Welcome. /10dThe wine in our tavern is the best in the world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/001: There is a famous female doctor living in our village, Esmeralda.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/002: Our tavern uses mineral water from the valley to make wine, so no matter where we go...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/007: Thank you for patronizing our store. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/011: [Miss Hayden]/nWelcome. Welcome to our hotel. The accommodation fee is 95 ELD. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/012: Thank you for your business and wish you a comfortable night...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/014: Thank you for staying at our hotel. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/015: Seriously, if it weren't for the water and Esmeralda, there would be no hope of living in this village...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/016: A few days ago, a family in our village escaped.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/017: On the one hand, it was to avoid the witch trial, but the most important reason was that the wife of that family was attracted by Viscount Ramon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/018: I will never let this world go!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/019: My relatives have left their homes to escape from the hands of Lord Ramon ... It is now unknown. Why, why do people with no power just let others bully them?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/020: I...I really hate those powerful guys!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/021: Who are you? who I am?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/023: Vicomte Ramon is famous for his lust. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/024: Not long ago, another family fled to avoid Viscount Ramon. Viscount Ramon sent troops to pursue him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/025: Occasionally, carriages of dignitaries pass by on this road.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/026: Our village has beautiful scenery since ancient times, and many nobles are vying to be the lord here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/027: This is one of the targets of this battle, Pretoria. /nHurry up and attack the mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/031: Hehehe... I used to be a good swordsman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/032: The most important thing when using a sword is not to be obsessed with the weapon. After all, weapons are just tools for swordsmanship, not the purpose.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/033: The highest realm is not to be able to perform swordsmanship even without a sword in your hand! Don't be limited to weapons!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/034: When speaking a foreign language, think and speak like a native of that country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/035: More and more people are learning the Tuer language recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/036: The war with them will one day end, and by then, it will be necessary to use the Tuer language.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/037: Don't run away. Running away won't solve the problem.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/038: The lord of our village is a rather eccentric man... To be honest, life here is hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/039: The rubber band was stretched too long and it broke!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/040: The broken rubber band hit my leg and it hurt so much that I burst into tears!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/041: The door seems to be locked from the inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/042: [Celia]/nWelcome. What are you looking for in our store?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/043: It is your good luck to come to our village. Please walk slowly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/044: I heard that Viscount Ramon has stored a large amount of treasures on the second floor of the mansion...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/045: Some people also divide swords into rapiers and epees based on their characteristics... In any case, if you want to survive, an epee is more suitable than a rapier. When using a rapier, while striking, the risk of getting hit is also high. If the level is not high enough, it will be difficult to survive the battle...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/046: Using a heavy sword such as Chrysaor Gilion or a half-hand sword will be more helpful in saving your life. Especially when facing strong enemies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/047: Swords are generally divided into defensive and offensive types. The defensive type is durable, but has weak attack power; the offensive type is just the opposite, although it is easy to damage, the attack power is very strong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/048: The representative defensive swords are Chrysaor Gilian and the half-hand sword. The representative attack swords are Cassandra and Gram.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/049: The half-hand sword is very strong and has the advantage of low maintenance cost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/050: Gram has strong attack power, but is not durable and must bear high maintenance costs. Moreover, our physical strength will be greatly consumed during the battle, so we need to prepare a lot of recovery medicine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/051: Have you heard this story? Not long ago, an outstanding swordsman entered the dragon's cave to explore, but his weapon was damaged on the way, and as a result... he never came back alive. Sure enough, is the most important thing for a weapon to be strong?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/052: Gram can be the strongest sword in the right hands. Although it is a thin sword, it is difficult to defend and the blade is easily damaged, but its power is not inferior to those famous swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/053: The Swordsmanship Research Association under our academy is dedicated to studying the sword, a weapon that has been gradually forgotten, and showing its charm to people, and has devoted all its enthusiasm to this end.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/054: ----The official meeting place of the Weapons Research Association under the Academy of Sciences----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/055: The point of fighting is not to kill the enemy, but to keep yourself alive. Now the armor is useless, whether it can protect the body depends on the sword in hand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/056: Although the rapier attacks happily, it puts a lot of pressure on your HP. It can be said that he is fighting with his life...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/057: Moreover, the durability of the rapier is low. If fierce battles continue, all of them may be damaged. In the end, you will have to face the enemy with bare hands. That would be no different than committing suicide.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/058: The Imperial Geographical Society branch of the Geysir Academy is located on the west side of the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/059: Pretoria: A medium-sized village with low prices and the residence of the famous female doctor Esmeralda. The nearby mountainous areas are known for their complex terrain and vast scope. The famous Phoenix Cave is also nearby, but because it is very dangerous, the exact location is not announced. It is said that inside the Phoenix Cave, it is possible to obtain the most powerful fire magic. /n----The Imperial Geographical Society under the Geysir Academy----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/060: Have you met anyone from the Western Geographical Society? Those weirdos just stare at the map all day long.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/061: Really, even people who do nothing all day can have food to eat...but we have to work very hard just to make ends meet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/062: Doesn't this prove that after the death of the Black Prince, this empire is no longer suitable for life? We also hope to have a strong leader to reunify this place...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/000_3: Welcome. The wine in our pub is the best in the world.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/008_3: [Miss Barton]/nWelcome, welcome to the village where the famous Esmeralda is located. How can I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/010_3: Take care. Thank you. May Esmeralda bless you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/011_3: [Miss Hayden]/nWelcome to our hotel. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/013_3: Then, come back next time when you have a chance...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/014_3: Thank you for staying at our hotel. So, goodbye...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/023_3: Vicomte Ramon is famous for his lust. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/024_3: Not long ago, another family fled to avoid Viscount Ramon. Viscount Ramon sent troops to pursue him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/025_3: Occasionally, carriages of dignitaries pass by on this road.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/026_3: Our village has beautiful scenery since ancient times, and many nobles are vying to be the lord here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/031_3: Hehehe... I used to be a good swordsman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/032_3: The most important thing when using a sword is not to be obsessed with the weapon. After all, weapons are just tools for swordsmanship, not the purpose.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/034_3: When speaking a foreign language, think and speak like a native of that country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/036_3: The war with them will one day end, and by then, it should be necessary to use the Tuer language.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/038_3: The lord of our village is a rather eccentric man... To be honest, life here is hard.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/001: Me? Hmm...who am I exactly.../nHey! You are carrying a strange sword!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/003: I feel a strange sword energy... Can you show me what's in your backpack? /n...This is Excalibur! Where did you get this famous sword...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/004: Although it is a good sword, it is quite worn...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/005: That is a famous sword...you actually keep it like this! Wait a moment! I'll fix it for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/007: You...could it be Paz? Thank you for repairing this sword for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/008: It seems you have heard of my name. It doesn't matter, just being able to repair this famous sword is already... a smooth journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/009: Me? Hmm...who am I exactly.../nHey! You are carrying a strange sword!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/010: In this remote and dangerous place... what are you doing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/011: [Paz]/nHmm...ask me? My name is Paz. I have been practicing swordsmanship all my life, but then I felt that the world was meaningless, so I came to live here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/012: But, living in a place like this... wouldn't you be lonely or scared?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/013:
[Paz]/nAfraid? Hahaha... I was also a famous swordsman when I was young. The monsters here can never hurt me.
How about
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/014: [Paz]/nJust...occasionally, I want to see a really good sword. For example, EOLYN Pendragon's Excalibur, the Pendragon family's Barisada, or the lightsaber said to be used by the Tur tribe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/015: Excalibur...you mean that shabby sword? It turns out that it is such a famous sword...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/017: If by Excalibur you mean that rather old sword, then I do have it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/018: [Paz]/nSince you have it with you, can you show it to me? Just fulfill the wish of an old man like me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/019: Of course, this is not difficult. It's just that it's so old and I've long outgrown it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/021: [Paz]/nThis is...the legendary Excalibur, God.../nHowever, it is indeed badly damaged...Will you let me repair it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/022: You want to restore this old sword? It was so shabby that no one ever thought to fix it...well. I would also be happy if I could repair an unusable sword until it can be used.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/023: [Paz]/nA sword that can be used...Okay, let me show you what a truly "usable" sword is.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/026: [Paz]/n...! This is the real famous sword - Excalibur!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/027: This sword...a shining blade and a sharp blade! The sword light demonstrates powerful attack power, and its heavy weight brings a solid sense of defense! But when he waved it, it was as light as nothing. This is the real famous sword...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/028: You were able to repair this sword so perfectly... Your skills are truly amazing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/029: [Paz]/nHahaha! This little thing is nothing! No matter what sword it is, just bring it and I guarantee that it will be improved by one hundred and twenty percent! Pendragon's barisada, anything, just bring it! Hahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/030: (Did this person really live in seclusion because he was despairing of the world...)/nThank you, Mr. Paz. I will never forget this kindness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/032: Before, I was also a well-known swordsmanship expert...

In particular, the SP-7 "Blitz" and PSX-9 "Armada" used by the Knights are both extremely outstanding swords. However, it is extremely difficult to obtain these standard swords in the empire.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/007: The injury is serious. Treatment must begin immediately. Come over here quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/008: However, how could such a young child be shot?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/009: Their parents were killed by the lord's soldiers, and the children were shot...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/010: Not even sparing such a young child...How can you be so cruel...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/011: By the way... I seem to have seen you in Port Cyreps...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/012: No, I have no impression. You probably have the wrong person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/015: When can the children be discharged from the hospital?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/016: Ah, I should be able to wake up tomorrow morning. But it will take a while to fully recover...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/017: Then we'll take our leave. The children will be picked up later.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/022: Hey, cheer up. Where did Esmeralda go?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/023: is yesterday's guest...! Please, please save Esmeralda, okay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/024: Viscount Ramon? Why did he want to arrest her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/025: He insisted that she relied on the power of the devil to heal people, and absurdly framed her as a witch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/026: What, why would he do this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/027: Viscount Ramon...has always been in love with Esmeralda, courted her many times, but was always rejected, so he holds a grudge.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/029: Cyrano, we must defeat Ramon immediately and rescue Esmeralda. This kind of abuse of power and oppression of innocent people cannot be tolerated!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/032: No matter what method I use, I will rescue her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/033: Silver, broke into Vicomte Ramon's mansion directly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/035: Now we still need to make some more preparations.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/036: It's not too late to observe Ramon's movements before attacking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/039: Thankfully you did a good job in first aid. You should be able to rest assured now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/042: Your name is Cyrano, right? /30dHave we met before?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/044: Ah, I remembered. In the city of Cyreps...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/045: This...did you admit the wrong person?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/046: You helped me before in the city of Cyreps, no, in the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/047: That's right, Cyrepus. That was two years ago, right? /30d It's great that you have recovered.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/048: What, you two have known each other for a long time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/049: Anyway, let's say goodbye today and come back tomorrow morning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/050: Ah, where is the treatment fee...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/051: Okay, come back next time, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/052: Have you ever been to Serreps two or three years ago?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/053: I've just been to Sylapse once recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/054: Anyway, Esmeralda, let's take our leave and come back tomorrow morning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/058: What happened? What happened to Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/059: What exactly happened? Tell me slowly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/060: Viscount Ramon...Viscount Ramon's soldiers rushed in and captured Esmeralda...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/061: Viscount Ramon, the lord here? Why would he want Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/000: Clausewitz, there is something I must say!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/002: Our Zephyr Falcon is being used as a puppet by that guy Cyrano. I can't stand it anymore!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/003: What are you talking about, Brother Meditch!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/004: Kana, you should also recognize the reality. He just uses us as a tool to avenge himself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/005: Meditch said this was Cyrano's personal grudge, but his goal was to overthrow Cardinal Cesare after all. Don't forget, this is in line with our goals at Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/006: Damn it, you are all talking for Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/007: I probably shouldn't interrupt, but I think Cyrano is just misunderstood.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/008: Whether it is a misunderstanding or not, if this continues, I would rather quit the West Wind Falcon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/009: Me too! Either Cyrano leaves, or we both give up. Take your pick!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/011: Meditch is my lifelong benefactor. However, without the help of the Zephyr Falcon, I might not be able to catch Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/014: I don't want the Falcon of the West Wind to be divided because of me. /40d I quit the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/016: If you can figure it out, Cyrano. It seems you are not as stubborn as I thought.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/017: If Cyrano wants to leave.../30d I will go too! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/018: Kana, in that case, it would be meaningless for me to quit the Falcon of the West Wind. /50d I hope you can respect my decision.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/020: Esmeralda, what are you going to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/021: Of course I will follow Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/022: Mr. Cyrano, I'm really sorry. I didn't expect things to turn out like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/023: It's just going back to the way it was before I joined, military advisor, you don't have to worry too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/024: I wish you all can realize your ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/025: I think Meditch is wrong. /40d I can't quit the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/027: Indeed, what Mr. Meditch said is too much. But it is definitely not what we want for Lord Meditch and Lord Rhidelhard to withdraw from the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/028: Inappropriate! No hope! ! /40d Stop talking nonsense, I have long disliked you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/029: Without Brother Meditch, do you think we could be as strong as we are today!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/030: No need to say more, Rhidelhard. Those who choose Cyrano stay, and those who choose me follow me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/031: This is really the latecomers squeezing out the first comers!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/035: Isabele, do you want to come with us too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/036: No.../30d I want to stay here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/038: I want to see what you can accomplish without us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/039: Okay, no time to delay. We must go to the underwater city as soon as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/040: The underwater city, isn't it one of the seven wonders near Cyreps? Why go there...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/042: According to the "Secret Records of the Creation War", the seal of the last God of Destruction still remains there. He must want to break the seal and resurrect the God of Destruction.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/043: Understood, Mr. Cyrano. I will move the main force near the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/044: Cyrano, where are you going next?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/045: Well... let's go back to Gesir City first... I think I can find some forgotten things there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/047: Esmeralda, it turns out you already knew.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/049: As long as you go there, you will definitely be able to find some forgotten things.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/000: Wait, Cesare.../30d You can't escape this time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/005: Sorry, Cyrano. /30d We can no longer sit back and watch your acts of destruction. /30d Please put away your sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/006: In order to stop me, have even Beafrost joined forces? /30d Haha, that's ridiculous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/007: Come on, stop me if you can!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/009: What did you say, Silver? The two of us can defeat them if we work together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/010: But there is no time. /30dIf you delay here, your long-cherished wish may not come true.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/012: Yes, /20d So please go chase Cesare and realize your long-cherished wish.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/014: Your long-cherished wish is also my long-cherished wish. /30d As long as you can get what you want, I will be satisfied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/016: How long will you keep mumbling! /30d If you refuse to put down your sword, prepare to die!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/017: Cyrano is not the person who should fight you people. /30d I am enough to deal with you all by myself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/018: Are you determined to fight to the end? /30d Okay, I want to see how long you can last!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/019: Come on, you troublemakers! /30d You can kill me, but you must not hinder Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/000: Thank you for giving me a ride.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/002: Are you planning to head to the old empire territory from here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/003: Gasir. /15d So, there is no need for a boat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/004: You all heard it! He no longer needs a boat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/005: Then we can continue to be pirates...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/006: From now on, you can do whatever you want. /20d Continue to be a pirate as before, /10d use the saved capital to do business, /10d or go to the countryside to farm...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/007: I am really happy these days. /20d I hope everyone can stay safe and live a good life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/008: Boss~What are you talking about? /20dWhy do you even seem to be saying goodbye?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/009: Please look after that foolish youngest brother of mine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/011: The happy times I experienced with my boss... I will never forget them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/012: The boss is leaving... It seems we should quit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/013: Then, let's just say goodbye. /20d There will always be a day when we meet again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/014: Boss, I wish you all the happiness in the future, and be sure to take care!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/015: Hehe, I still feel uneasy if I really have to leave those stupid guys behind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/016: I have no such plan. /15d I am not the kind of person who makes up his mind and then regrets it easily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/017: If you don't want to, there's no need to force yourself to come. By sending me to Cyreps, you have fulfilled your original agreement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/018: Really.../30d/nThen I'll leave it to you from now on.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/020: Let's go through the Trixis Desert first and go near Gesir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/021: It turns out that the person the boss has been waiting for is that person...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/022: He always said that he would wait for someone who could defeat him, and he finally found him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/023: Sigh... With the boss's skills, I thought he would never be able to find him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/024: Then who are those of us who have been following the boss?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/025: What else can it be~/15d extra people...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/028: Forget it, I still have plenty of capital anyway, so let's just go do business...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/001: Hmph! The evil lord who oppresses the poor people! We, the Falcon of the West Wind, are here to judge you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/002: Guard, guard! Catch them quickly... arrest them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/003: Haha, do you think there are still guards? All the guards nearby have been dealt with long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/008: Being cheated, what does it mean?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/009: This man is definitely not Reuben.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/010: Is he a substitute found by Ruben?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/011: As you said, this man is just Ruben's puppet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/012: But how do you recognize it? In my opinion, he is Ruben?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/013: Absolutely not. Even if he turns into bones, I will still recognize him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/014: Silver, we don't have time to waste here. Go after that guy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/015: Can you guess where he escaped?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/016: That guy won't abandon his territory and run away too far. He must have gone to ask the nearby lord for help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/020: The next step should have nothing to do with the Falcon of the West Wind...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/021: Ruben has abandoned his territory and fled. Hasn't the goal of the West Wind Falcon been achieved?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/029: I know...I know. /10d/nGo wherever you like. It has nothing to do with me anyway.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/032: Fake uncle, what's wrong with you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/034: Uncle, stop dangling in front of my eyes and go home quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri01/000: The road is at your feet. /n----Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri01/001: There is such a cave under the city...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s03/000: [Diablo]/nHehehe, if you let me reveal my true form for the first time in hundreds of years, you can't even think of leaving alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/001: Damn it, the power of the church continues to expand to the entire Gesil, but it is us businessmen who are suffering.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/002: Those people in the church do nothing but point fingers all day long. The more they watch, the more irritated they become.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/003: The mayor has a bad relationship with the captain bound for Dacama. Didn't we have a big quarrel not long ago?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/004: Even if you are a wolf, you have to wear sheep's clothing. This is the ability to survive in this world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/005: The more people who hold hatred against the church, the more people will naturally defect to the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/006: The mayor's official residence is the first house after entering the west area of the city. Will that place also become the target of Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/007: Recently? I simply can't live anymore. Prices keep rising, and thieves are everywhere...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/008: It's not making any money in the first place, but the church actually has to charge more donations.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/009: He often had a drink in the tavern next to the Granada store. As a politician, he has no airs and is easy to talk to.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/010: Bandits have become rampant in the desert recently, making this business increasingly difficult to do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/011: The desert is getting harder and harder, and the prices of goods are also rising. As long as you can get through it, you can make a lot of money.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/012: Mayor Charles in the mayor's mansion at the west entrance of the city heard that he was also from the desert caravan.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/013: It's wrong to think it's just desert bandits. Pirates out there today are worse than ever!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/014: It's not all caused by those damn Tu'er people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/015: Unless Mayor Charles, who lives in the mayor's mansion on the west side of the city, tightens security, this will always be the case!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/016: Dacama? Aren't all the pirates from all over the world gathered there now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/017: I heard that pirates had to run for their lives when they encountered a Tuer warship. How did Pendragon end up fighting those guys?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/018: Control the pirates of Dacama and you can rule the entire ocean. Pirates have been talking about this recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/019: How many years has it been since Rashid III, the son of Rashid II who is currently the most promising successor, left the royal city of Pendragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/020: The Pendragon royal family is known for their love of traveling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/021: Rashid III? He is the only grandson of Robin and King Rashid, so it is not surprising that he has the full support of the King.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/022: You don't know Robin, do you? She was King Rashid's first wife, and it is said that she was also the woman he loved most.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/023: King Rashid ignored the status gap and the unanimous opposition of his ministers, and insisted on marrying Robin as his official wife.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/024: I heard that Queen Robin and King Rashid met when the king embarked on an adventure to rebuild Pendragon when he was young, and they fell in love like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/026: The most suitable place for doing business in Gesir is indeed Dhakama. When the old empire was still around, this place was pretty good...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/027: I really miss the days when the empire was still there. At that time we also had hope, ambition, and everyone was full of energy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/028: Of course, no one could have imagined at that time that a force like the church would become as rampant as it is today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/029: Oh, oh? You are such a charming person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/030: Do you know the legend that the dragon on Huolong Mountain wakes up once every thousand years?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/031: Don't know? Of course! Because I just made it up.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/032: The nearby Lake Cyreps, with its underwater city, is famous for its legends and beauty.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/033: Ah... The place where my man proposed to me was also by the lake where I could see the underwater city... I was really happy then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/034: Now whenever I think of that scene, I still blush, hahaha.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/035: Mom talks about dad all day long.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/036: What's so good about a father who abandons us and runs away!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/037: When I grow up, I will never be like my father!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/038: Oh, is this your first time here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/039: What, did something good happen to you? It's all written on his face. It says "I am the happiest person in the world".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/040: Hehehehe! You must have a great lover! Ah...that's great. If I were still at that age...please tell me, what kind of person is he?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/041: Although she is my wife, she is too talkative...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/042: How on earth can that mouth keep talking non-stop? I really can't understand...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/043: Go and look up the Mandarin dictionary.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/044: My sister-in-law talks a little too much. That's what everyone says. But she's very kind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/045: Okay, okay. I took a step back and admitted that my sister-in-law not only talks a lot, but also often makes mistakes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/046: Got it, got it. If I hadn't had to live here to earn a living...if it were me, I wouldn't be able to live with someone like my sister-in-law.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/047: I know that sometimes my mother talks a little too much, but can't you be considerate of this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/048: How can a woman who takes care of the house relieve stress if she is not even allowed to chat?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/049: No matter what others say, my mother is still my mother...I can't scold her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/050: Hmph! Who are they and why do they look down on me? I think back when the Black Prince was still around, I was a well-known figure in the Imperial Army!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/051: If the Black Prince was still alive, how could this place be like this! Woohoo...His Royal Highness the Black Prince...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/052: Our master is not in his right mind. A little confused.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/053: However, working here is quite easy. You can take your time...The most important thing is that you will be given more money.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/054: The maid in the old man's house nearby doesn't have a good reputation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/055: I heard that the maid has bad conduct, especially she deceives her master...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/056: Standing here like this, you will recall the days you have traveled along the way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/057: I have been to a place called Pretoria near Inferno.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/058: In the mountains nearby, I can feel a strange aura. It's the same thing in the cave...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/059: Although Cyreps is located on the outskirts of the old empire's territory, it is actually easy to hear news from all over the place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/060: Traveling around the territory of the old empire is equivalent to walking over mountains and forests all day long.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/061: Although there are no plains, we can still maintain our livelihood by relying on those relatively complete trade routes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/062: I don't know who will be elected mayor of Cyreps City this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/063: Will Miss Ruth finally win in her fourth bid, or will Mr. Charles continue to be re-elected?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/066: Hmm... The current mayor, Charles, is a nuisance, but Miss Ruth, who is running for office this time, is quite nice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/067: Mayor Charles's mansion is located near the Granada Store. However, I don't want to see him. Really, not at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/068: Hmm...the two candidates have very different personalities. Miss Ruth liked to talk to people in the pub, but Mr. Charles always stayed in his home near Granada.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/072: This house appears to be unoccupied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/073: Guest, you can't come in from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/074: Ah! Are you Rashid Pendragon? come over! Let you taste my sword!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/076: I...will leave this world soon. Now that I'm leaving, what are you doing with the jewelry?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/078: Take this gem and make good use of it... Then, goodbye, handsome gentleman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/079: I waited for him to leave for seven years. Now, I'm going to die...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/080: I really hope that the thieves will visit the mayor's residence in the first house after the west entrance of the city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/081: He betrayed me. He obviously said that I am his only love in the world, but yesterday he married another woman, who used to be my friend. I...am I still worth living? All that's left for me now is death... I want to take a good rest.
