Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/096: Swords can be distinguished both by size and characteristics.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/097: For example, attack swords and defensive swords built for specific purposes fall into the latter category. The attack sword completely abandons other properties and only enhances the attack power; the defensive sword does not consider the attack power and is designed for defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/098: The offensive swords are represented by Kassandra and Gram, and the defensive swords are represented by Chrysaor Gillian and the Half-Hand Sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/099: [Member of Tactics Research Society]/nBattle consists basically of attack and defense. Both are greatly affected by weapons. The mechanics of attack and defense are as follows.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/100: [Member of the Tactics Research Association]/nLet's talk about attack first. Attacks depend on the attacker's strength and weapon attack power. The higher the two, the higher the overall attack power will naturally be. Hit judgment is closely related to the hit rate of the attacker's weapon. When using firearms, the hit rate is determined by the "gun" and the attack power is determined by the "bullet".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/101: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/n Defense is more complicated... There will be others who can explain it to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/102: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nI will explain defense. After the attack hits and the enemy's attack power is determined, it is necessary to determine whether the defense is successful. The defense rate, which determines the probability of success, is provided by the weapon equipped by the defender. If the defense fails, it will directly bear the enemy's attack; if the defense is successful, it will enter the calculation of weapon defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/103: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nAfter successful defense, first reduce the enemy's attack power by the /3c percentage/5c corresponding to the defender's weapon defense power, and then apply the remaining attack power to the defensive weapon. If this value is lower than the weapon's limit, the defender will not be injured, which means the HP will remain unchanged. For example, if the enemy's attack power is 1000 and the weapon's defense power is 30, 30% will be deducted first, leaving 700 for the weapon. If the weapon limit is 800, I won't take any damage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/104: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nHowever, if the attack power applied to the defensive weapon exceeds its limit, the attack will penetrate the weapon. At this time, the HP of the defensive weapon is reduced by 1 point (if the HP of the defensive weapon drops to 0, the weapon will be damaged and disappear), and the damage suffered by the defender is equal to the attack power of the weapon minus the weapon's limit value.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/105: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nWant to learn about magic? The attack power of magic depends on the attack power of the magic itself and the intelligence of the caster, of which intelligence is particularly important. The same kind of magic will also have a huge power gap due to the different intelligence of the user. Of course, there are also minimum intelligence requirements for using magic. If you lack intelligence, you cannot cast it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/106: [Member of the Magic Research Association]/nAll magic has its own attributes, which are divided into five types: fire, thunder, water, darkness, and light. If the enemy monster also has one of these five attributes, the damage will be calculated differently. Please refer to the manual for details...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/107: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nOf course, you can't cast magic without MP. There are also people whose MP will not increase no matter what.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/109: ----Celepos City Guide----/nGranada Business Group: West of the City/nMayor's Residence: West of the City
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/110: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHave you clearly understood attack and defense? So, let me briefly introduce the types of swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/111: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nThere are four types of swords, among which the rapier and the heavy sword are particularly important. The rapier has strong attack power, but low defense and is easily damaged, so it is more dangerous to use it at a low level. Although it is easy to defeat the enemy, your own HP is also depleted quickly and the maintenance cost is high.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/112: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nThe heavy sword has high defense and is not easily damaged. The disadvantage is that the attack power is low. However, if you don't bring a heavy sword with you, you may not be able to continue fighting after all the rapiers are damaged.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/113: ----Swords by type----/n rapier: thin-edged dagger, stabbing sword, saber/n epee: Roman dagger, swordbreaker/n/n Swordsmanship Research Society under the Imperial Academy

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/005: Our West Wind Falcon has high morale now, but the enemy seems to be getting stronger.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/009: Before joining Zephyr Falcon, I did some petty theft in Caracas. However, now I have completely given up on it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/010: Hmph... That guy said he was done with it. Even if he said the sun rises from the east, I wouldn't believe it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/011: The things that have been lost in the barracks recently, you can definitely see this guy taking them out and selling them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/012: Our West Wind Falcon has gained a reputation far and wide, and our morale is even higher.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/013: Now, we are no longer just Avengers or righteous thieves, but an organization that will bring change to this empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/014: Ron's Lord Frederick's troops are the opponents I least want to encounter. Their elite archers aimed accurately and shot steadily, and their swordsmen were also very skilled.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/015: Seriously, if other lords were like him, there would be no need for us to exist. Isn't it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/016: I joined here because my whole family was killed. Moreover, it was the lord who took action...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/017: I have always lived only for revenge. If even this thought disappears, I will have no reason to live...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/018: As the reputation of the Falcon of the West Wind becomes more and more famous, all parties have more and more restrictions on us. This can be considered a problem at the moment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/019: Perhaps our reputation has exceeded our actual strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/020: Occasionally, strange sounds can be heard in the tavern. I obviously didn't drink much wine either...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/021: Sometimes it feels like there's something hidden on the other side of the pub...Isn't it weird?

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/023: We women are also members of the West Wind. There is no distinction between men and women. The clearest example is that half of the commanders are women.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/027: After searching for a long time, I found out that those things were actually being bought and sold on the black market in the military depot.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/000: Long time no see, Sir Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/001: Prince Rashid... I haven't seen him for three years. Has it been so long?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/002: It seems you are running the empire well. /30d is really admirable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/003: Without Mr. Meditch's help, I'm afraid it would be difficult to do it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/004: Ah, Mr. Meditch...I see. I hope Mrs. Meditch is okay too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/005: Isabele is also very good. She also helped me a lot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/006: The Frederick family and the Meditch family... Now that the Empire seems to have finally entered stability, I feel relieved.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/007: In fact, Prince Rashid laid the foundation for what we are today. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/008: I... No, you are exaggerating. I may have contributed a little, but I didn't fully contribute, so I'm not qualified to accept your thanks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/009: The person who should really be remembered and grateful is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/011: Yes, Cyrano Bernstein. He is the benefactor of the two leaders of the Empire today, and he is also the one who makes us understand something...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/012: He made the ultimate sacrifice and truly became the founder. I will never forget his legacy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/014: When will you return to Pendragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/015: No plans yet. I want to go back to my hometown before the war breaks out again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/016: I also stopped by my father's grave to have a look...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/018: Yes, I haven't been back for about fifteen years. And when I left there, the war was still going on, so it must have changed a lot now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/019: Then, I'm afraid it will be a few years before we meet again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/020: How many years do I have to promise? But Ashuro, who was originally an empire, is now in my custody, so one day we will see each other again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/021: During this period, I will work hard to build a stronger empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/022: Since it is Christina Frederick, she will definitely live up to my expectations.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/000: After all, Gesir City was once the capital of the old empire. Even if its former glory is gone, the taxes collected are not a small amount.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the chief hero of the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/002: Geisir Cathedral was completed more than ten years ago. I remember it was a huge project that took a very long time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/003: Since this place became a church territory, no religious trials have been held.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/005: Miss Sharon's most recent performance was held here, in Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/006: The sister who lives next door to my house is a little strange. Sometimes he is very gentle, and sometimes he becomes very irritable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/007: Thieves have been rampant in the desert recently. As a result, I almost died several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/008: People who live in hot places mostly have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/010: In the year when Geisir Cathedral was completed, the Bernstein family, which contributed the most to the project, was exterminated. It is really ironic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/011: There is a road in the nearby forest that leads to a cave where legendary dragons once lived.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared in this area...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/013: Below Geysir Cathedral, there is an underground waterway built in the past.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/014: I heard that the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe has temporarily subsided recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/015: However, both the underground waterway and the dragon's lair are just rumored places, and no one knows whether they exist or not.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/016: I heard that the science and technology of the Tur people are far beyond our imagination.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/017: That sister seems to have had a strange personality since she was a child...my mother said so.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/019: The destruction of the Bernstein family may have been doomed long ago. That family is incompatible with Lord Cesare's ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/021: I heard from several aunts that she became like that after she was treated roughly by her stepfather. I asked what was going on, but was scolded severely...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/023: Do you know the musician Mr. Nikacha? He was popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/024: Gasir City is now ruled by Cardinal Cesare and is of course also a church territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/026: Gesir here is a city that can make people feel that it is declining day by day. The most obvious thing is that the population has not increased.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/027: Why? Compared with other cities, the church power in Gesil City is far less domineering...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/028: People in Gesir City keep moving away. Could it be because the city itself has lost its vitality?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/029: Pendragon and the Tur tribe have been at war for a long time. It is said that the only thing that can block the powerful firepower of the Tu'er tribe is numerical superiority.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/030: I heard that in the face of Pendragon's numerical offensive, the Tur tribe's attack also slowed down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/031: General Sander is a retired soldier. Recently moved to Geysir City. Usually retired soldiers go to Ron, the "City of Soldiers"...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/032: General Sander has four daughters, and I heard that all of them are beauties.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/033: The general seemed to have a bad temper when he was a soldier. I heard that I still retain a bit of the temper I once had...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/034: General Sander's family often holds banquets and is very famous. General Sander is undoubtedly a man well suited to this city of ancient traditions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/035: You must also go to General Sander's banquet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/036: There are often many people gathering at his home. General Sander seemed to have many acquaintances everywhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/037: Well, if you still like adventure, it would be a good idea to go look for that cave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/038: When I was a child, I often looked for dragon caves everywhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/039: A long time passed after that, but no news of her performance was heard again. Why exactly?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/040: I really want to watch the performance of my idol Sister Sharon again... Is it true that she is quitting the music industry as the rumors say?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/041: As a member of the garrison of Gesil City, the proudest moment is the annual military parade.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/042: While marching on the streets of Gesir, I can really imagine what the military parade was like when the Black Prince was alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/043: Of course, the current strength is far from being compared to the grand occasion of commanding the entire Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/044: The security in Gesil City is quite good.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/045: The influence of bad forces such as the West Wind Falcon is still very weak here, so you can rest assured about the security of Gesil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/046: The most turbulent period for public security was when the Bernstein family was destroyed more than ten years ago. At that time, the remnants of the Bernstein family had been resisting...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/047: I was a soldier wearing the Bernstein family crest. I was on vacation ten years ago when my family collapsed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/048: When I heard that the young master of the Bernstein family was going to undergo a religious trial, I immediately rushed back to Gesir City, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/049: By then, it was all over. That was the greatest shame of my military career. When all my comrades were wiped out, I was not on the battlefield...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/050: I am a mage who studies magic at Lord Iscariot's academy. In order to search for information, I just returned from the Dakama Port in Pendragon territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/051: After going to Da Cama Port, I realized that Pendragon's economy was already quite difficult. It seems that the war with the Tu'er people is indeed difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/052: At this time, if the power of our empire can unite... Alas... His Highness the Black Prince...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/053: General Sander? My brother likes his third daughter. His daughters are all beautiful, but General Sander is not good-looking...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/054: The mother of those sisters must be a great beauty, right? But to be honest, I don't like that General Sander.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/055: My brother is a doctor. And when I say this, he laughs at me, "What do kids know?" But I think I'm good at seeing people. Sooner or later, my brother will suffer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/056: [Dustin]/nI am a doctor. Not long ago, I fell in love with General Sander's third daughter, Priscilla.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/057: [Dustin]/nBut not long ago, I saw Priscilla was arrested on suspicion of taking drugs. Although she was released with the guarantee of my identity as a doctor...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/058: [Dustin]/nPriscilla must have been bewitched by the bad guy! Is there any way I can help her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/059: If there is any shortcoming of our boss, it is that he is almost obsessed with desserts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/060: This store was passed down from the owner's family. The current boss doesn't seem to care about the store as much as the previous one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/061: My father's interests are actually not suitable for running a weapons store. His favorite thing is cooking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/062: The person manning the counter now is my father's cousin. My father is temporarily away on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/063: Really! My son has no affection at all for this time-honored brand that has been passed down from generation to generation! I think about eating all day long...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/064: Do you know the Fire Dragon Cave that Lord Kars sealed after slaying the dragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/065: I heard that the Fire Dragon Cave is to the south of this city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/066: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome. This hotel provides the cleanest and most attentive service. The accommodation fee is 80Eld. Want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/067: Thank you, please have a good rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/068: Welcome to visit us next time. We always provide the best quality service.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/069: Thank you for staying at our hotel. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/070: [Mr. Oldfield] Welcome! Here are the best weapons in the world! Please take your pick!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/072: Good weapons can save lives in critical moments. Welcome to visit us next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/073: [Mrs. Oldfield]/nWelcome. I help my husband run the business and am responsible for selling firearms.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/075: Thank you for purchasing our products.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/076: [Raymond]/nWelcome, we only deal in the best products! You might as well buy one and try it first!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/079: There is a dragon cave nearby, and occasionally people will bring out precious ancient treasures from inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/080: However, since it is being passed in everywhere and will never come back, you'd better not go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/081: [Mr. Durant, Merchant]/nCome, come, come, sell the leftover goods at a cheap price!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/083: Thank you, thank you. Next time I go to Dhakama, I will bring back better products to repay you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/084: Hmph, Durant is not sold cheaply, so I have the nerve to say it is on clearance!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/085: I am traveling in search of enlightenment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/086: Not long ago, under the Bodhi tree, a mysterious light said to me: "Let's go."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/087: I will not go back until I have enlightenment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/088: Today's young people have no energy at all! From this point of view, Lord Frederic of Ron is a role model for young people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/089: Would you delay your own affairs because of other people's affairs? The most important thing in the world is to satisfy yourself. When people live, they have to satisfy themselves.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/090: Speaking of this, I live too indulgently... I really miss my hometown of Pretoria...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/091: Recently, Iscariot's Imperial Academy seems to be studying the limits of magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/092: I know who you really are. You think I'm old enough to live?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/093: You are the one looking at the monitor and clicking the mouse. He is a traveler drifting along time, isn't he...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/094: Do you know the legend of Gesir House?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/095: Ten years ago, the Bernstein family lived in that mansion. But later, that family was wiped out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/096: No one has lived in it since. The reason is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/097: Are there an unusually large number of merchants traveling around recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/098: More and more families were forced into bankruptcy by lords from various places, and many people had no choice but to work as merchants to make ends meet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/099: But the situation in Gesil City is pretty good... I'm really lucky.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/100: It's silly to always think that there must be something hidden in the basement and run down to look for it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/102: Business has been really hard recently. I don't know where all the money in people's hands has gone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/103: Even Gesir City, which is said to be in better condition, is like this... How can other places be so good?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/104: The economy was not like this when the Black Prince was alive. Look what it's like now!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/105: The empire must be reunified! The only person who can do this is our Cardinal Cesare!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/106: Hmph... If you want to appreciate my beauty, you can't do it in a bright place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/107: That way you can see my makeup.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/108: In short, you must not believe what the businessman says!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/109: On my day off today, I returned to my hometown of Gesir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/110: My troops are stationed on the other side of Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/111: I have a friend on duty here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/112: The door to this house is locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/114: [Ancestor of Bors]/nYou broke into a room you shouldn't have entered. If you want to leave, answer the following questions correctly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/120: [Ancestor of Bors]/nYou are not qualified to own a long sword! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/121: [Ancestor of Bors]/nI will let you get out of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/122: [Boers' Ancestors]/nIn the name of our family, you may leave this room. Please take care of Boles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/123: [Soldier]/nAs a warrior, the most important thing is of course physical strength! Run around the city three times and you will be given two brass gems; run ten times and you will be given a diamond gem! However, once you leave this area, you have to start all over again! Let's go!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/125: [Soldier] OK! Already passed the south gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/126: [Soldier] OK! Already passed the east gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/127: [Soldier] OK! Already passed the north gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/128: [Soldier] Good job! Completed one lap! continue!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/129: [Soldier] All ten laps completed! Come here! Give you a prize!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/130: [Soldier]/nVery good! Finally looking a bit like a soldier! This is for you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/132: Okay, you've graduated now! Don't forget to continue to exercise in the future!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/133: The forests in the old empire are now so dense that you need to draw a map when traveling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/134: The central square of the great city Gesil City
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/136: [Soldier] Completed three laps! Come here now and I'll give you two brass gems! Keep running, there are other prizes!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/140: [Soldier] has completed five laps. Come here now and I will give you the brass gem!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/141: [Soldier]/nThe foundation of a soldier is, after all, physical strength! Never forget to exercise!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/142: [Soldier]/nOnce you get out, you have to run all over again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/010_3: In the year when Geisir Cathedral was completed, the Bernstein family, which contributed the most to the project, was exterminated. This cannot be said to be ironic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/066_3: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome. This hotel provides the cleanest and most attentive service. Want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/112_3: The house appears to be empty.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/000: /2c Falcon of the West Wind. War meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/001: An emergency has occurred. /10d/nAt the request of Cardinal Cesare, the Bifrost Army sent troops again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/002: Those guys haven't learned enough lessons yet. This time I will completely defeat them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/003: This invasion is not that easy to deal with.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/004: It is said that they will invest in the first-level magical machine, Ascalon, which was successfully discovered not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/006: The first-level magic machine has a decisive impact on morale and combat effectiveness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/007: Facing this kind of opponent, conventional tactics will not work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/009: I suggest sending troops to Manticorea Peak, where the enemy's main line is stationed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/011: Organize an elite team and capture the enemy headquarters in one fell swoop, and you will have a good chance of winning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/012: Even so...who will deal with Ascalon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/013: Please don't worry about this. /nI have prepared several response plans.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/014: Moreover, this operation will be the last battle of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/015: The success or failure of this operation is related to the survival of Bifrost, the Church Alliance, and the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/017: Everyone, we lost too many comrades in the last battle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/019: Ah, there is also a sword to give to Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/022: "Armada"? Isn't that the next-generation standard sword Pendragon is testing in secret?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/023: That's right. This is Chrysaor's new sword, a contender to succeed the "Blitz" you received earlier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcd3/000: Go up and Chapter 13 will begin! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss01/000: <<Dragon Attack Operation>>/nSneak behind enemy lines and cut off supply lines!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss01/001: On the orders of Mr. Clousewitz, I came to deliver the goods. Of course, it's not free.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss01/003: For the glory of the empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro10/000: << Warning >>/nThis underground maze is extremely dangerous and civilians are prohibited from entering/n----Lord Ron
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/003: Actually... Ron sent a letter addressed to you, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/005: No. /20d is from the widow of General Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/008: After all, this is a letter written to you, Mr. Cyrano, so I still report it to you.../50d But I think you don't need to pay too much attention to the content of the letter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/010: How could it be? However, under the current circumstances, it is not difficult to guess the content of the letter sent by Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/011: Moreover, if it were written by General Frederick's widow, it would either be extremely emotional or very short and cold. Nothing more than these two, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/014: /2cDear Cyrano/n/n/n/n/n/nI will wait for you in Ron's living room. /n/n/n/n/n/nMercedes Frederick
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/017: ...Mr. Cyrano. /30d Although I don't know what past grudges you have with the Fredericks, this invitation is undoubtedly a trap.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/019: Mr. Cyrano, please think calmly! /30dNo one can guarantee that she will really be there waiting for you! This must be Cesare's trick!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/020: I'm calm now. /nClausewitz, if you knew how I survived until now, you would understand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/021: Even if I lose everything I have, I have to go there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/025: ...Give me some time to think about it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/027: .../30d Got it. I will await your informed judgment, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/028: Mercedes....../30d Silver, Kana and Esmeralda who can always follow me......
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/030: For me, Mercedes is the most important.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/031: Can't leave without saying goodbye to Silver.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/034: Don't think about anything else. The most important thing now is to see Mercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/035: Even if this is Cesare's trap...even if the cost is my life, I must see her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/037: Silver....../40d That's right, she has been following me to this day. I can't leave without even saying goodbye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/038: She will definitely stop me. But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/042: I can't let you go there alone, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/044: Why...why did you leave me? If you go there, you won't be able to come back safely!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/045: It's because I know this that I can't take you with me, Silver.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/046: So far...you have followed me faithfully. As a woman... you must have suffered a lot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/047: What are you talking about...what are you talking about. Do you really want to leave me alone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/048: Indeed... I went there, and it would probably be difficult to come back safely. Moreover, even if I come back, I am not qualified to restrain you anymore.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/050: This is the final order, Silver. /30dDon't stop me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/051: I cannot obey such an order!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/052: If you are going to see that woman no matter what.../40d Then just step over my corpse!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/054: Even if you slash me with your sword, I will go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/056: Even if you slash me with your sword, I must go. I live to this day just to see her again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/060: Kana... I'm afraid I'll never see her again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/061: No, maybe it is for her own good that I should leave her side.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/065: I heard that you received a letter from Frederick's widow and planned to see her. Is it true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/067: Why...you knew it was a trap and you walked into it, Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/068: Because that's what keeps me alive today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/073: If...if I let you go there...I wouldn't be able to survive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/076: Move, Kana. I have to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/077: Kana, I listen to you and I won't go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/078: Stop pestering me and get out of my way, Kana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/080: Let go of this meaningless attachment. You get nothing by falling in love with someone like me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/081: Hope you can live a good life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/082: You have gone too far, Cyrano...can't do this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/086: Esmeralda...another person who saved my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/087: But I will never see her again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/088: I didn't expect... you would think of me so much, Silver.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/089: How can I ignore your feelings and only think about myself?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/091: I'm not going, Silver. /30dI will always be with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/092: Please forgive me for being rude!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/094: What are you talking about, Silver? You did that because you were worried about me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/095: Okay, forget about that letter and prepare for the next action quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/100: ...you know where I plan to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/101: Even if I beg you not to go...it's useless, right...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/104: Yes, I have made up my mind. /30d The reason why I am alive today is there, so I have to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/106: Mr. Cyrano...I will pray.../40d for your safe return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/110: I can't die without Esmeralda's permission, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmf05/000: Come on, just leave from here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr108/000: After hearing about the last incident, this place has been blocked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni09/001: Okay, let's sneak into the fortress!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/001: This is the Bifrost Army Logistics Base that Clausewitz mentioned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/005: [Officer Bifrost] /nWhat's worse...the enemy actually hit here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/007: Come on, take this place quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/009: Yes. /nThe enemies seem to have all retreated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/012: It is said that due to the unauthorized actions of Mr. Rhidelhard and Mr. Meditch, our army's supply line has been occupied by the Bifrost Army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/013: He asked Mr. Cyrano and his party to return to our position as soon as possible and retake the supply line.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/015: Could it be that Brother Meditch and Rhidelhard...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/016: Please recapture our supply lines as soon as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/018: The fastest way to our army's supply line is to bypass the mountainous area to the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/019: I am here to deliver supplies on the order of Mr. Clausewitz.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/021: Please recapture our supply lines as soon as possible.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr100/001: What, are you...! /30d Hey, what are you doing! Get him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/000: Today is the young master's engagement day, and everyone in the family is busy preparing for the engagement ceremony.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/001: The young master has always been steady, and I believe he will be able to handle it smoothly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/002: Now the young master is also an adult and wants to become a man responsible for a woman. You must love yourself more from now on than before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/003: Congratulations, brother Cyrano. Being able to marry a wife as beautiful as Sister Mercedes... is really enviable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/004: When I grow up, I also want to marry Lance. By that time, Lance will become an outstanding lady like Sister Mercedes now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/005: Oh, Brother Cyrano, I sincerely congratulate you on your engagement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/006: Can that guy Joel become as outstanding a person as his brother when he reaches his current age?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/007: Today will be the busiest and happiest day in the Bernstein family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/008: We are all excited at the thought of welcoming our beautiful mistress. After Madam's death, the Bernstein family has been in need of a mistress.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/009: Miss Mercedes is not only outstanding in appearance, but also has an excellent education as a lady, isn't she? It is our honor to serve her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/010: Hahaha... Today is such a good day. /20d The young master is finally going to become a real man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/011: I have always found the young master when he plays the piano very charming, but I have never seen such an outstanding young master as he is today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/012: I have never been so happy and moved as I am today.
