Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/002: You don't intend to just let go of the humiliation you suffered last time when you sent troops.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/003: This is a great opportunity to eradicate the rebels and the lords who support them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/005: Also, shouldn't it be time to test the performance of the successfully unearthed Ascalon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/006: Oh, it's really not simple. That matter should be classified as a first-class secret.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/007: What are you still hesitating about? /n/10d As long as you help me unify the empire, I will give up half of the entire empire's territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/009: At this point, there is no choice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/010: As expected of Cardinal Cesare, you always hit the mark.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/011: Okay. In this case, I will mobilize our troops and Ascalon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/012: I will send an envoy to Pendragon and send a letter explaining that the empire has lost control due to the rebellion, and therefore I am requesting assistance from your country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/013: Since it is an internal matter, even Pendragon cannot easily interfere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/014: Haha, even if this were not the case, Pendragon seems to be busy fighting against the Tur tribe recently and may not have time to take care of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr17/000: Do you know what true courage is? /nThe strong man is sure that he will win before he fights the weak man. That is not courage. /nFearing the eyes of the world and deceiving yourself is not courage. /nEven if you know you will lose,/nEven if you are ready to bear the ridicule of the world,/nYou are a real man if you still follow the path that you firmly believe is right. /n/nMay I have a clear conscience until the last day of my life.../n----Imperial Knight Kars
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/003: It is reported that Bifrost... has led an army across the border and entered imperial territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/005: Moreover, Cesare is sending troops this time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/009: The entire army has entered a state of combat readiness! /nWe must not let the Bifrost Army trample on the Empire's land...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/010: Departs at noon tomorrow. /nBe prepared for everything and don't delay.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/012: My father-in-law sent Machiavelli to Bifrost just for this matter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/013: Even so, using foreign power is related to the dignity of the empire! /15d This time we will never tolerate it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/014: This time it will not be tolerated!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/015: The problem is Bifrost's Valkyrie troops...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/016: First, you must send a messenger to find Clausewitz of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/001: This is the legendary summoned beast Unicorn! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/007: I...have no...name. /nJust...in charge of...ice...among the three major elements...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/008: Ice Dragon Zabeel acted together with Holy King Rashid...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/016: That is... the... mark of the summoned beast. /nAs long as... use it... no matter when... I will... help you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/022: Here...is...an extremely cold space. /10d/nEvery time...you breathe...the cells in your lungs...will...gradually...freeze.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/023: This place...is filled with an astonishing chill.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/000: Welcome, Mr. Cyrano. Lady EOLYN ordered us to have a bed ready for you at any time. Want to rest?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/001: Please rest peacefully. Practicing on Storm Island requires adequate rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/002: Don't push yourself too hard when practicing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/003: Did you sleep well? Today is another refreshing day. If you are tired, you can come back anytime.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro00/000: East - Ron Forest/n Northwest - Ron City/n North - Magic Sword Forest
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/000: When crossing the desert, someone must stay vigil while sleeping. Want to take a nap?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/001: Sleep peacefully, we will take care of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/002: Sigh... If you just rush into the desert without sleeping, there will be only a dead end waiting for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/003: Did you sleep well? See you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/004: Welcome. Crossing the desert requires many tools.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/007: Welcome. Crossing the desert requires many tools.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/010: Crossing the desert requires sufficient weapons and courage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/000_3: Resting in the desert, someone must stay vigil while sleeping. Want to take a nap? The price of our hotel is 1500Eld.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/002_3: Sigh...Is it really okay not to sleep? If you are too tired and rush on your way, your life will be in danger...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/006_3: Well, good luck to you in this desert of death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/013: Looking for Lake Cyreps? /n/20d Lake Cyreps is not far to the southeast from here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/014: Go west from here to the Caracas Forest; go southeast to find Serrepos or Lake Serrepos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/015: I heard that the underwater city, one of the seven wonders, is at the bottom of Lake Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/000: This is the village of Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/001: This is a quiet village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/002: I heard that Gesil City is to the south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/009: Have you ever seen Lord Irus wield a sword? That momentum is really amazing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/010: Huh? You guys are very unfamiliar...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/011: David? I heard he was hiding a bad demon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/012: That guy David is really stupid for harboring the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/013:
Maybe it would be better to have a church. Now it seems that everything is at the discretion of Master Ruben.
What did
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/014: No one should have heard it, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/015: Why is there no church in our village? Because Lord Ruben is against the presence of the Church.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/016: Of course, the main religion is also believed in here. However, Lord Reuben said that it is enough for each to have his own faith, and there is no need for a church.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/017: The Inquisition was of course presided over by Lord Reuben himself...Poor David...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/019: Elegance and romance are the real joys of living in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/020: I don't have the hobby of building secret paths everywhere like that guy Ruben.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/021: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/022: I heard that the sun in the desert hangs in the sky for too long and seems to be fixed in one position?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/023: Ramon, the lord of Pretoria, has always been known for his eccentric behavior. But Duke Ruben here is no less generous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/002: That's great, there are so many, and you don't have to worry about military spending for the next ten years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/003: Hahaha, let's see. /10d/nI just said Clausewitz's information was accurate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/004: But even so.../10d is an astonishing amount...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/005: Sister, look at this. /10d There are such beautiful diamonds in the world...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/006: Hehehe...Clausewitz is really not easy. To be able to get a map of a place like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/010: It seems...this batch of treasures has another owner.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/012: Don't be so fierce. If there is something good, shouldn't it be shared with everyone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/013: [Organization Member]/nDamn it! /nThey are treasure thieves, stop them quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/014: Now...what to do now? I'm afraid they will keep coming...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/015: Hmm... As of now, there is nothing we can do...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/016: Take some and get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme02/000: I always feel like I shouldn't go this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/000: Our lord is a really hot-tempered man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the chief hero of the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/002: Our lord is known for his violence, and it would be terrible if he accidentally targets us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/003: My relatives wrote that they have settled in Libreville and I plan to move there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/005: Not long ago, I saw a beautiful woman passing by here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/006: The lord only needs to hunt once, and almost all the animals in the forest will be killed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/010: No one who was captured into the castle came out alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/011: Our Lord of Memphis is very violent. The best thing to do is not let him notice...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/013: Our rice wine tastes very good. Just look forward to it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/014: I heard that the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe has temporarily subsided recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/015: When I save some money, I plan to move to Ron... Although I can't bear to leave my familiar hometown, I have to live on. This place is really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/016: I heard that the science and technology of the Tur people are far beyond our imagination.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/019: He has been making trouble in the village since he was a child...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/023: Do you know the musician Mr. Nikacha? He was popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/026: No need to go there now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/029: Thank you. Hope to see you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/030: Not long ago, someone proposed to me. But one thing bothers me. If you live here, you have to pay wedding tax when you get married...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/031: This used to be a livable village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/032: But since the current lord took over, he has made everyone miserable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/033: Not long ago, the lord said he didn't like it and drove the tailor's family away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/034: I heard that he even beat up the tailor until he was crippled before driving him out. It's really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/035: Not long ago, my marriage proposal was rejected.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/036: The saddest thing is that she married to Libreville in a blink of an eye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/037: None of the girls in our village want to stay. I'm also wondering if I should leave here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/039: I once dreamed of becoming a scholar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/040: It's been about ten years since I came here, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/041: I managed to save my life and escaped here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/045: /nTurn the corner, maybe still waiting,/nA new road, a secret door. /nAlthough I often pass them by,/nBut one day, the time comes,/nI will set foot on the hidden path,/nleading to the west of the moon and the east of the sun.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/047: [Sid]/nIt is indeed you...You are safe and sound, Master.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/048: [Sid]/nI will never regret seeing you again like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/049: It is indeed you, Sid... I heard you were kidnapped before... Are you okay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/050: [Sid]/nKidnapping... Because of the shock at the time, I can no longer remember what happened when I was kidnapped... But, it's okay now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/051: [Sid]/nAh...that's right. Master, there is something that should be returned to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/052: [Sid]/nThis is...the family heirloom sword that I kept for you during the war. Now, it finally meets its owner again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/054: [Sid]/nI hope this sword can help the young master to some extent. So...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/056: [Sid]/nMaster, you must take care of yourself...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/057: [Edros]/nMy wish is to open my own store... What do you want to buy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/059: Thank you for your patronage. When I open a store in the future, I will definitely give you a big discount.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/060: [Aunt Linda]/nAre you feeling uncomfortable somewhere? Then you have to take medicine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/062: If you feel uncomfortable, please tell me anytime!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/063: Sid, who lives in the house on the upper left side of the village, is a somewhat weird person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/064: Always lives alone...and always has a sad look on his face.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/065: The forest seems to be getting denser and denser lately. If most people didn't get lost, why would there be any need to hang road signs?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/066: If you don't want to get lost in the forest, you must follow the road signs carefully.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/067: [B&B owner] Welcome. Our family runs a B&B, so tourists can rest comfortably when they come. Only 80Eld! Want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/069: Hmph...I'm afraid you can't find one cheaper than mine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/070: Be careful on the road. May peace and good luck be with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/033_3: Hey, you said, not long ago the lord drove away the tailor's family because he was dissatisfied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/036_3: Unfortunately, she has already married to Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/037_3: None of the girls in our village want to stay here. I'm also wondering if it's time to leave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/038_3: She is such a beautiful person...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/039_3: I once dreamed of becoming a scholar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/040_3: It's been about ten years since I came here, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/041_3: It was not easy to save a life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/049_3: It's you, Sid. I heard you were kidnapped before...are you okay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/060_3: [Aunt Linda]/nAre you feeling uncomfortable somewhere? Then you have to take medicine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/000: Are you from the Falcon of the West Wind? /30d/nThe Lord has been waiting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/001: Have the others from the Falcon of the West Wind arrived too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/005: Yes, everyone is here except Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/007: It seems that we have to wait for a while before Lord Meditch will arrive. /20d Why not go and meet the owner of this place, Mr. Esther Dodd first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/008: Understood, let's go meet the master.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s2b/000: I always feel like I shouldn't enter here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/000: Finally arrived in the imperial territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/001: What are you going to do next?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/002: First, let's understand what changes have taken place in the empire since I left.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/003: Remember this is the Caracas area.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/005: Hehehe, I've been waiting for you for a long time, Kana Milanovich!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/006: Turns out to be the commander of the Zephyr Falcon, and the harvest is greater than imagined! /30d Surrender now!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/007: Oh no, it really is a trap?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/008: However, the only way to the dukedom is here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/009: Ah! Hey, this way, this way! Attack them from the side!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/010: What, there are accomplices over there too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/011: Okay, don't let anyone go, catch them all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/012: What happened to that girl! /20d actually involves unrelated people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/013: Heh, that girl really dares to take risks.../20d However, since the soldiers are blocking the way, there is no need to avoid them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/015: Hmph, you might as well stab someone first and then say sorry!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/016: This will take care of all the soldiers, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/017: Thank you very much for your help, but I have something urgent and I have to leave first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/019:
What, what a rude girl!
What does
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/020: Forget it, just consider it a welcome from your hometown.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/021: Okay, there should be a small village nearby. /30d Rest there tonight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri13/000: << Thunder Nightmare >>/n/nIn the beginning, chaos reigned. /nA bolt of lightning penetrates it.../nThe demon king who controls thunder and lightning is sealed here. /n/nIn the year 705 of the Ezekiel calendar, the adventurer King Yogged Pain
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/001: This is Paro Village. Although it is geographically close to Gesir City, it is culturally very different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/002: The outside world is noisy, but our village is peaceful and quiet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/003: It's really scary. The most handsome man in the village is mentally ill... not to mention, he has a fiancee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/004: This village is very remote and few people come here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/005: But not long ago, a chef moved here from another place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/006: He said he wanted to look for fresh high-end ingredients and thought the place was clean, so he came here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/007: Before, I was invited to Gesil City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/008: There are wide roads, beautiful buildings, and well-dressed people, which is dazzling to see.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/009: Living in the city... must be much better than living in a rural village like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/010: A small village like ours is more worried about harassment by bandits.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/011: This is all the fault of the Silver Arrow that destroyed our Gesir Empire. If only they hadn't cut off the royal bloodline back then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/012: Although it is a bit late, we should also establish a country or form an alliance! Do we want this chaos to continue?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/013: I knew it! Haven't I always said that Mr. Dan Welling is not a normal person!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/014: Mr. Brian is handsome, rich, smart, and good at sports...how could he be so outstanding!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/015: Ah...I really envy Miss Diana. They must be very happy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/016: Our lord seems to like children. There are many children in the lord's family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/017: However, the strange thing is that they are all girls.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/018: The lord also likes flowers. I heard that there are many flowers growing in the garden.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/019: I also saw Sharon perform. /20d She is such a beautiful sister...she also dances very well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/020: I originally wanted her autograph, but all those big brothers jumped in line, and I didn't get one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/021: If you meet Sharon, can you get an autograph for me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/022: [Dan Welling]/nOur family is a cursed family. /15d I have always opposed my son's marriage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/023: [Dan Welling]/nAfter experiencing these recent events, his son seemed to finally understand what kind of blood he was bleeding. /10d Hey hey hey...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/024: [Dan Welling] /nIn this way, this cursed family will be extinct.../10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm done. To actually do such a terrible thing with my own hands.../20dmarry?/10dWhat a fool I am for holding on to that kind of hope!/15dHahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/026: [Brion Weylin]/nNo need to comfort me. Don't even try to persuade me. /20d All I have left is death...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/028: [Diana] /nThere must be something wrong with this matter.../20d Brian must have misunderstood something!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/030: [Haisen]/nOh, it's Mr. Cyrano. I'm doing fine. Ah, Brian and Diana asked me to say hello to you on their behalf.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/031: [Haisen]/nThat guy Dan... wasn't so weird when he was a kid. At that time, he was cheerful, smart, and good at all sports...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/032: [Haisen]/nNow that I think about it, it's really a pity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/033: It's time for us to build a unified country, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/034: In this current situation of power vacuum, no matter what happens, it will not be surprising...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/035: What's even more shocking is that those fragments were found in the bag in Mr. Xio's room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/036: Welcome. It's hard to say anything else, but the portions in our family are definitely sufficient.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/037: Where is Rashid III, the first in line to the Pendragon throne, hiding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/038: However, King Rashid is still so healthy, and he will not inherit the throne so quickly... If you come to my house one day, I would like to bring more food and drinks...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/039: There is a place near here called Caracas, where my brother Caag owns a restaurant.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/040: That guy's craftsmanship is good, but he pursues perfection too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/041: That guy urged me to find good ingredients for him whenever he had time. Haha...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/042: Hehehe... Do you think there will really be an overlord who controls the empire in the near future?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/043: If you want to become the overlord of the empire, you must have power that can overwhelm Cesare Borgia, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/044: Although there are rumors that someone has pulled out the Asura Sword that can determine the overlord of the empire...but rumors are just rumors after all, aren't they? Hahaha.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/046: I got Sharon's autograph at the last show. Hehehe... I am the only one in our village who has it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/047: No matter how much money you pay, I will not sell it. /15d I want it to be a family heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/048: Hmm... If you can exchange it for something particularly good, you can consider it... such as Asmode's fragments...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/049: Diana is the most beautiful girl in the village. The men of the village admire her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/050: And when she announced that she was going to marry Brian, who was also admired by all the women in the village, she didn't know how much discussion she attracted...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/051: In a sense, no one welcomes this engagement. Except for themselves.../20d They became the object of everyone's envy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/052: Welcome. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/054: Thank you for visiting our store. Walk slowly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/055: Oh my god.../10d This is sister Sharon's signature! /20d Yeah~~~!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/056: This is for me, right? /10d Oh~ I'm so happy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/057: Then I'll give you something too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/059: This is the ring I picked up in the forest not long ago! Very beautiful! /20dThank you for the signature!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/060: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/061: It is said that this flower will only bloom where true love emerges. This is a very precious vanilla. Please keep it properly and give it to my brother for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/063: Want to take a rest? Our host will entertain guests who come to his home. Want to take a nap?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/067: [Paul]/nI got a good weapon this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/069: Then, we will prepare high-quality goods for you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/070: Wanted: Roberto de Meditch/nCharge: arson, homicide. /nReward: 1000000Eld
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/071: Are you going to agree to the girl's request and get Sharon's signature for her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/072: If you meet Sharon, I will definitely ask for your autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/073: Sorry, I'm too busy to help you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/074: Okay, if I meet Sharon, I will definitely ask for your autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/076: Sorry, I'm too busy to help you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/077: Moreover, it only makes sense to get this kind of thing with your own hands. /20d Don't leave it to others, go find Sharon yourself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/078: Ugh...that's too much.../10d I'm still too young to travel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/079: Thank you. /nDon't forget to agree to get my autograph for me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/081: Although it is not prosperous, we can live a peaceful and quiet life, and we are very proud of this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/082: [Brian Welling]/nGet out of the way, go away! Please, leave me alone!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/083: Looking at it from another perspective, doesn't the church power also play a role in maintaining law and order in this regard?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/084: [Brian Waring]/n The first time symptoms appeared was last fall. The night of the village celebration, I got very drunk. /10d After eating and drinking, I was already at home when I woke up. To relieve my hangover headache, I went to the bathroom and found blood on my hands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/085: [Brian Welling]/nI thought I was injured somewhere, so I checked my whole body, but there was no wound at all. But the next day, I heard that a wolf broke into the farm in the village, killed chickens and livestock, and then escaped. /10d But, but, I intuitively knew that it was not a wolf.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/086: [Brian Waring]/nAt first, I convinced myself that it was just a terrible dream. However, the symptoms never stopped.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow, I'm afraid to wake up. Every time I wake up and see my room in a mess, or find my hands covered in blood, I really, really start to fear myself. /10d So scared... /10d So scared... Now, I'm even scared of sleeping itself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/088: [Brian Welling]/nGetting married! Ha ha ha ha! What if I wake up one day and take the lovely Diana with my own hands... No, no, absolutely not! I can't get married. /10d Absolutely not as long as this cursed blood flows within me. Ha...hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/089: [Dan Waring]/n... Mental illness has been in our family for generations. This is the price of incestuous marriage in the past to preserve the bloodline... This kind of bloodline should disappear from the world, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/090: [Diana]/nDo you think Brian is crazy? This is impossible! Just a year ago, it was clear that everything was fine with him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/091: [Diana]/nI met him at Gesir Academy. At that time, I happened to be looking for a quiet countryside, so I moved here. About a year after we got here, we got engaged.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/092: [Haisen]/nBut, Diana. Madness does not occur all the time; it may occur only occasionally.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If he was really, really abnormal, why didn't even the doctor want to see him? Since it is a disease, it can be cured, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/094: [Haisen]/nThat is not a disease that can be cured. It's inherited from their family...Diana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/095: [Diana]/nNo, that's not the case. Absolutely impossible! I, I will definitely cure his disease, no matter what method I use, I will!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/096: The Wellings? That family has been cursed since ancient times. No one in the family died normally.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/097: Let's just say that Mr. Dan's parents have disappeared; his wife lost her life when the boat capsized when they were swimming in the lake with him, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/098: After Mr. Dan's wife died, rumors spread in the village that Mr. Dan pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/099: Is it my son's turn now? How pitiful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/100: It seems that there really is something genetically wrong with that family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/101: You can say that. However, could the real reason be that the family is too rich?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/102: Because you are too rich, you suffer from mental illness?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/103: Rather than say that...their family used to have endless conspiracies over inheritance and inheritance rights. Could it be that those things made people in the family act weird?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/104: Speaking of which, weren't there people who had doubted whether Brian was Mr. Dan's biological child?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/106: So in order to reduce disputes, intermarriage among relatives resulted in the emergence of mental illness inherited in the family... From this point of view, being rich is not always a good thing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/107: [Dan Welling]/nI was opposed to my son's marriage from the beginning. Absolutely not. Hey hey hey...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/108: Excuse me. I'd like to visit Mr. Dan's house and get something to bring. What's appropriate?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/109: A family full of conspiracies... I want to know more about their family. Maybe someone else can go into more detail?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, you mean Mr. Dan Welling? He recently said his eyes were not doing well and he had been taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/111: [Pharmacy Owner]/nI don't know if I have been busy with my son's affairs recently. It was time to come to buy medicine, but I never came. It should be good if you buy some and take them over.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/112: Datura...isn't that a very dangerous poison?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/113: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIt doesn't matter. He has been taking it for a long time and knows the dosage very well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/115: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWait, wait a moment. Where's the medicine?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/117: As expected... He is the root cause of this matter. Go check out Weylin's house...this matter must be settled.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/118: Excuse me. Do you know the Warings?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/119: The Wellings? Of course I understand! The family had a history of trouble. I saw it when Rachel married in. Marriages in their family always make people uneasy, and even this one is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/120: (Ask her to continue talking, there will be no end.)/nAh... Auntie. Who is Rachel?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/121: Rachel? She is Mr. Dan's wife. In fact, Mr. Hessen also liked her. After Mr. Dan married Rachel, Hessen was heartbroken and went on a long trip. Mr. Haisen also came back recently. However, not long after he left, something happened.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/123: When Rachel gave birth to Brian, it was a little earlier than expected. Everyone is discussing privately whether Brian is Mr. Dan's child. Although he later admitted it publicly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/124: People had suspected the relationship between Rachel and Mr. Hyson, but Hyson himself was not around, so the matter was dropped in the end.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/125: That's not necessarily the case...I mean, it's not impossible. Oh, oh, what nonsense am I talking about to people I meet for the first time... So be it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/126: Interesting. The family is filled with madness and the past is so complicated. So that father is suspicious... Let's investigate further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/127: [Brian Welling]/nWhat do you want from me, a madman?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/128: Crazy man... Looking at it from another perspective, how many people in the world are truly awake? However, you are normal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/129: [Brian Welling]/nWhat...what does it mean? Do you think I'm normal?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/132: This is the village pharmacy. If Brian Waring's anomaly is man-made, perhaps a clue can be found here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/133: I have something to ask you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/134: I haven't seen you before. Is this your first time coming to our village?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/135: Yes, it's my first time here. But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/136: What do you want to ask?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/137: Want to hear about the Welin family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/138: [Diana]/n Starting about a year ago, he became more and more depressed, and then he did start to say some strange things. However, in my opinion, he couldn't be more normal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/140: Want to know the ins and outs of this matter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/141: You're saying that Brian Waring might not be Dan Waring's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/142: What's going on? If I can help, I will definitely help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/144: Want to know who has purchased highly toxic drugs recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/145: What gift would Mr. Dan Waring like?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/146: With all due respect, could you give me a list of recently purchased highly toxic drugs?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/147: [Pharmacy Owner]/n...Do you think we are a pharmacy in a small village, so you can just look down on us? We have our own rules when opening a store. How could we casually show that kind of thing to strangers?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf you just want to ask this kind of question, get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/150: Now...it seems that I can't get the information from the pharmacy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/151: [Mr. Hyson]/nDiana, don't do this. Go home quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/152: No, it came just in time. Please listen to me here, Mr. Hyson, and Miss Diana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/153: First of all, it must be stated that Mr. Brian Waring is not suffering from mental illness. He wasn't crazy, he just fell into the trap of someone who wanted to make him look like one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/155: [Dan Welling]/nWhat nonsense! My son must rest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/157: I heard that Mr. Haisen traveled for many years. During your travels, you may have heard of a grass called datura, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/158: [Mr. Haisen]/n Isn't Datura a poisonous plant that can cause hallucinations? If you eat too much, you may even die...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/159: [Brian Waring]/nNo matter what I eat or drink now, I can't taste it. I always feel dizzy and my mouth tastes bitter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/160: That's right. Datura is bitter and can cause headaches and dizziness even after the hallucinations subside. /nMr. Brian Welling, hasn't he been complaining about bitterness in his mouth and dizziness recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/162: And, Mr. Dan Welling, haven't you been taking medicine made from datura recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/166: [Dan Welling]/nWhat nonsense... I am indeed taking medicine made from Datura, but why would I harm my son...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/167: What if he is not your son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/168: [Brian Welling]/nWhat are you talking about...! Of course he is my father!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/169: Mr. Heisen should know better about this issue. Isn't that right, Mr. Hyson?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/173: [Dan Welling]/nWhy, why do you call me father? Rachel, who could understand my shock and anger when Rachel said she was pregnant! There's no way I'm going to have kids...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/175: [Dan Welling]/nYour mother... Your mother, by the lake, was touched by my hands... No, no, that's not me! She jumped down on her own! Yes, she jumped by herself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/176: So, because of this resentment, you poisoned your son, made him hallucinate, and arranged the scene?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/177: Mr. Heisen, are you the real father of Brian? Out of jealousy, Mr. Dan gave Brian a dose of Datura, causing him to fall into hallucinations and perform another scene, pretending that he was crazy. I'm afraid his mother's death was not a simple accident. Isn't that right, Mr. Dan Waring?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/178: [Dan Welling]/nDamn, I have a headache! I have to go to the pharmacy to buy some medicine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/181: Mr. Dan Waring...is off to find his own solution. Can't chase after...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/182: So, Mr. Briand, are you leaving here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I want to travel around for a while and calm down. Of course, my lovely Diana will also accompany me... Ah, and please wait a moment, come over here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is an heirloom of our family. For us, it holds sad memories, but it can be given to you and will surely become a beautiful memory. Hope you are willing to accept it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/187: is Miss Diana's home. Now she has gone on a trip and is no longer at home...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/188: is the Weylin family. Now they have traveled and are no longer at home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/190: Diana? About two years ago, she came to the village with Brian, who had gone to Gesil to study. She seemed to be the girl Brian dated when he was a student.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/191: However, she is naturally beautiful and has a cheerful and outgoing personality. As soon as she arrived in the village, she attracted the attention of all the men. After all, they weren't engaged yet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/192: Hmph... It's not an exaggeration to say that she was pursued by young men in the whole village, right? The man is really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/193: [Tavern Owner]/nBut the strange thing is that no one knows the origin of this woman named Diana. She still lives alone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/194: Speaking of which, I heard a rumor: A young man in the village proposed to her behind the banquet venue, but she rejected him coldly. It is said that she said: "I don't want to deal with people like you who have neither power nor money!" Is that so?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/195: As far as I know, it was because the man wanted to pull her away by force, so she pushed him away, right? It's just that the rumors got lost somehow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/197: I would like to know something about Mr. Brian Waring's dissolution of engagement...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/198: That thing? Diana and Brian were engaged about a year ago, but a few days ago, Brian suddenly announced the termination of their engagement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/199: The reason is that he himself is mentally ill! This incident caused a great sensation in the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/200: [Tavern Owner]/nTo be honest, no one welcomes that engagement except themselves. His father was famous for his madness, and no one in the village wanted to see the Welin family's property fall into the hands of outsiders, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/201: However, is Brian really suffering from mental illness? Although he's been acting strangely lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/202: It is a fact that livestock on various farms have been frequently killed recently. Didn't everyone say it was Brian who did it? Can normal people do such a thing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/203: [Tavern owner]/nThere are indeed some things that don't make sense...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/204: So, Brian Welling and Dan Welling, father and son, are a little weird to begin with?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/205: [Brion Weylin]/nMaybe we will meet again during the journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/206: It's amazing that the murderer turned out to be Mr. Dan Welling. In this way, the true bloodline of the Welin family will be cut off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/207: Come and drink to Diana who finally found happiness...and to those who stayed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/208: Welcome. According to the wishes of the owner of this house, Miss Diana, visiting guests can stay for free. Want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/211: is the Weylin family. The owner of the house, Mr. Brian Waring, was traveling with Diana. No one was in the house and the door was locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/002: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nWe are re-surveying the forests and mountains near Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/003: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nWant to go to Ron? From here, go west, then south, and then all the way west to reach Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/004: [Member of the Geographical Society]/n Ron and Gethier are far apart. From Gesir to Ron, you have to pass through Gesir Forest, climb over the Ron Mountain, and then pass through the Ron Forest. This is roughly between the two places, two-thirds of the way from Gesir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/005: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nTo go to Gesir from here, you have to go south first, and then east until you enter the forest. Continue east in the forest, and when you get stuck, turn north and keep going.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/006: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nGo straight up from here to enter the Ron underground labyrinth. It has been famous for its raw diamond mines since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/007: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nTo go to Memphis Village, just walk in the direction of Gesir, go north at the second fork in the forest, and then go south at the first fork. To get to Nicosia, take the fork to Memphis to the north and then the next fork to the east.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/000:
How about it, Esmeralda, have you changed your mind?
How about
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/002: Hey, you don't even want to reply now? /30dHuh?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/003: Listen, Esmeralda...as long as you listen to me, you can enjoy all the glory and wealth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/004: My lord is willing to love you, how dare you refuse so flatly? /30dHuh?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/007: You are so pathetic.../30d Do you think you can buy people's hearts with money?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/008: You...you impudent woman...don't even look at who you are in front of...! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/009: If you dare to talk nonsense again, /20d I will make it impossible for you to speak a word again in your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka15a/001: Nicosia is on the other side of Gesir City, at the southern tip of the mainland. /nFind Gesil City first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga04a/001: To go to Nicosia, you have to go southeast from here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga04a/002: The Fire Dragon Cave is over here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/002: You have to get out of here quickly, otherwise...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/003: This place has been blocked. Find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/005: This place has been blocked. Find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/006: This is the staircase leading to Frederick's mansion.
