Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/018: Iscariot? The one from Imperial Academy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/019:
? What are you going to do next?
How about
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/020: As long as you hand over that friend obediently, I will promise not to hurt your lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/025: (Let's go! /nWe can't fight together, Kana knows this better than anyone.)
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/027: (Don't worry, I'm not trying to show off.../n will follow soon, just wait for me.)
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/030: ... doesn't seem to be a wise choice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/003_3: This place has been blocked. Find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/005_3: This place has been blocked. Find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/009_3: Great. /10d /nThis side has not been blocked yet. /10d /nAs long as you escape from here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/017_3: My name is Iscarriot./10d /nIt's Cyrano Bernstein's old friend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/000: Our Lord Esther Dodd has a stunning beauty. We are proud residents of Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/001: Although it is located in the north, the climate is quite warm. We citizens say it's because of "Esther Dodd's wind."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/002: I heard that Gesir's cathedral was built more than ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/003: I heard that Lord Esther Dodd was from a family with a long history. Otherwise, where would such grace come from?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/005: Originally, the trade volume between the two countries was not large, but recently the amount of materials exchanged has increased significantly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/009: My family owns a hotel, so I can meet all kinds of people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/010: I heard that there are more people coming and going in the north recently. My family owns a hotel, and there are many more guests coming south from Beafrost than before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/011: Do you know the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/012: Have you ever heard of Josephine, the concubine of Archduke Bifrost? There are many rumors about her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/013: Some people say that she is a descendant of the common people here, while others say that she was born in the dusty land of Gesir... In short, she is definitely not of noble origin.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/014: No one should have heard it, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/015: It can be said that the inheritance of the imperial family has been discontinued since the Black Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/016: The Tur tribe relied on advanced technology to try to win the war, while Pendragon was fighting on their own soil, so they used their abundant resources to invest a large amount of troops and materials to fight a protracted war. Now neither side can tell the winner, and it is said that the war has reached a stalemate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/017: Nikacha of Cyrepus, I know it too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/018: When I reach my age, I will look back on the days I have gone through. Thinking about what I have done all these years and what kind of person I am...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/019: Think about it carefully... I seem to have heard strange noises coming from the underground of the arena recently. Am I really getting older...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/020: People in this city really don't like to exercise. This worries me the most... If something happens, wouldn't it be necessary to use force and financial resources the most? The force of our city people is too weak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/023: Do you know the musician Mr. Nikacha? He was popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/024: The lord here is so beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/026: I heard that the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe has passed its most intense stage?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/027: We in Libreville derive our income mainly from trade between Bifrost and the territories of the Old Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/028: It is said that once a man takes one look at Lady Esther Dodd, he will never forget her appearance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/029: But I am a woman and I don't understand what men think...but our lord is indeed a beauty.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/030: Welcome. Our arena always entertains you with low prices...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/031: Among the kings of the past, the one who left the most legends is probably Yogged Finn, who is known as the Adventure King, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/032: The legend our Black Prince left behind during his knightly training journey is also remarkable, but it seems that there are also many stories left behind during the reign of Yogged Fein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/033: Hehe... What's so scary about a remote country like Bifrost? When our empire was at its peak, they simply didn't have enough to watch...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/034: Moreover, in that long history, haven't they always been a nation that only knows how to defend?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/035: Oh...haven't you heard that the harder something is, the easier it is to break?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/036: Being too tough is never a good thing. Isn't there a saying that softness can overcome strength?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/039: Thank you for purchasing our weapons. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/040: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for? Let me help you find it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/042: Thank you for visiting our premier store in Libreville. You are always welcome to come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/043: Did you know there are strange noises coming from near the arena? By the way, is the arena still open these days?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/044: [Mr. Harrison]/nWelcome. Our Libreville hotel offers the cleanest rooms in the Geysir North. Only 150Eld! Do you want accommodation?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/045: Thank you for your business and wish you a comfortable night. Libreville Inn always offers you the best service.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/046: We welcome you next time you come to Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/047: Thank you for staying at our hotel. Welcome to visit us anytime in the future when you come to Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/048: I heard that there was a passage leading to a strange cave in Esther Dodd's mansion. However, it is now completely sealed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/049: I have heard strange noises coming from near the arena late at night before. Although no one goes to that arena now, I still feel very uneasy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/050: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/052: Yggd Fein is a king, but he travels to explore remote places. It is said that he finally disappeared in the Demon Sword Tower.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/053: A colleague at my workplace said he likes me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/054: But the problem is, is he younger than me? A full five years old...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/055: I've been worried about this lately. To me, he is more like a brother than a lover... How can we fall in love like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/056: The door to the arena is locked with a strange lock.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/057: Cheers to peace in beautiful Libreville!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/058: Cheers to Lord Esther Dodd of our beautiful Libreville!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/059: Cheers to the beautiful you too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/060: [Gustav]/nYou mean the arena in the city? I used to go there often, but people in the city don't like to exercise at all, so it closed a while ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/061: [Gustav]/nAlthough...some people said they heard strange noises there, but I don't really believe it. If you really want to know, why not ask the boss there? He has a good relationship with the owner of the weapons store and often stays there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/062: [Mr. Emery]/nArena owner? He used to come to my place often, but he didn't come today. Sounds like you're not feeling well? He's been saying some strange things recently... maybe it's because his store is closed and he feels too sad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/064: [Mr. Emery]/nIn the north block, the house opposite the steps going down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/065: You want to try the key on the table?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/067: Do you know the mysterious story behind the Chaos Cube?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/068: A long time ago, the Chaos Cube was a star in the sky. That era was just like today, with frequent wars. One day, a girl's lover was about to go to the battlefield, so she came to the lakeside, looked at the star and made a wish: "Please protect my lover on the battlefield."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/069: Xingxing was moved by the girl's pure heart and replied: "I can agree to your request, but,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/070: Do you know the story of Chaos Cube? Once upon a time, when this land was in constant war, there was a pair of lovers. The woman's name is Awen, and the man's name is Al. The two had agreed to get married, but Al went to the battlefield.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/071: Awen prayed to the stars in the sky for Al's safety, again and again. Xingxing was moved by her sincerity and one day said to her: "Do you really have the courage to save him? If so, go to the lake behind the village."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/072: Someone else will tell you the next story...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/073: Mr. Jones asked me to bring some wine, okay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/074: [Tavern Keeper]/N Jones...? Forget it. Do you want to see if my business can't continue? Do you know that as soon as he is found to be drinking, his wife will come here and make a fuss?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/075: However, Mr. Jones gave me this back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/076: I placed the brass gem on the counter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/077: Uh...is this a brass gem? Ho, ho ho ho! Speaking of which, he is also a poor man. Marrying such a powerful wife, it's really... if he is deprived of the pleasure of drinking, what's the point of living?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/080: Behind the Chaos Cube, there is a beautiful legend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/082: However, I don't like people from Beafrost. The way they stare at people is really scary...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/083: However, her appearance and charm do seem to be extraordinary, and she is known as the "Twin Sisters of the North" along with our Lord Esther Dodd. But in terms of demeanor, it is definitely far inferior to Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/084: However, this has little impact on us in Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/085: Is the rumor circulating among the people that Bifrost is going to invade true? I really don't want to fight...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/086: Hehehe. Sure enough, no man can resist the charm of beauty?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/087: Compared to Frost's attack, we Libreville can't stop it ourselves, hahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/088: I heard that Bifrost is preparing to attack our Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/089: I'm really afraid of war. The gentleman over there said that more than Frost's military might was worth nothing...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/090: But what really scares me is his kind of person who only shows off his courage. He talks big words but can't do anything practical.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/091:
The same goes for weapons. The more expensive and harder they are, the better. However, expensive weapons have the advantage of lasting a long time.
The meaning of
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/092: Shortly after the arena closed, strange noises started coming from inside. It was all late at night, after everyone had gone home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/093: The voice simply didn't seem to come from this world. Sometimes it sounded like the sound of wind, and sometimes it sounded like moaning. It echoed and was indescribably ominous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/094: Is there another world underground in our city of Libreville? It's really terrible. What if something suddenly appears from that world one day?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/095: I went to Antananarivo. It's small, but it's pretty rough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/096: Perhaps it is because they have suffered from war for a long time and it has been engraved in their blood. However, after the collapse of our empire, there was peace there for a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/097: No enemies have invaded Bifrost before, and it has always been peaceful there...but recent rumors say that the people from Bifrost are going south, which makes people very uneasy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/098: Sorry, guest. You can't come in from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/009_3: I have a friend who wants to move to Caracas. What are you doing in a rural village like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/012_3: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/013_3: Lord Esther Dodd and Josephine of Byfrost are known as the Twins of the North.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/016_3: I heard that the Tu'er people's technical strength is amazing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/020_3: Do you know Chaos Cube? I heard it is a very amazing prop.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/031_3: Bifrost's recent movements are very suspicious. Especially the matter of expanding armaments...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/032_3: Bifrost's movements are so suspicious, does it mean that their expansion policy has become more and more obvious?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/040_3: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/042_3: Thank you for visiting our premier store in Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/044_3: [Mr. Harrison]/nWelcome. Our Libreville hotel offers the cleanest rooms in the Geysir North.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/045_3: Thank you for your business and wish you a comfortable night.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s04/000: [Cesare]/nHaving gained the power of the God of Destruction,/30d I am no longer a human, but a god!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s04/001: [Cesare]/nThose who dare to resist me are committing blasphemy and can only atone for their sins by death!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s04/002: Even if you are really a god, I will never forgive you. /30dYour time to die has come, Cesare!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx23/000: This is not the direction to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx23/001: << Phoenix Cave >>/nEvery 1000 years,/nThe phoenix burns itself and/ngives birth to new life. /n/nIf you want to get the most precious thing,/nyou must first sacrifice your most precious everything.../n/nAdventurer Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/000: This is the magic installation machine Asura!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/002: Sure enough, Cesare has been secretly manufacturing magic machines!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/003: Before it fully activates, defeat it quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/004: The church is even manufacturing magic machines...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/006: Everyone, I would like to ask, can I also join your West Wind Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/007: Why do you want to participate in our action?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/008: It is difficult to elaborate on the specific reasons, but I very much agree with your ideals. /nPlease let me join the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/009: Let's go back to the base together and discuss it with the military advisor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx13/000: North----The top of the mountain/nSouth----Pretoria Village/nEast----Caracas, Gesil direction
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx13/000_3: North----The top of the mountain/nSouth----Pretoria City
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka11a/000: This is the direction of Libreville. /nI heard that Nicosia is in the southern part of the mainland.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka11a/001: This is the direction of Libreville. /nPretoria is to the west.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/000: I heard there are some suspicious movements on Bifrost's side. Today's Grand Duke Moser II is too ambitious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/001: This has been the case since the last Grand Duke. The Senate system in Bifrost has actually collapsed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/002: Once someone who is ambitious and convinced of his own abilities appears, the Senate system will be easily shaken. If there are still people who are longing for heroes, then even more so...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/003: We will have to fight Frederick sooner or later. He ranks first among the lords of Gesil, and without defeating him, there is no way to overpower the other lords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/004: Frederick was powerful because his governance was truly effective. His people trusted him and the morale of his soldiers was high.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/005: Come and drink to the eternal prosperity and glory of the empire! We can be the core that unites everyone's strength!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/006: For the prosperity of the empire and its people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/007: Hmph...can we really change the history of the Empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/008: I joined this organization just for my own revenge. For the people of the empire? Hey hey hey...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/009: Occasionally there are strange sounds coming from around here. Could it be an auditory hallucination...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/010: Looks like I've been drinking too much lately. Every time I walk out of this door after drinking, my ears buzz and it feels weird...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/011: I have a friend who once got sucked behind a wall. Of course, maybe I was too drunk and saw it, but that scene was so real...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/001: [???]/nWell...no one has been here for a long time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/003: [???]/nSadly, it seems so. It seems that you are not one of their subordinates, how could you get in here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/004: Who are you? Also, when you say "they", do you mean the Church of God?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/005: [???]/nAsk only one question at a time. You don't know how to be considerate of others.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/006: [???]/nFirst of all, I don't know anything about the Church of God. As for my name, it's Deimos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/007: Deimos... I seem to have heard this name somewhere... In short, it seems that you have been locked up here much longer than me, and you don't even know about the Lord God's Cult, which has power throughout the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/008: [Demos]/nYou have been emphasizing the church. It seems that you were imprisoned because you resisted them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/009: Resistance... If that's the case, I have nothing to be wronged about. It can be said that Cardinal Cesare, who single-handedly established the power of the church, is my fiancee's father.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/010: [Deimos]/nSo, you must have done something very detrimental to that cardinal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/011: Not so. I just want to study the truth of history. How on earth does this endanger the church?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/012: [Deimos]/nThe truth is always accompanied by pain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/013: [Deimos]/nHowever, the truth of history... What truth in history do you want to uncover?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/014: I just studied a history book written by a sage from the old empire, called "The Secret Record of the Creation War."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/015: [Deimos]/nOh, you have studied the Creation War. Then maybe he knows about me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/016: What's your business...? What does this mean?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/017: [Deimos]/nYou should have seen my name in that book.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/019: You are Deimos, the former leader of the Dark God!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/020: [Deimos]/nThat's all in the past, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/021: Are you really the Dark God? /30d How could it be... Sure enough, "The Secret Record of the Creation War" is not a lie!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/022: [Deimos]/nHowever, more than this, I want to hear you finish what you just said. Maybe I can answer that question for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/024: [Deimos]/nIt seems the time has come. If we meet again, can you tell me in detail?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/001: Mom, why is that person staying there?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/004: You are not allowed to talk to that kind of person again, do you understand?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/005: How strange, that brother gave me candy a few days ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/006: ! ! /nWhy didn't you tell mom about that!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/007: That person is a big bad guy who will catch good children and eat them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/009: The eldest son of the famous Bernstein family turned out to be a devil worshipper.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/010: There should be a limit to embarrassing the family!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/013: I.../10d I really didn't expect you to be such a person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/000: So, Frederick just withdrew his troops?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/001: Yes. /nThere was clearly a chance to completely eliminate the West Wind Falcon, but he let the troops withdraw.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/003: Tsk...a mere mercenary captain, I promoted him to where he is today, but he is ungrateful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/004: Now that things have happened, it seems that even he can no longer be relied upon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/005: I heard that he also strongly opposed the marriage of Miss Christina to Bifrost a few days ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/006: Stupid. /20d Do you think you can guard your daughter for the rest of your life?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/007: The daughter is also a bargaining chip for political marriage after all. /30d /nYou can't even use the most powerful resources in your hands. You really live up to your reputation as the overlord of the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/008: It seems that we can only rely on the power of Bifrost?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/010: Mozer II seems to have been completely smitten with Josephine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/011: It is said that thanks to the dark killers sent by His Excellency the Cardinal, most of the forces that hindered us have been eliminated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/012: Then, I'll have to work hard on you this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/013: You want me to bring Bifrost's army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/015: It doesn't matter, Moser is an easy man to manipulate. /nAs long as you make good use of this opportunity, even Bifrost can be in the bag.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/016: Duke Frederick will probably object strongly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/017: Don't worry. /15d Regarding him, I have already arranged countermeasures.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/018: When can we unify the empire under your leadership and restore the glory and peace of the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/019: Soon. The day when we will achieve our great cause is not far away...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/020: Those fools may not recognize our great achievements now, but history will judge our achievements fairly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/021: /2c Geysir Cathedral, Office of the Cardinal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/023: Hehehe.../25d /nIn a little while... In a little more time, my ambition will be realized.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/024: The Falcon of the West Wind, Frederick and the like, don't even think of blocking me. /nHehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/026: Soon, not only the empire, /15d Bifrost, Pendragon, Astania.../20d the entire Antalya will be reborn as a powerful country!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/000: This is the village of Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/001: This is a quiet village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/002: I heard that Gesir City is south of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/007: Thieves have been rampant in the desert recently. As a result, I almost died several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/008: People who live in hot places mostly have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01b/002: The cathedral is in the east of the city. /nCesare must be there!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka12e/001: We should go find the treasure. /n Gesir Forest is still further south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck01/000: This way leads to the town. /nQuickly find an entrance that can lead to the interior of the mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/001: Don't worry here. /10d/nThe Justice is waiting, please get on your way as soon as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/004: You are a step too late. /nCyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/006: My name is Catalina. /n is the captain of the Bifrost Valkyrie unit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/007: I have been interested in you for a long time. /nI heard that you are the best swordsman in the empire...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/008: If you want to get through here, you have to defeat me, the best swordsman in Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/010: I'm in a hurry, so let's do it quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/011: How...how is it possible.../10d I actually...lost...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/012: You were so arrogant just now, now you look better.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/016: [Catalina] /nCyrano Bernstein, I will never forget the shame of today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/019: The delay was longer than expected. I wonder...if I can still catch up with Machiavelli.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/000: This is the labor camp of Invernor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/002: This is the labor camp of Invernor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/003: Dig more sulfur and come back, I'll let you have a rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/004: Hehehe... How many people can get out alive today?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/005: These bugs should dig sulfur for the country!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/006: You can also jailbreak if you don't want to work. /15d If you have the ability. /nHehehe.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/009: Where do you want to go, No. 102?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/010: You want to go out without working?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/011: You guys, are you here just now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/013: If you don't want to end up like those 13 people, just be diligent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/014: You are all traitors to the country. /nRight here, pay for your sins.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/015: In the 12th group that went to work yesterday, only 7 out of 20 people came back alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/017: If you understand, don't wait any longer and start moving! /nYou trash!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/018: Tsk...I have to deal with this kind of guy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/022: You guy! /nWant to be lazy again! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/023: Stop pretending to be sick and get up quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/028: If it dies, remove the body immediately, don't wait for it to rot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/032: comes, climb into the sulfur cave immediately!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/001: Hehehe. /15d /n Those guys from the West Wind Falcon were really embarrassed to escape.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/002: General, what should we do? /nDo you want to send pursuit troops?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/003: No need. /nThis should be enough to wake them up.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/006: Someone reported that there was a person in the escaped Zephyr Falcon who looked very much like Miss Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/009: Okay! /nThe purpose has been achieved and everyone is ready to return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/000: Meditch brother? /20d Could it be Rhidelhard...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/004: [Esther Dodd]/nHehehe! /30d The first person to betray your companions is yourself. How stupid to put the blame on me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/005: Esther Dodd, it's not too late, go after him and ask for forgiveness. I will forgive you too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/007: Hehehe, something worse than a bug!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/009: Diablo...and Cesare Borgia! /40d My and Master's enemies are actually here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/010: However, as long as you hand over Christina obediently, I can spare your lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/011: How sad, Cyrano Bernstein. /nHe actually called his savior his enemy. When you were almost burned alive, didn't I just show mercy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/012: Also, how dare you speak rudely to Lord Diablo!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/013: Enough, Cardinal Cesare. If my feeling is correct, the aura exuding from that guy is the same as that of Deimos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/014: No wonder I can't feel the aura of Deimos since a few years ago. It turns out that I have become one with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/015: Hehehe, who do you think Christina is, how dare you order me to hand over my granddaughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/016: No need to say more. /20d Hand over Christina obediently, and I will make your death painless.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/017: Lord Diablo, that boy is poisoned and his life is short. He is worse than a bug. Ignore him and continue the ceremony...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/018: I'll see how long you're going to talk, Cesare!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/023: How dare you be so presumptuous!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/025: You can't just watch your savior die in vain, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/027: I wonder if you still remember the prisoner who escaped with you in Invernor three years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/029: Your eyes were shining then. But now, you are beguiled by that kind of witch, and the light in your eyes is disappearing. /60dLook at yourself, Meditch!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/032: Haha, Mr. Cyrano is stupid enough to stand up for that kind of coward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/033: There should be a limit to telling jokes, what? You want me to beg for mercy? /50d Hahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/034: Lord Diablo will protect me! It's you who should beg for forgiveness!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/037: It's too late! The God of Destruction...is being resurrected! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/038: Esmeralda saved Christina at the expense of herself...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/039: No more... Christina's breathing is getting weaker and weaker...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/041: The underwater city is collapsing, you must get out of here first!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/042: Christina will die before she escapes!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/043: But there is no other way now. I will take Miss Christina and escape as soon as possible!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/045: Deimos... It's only now that I finally seem to understand your mood.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/048: There is no other way! We must destroy the God of Destruction before it fully exerts its power!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/050: Deimos! ! Please give your life to that child! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/056: So you already know, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/058: He used his own life to save Miss Christina...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/060: The city seems to be beginning to collapse on a large scale, Kana! /50dMiss Christina, leave it to me, let's escape quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/061: I want to stay with Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/063: All his life...he has always been chasing the shadow of the person he loves, and is a lonely person...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/064: It was only now that he finally found his resting place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/065: I want to stay with him forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/066: ...I understand. Everyone has a different understanding of happiness, and I have no right to stop you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/067: I hope you can find true happiness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/068: It's quite durable, but the game ends here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/069: Damn it, with our own strength, we can only get so far...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/073: Why do you want to save us! Haven't you already quit the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/074: Although I am no longer a member of the West Wind Falcon, we are companions who have lived and died together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/075: Even if you risk my life, I can't let you die in vain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/077: Cyrano, you really didn't abandon us...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/079: Let go of the past now, and now it's time to work together to deal with the enemy in front of you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/080: Are you that boy named Cyrano? Sure enough, the life that inherited Deimos was a little different from other guys.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/083: Among the Dark Gods who survived the Creation War, Irus has died in my hands, and you are the only one left.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/084: That guy is the Dark God? !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/085: Also, Cesare...the root of all evil, I will eradicate you with my own hands.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/086: Hehe, we met again after a long separation, but he was so murderous when he opened his mouth. /30d I was given a lenient sentence to save you from turning into ashes on the burning platform. Wasn't it your savior?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/087: Stop playing tricks, Cesare! /20d Even if I put aside my personal revenge, I will never forgive you for the sake of mankind!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/091: Isabele, I would like to fight alongside you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/093: Haha, you still can't get rid of those stupid stereotypes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/094: Everything I do is for the motherland. I don't ask you to understand, but don't misunderstand me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/095: Having heard Machiavelli, I know what you're thinking, but it's wrong. There is no point in using the wrong means to achieve your goals.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/096: Both human beings and history have grown through constant trials, mistakes, failures and successes!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/097: Forcibly manipulating history will only bring about regression in the end!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/098: I didn't expect that at this time, I would still argue with you about ideological issues.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/101: No time! ! If this continues, the God of Destruction will be resurrected...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/106: Okay! Cyrano, let me help you too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/107: Diablo is dead. Cesare, this time is really the last.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/115: Forgive me for not agreeing, Mrs. Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/116: It was not enough for him to send me, your fiance, to hell. He also killed your husband and even wanted to use your daughter. Do you still want to protect such a person just because he is a father?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/117: I know that he is a villain...a murderer...not a good father.../50d but.../30d but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/119: Break...the seal of the God of Destruction! ! !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/121: Your father was a murderer who killed many people, including your husband. Keeping such people around will only cause more people to suffer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/123: But.../30d He is the father who gave birth to and raised me after all...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/124: What a shameless woman! Just because he is his father, he wants us to let such a wicked person go!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/127: The situation is not good. /30dEsmeralda, can you save her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/133: Everyone, be careful! The underwater city begins to collapse!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss27/000: Maze Forest/n1. Don't go back the way you came. /n2. Always face the sun. /n /n Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss27/001: It seems that here... we seem to be trapped in Beafrost's maze!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss27/002: Everything around him is an illusion. /nNever turn back the way you came, /nhead towards the sun!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/001: How strange. /nForget it, Brother Meditch, the military advisor is a very punctual person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/007: At the request of Mr. Clausewitz, everyone has set off to the top of Rowan Mountain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/009: I don't know the details, but I heard that General Frederick is near Ron Mountain, which may have something to do with it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/012: So, shall we also go to the top of Ron Mountain?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/014: Hmm...then please go first. There is another place I want to visit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr00/000: < Dragon Cave >/nIt's dangerous here. No one is allowed in here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro04/000: West----Ron City/nThe south is an area infested by rebels and civilians are prohibited from entering.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/006: You can actually catch up here.../nYou are really capable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/007: At this point, there is nothing I can do. /nI'm just a scholar, /30d can't resist, so I'll leave it to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/008: Hmph, do you think you can save your life by adopting this attitude? /nI will make your way without pain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/012: Do you think I would know a rebel pawn like you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/013: Same, after all, 15 years have passed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/014: I was once called Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/015: Cyrano! /nHow is it possible...you are still alive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/016: Hehe, it seems that my life is quite tough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/017: However, I couldn't be happier to see my once best friend become Cesare's minion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/018: I am a scholar. Following your own thoughts is more important than friendship and personal relationships.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/019: It is in accordance with my own philosophy that I follow Lord Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/020: Cesare's philosophy? Is he planning a conspiracy to frame his friend's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/021: Use your daughter as an instrument of power?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/022: Or is it like now, introducing foreign forces into the motherland? Machiavelli!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/023: The empire now has no emperor. /nBecause of this, people like you are more needed. /nWe need a monarch who can cut off all personal relationships, even if cruel means are used, to unify the empire and rebuild peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/024: You also know very well that the only person who can unify the empire now is Lord Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/025: History is not determined by one person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/026: Why must the empire be unified for him? Why did so many people have to bleed for him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/027: Shouldn't history take its own course?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/028: Of course, as time passes, decades or centuries later, the current chaos in the empire will eventually subside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/029: But how many people will be sacrificed during that period?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/030:
How many more wars will break out?
Where did
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/031: People of the current generation may condemn Lord Cesare, but historians of later generations will definitely be grateful to him because he shortened the suffering time of countless people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/032: Hurry up! When Valkyrie completes the siege, we won't be able to get out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/033: Get rid of this guy quickly and escape!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/034: I'm just faithful to my beliefs as a scholar./nEven if that were the case today, I will die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/036: Okay, Machiavelli. /nI will spare you once today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/038: I'm sure Cyrano's going to get his rotting head.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/039: Are you going to let this guy go?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/040: Please./nIt's a shame this guy killed him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/041: Anyway, get out of here quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s07/001: With my strength, can /10d really subdue this huge monster...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma14a/000: Mantigoa Mountain.../20d The top of the mountain is in sight. /nHurry up and attack the enemy base camp stationed on the top of the mountain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma14a/001: Cesare is escaping to the top of the mountain!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber02/001: Hehe, Cyrano. /15d Sorry, can you please go out?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber02/001_3: Hehe, Cyrano. Sorry, can you please go out for a moment?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s01/001: Then, let's start the combat meeting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/002: Speaking of which, is everyone safe?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/003: Yes. /20d Fortunately, no one was killed, and most people suffered only minor injuries.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/004: Haha, as expected, the battle was successful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/005: Then, disperse here and regroup at the second meeting point as planned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/010: Haha, isn't it a common thing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/011: So, what are you going to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/012: If you have nothing else, why not join us, the Falcon of the West Wind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/013: I'm sorry, I've got work to do./30dSomething very important...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/014: Really? Since something is wrong, there is nothing we can do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/018: I will never forget this kindness for the rest of my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/020: I am Roberto de Meditch, captain of the Zephyr Falcon First Unit. /nIf you want to remember, remember it accurately!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/023: Thirteen years... I saw the sky again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/024: This beautiful night sky is still the same as before, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/000: We have Miss Esmeralda's clinic in our village. It's the famous one... you know, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/001: For a long time, many people have come here to see her beauty or to witness her sincere dedication.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/003: Heh, no matter how you think about it, this place is great.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/004: The scenery is good and the girls are beautiful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/005: Why don't you just stay here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/006: What should I do? Prices have risen too much recently...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/007: Life is already very difficult... It seems that even this only piece of clothing has to be sold.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/008: Oh...my brother is very popular with the girls.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/009: My brother used to study medicine at Miss Esmeralda's house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/010: Miss Esmeralda is really like an angel! The sound is the same, the appearance is the same, and it can also treat sick people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/011: When I grow up, I also want to be a doctor like Miss Esmeralda!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/012: Miss Esmeralda, I haven't been back for a long time. All is well in the hospital. There are no more medical appointments, and there is nothing to take care of...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/013: Uncle said that my parents went to heaven together not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/014: I told my uncle that I also wanted to go where my parents were, but I was scolded severely. I hate uncle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/015: My lord, this is so strange. Why do we always stop us from doing what we want to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/016: It is not an exaggeration to say that the child's parents died at the hands of Viscount Ramon. How pitiful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/017: But I'm not even married yet, so I have to take over taking care of the children... This world is so damned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/018: Why do parents have to leave such a young child to die? Can rich and powerful people bully poor people or even kill them?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/019: I think it's true that Miss Esmeralda is the incarnation of God.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/020: She is so beautiful and kind-hearted, and she also treats people who have no money for free, isn't she?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/021: There are a few people in our village who really like maps. I also love maps...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/022: Have you heard of the legendary geologist Largo? Although he was a silver arrow, he spent the rest of his life in the territory of the old empire and devoted his whole life to mapping the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/023: It can be said that he drew the original draft of the maps circulating in the empire today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/024: Master Esmeralda's disciples have now returned to their hometowns to practice their teacher's ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/025: However, the teacher's students are scattered all over the country and are providing free clinics. You can just go to the nearest one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/026: Although she is no longer here...that kind heart still continues.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/027: It's all Gesil's fault for being restless. Why does the Falcon of the West Wind want to disturb the peace of the whole country?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/028: He is no longer here. In order to learn advanced medical skills, I went to Pendragon to study abroad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/029: Yesterday, the children in our school skipped class collectively.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/030: Led by the student council president, everyone stood up to protest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/031: But when I went to school today, I was severely scolded...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/033: Other students have gone back to other places. Everyone sent word that they had arrived safely and everything was fine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/034: I...I...will stay here until the teacher returns to this village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/035: Welcome, Miss Esmeralda. For those who are traveling with you, I will give you a special discount price.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/037: Walk slowly, Miss Esmeralda. Please take care of yourself...we will be waiting for the day when you come back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/038: Making money is really not easy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/039: People who can truly make a living don't pick and choose their jobs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/040: There is a base of Zephyr Falcon nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/041: The forest below the Zephyr Falcon base has been famous for the frequent occurrence of strange things since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/042: There have been many caves around here since ancient times. There are many legends spread in every cave, and those legends are all related to treasures.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/043: Guest, you can't come in from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/044: Miss Esmeralda's students have now returned to their hometown to fulfill their teacher's wishes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/045: Miss Esmeralda's students have now returned to their hometown to fulfill their teacher's wishes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/046: In order to make money, I am willing to do any job... Alas, this place is really too poor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/047: The Pretoria Branch of the Imperial Geographical Society/nHelps everyone who is not familiar with geography. We are part of the Imperial Academy Foundation, which is run by public funds.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/048: If you want to walk in the territory of the old empire without getting lost, the key is to find the way in the forest. As long as you are familiar with the forest trails, it is not an exaggeration to say that you have mastered half of the empire's geography.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/049: For example, the forest between Ron and Bordeaux leads to the city from both north and south ends, but if you go to the right, you will enter a maze called the Demon Sword Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/050: There is a rather complicated forest between Gesil and Ron. There are not many signposts in Gesir Forest, and it leads to Nicosia to the east and Memphis to the south. Although heading west is the direction of Ron, you still have to climb another mountain on the way. That road is quite difficult...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/051: The forest near Caracas is characterized by connecting many places. To the north is Libreville, to the south is the city of Gesir, to the east is the village of Paro and the Desert of Trixis, and to the west is the city leading here, Pretoria. Simply put, just think of it as an important transportation location in the north of Gesil City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/052: So, in the forest near Caracas, it can be considered that each fork in the road leads to a different area.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/053: After leaving Caracas, go south and you will reach Paro; go south, then turn west, and then south, and you will reach Gesir City; first go south, then west, then north, and then northeast, and you will reach the Libreville area. Of course, you should know the road between Caracas and here in Pretoria, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/054: After leaving our village and heading north, you can find the Phoenix Cave. That's the famous one...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/055: After leaving the village, go west, then turn southwest, and you will enter the southern end of the Dragon's Breath Mountain Range. There have been many resistance forces operating there since ancient times. The southern end of the Dragon's Breath Mountain Range also leads to an unnamed cave. It is said that there are many valuable treasures hidden in the cave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/056: It is said that the cave is at the westernmost end of the southern end of the Dragon's Breath Mountain Range.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/057: The Gesir Forest south of Gesir City now has insufficient road signs due to neglected municipal management. However, the forest is quite vast and leads to many places. It can be said to be an important transportation hub in the south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/058: After leaving Gesir City, keep going south, which is the village of Memphis; go south, then turn northeast, and you will reach Nicosia Church Fortress; go south, then turn northwest, and you will be on the way to Ron. However, it is easy to confuse the road to Ron and the road to Fire Dragon Cave...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/059: It's not easy to get to Ron from Gesir. Go south from Gesir City, turn northwest at the second fork, and then keep heading west. The roads in those forests are quite complicated...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/060: I am a member of the Geographical Society and received my PhD with the thesis "A Differential Investigation of the Changing Patterns of Geography and Resident Life in the Frost Border Region".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/061: Go all the way north from Geisir City, cross the east bridge, and then go north again to reach Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/062: Going northeast from Libreville is the Antananarivo region, which is a quite remote mountain village. To get there from Libreville, you have to go north from the nearby forest, reach the first fork in the mountainous area, go west, then immediately turn north and keep going.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/063: Ah, Miss Esmeralda. There are still people coming here looking for you. Even if you advise them to go to the nearby charity hospital run by your students, many people will not listen.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/064: Aren't you planning to come back just yet... I have always hoped that Miss Esmeralda can live for herself...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/065: Please always follow your own heart and make a choice you won't regret. I will continue to guard here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/066: Ah! Teacher Esmeralda! I also followed your wish and returned to my hometown to open a charity hospital. But maybe I'm still incapable, and no one has ever come to see me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/067: The most important thing is that there is too little money to maintain the charity hospital, so it is now closed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/068: Looking back now, I really admire the teacher. Whether it's your dedication or your business talent...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/012_3: This is Miss Esmeralda's hospital. What do you want?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/020_3: She is so beautiful and kind-hearted, and she also treats people who have no money for free, isn't she?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/021_3: My father went to the village below.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/022_3: He said to close the door to prevent bad people from coming in... Why didn't he close it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/024_3: Miss Esmeralda is not here and there are no more medical appointments here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/027_3: It's all Gesil's fault for being restless. Why does the Falcon of the West Wind want to disturb the peace of the whole country?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/032_3: I am a nurse at Miss Esmeralda's hospital.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/033_3: The other companions have gone back to various places.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/034_3: I plan to stay here until one day she comes back and reopens the door.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/035_3: We are selling the medicines that Miss Esmeralda used. Do you want to pick one?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/040_3: There is a base of Zephyr Falcon nearby.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/004: What are you talking about! /nEven if they are not our companions, now that they are all here, we cannot pretend not to have seen them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/006: Can people who are imprisoned in such a place still be considered nobles?

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/012: The captain's temper is really.../30d/nThen let's go over and wait for you.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/013: I have to go to my room on the second floor to find the copy of "The Creation War"...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/017: You also saw it...it really can't be said to be good...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/018: Meditch, you are such a disappointment. Is this look worthy of the name Roberto de Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/020: Damn it...Now that things have happened...what else do you expect me to do...what do you expect me, an incompetent person, to do!

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/023: Yes, according to your opinion, I am the one who has no face to face him because I exchanged his life for survival.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/024: However, I cannot let his sacrifice become meaningless, so I am trying my best to survive today.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/008: If it weren't for that phantom thief named Sharn Hoiste and you, our Zephyr Falcon might have been completely wiped out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/013: So...what are you going to do next?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/015: I'm talking about the future. /nNow that things have reached this point, I'm afraid you, like us, the Falcon of the West Wind, will be branded a traitor by the church.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/017: Also, once the truth about your body, sword, and magic is exposed, your actions will be greatly restricted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/018: ! ! ! /10d/nYou are not an ordinary person either.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/019: I'm afraid the whole church will be looking for you like crazy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/020: How about it?/nWhy not take this opportunity and join us in action?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/021: With our West Wind Falcon's ability to collect intelligence, we should be able to help you a lot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/024: Okay. /nThen first please join Miss Kana's fourth unit and help them. That unit lost a lot of combat power in this incident.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/025: Great~/nThen we can act together in the future.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/000: Then it's time for me to say goodbye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/001:
What's going on? So suddenly...
How about
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/002: [Frog Merchant]/nIn such a dangerous place, there are still humans coming one after another? If you want to survive, buy my goods!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/003: Frog Weapon Shop Underwater City Branch
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/005: [Frog Merchant]/nIn a dangerous place, only by preparing the best medicine and equipment can you survive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/006: Frog Jewelry Store Underwater City Branch
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/007: [Frog Merchant]/nIn short, just get out of here alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/008: [Frog Innkeeper]/nWelcome. Sleep here and our companions will protect you. Only 100Eld! Want to stay one night?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/009: [Frog Inn Owner]/nHey, you've been fooled! In fact, I want to take away 10,000Eld!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/010: Hmph... He actually left without staying. Wish you Game Over on your way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/011: [Frog Innkeeper]/nWe will never see you again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/001: How stupid. /40d With this little ability, he still dares to challenge me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/007: Are you also in the same group with this weak guy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/010: You are Deimos! ! /30d/n No, there is something different. /20d You can feel both Deimos and the Black Prince's fluctuations. Who are you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/011: There is no doubt that it is the fluctuation of Deimos' soul.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/012: No matter what, if you want to inherit the will of that guy Deimos and become my enemy, I will support you with all my strength!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/013: Cyrano... As expected, you are still alive, as rumored.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/014: Lord Irus, that guy is no small matter, so be careful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/001_3: You are so stupid, you dare to challenge me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/007_3: You are also one of them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/011_3: Hehehe... Deimos. /nYou actually want to resist me in this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/012_3: In that case... let you see my true form!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/013_3: Cyrano...You are indeed alive as per the rumors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/014_3: Lord Irus, this guy is not an ordinary person, you should be more careful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/000: /2c Three years later, Inferno is in the underground prison.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/004: ...After three years, all I got was sulfur poisoning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/005: Why... I still have to live in this hellish place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/006: Are you going to live like a bug for the rest of your life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/010: Damn...Why can't I forget her? The woman who betrayed me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/013: /2c Three years later, Inferno is in the underground prison.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/014: ...As of today, /10d has been three years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/016: Hehehe... After three years, all I got was /15d despair and /15d this tattered body.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/017: Why.../10d I still have to live in this hellish place? /10d/n endure this pain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/018: Are you going to live like a bug for the rest of your life.../10d...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/021: Damn.../15d Why can't I forget her? /nThe woman who betrayed me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/027: /2c Three years later, Inferno is in the underground prison.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/028: Get up quickly if you don't want to die!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/029: Go to work in the underground mine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/031: Damn it. /nIf you dawdle, I will be scolded.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/032: Tsk...a tough guy. /nHe's not dead yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/033: I can live a more comfortable life without that uncomfortable guy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldpr13/000: [Pirate Kidd]/nHehehehe... Did you disturb my sleep? Within three times, I can spare you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldpr13/002: Hehehehe...walk slowly. Once you leave here, it will be difficult to come back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/001: Then, starting from tomorrow, we will fight side by side with Frederick...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/002: It feels so amazing. Not long ago he was an enemy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/004: Grand Duke Beeffrost is really amazing, he actually dares to have the idea of invading the empire...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/005: Hmph, I heard it was all because of a woman named Josephine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/006: Really, men are all the same.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/007: Speaking of which, where are Cyrano and Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/008: Just went out with Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/011: There is actually a piano here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/015: Wow~ Then play a song for us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/016: Well, I haven't played this for a long time, and I don't know if I can play it well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/023: This piece of music can only be played so far by one person. /nFrom the next section, two people have to play together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/024: However, mother can always play to the end alone. Every time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/028: Hoo, hoo...what happened suddenly? /n Without saying a word...he rushed into this room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/029: That piano piece just now...who played it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/031: That piece.../10d Where did you learn it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/032: ...? /nMy mother taught me this. What's wrong?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/042: Ah! How do you know this song...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/046: Oh my god...Cyrano can actually play the piano...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/048: But how does Cyrano know this song?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/050: Obviously only my mother knows this song...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/051: Don't worry. /nI just heard it once before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx19/001: Our attack targets are the lords' mansions in Pretoria, Memphis and Bordeaux.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat21/000: As expected, they are all locked up here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat21/001: You are here to save us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat21/003: Come on, let's escape with the residents.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/000: Hmm... these guys... are actually able to come here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/001: Hehehe... I had already taken precautions and hired the Tuers as private soldiers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/002: Damn it! Arrest those guys immediately!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/003: ...Where did you keep the prisoners of the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/004: In...in the prison on the roof...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/005: Lord, I give you one hour. /nRelease the captives and get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/002: Fortunately, the injury was not fatal. /nHe seemed to instinctively turn sideways at the critical moment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/004: Speaking of which, your swordsmanship.../10d is quite unique.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/005: You are the one. Since you claim to be the descendant of Sombra, why do you use the Pendragon sword technique?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/006: Heh, it seems we all have a lot of secrets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/007: Then, let's talk about it next time we have a chance...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/010: What's going on? /nYou suddenly ran out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/012: Not yet fully in control of the mansion. Lady Esmeralda is treating the wounded, and Kana has gone to support other troops.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/013: Okay. /nThen, Meditch is up to you. /nAlthough the injury was not fatal, he has not woken up yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/015: I want to enter the mansion. /nRuben...should be waiting for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/017: Is it okay for you to go alone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/018: There are some things that need to be settled between Ruben and I.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/021: There is something between Ruben and I that must be settled between the two of us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/023: [West Wind Falcon Supply Soldier]/nIf you need any items, I can supply them for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflxca06/000: Is this the secret stronghold of the church?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/001: Hehehe, I had expected this, so I hired the Tuer army...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/002: Damn it! Teach those guys a lesson!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/004: ...Where did you keep the prisoners of the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/006: Lord, I give you one hour. /15d/n Release the captives and get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/000: Is this the true face of the God of Destruction...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/002: Avoid the center part where Christina is and attack the enemy's offensive part!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/003: All parts of the God of Destruction that can launch attacks have been destroyed!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/008: [Esmeralda]/nO Almighty Mana, I pray with my life...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/009: As expected...can't we destroy it without touching Christina at the core...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/010: It seems there is no other way.../40d The time spent with everyone.../30d I will never forget...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/000: Phew, it looks like /10d finally escaped.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/001: /2c Cyrepus. The entrance to the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/006: This is... the entrance to the underwater city? /15d And, Sharn Hoiste, you...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/007: There is no need to hide it anymore.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/009: Oh my God! /15d Nerd Clausewitz is actually the Phantom Thief Sharn Hoiste!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/010: For some reasons, I have been hiding my identity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/011: Did you bring me out of the underwater city?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/013: All I remember was that I attacked Cyrano after being united with the God of Destruction.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/014:
It was Lady Esmeralda who sacrificed herself to separate you from the God of Destruction, /30d and then Lady Cyrano sacrificed herself to save you.
Is
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/016: But, I don't understand. /30dWhy did Cyrano save me who wanted to kill him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/017: I don't know the reason, but one thing has become certain recently. /30d Sir Cyrano did not personally hurt your parents.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/018: We carefully investigated the body of Lord Frederick, who was said to have been killed by Cyrano, and /40d found traces left by the dark killers under Cardinal Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/019: What? /20d Could it be that grandpa brought dad...? !
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/020: Not only that, Mrs. Frederick did die after meeting Lord Cyrano, but according to our intelligence, the cause of her death was poisoning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/021: Sir Cyrano wants to kill an ordinary woman, will he need to use poison?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/022: ...Could it be that...even the mother...? /30d Impossible.../20d Mother is grandpa's only daughter...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/023: Although Lord Cyrano has passed away and the truth remains a mystery, what is certain is that Cardinal Cesare was involved in the matter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/024: The mother seems to know Cyrano well./20dThe piano song was the same.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/025: When she taught me that piece of music, she said that the only people who knew it now were me and her. Her expression at that time seemed like she was missing something. /50d But Cyrano also knows that song...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/026: Actually, I don't understand why Lord Mercedes invited Lord Cyrano alone, and /40d also doesn't understand why Lord Cyrano accepted the invitation and went to a dangerous place alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/027: According to my guess, the two of you must have had an unusual fate in the past.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/028: Even so.../20dWhy do you still sacrifice your life to save me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/029: Well...I don't know the specific reason, but he even left a request for me to assist Miss Christina...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/030: It seems that Lord Cyrano does not regard Miss Christina as an outsider.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/031: ...Grandpa must know the inside story of all this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/032: Furthermore, I have the responsibility to stop grandpa's vain ambition on behalf of my father, mother, and Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/033: Cardinal Cesare may have set off in person to request reinforcements from Bifrost again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/034: To protect this land from another invasion by Bifrost, we need Miss Christina, the legitimate heir of the Frederick family, to inherit the legacy of His Excellency Alfred Frederick and join forces with our Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/036: So, in order to reunite the divided Zephyr Falcon, we must first find Lord Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/038: Well...according to his usual temperament, I think he probably moves between taverns in various places.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/000: This is Antananarivo. /nA village located on the border between the empire's territory and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/001: People here are always living under the threat of war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/002: There is a mountain called Manticoa to the north. Over that mountain is Beeffrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/003: Recently, the number of soldiers traveling from the north to the south and passing through our village has increased significantly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/004: This has been a strategic location since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/006: Alas...Celepus is too far away...I really want to see Nikacha with my own eyes...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/007: I also know what Nikacha said.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/008: Hello, this is a mountain hotel. Accommodation costs 85Eld. Want to stay one night?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/009: Thank you and have a good sleep.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/010: The next time you come, you must stay one night before leaving.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/012: Hello, this is a hotel. Want accommodation?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/013: Hmph! If anyone can work as hard for this hotel as I can, tell him to come out and take a look!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/014: I work so hard, but my boss is so stingy with me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/015: That is, I am still willing to stay in this hotel. Otherwise, who would be willing to guard this kind of mountain village hotel?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/016: This place is very suitable for resting your tired body and mind...and quiet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/017: I was a Templar in Astania. The scene of Lord Shuli and Lord Kaza making heroic sacrifices in the war against the Tuer people is still deeply etched in my heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/020: Welcome. This is the only tavern in Antananarivo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/021: Our village is located on the border of the empire and has been invaded by foreign enemies many times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/022: However, there has not been such a force recently, so it is relatively calm.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/024: This village has beautiful natural scenery and was once a resort for many people to rest and recuperate; but it has also shed countless blood due to years of war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/025: I heard that His Majesty the Black Prince also stayed here in the past.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/026: Nothing tastes better than a beer on the job.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/027: What mission? /10d Well, that's a secret... /30d Actually, I was fired and now I'm unemployed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/028: Is there anyone you want to get rid of? /20d I can help you solve it very cheaply.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/029: Heh, I am a traveling nobleman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/030: I've met all kinds of women, but none quite like Sharon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/032: I am a captain. /10d I should have stayed at the beach, but do you know why I ended up in a mountain village like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/033: I was fired. He had to leave the boat he had driven for decades. Today's ship owners prefer young captains.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/034: You won't understand how I felt when I left that ship that was like my wife...! /15d My heart felt like it was being torn apart, and I was filled with resentment and resentment stuck in my throat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/035: [Cole]/nWelcome. Although we are located on the border, we have many good guns and weapons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/037: Gun is the best among weapons. We will prepare high-quality goods for you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/038: [Hilde]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/040: Thank you for visiting our store and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/041: The uncle at the weapons shop in our village has many, many guns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/042: He once showed me a particularly good gun. It was really beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/044: More and more soldiers are moving from the north to the south, and they are carrying more and more weapons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/045: I used to be a member of the Zephyr Falcon. But when I went to the battlefield for the first time, I was so scared...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/046: I ran away from there...I'm a despicable coward...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/047: The atmosphere of war in Antananarivo is getting stronger and stronger...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/048: Recently, no matter where people meet, they talk about war. They say that Beeffrost seems to be heading south in a big way...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/049: Not long ago, a friend of mine was standing under a tree and suddenly showed a strange look in his eyes...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/050: /2c "I understand. Now, it's time for me to embark on my journey."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/051: Then, he left the village. Leaving your family behind...it's weird, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/052: My homeland is on the far side of the sea. A lot of people who can no longer sail here live.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/053: People who used to sail boats often settled far away from the sea like this in order to forget about missing the sea.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/054: [Gina]/nOh, so you still think you did the right thing, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/055: [John]/nAh...just for that little thing, is this all? Really.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/056: [Gina]/nWhat about that? What is that thing? Are you dating me? How can I go see other women?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/058: [Gina]/nLunch, lunch! ha! Just lunch, right? /nBut my friend Jane said she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/059: [John]/n (guilty)! ! /nSee? /10dWhat did you see? Where is /10d? /10dWhere did she see me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/060: [Gina]/nA place like that.../20d I can't even say it, really!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/061: [Gina]/nHey, this one! /15d Do you think a person who already has a lover can still date others?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/063: Okay. Love is not a bondage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/064: No, that would be betraying the other party.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/066: [Gina]/nHa! /10d Ha! /10d man! /20dOkay, this one, /10dThis is for you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/068: [John]/nHuh? That's my birthday gift to you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/069: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away. /10dWhat do you want?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/071: Looks like it's better to avoid it as soon as possible...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/072: If you really like the other person, you can't do that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/076: [Gina]/nOh, oh! What are you doing! That's the gun I finally saved up to buy for you...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/077: [John]/nAlas... She gave me other gifts. I don't need this gun anymore...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/078: [Gina]/nHa! /10d Ha! /10d You have to do this, right? /10d Let's make it clear today!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/079: Mind your own business and go away!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/081: East----Antananarivo Fortress, direction of Manticoa Mountain
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/082: Guest, you can't go over there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/083: Maybe. After all, people are not other people's property.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/086: Goodbye. Good luck with the testing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/087: There are many bad rumors about Miss Jane, the hotel waiter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/088: [Jackie]/nI have some good stuff here, do you want to see it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/090: Walk slowly, see you next time!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/091: It looks like a war is about to begin, as the adults said. If war puts our village in danger, I will risk my life to protect it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/092: But it seems that this place cannot escape the threat of war... Is there really no place in this old empire territory where people can live peacefully and peacefully?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/093: I heard from the elders in the village that this is the first time that this place has not experienced a war in so long. /20d Even I grew up without seeing war.../15d But I am still scared.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/094: ...Have you seen that child? /nI have been waiting for him. I hope he will come back one day, but...but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/095: It seems that the shadow of war is also hanging over this place, and it's time for me to leave... But this time, where can I go...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/096: War, I've had enough. Otherwise, why should I live so far away.../30dBut I'm afraid it's over./10dAlas, Lord Shury...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/000_3: This is Antananarivo. /nA village located on the border between the empire's territory and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/001_3: People here are always living under the threat of war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/002_3: There is a mountain called Mantegoa to the north of here, and over it is Bifrost.
