Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/003_3: Do you know Sharn Hoiste, the Phantom Thief?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/004_3: This has been a strategic location since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/008_3: Hello, this is a hotel. Accommodation requires 85 Gold. Want to stay one night?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/010_3: The next time you come, stay one night before leaving.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/012_3: Hello, this is a hotel. Want accommodation?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/014_3: But even so, the boss is still extremely stingy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/016_3: This place is very suitable for resting your tired body and mind...and quiet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/017_3: I was a Templar in Astania. The scene of Lord Shuli and Lord Kaza making heroic sacrifices on the battlefield still remains deeply in my heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/020_3: Welcome. This is the only tavern in Antananarivo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/021_3: Our village is located on the main road leading to Bifrost and has been invaded by foreign enemies many times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/024_3: There are many bad rumors about Miss Jane, the hotel waiter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/025_3: Her words are not very credible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/027_3: What task? Well, that's the secret... Actually, I got fired and am now unemployed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/028_3: Is there anyone you want to kill? I can help you out very cheaply.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/032_3: As you can see, I'm a captain. Do you know why I am staying in this mountain village when I should be at the beach?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/034_3: That ship is like my wife, do you know how I felt when I left it! My heart felt like it was being torn apart, and my throat was full of resentment. I want revenge...that bastard captain...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/035_3: [Mr. Cole]/nWelcome. Although we are located on the border, we have many good guns and weapons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/038_3: [Miss Hilde]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/044_3: I heard that he would take money from the rich and give it to the poor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/047_3: What makes Sharon's show so beautiful is not her song, nor her voice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/048_3: It's her unpretentious attitude and her genuine concern for her fans.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/050_3: "I understand. It's time for me to go on a long journey."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/051_3: Then, he left the village. Leaving your parents behind...isn't it strange?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/052_3: My homeland is on the far side of the sea.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/053_3: Unfortunately, there is no boat to drive, so I came here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/054_3: [Gina]/nOh, so you still think you did the right thing, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/055_3: [John]/nAh...just for that little thing, is this all? Really.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/056_3: [Gina]/nWhat about that? What is that thing? Are you dating me? How can I go see other women?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/058_3: [Gina]/nLunch, lunch! ha! Just lunch, right? /nBut my friend Jane said she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/059_3: [John]/n (guilty)! ! /nSee? What do you see? Where? Where did she see me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/060_3: [Gina]/nThat kind of place.../nI can't even describe it, really!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/061_3: [Gina]/nHey, this one! Do you think a person who already has a lover can still see others?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/066_3: [Gina]/nHa! ha! Man! Okay, here, this is for you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/068_3: [John]/nHuh? That's my birthday gift to you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/069_3: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away. What do you want?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/071_3: Looks like it's better to leave here as soon as possible...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/072_3: If you really like the other person, can you still do that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/076_3: [Gina]/nOh, oh! What are you doing! That's the gun I finally saved up to buy for you...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/077_3: [John]/nAlas...she gave me other gifts. I don't need this gun anymore...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/078_3: [Gina]/nHa! ha! You have to do this, right? Let's make it clear today!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/081_3: East----Antananarivo Fortress, direction of Manticoa Mountain
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/082_3: Guest, you can't come from there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/005: How could Brother Meditch arrive so early? /15d/n Probably got involved in something inexplicable again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/006: Putting aside that, Kana, do you have any brain? /10d/n actually left his subordinates and left without authorization!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/007: Huh~/15d/nI never thought Duke Ruben would come back so soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/008: He seems to have gone to see General Irus, who happened to be stationed nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/009: I think this is indeed something Kana-sama could not predict.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/010: Kana! No matter how it happened, the sacrifice of his subordinates is the captain's responsibility.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/011: Clausewitz, /10d/n Once this matter is resolved, appropriate accountability must be held.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/013: So, who are the people behind you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/014: Ah, they helped us a lot this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/015: Kana! You actually brought an outsider here.../15d/nCan you wake up?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/016: However, thanks to them, we can liberate the territory of Viscount Ramon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/017: I also heard about that.../nThe three of them razed the Viscount's mansion to the ground. Is this true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/018: They are really awesome. /nEveryone is a top master.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/019: Even so, it would be too rash to bring outsiders to our top-secret meeting place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/020: Hmph! I don't know what's so great about you, but it's very ugly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/021: Solve your own quarrels among yourself. We don't want to stay here, let's go!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/024: Lord Esmeralda, it would be better for you to stay here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/025: No, if you don't bother me, I hope to act together with Sir Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/026: Are you the famous Saint Esmeralda from Pretoria?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/027: Don't dare to be a saint. I'm just a regular doctor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/028: No. Lady Esmeralda is the most outstanding doctor in the empire that we have managed to invite many times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/029: I didn't expect to see you here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/030: Sorry./nLord Clousewitz's letter, I did receive it a few times, but there were too many patients to leave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/031: In this case, why not act together with us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/032: However, I have already received great kindness from these people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/033: Sorry, I have to leave with them too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/034: It doesn't have to be like this, Lady Esmeralda. /nDon't worry about us, just stay here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/035: Since he is traveling with Saint Esmeralda, he is worthy of trust. /nPlease also join us as the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/036: Tsk, the attitude suddenly changed completely.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/037: Sorry, we have our own things to do...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/039: Brother is late again! /nWhat happened this time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/040: This time is also very dangerous! /nHe rushed into the house that was almost burned by the fire and rescued four brothers and sisters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/042: Meditch, you are the true captain of the Zephyr Falcon. If something happens...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/043: But you can't pretend not to see people who are in trouble, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/044: It is indeed what Roberto de Meditch would say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/049: By the way, I heard that Kana's subordinates are in trouble this time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/050: It seems that General Irus intervened. /nGeneral Irus is the bravest general in the empire and a legendary figure who was listed as one of the four kings of the empire in the past.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/051: Well, if it was really that Irus, it might be a blessing that Kana wasn't there at the time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/052: It seems that we can only ask Lord Meditch to deal with General Irus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/053: Hmm.../10d Even I don't know if I can compete with him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/055: Hahaha, but we can't leave Kana's subordinates alone. /nOkay, let General Irus see it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/056: But.../10d There are some new faces here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/057: They are the ones accompanying Lady Esmeralda whom we have always wanted to invite.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/058: Are you also willing to help us and participate in this battle?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/059: I apologize to everyone for what happened just now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/063: Great! /nCyrano-sama, please join our fourth unit and act together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/064: Great! /nCyrano-sama, please join our fourth unit and act together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/065: Then, the following explains the battle plan for attacking Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/066: First, ask the second unit led by Lord Isabele and the third unit led by Lord Rhidelhard to attack both sides of the village and town at the same time to disrupt the enemy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/067: After successfully infiltrating, ask Lord Meditch to attack the lord's mansion from the front.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/068: When Lord Meditch was dealing with General Irus, Lord Kana entered the underground of the mansion through the underground waterway and rescued the captured people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/069: Then, let me meet the Four Heavenly Kings of the old empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/000: This is the village of Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/001: This is a quiet village surrounded by forests.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/002: Have you been to Gesir City in the south? I've been there once, what a great place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/003: Our tavern's chef, Mr. Kagg, is a bit eccentric. /15d He is always traveling to find ingredients for new dishes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/004: I heard that General Kars of the old empire defeated the strongest dark dragon and won the title of "Dragon Slayer"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/008: It is easy to get lost in the desert, but it is difficult to find your way back. This is especially true when there is no good guide...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/009: Have you ever seen Lord Irus wield a sword? That momentum is really amazing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/010: Huh? You guys are very unfamiliar...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/011: David? I heard he was hiding a bad demon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/012: There are many treasures left by the nobles of the past hidden in underground cities all over the territory of old Gesir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/013:
Maybe it would be better to have a church. Now it seems that everything is at the discretion of Master Ruben.
What did
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/014: No one should have heard it, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/015: Churches are usually not located near villages. Monasteries are usually built in deep mountains.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/016: What's the use? Most of the clergy continued to come in and out of the village and interfered.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/017: Shhh...if you offend the church, you won't survive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/019: Elegance and romance are the real joys of living in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/020: That guy Ruben's guys are despicable. Select the enemy with the least physical strength to fight first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/021: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/022: I heard that the sun in the desert hangs in the sky for too long and seems to be fixed in one position?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/023: Ramon, the lord of Pretoria, has always been known for his eccentric behavior. But Duke Ruben here is no less generous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/025: So he is often not in the store. However, his cooking is really delicious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/026: [Chef Kag]/nReal cuisine comes from the best ingredients, the chef's skills, and his heart. If you can find good ingredients, I will thank you very much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/027: [Chef Kag]/nWithout good ingredients, no matter how good your craftsmanship is, it will be of no use.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/028: [Chef Kag]/nHaven't found any good ingredients yet? Really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/029: [Chef Kag]/nWe are a family of chefs. The brothers are scattered all over the country. If you see them, say hello for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/030:
amazing? Killed the Dark Dragon with just one sword! ! /20d I will also work hard to learn swordsmanship, and one day I will become an outstanding swordsman like General Karls!
Isn't
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/031: But...I heard that dragons hide very powerful gems? /20dDid General Kars also discover those gems?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/032: My father is a businessman, so I often move around.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/033: Go all the way northeast and you will reach a city called Libreville. It's a pretty strange place there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/034: Hehehehe... do you know? I found an incredible treasure before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/035: However, after going there once, I can no longer find the way! /15d what to do? What to do with /5d? What to do with /5d? /5dMy treasure! /5dMy treasure!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/036: Obviously, /10d obviously remembers that /10d is somewhere near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/037: In the desert, you must believe in yourself. /10d Once you start to doubt yourself, you will no longer be able to survive in the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/039: [Jane]/nAh...I hate nagging the most...Don't look at me like this, I will do whatever I need to do, don't worry...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/040: [Jane]/nShh! There seems to be a business to do today...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/041: [Jane]/nWho are you? If you want to say nonsense about "you shouldn't come to this kind of place", just get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/042: Jian's child? He used to be a good boy, but after his mother disappeared, he has always been like this. How pitiful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/043: Enter the cave to explore, but you have to risk your life...it's very dangerous inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/044: The really scary thing is not the enemies in the dungeon, but the exhaustion of equipment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/048: This is the shop opened by my mother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/050: Bifrost's swordswoman Katarina is our distant relative.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/053: You bring good things, and I will give you good things.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/055: The forest near the village, leading to many different villages.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/056: There is even a road through the desert to Seraps. However, it is best not to go to the desert, it is too easy to die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/057: Libreville is such a strange city. Even though we are so far north, the weather is always warm.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/059: Welcome to Caracas Hotel. Do you want accommodation?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/060: Thank you and have a nice rest...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/061: You don't plan to live there, so why are you talking to me? Are you interested in me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/062: Thank you for your patronage and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/063: Oh...this is the ultimate mushroom! It's the kind of mushroom that only grows deep in inaccessible caves!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/064: Thank you, thank you so much. Let me think about it, what should I give you in return...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/065: Please choose one item from the following.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/068: [Mr. Chef Karg]/nOh... isn't this Love Herb! Only where true love sprouts, precious spices will germinate by absorbing that essence!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/069: [Mr. Chef Kagg]/nThank you, thank you very much! Let's take this as a return gift!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/070: Ah! This is...the ultimate spice "Higashi"! Isn't it the legendary spice of the Tu'er people? Where did you find such a precious thing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/071: Thank you so much for finding it... I have to give you something in return...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/072: There are many edible fruits growing nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/073: John came back from picking a strange mushroom not long ago. He said he picked it deep in the cave near the village...the smell is really delicious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/074: Looks like I have to stay in this village for a while...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/076: [Miss Moncrief]/nWelcome and thank you for coming to our hotel. Want to stay one night? The price is 80 eld.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/077: Thank you, please have a good rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/078: That's it...welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/079: Thank you for staying at our hotel. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/080: [Elgi]/nWelcome, is there anything you are looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/082: Thank you for patronizing our store. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/083: [Mr. Joseph]/nWelcome. How can I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/086: [Mrs. Simpson]/nWelcome. Our signature weapon is the Swordbreaker. This sword is very cost effective, be sure to buy one as a backup.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/087: Weapon Shop, "One Thousand and One Nights"
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/088: Good weapons are the basic equipment for a warrior. Thank you for your patronage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/089: [Mr. Simpson]/nWelcome to our store. To buy spears, spears and swords, please see my wife.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/090: "One Thousand and One Nights" Weapon Shop
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/091: Our products are trustworthy. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/092: Is there anything else to eat?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/094: [Arena Boss]/nHahaha! Men need to exercise their strength! Come try it out in our arena! However, this is actual combat, and I won't be responsible if you die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/096: Currently all the products for sale in our store have been moved to the jewelry store.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/097: [Mr. Ergul]/nHahaha! The arena in our village is the most suitable for actual combat training! Men should have power, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/099: Thank you! If you have the chance, go to the arena run by my brother Ron!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/100: [Arena Clerk]/nPlease show your ticket before entering.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/102: is a one-time pass, please come in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/103: is a lifetime pass, please come in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/104: When XP increases, the character's attack power and defense power will increase at the same time. XP will also be increased when defending, so when the battle is unfavorable, you can use defense to persevere. /n----Tactics Research Association under Geisir Academy----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/105: Various weapons can be easily damaged due to their own characteristics, so always carry a spare weapon. /n----Tactics Research Association under Geisir Academy----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/106: The current map of Old Empire territory is inaccurate. When walking in the forest or on mountain trails, be sure to draw your own map. /n----The Imperial Geographical Society under the Geysir Academy----
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/107: How pitiful... David is the only one who suffers. He was going to be burned to death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/108: David was sentenced to be burned at the stake for harboring the Zephyr Falcon. How pitiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/111: Thank you and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/112: Guests cannot enter without a ticket.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/113: Pay the ticket. You can't go in without the ticket.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/114:
weapon information is as follows. /nWeapon HP: HP of the weapon itself. When the damage sustained by the weapon exceeds its own limit, the weapon's HP will drop by 1 point; when the weapon's HP drops to 0, the weapon will be damaged. Repairing can restore the weapon's HP.
The meaning of
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/115: Attack power: The attack power of the weapon. The character's attack power is determined by the weapon's attack power and its own strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/116: Defense: When blocking enemy attacks with weapons, the damage will be reduced by the percentage corresponding to this value. Remember, this is a percentage, not a fixed number!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/117: Have you heard what your friend said about the previous content? Let me explain the next value. The limit value is the upper limit of the damage the weapon can withstand without losing its own HP. In other words, the three values of the weapon's defense, limit value and HP determine its lifespan.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/118: Next is the hit rate, which is the attack hit rate of the weapon itself. Although not shown, weapons also have a defense success rate, so the defense probability in battle varies. On a successful defense, the damage is taken by the weapon, so weapons with a high defense rate are also more susceptible to damage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/119: Our branch of the Gesil Academy Swordsmanship Research Society is located in the west of Caracas. You can go and have a look.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/120: Let's replenish supplies at the weapon shop here first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/121: Hmph...that guy Ruben's men are all despicable cowards.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/122: When fighting, they only single out the weakest members of our party to attack. Really despicable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/123: However, you can also take advantage of this and deal with them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/001_3: This is a quiet village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/002_3: Have you been to Gesir City in the south? I've been there once and it's such a beautiful place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/003_3: The chef in our tavern, Mr. Karg, is a bit eccentric. He is always traveling in search of ingredients for new dishes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/004_3: Have you heard that our Lord Kars once killed a dragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/007_3: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. I almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/008_3: It is easy to get lost in the desert, but it is difficult to find your way back. This is especially true when there is no good guide...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/016_3: What's the use? Most of the clergy continued to come in and out of the village and interfered.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/017_3: Shhh...I've offended the church, but I can't survive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/019_3: Elegance and romance are the real joys of living in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/021_3: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/023_3: Ramon, the lord of Pretoria, has always been known for his eccentric behavior. But Duke Ruben here is no less generous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/030_3: Isn't it amazing? Actually killed the dragon! ! I will also work hard to learn swordsmanship, and one day I will become an outstanding swordsman like Lord Karls!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/031_3: But... I heard that dragons hide very powerful gems?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/032_3: My father is a businessman, so I often move around.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/033_3: Go all the way northeast and you will reach a city called Libreville. It's a pretty strange place there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/034_3: Hehe... do you know? I found an incredible treasure before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/035_3: However, after going there once, I can no longer find the way! what to do? what to do? what to do? My treasure! My treasure!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/036_3: Mingming, Mingming seems to be somewhere near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/037_3: In the desert, you must believe in yourself. Once you start doubting yourself, you will no longer be able to survive in the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/043_3: If you venture into the cave, you may have to risk your life...it's very dangerous inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/048_3: This is the shop opened by my mother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/057_3: Libreville is such a strange city. Although it is so far north, it is very warm.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/068_3: Oh... isn't this Love Herb! Only where true love sprouts, precious spices will germinate by absorbing that essence!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/069_3: Thank you, thank you so much! Let's take this as a return gift!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/076_3: [Miss Moncrief] Welcome and thank you for coming to our hotel. Want to stay one night? The price is 80 Gold.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/080_3: [Elgi]/nWelcome, is there anything you are looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/086_3: [Mrs. Simpson]/nWelcome, please choose the weapon you want. Our store has cheap prices and good weapons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/089_3: [Mr. Simpson]/nWelcome to our store. Please choose slowly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/091_3: Our products are trustworthy. Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/001: It's like a dream to be able to look at you next to you like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/002: You are so beautiful, so stunningly beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/003: But true beauty is not just about appearance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/004: Mercedes, your kind heart makes you more cute and beautiful than your appearance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/006: Only you would say something like this to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/007: No one understands how I feel. Even my father is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/009: I really hope that the time I spend with you like today can last forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/010: Don't worry, not even death can separate us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/011: As long as we believe in this feeling and keep it in our hearts forever,
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/012: Are you willing to believe me and follow me? Mercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/013: Cyrano, you are all I have. Please always stay with me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/014: Okay, we will always be together. No matter what happens...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/016: I love you, Mercedes. Love you more than anyone else...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/019: It's like a dream to be able to look at you next to you like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/021: You are so beautiful, so stunningly beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/022: But your beauty is not just because of your appearance. /10dMercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/023: Mercedes,/15d/nYou always treat other people's misfortunes as your own.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/025: Don't look at me like that... /10d... /10d... /10d Don't look at me like that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/026: You are so beautiful, so stunningly beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/028: Did you know? That kindness makes you more lovable and beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/029: Because of what happened to my father.../8d.../8d.../8dYou have been in pain, /15dI know it all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/031: No one understands how I feel. /10d Even my father is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/033: I really hope that the time I spend with you like today can last forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/034: Are you willing to believe me and follow me? /15dMercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/035: Cyrano, you are all I have. /15d/nPlease stay with me forever.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/036: Okay, we will always be together. /10d/nNo matter what happens.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/038: I love you, Mercedes. /18d/n love you more than anyone else...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/039: [Butler]/nMaster, Miss. /nThe engagement ceremony is about to begin, please enter the hall.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka08a/000: This is not the direction to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/001: Come on, let's go to Esther Dodd's Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/002: I really don't understand why Meditch is like that!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/003: ...? /nDidn't you say you were going to Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/004: When will your heart finally gain peace?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/005: The lord named Esther Dodd seems to be very simple.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/008: I've heard that Libreville is surprisingly warm despite being located at the northernmost point of the Empire's territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/011: Meditch-sama, I leave it to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/012: This is the war conference room of Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/014: Do you know the book "Secret Records of the Creation War"? It's a very interesting book.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/015: /2c Falcon of the West Wind. War meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/016: Everyone is here. /15d/nThen, let's start the meeting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/017: Just now, Lord Esther Dodd's messenger arrived.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/018: Esther Dodd.../5d is the one from Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/019: That's right. /10d/n is the female lord of Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/020: Libreville is located in the northern part of the empire, near Bifrost, so the church's power is not strong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/021: So, what's up with the Lord of Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/022: Everyone should know that Archduke Bifrost is extremely ambitious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/023: A while ago, he began to massively expand the army, and now it seems that he is using the army to put pressure on the small lords in the imperial territory near Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/025: So she asked us, the Falcon of the West Wind, for help!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/027: Hmm...Don't you think it's a little strange that the lord of the empire asks for help from the Falcon of the West Wind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/028: Hmm...Don't you think it's a little strange that the lord of the empire asks for help from the Falcon of the West Wind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/029: Therefore, I have also conducted multiple investigations, and it should not be a trap.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/030: Lord Esther Dodd is not very close to the church or Gesil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/031: Hahaha, what kind of man would he be if he ignored the beauty lord's request? /15d/nLet's go, hurry up and set off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/033: We'll discuss the specific situation when we get to Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/036: That's not what it means... /15d is because there is no /5d key and it cannot be opened.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/038: Are we going to the Caracas Forest with our fourth unit?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/039: Going to the Caracas Forest with Kana's troops?/n(The selection of peers will be automatic./nMove to Caracas Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/042: Okay, let's go to the Caracas forest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/043: Then go to Caracas with Kana?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/044: We split up to get familiar with the terrain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat02/000: The fortress here has been destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat02/000_3: The fortress here has been destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/001: This ship is the Pendragon liaison ship bound for Storm Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/002: Sorry, you can't get on the ship.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/003: This is the liaison ship to Storm Island.../10d What to do now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/008: Yes, everything went well. /nShould be able to set sail around dawn tomorrow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/009: Okay. /nThanks everyone for your hard work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/010: By the way, has everyone had dinner?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/012: As expected, I haven't eaten yet. /nJust to celebrate the voyage, I'll treat everyone to a good meal and follow me to the tavern.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/014: Hahaha, don't worry. How could anyone want to go to Storm Island? /nIt's okay, everyone, let's go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/016: This is the liaison ship to Storm Island.../10d What to do now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/018: Explain the situation well to the crew.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/019: Hide and wait for the opportunity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/020: No way.../10d Explain the situation to the crew, maybe they will let me on board...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/021: Excuse me, can you take me to Storm Island? /30d I must go there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/022: Huh? /15d Do you want to take this boat? /20d/nNo, this ship is for those who live on Storm Island...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/023: Wait, it's boring anyway, so why not give him a chance /15d.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/024: Opportunity? /15dWhat do you want to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/025: I will ask a few questions. Can you try to answer them? If you answer correctly, I will take you to Storm Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/026: I don't have any other choice, right? /20d As long as it takes me there, I'm willing to try anything.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/028: Okay, as long as you answer correctly, the two of us will be responsible for sending you to Storm Island!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/029: Then it begins! Listen to the question clearly before answering.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/030: During the Creation War that year, what was the name of the four-nation Eastern Alliance formed by Pendragon, Astania, Dagar, and Curtis?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/033: The second question is mine. /15dChoose one of the three answers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/034: Beladin, the culprit of the Creation War, is the inheritor of the Dark God. /20d Do you know what the Dark God is in charge of?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/038: Oops, wrong answer. /20d Dark Armor refers to the imperial alliance composed of the three western countries of Gethir, Trixis, and Galad. /20d is also called the black flag.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/039: The Eastern Four Nations Alliance is called Silver Arrow, and it is an alliance centered on Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/040: This is common sense, but you don't know it. /nThink carefully before answering the next question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/041: As expected, the answer was correct. /15d However, this question is really simple.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/042: Dark Armor refers to the imperial alliance composed of the three western countries of Gethir, Trisis, and Galad. Of course you know this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/043: Starting from the second question, it needs to be a little more difficult, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/044: Oh, I answered it right in one go. /20d Yes, Beladin is the inheritor of the Dark God "Bella Mod of Conspiracy".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/045: Is this question a bit difficult? /15d The Dark God in charge of destruction is "Eustacia of Destruction" and has nothing to do with Belatin.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/046: The next question will be easier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/047: Oh my, the dark god of war is the goddess "Shakbari of War". /20d has nothing to do with Belatin.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/050: Curtis, the only country on the continent that implements a republican system, do you know the name of its first president?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/055: Yeah, I know very clearly. Curtis' first president was Arcia. /20d Ariana and little Ariana are the people who support him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/056: Ariana, then known as the Divine Bow, never served as president, though she did lay the foundations of the Curtis Republic/30d.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/057: I thought modern history was relatively simple. Have you remembered it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/058: Little Ariana is the son of Ariana the Divine Bow and an important figure in promoting the Curtis Republic, but he was still too young when the Republic was established.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/060: Pfft hehe, I didn't expect you to fall into such a trap. /20d There is no such person as Little Alcia at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/061: Maybe I misremembered it, but it was the wrong answer anyway.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/062: If you don't know this question, I really don't feel confident taking you to Storm Island. /20d You must answer it correctly this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/063: What is the relationship between Eoline who lives on Storm Island and our Majesty Rashid in Pendragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/065: The sister of His Majesty Rashid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/067: The daughter of His Majesty Rashid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/068: As expected, the answer was correct. /15d Also, Eoline is the sister of His Majesty Rashid. This matter is well known to every household, and few people don't know about it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/069: Come on, then, let's answer the last question well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/070: Tsk tsk... How could it be that the daughter of His Majesty Rashid lived on Storm Island fifty years ago. /30d His Majesty's eldest daughter is not yet forty years old.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/071: However, it seems that you don't know much about Ioline.../20d This makes me a little worried about taking you to Storm Island...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/072: Oops... His Majesty Rashid's parents were killed in the Battle of Glates in the early days of the Creation War and are no longer alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/074: Correct answer. /10d Arcea was the first president of the Republic of Curtis. /15d Ariana and Little Ariana are characters who support him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/075: You answered the question of modern history better than I thought.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/076: Hmm... They are indeed siblings, /20d but Ioline is older.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/078: This is the last question. /15d is not easy to answer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/079: During the Creation War, four swordsmen were known as the strongest in the entire continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/080: The Black Prince of the Gesir Empire, Rashid Pendragon of the Pendragon Kingdom, General Kars, one of the Seven Warriors of the Empire and one of the Four Heavenly Kings, and the wandering swordsman Crow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/081: People began to give each of these four people different titles based on their personalities and swordsmanship. /30d Okay, now the questions!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/082: Among the four great swordsmen in the Creation War, what is the title of General Kars?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/087: Oh my God, the Sword Emperor refers to the Overlord Black Prince. /20d General Kars is the disciple and subordinate of the Black Prince. How can someone who serves the monarch be called the emperor?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/089: Sword Demon.../15d No.../20d Sword Demon refers to the elusive wandering swordsman Crow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/090: The last question, unfortunately I got it wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/091: Tsk.../10d Sword Master, isn't it the title specially given to our "His Majesty the Holy King Rashid"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/092: Although Kars is a great swordsman, he is not a saint. /20d It would be more appropriate to say that he has some evil tendencies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/093: Sword Demon! /15d Yes, that's the right answer! /nKars's swordsmanship has long surpassed that of mortals and reached the realm of the magic sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/094: The sword he uses also has a terrifying name like "Hell-Destroying Sword".
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/095: It's not just the name that's scary. /20d It is said that it is a legendary magic sword as famous as the Black Prince's Asura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/096: In short, the last question was answered well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/097: Okay, then.../20d Since you answered at least three questions correctly.../15d We will let you board the ship as originally agreed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/098: We are responsible for what happens next!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/100: Thank you, we had a great time too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/101: Then quickly enter the cabin. /20d before the captain comes back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/102: Uh, then.../20d Oops...you can't even answer three of these common sense questions correctly. You...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/106: It seems that you are also in trouble.../20d Anyway, we passed the boring time, so as a return gift, it's okay to take you with us, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/107: I think so too. /20d is not inherently incapable of carrying people, and it makes no difference if you get a few questions wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/108: Life cannot be measured by scores.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/109: Thank you very much for letting me come on board.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/110: Okay, okay, leave the rest to us. Let's get into the cabin before the captain comes back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/112: It seems that instead of negotiating head-on, it is better to find an opportunity when the guards are lax.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo03/000: Who are you! /nIf you have nothing to do to find the lord, get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldro09/000: This is one of the few raw diamond mines in the empire. The diamonds we offer are far cheaper than the market price. Want to pick one?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldro09/002: Please take care. It's dangerous on the way out. Be careful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/002: Oh... today is the day when the young master is engaged.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/003: ...Congratulations on your engagement. As a woman, I really envy Miss Mercedes. Please be happy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/002_3: Oh... today is the day when the young master is engaged.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/003_3: ...Congratulations on your engagement. As a woman, I really envy Miss Mercedes. I wish you happiness...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/000: I also want to go together.../nI will be worried if you go alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/001: It's been a long time since I've been out as a team leader...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/002: This mission is very important. Please be successful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/003: This is the war conference room of Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/006: I didn't expect to go on a mission with Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/007: Will there really be a treasure?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/009: It's up to you this time. /nI hope you will succeed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/010: Treasure hunting.../10d It's not bad to come here once in a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/012: /2c Falcon of the West Wind. War meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/015: There is a situation. /nCardinal Cesare seems to be planning something in the Nicosia area.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/016: Cesare.../10d Are you talking about Borgia?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/017: According to intelligence, he built a fortress in the Nicosia area and seemed to be planning something.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/018: However, the place was heavily guarded and we were unable to send intelligence agents to infiltrate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/019: The mission is to go there with me and investigate what they are doing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/020: Nicosia is a small place south of Gesir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/021: Then you have to pass through Gesil City and go south. /15d/nThe road is not close.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/023: Have you been there? /15d/n It was once the capital of the old empire, and it is still the largest city in the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/024: But recently, Duke Frederick's Ron seems to be more energetic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/025: After all, that is the territory of Duke Frederick, the most powerful force in the empire today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/026: The power of our Zephyr Falcon has not yet extended there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/027: Then leave as soon as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/028: If there are any changes on our side, we will send messengers to inform you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/032: ....../20d Got it. /nI will not open this drawer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/033: Anyway...then...that drawer.../120d/n must not be opened!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/036: Gasir City. /nHas it been fifteen years...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/040: May you also find peace in your heart...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/041: So, what the strategist means is that Cesare intends to introduce Bifrost's army into the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/042: In my judgment, it is almost certain. /nA long time ago, we have noticed that there is a secret relationship between Bifrost and the church, and Cesare's right-hand man Machiavelli actually went to Bifrost in person, which is not a trivial matter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/043: This time Cesare's right-hand man, Machiavelli, went to Bifrost in person, which is very important.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/046: Machiavelli is actually very famous among scholars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/047: Machiavelli is actually very famous among scholars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/048: is known for researching new ideas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/049: ...He was my best friend when I was young. /nI didn't expect that he would actually work under Cesare...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/050: He and our military advisor are now known as the two greatest sages in the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/051: You say I am a sage, but I really don't dare to take it seriously.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/052: In short, he is famous for his thoughts and history, while I am better at strategy and war history.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/053: He has been a genius since he was a child. But he came from a poor background and was full of ambition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/054: In short, since he went to Bifrost in person, we can't just sit back and watch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/057: No, Miss Kana, I have another thing to ask you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/059: Not long ago, I accidentally got a treasure map. /nAfter identification, it was confirmed to be an authentic product left by the past mercenary group Cashmir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/060: If we can find those treasures, we can solve the funding and equipment problems we are facing after the recent attack by Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/062: He has been a genius since he was a child. But he came from a poor background and was full of ambition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/063: Oops... I have to go too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/064: Yes, please come with Kana-sama this time. /nThere are also Sirs Isabele and Meditch, please take care of them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/065: So, while Cyrano is tracking Machiavelli, we have to hunt for treasure?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/066: Yes! /nIf I go with my sister, there will definitely be no problem!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/067: ....../25d Well, it's good to take a little break once in a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/068: In addition, please ask Lord Rhidelhard to assist Lord Cyrano in tracking down Machiavelli.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/070: This mission is important to us. Please put your personal feelings aside and get the job done.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/072: So, that's it for the meeting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/076: To go to Bifrost, you have to pass through Libreville. /nI'll take you to the Caracas forest first, okay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/077: Going to the Caracas Forest with Kana and others?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/079: Explore the remaining underground cities in the vicinity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/080: Okay, let's go to Caracas with Kana and the others!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/082: Sorry, I want to explore the dungeons around here again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/083: There is nothing we can do...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/084: I heard that there is a cave where the unicorn spirit is sealed on Mount Manticoa on the border of Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/085: Do you know about the new sword recently developed by Chrysaor Company of Pendragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/086: I heard that the price is not expensive, but its performance exceeds previous mass-produced swords, so it was selected as the standard sword by the Pendragon Army. /nAlthough it has not been circulated within the empire's territory, it has become a hot topic among swordsmen.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/087: Pendragon's new sword? Are you talking about the PS-7 "Blitz"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/088: I heard it was made to fight against the lightsabers of the Tur tribe. /nIt is not made of ordinary metal, but a special alloy, which is heat-resistant and impact-resistant. It has excellent offensive and defensive properties. It is said to be a top-notch weapon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/089: It looks like we need Captain Silver's help for this mission.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/001: This is Paro Village. Although it is not far from Gesir City, the customs and customs are quite different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/002: There is a lot of commotion outside, but our village is peaceful and peaceful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/003: It's so scary. He is the most handsome man in the village, but he has gone insane...and he also has a fiancee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/004: This place is quite remote, and few people usually come here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/005: However, a chef moved here from other places not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/006: I heard that he was looking for fresh ingredients for high-end cuisine, and felt that the environment here was clean and suited him well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/007: I was invited to Gesil City once before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/008: There are wide roads, beautiful buildings, and well-dressed people, which is dazzling to see.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/009: Living in the city... must be much better than living in a rural village like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/010: Our village is too small, and the lords don't even bother to ask.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/011: Hehe... Thanks to you, I live freely now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/012: Gasir City? Oh, city life is just an illusion. There is only superficial prosperity there, no real freedom at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/013: Let me just say that I was right, that engagement was a mistake! Their family should not have arranged this marriage in the first place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/014: I may feel sorry for Mr. Brian in saying this, but in the end, aren't both parties unlucky?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/015: That is a cursed family... Even if they are the richest family in Paro, they have nothing to do with the peace of our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/016: Our lord here seems to be particularly fond of children. There are many children in his family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/017: But the strange thing is that they are all girls.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/018: The lord also likes flowers. I heard that his courtyard is full of flowers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/019: I also saw Sharon perform. /20d She is such a beautiful sister...she also dances very well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/020: I originally wanted her autograph, but all those big brothers jumped in line, and I didn't get one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/021: If you meet Sharon, can you get an autograph for me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/022: [Dan Welling]/nOur family is a cursed family. /15d I originally opposed my son's marriage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/023: [Dan Welling] /nWith this series of things happening recently, my son seems to understand what is in the blood of our family. /10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/024: [Dan Welling] /nIn this way, this cursed family will be extinct.../10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm done. To actually do such a terrible thing with my own hands.../20dmarry?/10dWhat a fool I am for holding on to that kind of hope!/15dHahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/026: [Brian Waring]/nI don't need any comfort. Don't even try to convince me. /20d left me with only a dead end...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/028: [Diana] /nThere must be something wrong with this matter.../20d Brian must have misunderstood something!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/030: [Haisen]/nI am Dan's old friend, my name is Haisen.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/031: [Haisen]/nIn order to prevent my friend's son from falling into misfortune, I am trying to persuade Miss Diana...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/033: The strange thing is that I haven't heard anything about the singer named Sharon recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/034: She has many fans and is very popular. Why is there no news suddenly?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/035: What's even more surprising is that the fragments were found in a bag in Mr. Xio's room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/036: Welcome. We dare not say anything else here, the portion must be enough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/037: Where is Rashid III, the first heir to the Pendragon throne, hiding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/038: However, King Rashid is still so healthy, and he will not inherit the throne so quickly... If you come to my house one day, I would like to bring more food and drinks...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/039: There is a place near here called Caracas, where my brother Caag owns a restaurant.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/040: That guy's craftsmanship is good, but he pursues perfection too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/041: That guy urged me to find good ingredients for him whenever he had time. Haha...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/042: Hehehe... Do you think there will really be an overlord who controls the empire in the near future?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/043: To be king of the empire, must we have enough power over Cesare Borgia?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/044: Although there are rumors that someone has pulled out the Asura Sword that can determine the overlord of the empire...but the rumors are just rumors after all, aren't they? Hahaha.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/046: I got Sharon's autograph at the last show. Hehehe... I am the only one in our village who has it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/047: No matter how much money you pay, I won't sell it. /15d I want to pass it on to future generations as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/048: Hmm... If you bring something particularly good, I might consider it... such as Asmodeus' fragments or something...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/049: Diana is the most beautiful girl in the village, and all the men in the village admire her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/050: And Brian is the object of admiration for all the women in the village. When she announced that she was going to marry Brian, you had no idea how much gossip there was...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/051: In a sense, no one welcomes this engagement. Everyone is jealous of them except themselves.../20d
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/052: Welcome. What do you want to buy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/054: Thank you for your patronage. Please walk slowly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/055: Oh my god.../10d This is sister Sharon's signature! /20d Yeah~~~!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/056: This is for me, right? /10d Oh~ I'm so happy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/057: Then I'll give you something too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/059: This is the ring I picked up in the forest not long ago! Very beautiful! /20dThank you for the signature!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/060: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/061: It is said that this flower will only bloom where true love emerges. This is a very precious vanilla. Please keep it properly and give it to my brother for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/063: Do you want to stay? Our host will entertain guests who come to our house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/069: I will also prepare something for you next time you come.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/070: Wanted: Roberto de Meditch/nCharge: arson, homicide. /nReward: 1000000Eld
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/071: Are you going to agree to the girl's request and get Sharon's signature for her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/072: If you meet Sharon, I will definitely ask for your autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/073: Sorry, I'm too busy to help you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/074: Okay, if I meet Sharon, I will definitely ask for your autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/076: Sorry, I'm too busy to help you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/077: Moreover, it only makes sense to get this kind of thing with your own hands. /20d Don't leave it to others, go find Sharon yourself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/078: Ugh...that's too much.../10d I'm still too young to travel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/079: Thank you. /nDon't forget to agree to get my autograph for me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/081: Our days, though not gorgeous, are peaceful, and we are proud of them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/082: [Brian Welling]/nGet out of the way, go away! Please leave me alone!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/083: Did she quit, or was there another reason...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/084: [Brian Welling]/nThe first time he got sick was last fall. The night of the village celebration, I got very drunk. /10d just focused on eating and drinking. When I woke up, I was already at home. /10d The hangover gave me a headache, so I went to the bathroom to sober up, but found blood on my hands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/085: [Brian Welling]/nI thought I was injured, so I checked my whole body, but there was not even a single wound. But the next day, I heard that a wolf broke into the farm in the village, killed chickens and livestock, and then escaped. /10d But, but, I knew intuitively that it was not done by a wolf.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/086: [Brian Welling]/nAt first I persuaded myself that it was just a nightmare. However, the symptoms never stopped.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow, I'm afraid of waking up. When I wake up and find that my room is in a mess, or my hands are stained with blood, at that moment, I am really, really scared of myself. /10d is so scary... /10d is so scary... Now, I'm even scared to sleep.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/088: [Brian Welling]/nGetting married! Ha ha ha ha! What if I wake up one day and take the lovely Diana with my own hands... No, no, absolutely not! I can't get married. /10d Absolutely not as long as this cursed blood flows within me. Ha...hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/089: [Dan Waring]/n... Our family has had mental illness for generations. This is the retribution for maintaining the bloodline by marrying close to one's own in the past... Such bloodlines should disappear from the world, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/090: [Diana]/nDo you think Brian is crazy? This is impossible! Just a year ago, he was fine, nothing unusual at all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/091: [Diana]/nI met him at Gesir Academy. I happened to be looking for a quiet country life at that time, so I moved here. About a year after arriving, we got engaged.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/092: [Haisen]/nBut, Diana. A mentally disturbed person is not abnormal all the time, but sometimes has sudden attacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If he was really, really abnormal, why didn't even the doctor come and take a look? Since it is a disease, can't it be cured?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/094: [Haisen]/nThat is not a disease that can be cured. Diana, that's something their family has inherited...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/095: [Diana]/nNo, no. Absolutely impossible! I, I will definitely cure his disease, no matter what method I use, I will definitely do it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/096: The Wellings? That family was cursed from the beginning. No one in the family could die normally.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/097: For example, Mr. Dan's parents disappeared, and his wife was killed in a boat capsizing accident while boating with him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/098: After Mr. Dan's wife died, there were rumors in the village that it was Mr. Dan who pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/099: Now it's his son's turn? How pitiful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/100: It seems that there is indeed a genetic problem in that family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/101: . However, could the real reason be that their family is too rich?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/102: You mean you get mentally ill because you have too much money?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/103: Rather than saying that... it would be better to say that their family has been fighting over inheritance and inheritance rights since the past. Maybe it was influenced by these things? People in the family can become so weird.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/104: So, hasn't anyone ever doubted whether Brian is Mr. Dan's biological son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/106: So they intermarryed with relatives in order to reduce disputes, which eventually led to mental illness inherited in the family... Thinking about it this way, having more money may not be a good thing, really.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/107: [Dan Welling]/nI was opposed to my son's marriage from the beginning. Absolutely not. Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/108: Excuse me. I'm going to visit Mr. Dan's house and I want to buy him something. What do you think is appropriate?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/109: A family full of conspiracies... I want to know more about it. Others may be able to tell me more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, you mean Mr. Dan Welling? He recently complained that his eyes were bad and he had been taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/111: [Pharmacy owner]/nI don't know if it's because I've been busy with my son recently. It's obviously time to come to buy medicine, but I haven't come yet. It would be nice if you buy some for him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/112: Datura...isn't that a very dangerous poison?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/113: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIt's okay. He had been taking it long enough to know how much to take.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/115: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWait, wait, where is the medicine?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/117: So...he is the root cause of this matter? Let's go see the Warings...this matter must be settled.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/118: Excuse me. Do you know anything about the Warings?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/119: The Wellings? Of course I understand! The family had a history of trouble. I saw it when Rachel married in. Marriages in their family always make people uneasy, and even this one is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/120: (If you let her continue talking, I'm afraid it won't be over.)/nAh... Madam. Who are you talking about Rachel?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/121: Rachel? She is Mr. Dan's wife. In fact, Mr. Hessen also liked her back then. After Mr. Dan and Rachel got married, Mr. Hyson was heartbroken and went on a long trip. It didn't take long for him to come back. But not long after he left, something happened.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/123: When Rachel gave birth to Brian, it was a little earlier than expected. Everyone is discussing privately whether Brian is Mr. Dan's child. Although he later admitted it publicly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/124: Everyone suspected that Rachel and Mr. Hyson had something to do with each other, but Mr. Hyson himself was not around, so it was settled in the end.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/125: That's not necessarily the case...I mean, it's not impossible. Oh, oh, what nonsense am I talking about to people I meet for the first time... So be it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/126: Interesting. A family full of madness, and the past is still so complicated. It seems that the father is very suspicious... Let's investigate further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/127: [Brian Waring]/nWhat do you want from a lunatic like me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/128: Madman... Looking at it from another perspective, how many people in this world are truly awake? However, you are normal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/129: [Brian Waring]/nWhat...what did you say? Am I normal?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/132: This is the village pharmacy. If Brian Waring's anomaly is man-made, perhaps a clue can be found here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/133: I have something to ask you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/134: You look very unfamiliar. Is this your first time coming to our village?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/135: Yes, this is my first time here. But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/136: What do you want to ask?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/137: Want to know about the Welin family.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/138: [Diana]/nAbout a year ago, he did start to become depressed, and later he gradually started to say strange things. However, in my opinion, he is completely normal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/140: Want to know the ins and outs of this matter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/141: You mean, is it possible that Brian Waring is not Dan Waring's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/142:
What's the matter? If I can help, I will.
Is there any movement in
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/144: Want to know who have bought highly toxic drugs recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/145: What gift would Mr. Dan Waring like?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/146: I would like to ask, can you show me the list of people who have recently purchased highly toxic drugs?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/147: [Pharmacy Owner]/n...Do you think we are a pharmacy in a small village, so you can just look down on us? We have our own rules when opening a store. How could we casually show that kind of thing to strangers?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf you just want to ask this kind of question, get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/150: It's true... because I am a foreigner, you are neglecting me like this... But why should I meddle in things that have nothing to do with me? Just do your own thing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/151: [Mr. Hayson]/nDiana, you can't do this. Go home quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/152: No, it came just in time. Please stay here and listen to me, Mr. Hyson, and Miss Diana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/153: First of all, it must be stated that Mr. Brian Waring is not suffering from mental illness. He wasn't crazy, he just fell into the trap of someone who wanted to make him look like one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/155: [Dan Welling]/nWhat nonsense are you talking about! My son needs absolute rest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/157: I heard that Mr. Haisen once traveled abroad for a long time. When you travel, you must have heard of datura, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/158: [Mr. Haisen]/n Isn't Datura a poisonous plant that can cause hallucinations? If you eat too much, you may even die...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/159: [Brian Waring]/nNow, no matter what I eat or drink, I can't taste it. I always feel dizzy and my mouth feels bitter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/160: That's right. Datura has a bitter taste and can continue to cause headaches and dizziness even after the hallucinations subside. /n Hasn't Mr. Brian Welling been saying recently that his mouth feels bitter and he feels dizzy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/162: Also, Mr. Dan Welling, haven't you been taking medicine made from datura recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/166: [Dan Welling]/nWhat are you talking about... I have taken medicine made from Datura, but why should I harm my son...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/167: What if he is not your son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/168: [Brian Welling]/nWhat are you talking about...! Of course he is my father!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/169: The answer to this question should be clearer to Mr. Haisen. Isn't that right, Mr. Hyson?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/173: [Dan Welling]/nWhy, why do you still call me father? Rachel, who could understand my shock and anger when Rachel said she was pregnant! There is no way I can have descendants...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/175: [Dan Welling]/nYour mother... Your mother is by the lake. It was my own hands... No, that's not right. Not me! She jumped down on her own! Yes, she jumped by herself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/176: Because of this resentment, you poisoned your son, caused him to hallucinate, and staged a play like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/177: Mr. Heisen, are you the real father of Brian? Out of jealousy, Mr. Dan gave Brian a dose of datura, causing him to fall into a hallucination, and then arranged the scene to pretend that he was crazy. I'm afraid his mother's death was not a simple accident. Am I right, Mr. Dan Waring?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/178: [Dan Welling]/nDamn, my head hurts! I have to go to the drugstore to buy some medicine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/181: Mr. Dan Waring...is off to find his own solution. Can't chase after...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/182: So, is Mr. Brian leaving here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I want to travel for a while and relax. Of course, with my beloved Diana... Ah, and, could you please come over?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is an heirloom of our family. For us, it holds sad memories, but if left in your hands, it will surely hold great memories. Hope you can accept it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/187: This is Miss Diana's home. She should be traveling now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/188: This is the Weylin family. They should be traveling by now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/190: Diana? About two years ago, she came to the village with Brian, who had gone to Gesil to study. She seemed to be the girl Brian dated when he was a student.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/191: However, she is naturally beautiful and has a cheerful and outgoing personality. She attracted the attention of all the men in the village when she first arrived. After all, they weren't engaged yet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/192: Hmph... It's probably not an exaggeration to say that she was pursued by all the young men in the village, right? The man is really...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/193: [Tavern Owner]/nHowever, the strange thing is that no one knows the origin of this woman named Diana. She still lives alone now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/194: In this case, I heard a rumor. A young man in the village expressed his love to her behind the banquet hall, but she coldly rejected him. It is said that what she said was: "I don't want to deal with a guy like you who has no power and no money!" Is that so?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/195: But I heard that that incident was because the man wanted to take her away by force, so she threw him away. But the rumors are getting weirder and weirder.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/196: [Tavern owner]/nWho can know? A woman's thoughts...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/197: I would like to inquire about Brian Waring's breakup of engagement...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/198: That thing? Diana and Brian were engaged about a year ago, but a few days ago, Brian suddenly announced the termination of their engagement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/199: The reason is that he is mentally ill! This incident caused quite a stir in the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/200: [Tavern Owner]/nTo be honest, no one except the person involved welcomes this engagement. His father was notoriously crazy, and no one in the village was happy to see the Wearing family property fall into the hands of outsiders, was it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/201: However, is Brian really suffering from mental illness? He's been acting strangely lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/202: Recently, livestock on various farms have been frequently killed. This is a fact, and it is said that Brian did it all. Is this something a normal person would do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/203: [Tavern owner]/nThere is indeed something unreasonable about this matter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/204: So, Brian Wearing and Dan Wearing, father and son, were originally a little abnormal?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/205: [Brian Waring]/nPerhaps we will meet again on the journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/206: What a surprise. The murderer turned out to be Mr. Dan Welling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/207: Come and toast to Miss Diana who has regained her happiness...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/208: Welcome. According to the wishes of the owner, Miss Diana, visiting guests can stay for free. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/211: [Diana]/N From now on, I want to go anywhere in the world with him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/212: Really, really thank you for asking for my autograph!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/001_3: This is Paro Village. Although it is not far from Gesir City, the customs and customs are quite different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/002_3: Our village has always believed that living peacefully and peacefully is a virtue.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/006_3: I heard that he was looking for fresh ingredients for high-end cuisine, and felt that the environment here was clean and suited him well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/012_3: Gasir City? Oh, city life is just an illusion. There is only superficial prosperity there, no real freedom at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/013_3: Let me just say it, that engagement was wrong from the beginning! Their family should never have allowed their children to get married.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/014_3: I may feel sorry for Mr. Xio when I say this, but in the end, aren't both parties unlucky?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/015_3: Although the Wei Lin family is the richest family in Paro Village, their family's experience is very unfortunate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/018_3: Ah, I have a friend who is as beautiful as a girl. He is also in the lord's house now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/019_3: I also saw Sharon perform. She is a very beautiful sister...she also dances well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/020_3: I originally wanted the sister's autograph, but my brothers jumped in line, and I didn't get one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/021_3: If you meet Sharon, can you get me an autograph?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/022_3: [Charles Waring]/nOur family is a cursed family. I was originally opposed to my son's marriage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/023_3: [Charles Waring]/nWith this series of things happening recently, my son seems to understand what is in our family's blood. Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/024_3: [Charles Waring]/nIn this way, this cursed family will be extinct...hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/025_3: [Hugh Waring]/nI'm finished. I did something terrible with my own hands... Marriage? What a fool I was to hope for that! Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/026_3: [Charles]/nI don't need any comfort. Don't even try to convince me. All that is left for me is death...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/027_3: [Diana] /nThis is impossible. Someone who was fine yesterday suddenly said that he was mentally ill and wanted to break off the engagement!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/028_3: [Diana] /nThere must be something wrong with this matter. Xio must have misunderstood something!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/029_3: [Diana]/nThis is not true. It must not be...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/030_3: [ Frobisher ]/nI am Diana's father. I have been friends with Charles for many years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/031_3: [Frobisher]/nAs a father, I really can't just watch my daughter fall into misfortune.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/032_3: [Frobisher]/nHowever, it is really difficult now. Whether she gets married or not, she will probably be unhappy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/035_3: What's even more surprising is that the fragments of severed limbs were found in a bag in Mr. Xio's room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/037_3: Where is Rashid III, the third heir to the Pendragon throne, hiding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/038_3: However, King Rashid has such a long life, it is not easy for him to inherit the throne... Whenever he comes to my place, I am willing to give him a few more plates of wine and food...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/039_3: There is a place near here called Caracas, where my brother Caag owns a restaurant.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/040_3: That guy's craftsmanship is good, but he pursues perfection too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/041_3: That guy urged me to find good ingredients for him whenever he had time. Haha...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/042_3: Hehehe... Do you think there will really be an overlord in the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/047_3: No matter how much money you pay, I won't sell it. I want to pass it on to future generations as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/048_3: Hmm... If you bring something particularly good, I might consider it... such as Asmodeus' fragments or something...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/050_3: And Xiu is the object of admiration for all the women in the village. When she announced that she was going to marry Hugh, you had no idea how much gossip there was...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/051_3: In a sense, no one welcomes this engagement. Except themselves. Everyone is jealous of them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/055_3: Oops...this is sister Sharon's signature! Yeah~~~!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/056_3: This is for me, right? Wow - that's great.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/059_3: This is the ring I picked up in the forest a while ago! Be beautiful! Thank you for asking for my autograph!
