Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/060_3: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/061_3: It is said that this flower will bloom only where true love sprouts. It is very precious. Please keep it properly and bring it to my brother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/000: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/001: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/002: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/003: After living for so long, this is the first time I have seen business so bad. Few stores are open now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/004: This is all the fault of policy failure. It's all the fault of those Tu'er people, business can't be done at all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/005: They are all stupid officials and nobles in the central government, and they have ruined what could have been accomplished!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/006: The current difficulties are only temporary. There's no need to get so excited.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/007: Where did that kid go? How dare you slap a lady on the butt and run away?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/008: If I catch him, I will have to teach him a lesson so that he will never dare to do such a thing again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/009: Ah! This sister is too fierce! He actually chased me endlessly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/010: If women all over the world were like this, how would they live like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/012: Hmph...Is this really the premier port of Dhaka?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/013: All the shops are closed, and we can only spend our days looking at the sky. What kind of world is this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/014: The wandering merchants all look forward to one day settling down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/015: What's interesting is that when they finally settled down, they couldn't stay long and set off again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/016: Maybe it's because I was born to wander... My father is the same. Don't know where he is now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/017: I heard that King Rashid's grandson, Rashid III, has not returned to the palace yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/018: It seems that he plans to leave the palace for a long time this time. However, being entangled by those complicated problems, even if you stay in the palace, you will be on pins and needles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/019: However, his black hair is so charming...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/020: It is Holy Sabbatical Week. The chapel is closed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/021: Hmph...Is this really the premier port of Dhaka?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/022: This is all the fault of policy failure. It's all the fault of those Tu'er people, business can't be done at all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/023: The most important thing is to do your best to do what you can do at the moment. After all, no one knows what the future holds.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/024: Even if the things you can do here are very limited right now, if you look carefully, you can always find something else, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/025: Welcome to our hotel. The accommodation fee in our hotel is 100Eld. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/026: Thank you for your patronage. Have a great rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/027: Business is hard enough, but if we only get customers like this, it will be troublesome.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/028: Thank you for your patronage and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/029: Our boss is a monster old man. Even at that age, I still get up at four in the morning and work until midnight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/030: The more diligent the boss is, the more tired he is in the end...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/031: ...Really, sometimes I really hope something happens to the old boss.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/032: I am a scholar from Bifrost. I came to Dhakama to investigate information.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/033: Finally found time to investigate, but it happened that the economy here was in recession...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/034: Although there is nothing wrong with the survey data, people can't live just by eating. Here, apart from checking information, there is nothing you can do...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/035: I am Curtis' officer. I came here to meet people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/036: The details involve military secrets and I cannot tell you, but this information can be of decisive help in the fight against the Tour Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/037: I plan to stay a few more days, and after getting the pass, I will go directly to the capital of Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/038: I am a Tuer magician who was naturalized here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/039: It's almost one year since I became naturalized. After waiting for one year, you can get a permit to enter Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/040: Ask me why I left the Tur tribe and became Pendragon nationality? For love. For her, I would even give up my life, not to mention my nationality...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/042: This is the best jewelry store in the world!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/043: I have been working here all my life and have saved a lot of money. Now I plan to pass this shop on to my granddaughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/044: However, it is not easy for a woman to run a store alone. I have to find a husband for my granddaughter... Are there any good young men?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/045: Why is grandpa so anxious to marry off his sister?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/046: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/047: Why does King Rashid send a liaison ship to Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/048: Excuse me, do you know about Storm Island?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/049: Storm Island? /nWho are you and why are you interested there?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/050: Storm Island? /nWhy are you interested in that kind of place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/051: Because I have a reason to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/052: I heard that a few decades ago, many people went there with false dreams...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/053: I didn't expect that there would still be such people today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/054: Anyway, King Rashid sends a ferry there every year.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/055: There happens to be a ship leaving soon, please go and find out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/058: Thank you for patronizing our store.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/059: The uncle in the hotel knows many stories from the past.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/060: I go to him occasionally and listen to him tell various stories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/061: The door here seems to be locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/062: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/063: Looks like he plans to stay out for a long time this time. However, being entangled in such complicated matters would make living in a palace feel like sitting on pins and needles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/064: I heard that he used to be a traveling bard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/047_2: Why does Holy King Rashid send a ferry to Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/050_2: Storm Island? /nWhy would a person like you be interested in a place like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/053_2: I didn't expect that there would still be such people today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/054_2: Anyway, Holy King Rashid sends a ferry there every year.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/059_2: The old man in the hotel knows many stories from the past.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/060_2: From time to time I would listen to my grandpa talk about this and that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/061_2: This place seems to be closed.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/000: Not everyone can enter the cathedral!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/001: Currently only those with permission can enter the cathedral.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/002: The cathedral is a sacred place and no one can enter it at will.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/003: It's true...the problem people have today is that their faith is too weak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/004: Must show powerful divine power in order for them to have stronger faith.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/005: Doubting your faith proves that you have no faith in your heart! That means being bewitched by evil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/006: Believing unconditionally is the true love for God! Must believe!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/002_3: The cathedral is a sacred place and no one can enter it at will.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/000: Everyone, work harder, we are not far from Cyreps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/001: Hey, new friend, you said this is your first time walking in the Trixis Desert, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/003: Haha, doing business across Trixis is a good way to make a lot of money from scratch, but for those who are new to the desert, it is also the easiest way to die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/004: You are lucky to meet companions like us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/005: Stop talking nonsense and wasting your energy! If you encounter desert thieves, you have to run away desperately, so save your energy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/011: Oops...Although I got rid of the thief, I got separated from my companions.../30d Where to go next...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/012: Celepus should be in the southeast. /30d They said it was not far away and they could only take a walk first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/013: Well...I really can't walk anymore.../30dIs this the end of it...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/002: Haha, you are still the same. /15d Scholar!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/003: Your Excellency Cesare's vision is truly remarkable. /15d/n How can I turn you, who was just a country farmer's daughter, into what you are now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/004: Hmph, we just each get what we need.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/005: You get what you want, I get what I want, that's all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/006: Putting that aside, did things go smoothly?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/007: Don't worry, the Grand Duke has made up his mind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/008: Oh, so he is willing to send troops to the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/009: In fact, the Grand Duke personally suffered the humiliation of the empire when he was young.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/010: It's only because I have been thwarted by the conservative style of the old men in the Senate that I have endured so far. Now that the killers you sent have eliminated those high-level elders, /15d will have no obstacles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/011: very good./10dThen tomorrow's meeting will not be difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/012: By the way, the one I said I wanted to discover last time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/014: seems to have been roughly found, but it is said that excavation requires a lot of time and manpower.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/015: However, with Bifrost's army here, it may not be necessary to use magic equipment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/016: As long as Valkyrie is dispatched, whether it is the Zephyr Falcon or Frederick's artillery unit, it can be easily solved.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/017: But you have to be careful not to let them take away the entire empire, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/018: Haha, Your Excellency the Cardinal has already made arrangements for this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/019: Well, I'll take my leave now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/021: Hehehe, /15d Those people still don't know that Bifrost's sending troops means the demise of the empire. /30d It's really pitiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/022: Haha, this dispatch of troops is at the request of the Imperial Cardinal, and Pendragon has nothing to do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/023: For those of us who claim to be neutral, this is an excellent opportunity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/024: However, Cardinal Cesare is not an easy person to deal with. /15d/nYour Majesty the Grand Duke, you have to be careful too, right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/026: Would you like/10d let me prove if I am that easy to bully?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/002: The culprit who destroyed the supply base and disrupted our army from behind...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/003: Hehehe. But lady luck is on my side.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/004: This bridge is the lifeline of the West Wind Falcon. As long as we occupy this place, victory will belong to us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/005: Come on, let's decide the winner again! /10d/nI want to take back the shame from last time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/006: How...how is it possible? /n unexpectedly...lost twice...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/009: Okay! /nIn this way, the battle will be successful.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy04/000: The conference room is always ready and can be used by everyone at any time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy04/001: conference room is like the heart of our Zephyr Falcon. I've been doing my best to keep this place clean.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka03a/000: North - Caracas region/nSouth - Paro region/nWest - Gesir City, Pretoria region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/001: Sealed in this underwater city is the only remaining God of Destruction on earth. You're really lucky.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/002: Haha, it would be too easy to say it was luck. You have no idea how much effort I put into finding this God of Destruction.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/003: But you have to be careful. Although the God of Destruction is powerful, even we cannot fully control it. If we are not careful, we will be swallowed by it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/004: That's why I'm here, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/006: However, I really didn't expect that you would agree to my request so easily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/007: As long as I can kill that enemy Cyrano with my own hands, I am willing to do anything.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/008: I don't want to wait any longer, let's start the ceremony.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/000: Nicosia, where the church fortress is located, is located at the southern end of the continent and can only be reached by crossing Gesil City in the center of the continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/001: It is said that if you want to go to Libreville, you have to go north of the Caracas Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/002: Our destinations are nearby Pretoria, Memphis at the southern tip of the continent, and Bordeaux north of Rowan City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/003: We must pass through Libreville, north of Caracas, to catch up with Machiavelli who is on his way to Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/001: As long as you work hard, you can become like me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/002: Please go to the Nicosia area to learn about the fighting there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/003: This is the war conference room of Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/004: Nicosia is a small city south of Gesir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/005: Hmm... I haven't been able to attack recently, and I feel itchy all over.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/007: I feel more at ease with you on my journey, Mr. Newcomer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/008: The mission this time is to collect intelligence.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/009: Hmph, ugly words ahead, I don't like you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/010: I'm so annoying. Stop pestering me and go away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/011: ...No matter how you look at it, Isabele is a beauty.../15d/nHmm? /10dWhat are you doing here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/012: /2c Falcon of the West Wind. War meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/015: There is a situation. /nCardinal Cesare seems to be planning something in the Nicosia area.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/016: Cesare.../10d Are you talking about Borgia?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/017: According to intelligence, he built a fortress in the Nicosia area and seemed to be planning something.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/018: However, the place was heavily guarded and we were unable to send intelligence agents to infiltrate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/019: The mission is to go there with me and investigate what they are doing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/020: Nicosia is a small place south of Gesir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/021: Then you have to pass through Gesil City and go south. /15d/nThe road is not close.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/023: Have you been there? /15d/n It was once the capital of the old empire, and it is still the largest city in the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/024: But recently, Duke Frederick's Ron seems to be more energetic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/025: After all, that is the territory of Duke Frederick, the most powerful force in the empire today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/026: The power of our Zephyr Falcon has not yet extended there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/028: If there are any changes on our side, we will send messengers to inform you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/033: Anyway...then...that drawer.../120d/n must not be opened!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/036: Gasir City.../10d/n Has it been fifteen years...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/038: He actually left me behind.../nWait for me~
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/001: Uh...we have to escape from here quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/005: Heh heh heh...sure enough, here it is, Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/007: According to the order of Lord Cesare, I have come to take your life!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/010: ...Tsk, it's so boring to fall down so quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/011: Hehehehe... just bear with it a little longer, and I will let you go...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/020: ....../10d Anyway, get out of here first.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber02/001_3: Hehe, Cyrano. /nExcuse me, can you please go out?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/010: Enough of that.../35d/nPlease focus on finding Christina./45d/nWith your abilities, you should be able to find her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/020: The person who can make our Frederick family famous, /45d/nI'm afraid it's not me, Alfred Frederick, /30d but Christina Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/023: It has been three months since my daughter left home.../45d/nYou/20d are really calm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/024: Haha, /50d I was her age, /20d/n also traveled around to increase my knowledge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/025: This trip will also be a good experience for Christina, /30d/n. /35d, don't worry too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/026: What are you talking about? /35d/nShe has just turned fifteen! /35d Besides, she is still a girl!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/027: However, /30d I can also understand her mood. /45d/n is only fifteen years old, /30d is about to marry a man she has never met...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/028: Even so, she shouldn't have run away.../45dIt's your fault!/30d/nYou raised her like a boy/20d and taught her to fight. That's why she's like this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/029: Haha! /50d Don't worry. /40d/nAlthough she is her own child, /30d her talent is indeed extraordinary.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/030: If something happens to that child/50d,/15dI...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/031: ....../70d I didn't expect you to be so worried. /60d/nOkay. /40d I will take this opportunity to look for her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/032: actually,/40dA few days ago, my father-in-law/35dIn the Nicosia area/nestablished church,/35dI heard it was destroyed by the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/034: Darling.../40dhe's/25d the man who raised me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/035: Another rebellion.../55d/nI am worried that my father-in-law is pushing the civilians too hard.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/036: Even if her grandfather ordered it, /55d/nit would be hard for her to accept so suddenly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/037: ....../50dSorry. /75d/nJust the fact that he raised you up, /35d is enough to make me grateful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/038: Anyway, /40d and the West Wind Falcon gang/30d have been causing trouble everywhere unscrupulously, /45d/n it's time to let them suffer a little.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/039: So, /15d are you planning to go on an expedition?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/040: I will /30d deal with the Zephyr Falcon, /35d/n while asking for news about Christina.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s07/001: .../30dWith my strength.../30d/nCan I subdue this huge monster?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/000: Okay.../50d It's time to say goodbye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/002: The Empire/45d regained peace because of you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/003: However, /30d you /40d want to leave here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/004: I am not the one who keeps the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/005: It was all the people who resisted Cesare along with the Falcon of the West Wind/40d/n to defend the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/007: You are also a member of the Zephyr Falcon, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/010: You guys are still so weird in the end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/011: There is obviously no better place than the Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/013: Rhidelhard, /20d is at the end, do you still want to do this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/014: It is precisely because peace has been restored in the empire that I can leave with peace of mind. /50d/nNow.../30d I have no regrets about this land.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/016: There were many places before, /30d I'm sorry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/017: Don't worry. /35d is no big deal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/018: I admit that you are the strongest swordsman in the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/020: but,/30dOn the attainments of imperial swordsmanship,/30dMeditch is still number one!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/021: Only this, /30d I will never give in.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/028: [Christina]/n...Mr. Cyrano. /45dCan you tell me why you want to leave?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/030: ...I wanted to see a new world, so I decided to leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/031: Maybe it is the eastern part of the mainland, /45d maybe it is a remote island... /35dMaybe, /35d it will be the eastern continent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/032: I want to go to places I have never been to and see new things/40d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/033: No, /30d shouldn't be just for this reason, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/034: ...After experiencing all this, /30d I understand one thing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/035: Even if you reach the end of revenge, /45d will not give birth to new hope.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/036: What can eliminate hatred, /40d can only have inner peace that transcends hatred. /80d/n is dominated by negative emotions, /30d ultimately gets nothing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/037: Only by allowing yourself to develop a heart of forgiveness... /65d/n can you get rid of hatred, /45d I finally understand this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/039: So, /40d I want to bury those unfortunate past events in this land and then leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/040: Keep only the good memories in my heart, /60d/n Go to a place where no one knows me, /45d go experience a new world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/042: If you can break free from the shackles of revenge and /40d live for your own peace, /50d/n we can /25d gladly see you off, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/045: [Christina]/nFinally, I want to ask you one more thing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/050: Haha, /30d I'm so sorry. /25dI'm late again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/054: We helped a lost little girl find her mother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/056: Are you still late at this time?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/059: Hey, /15d brother is still as cheerful as usual, isn't it nice? /40d haha.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/061: To be honest, /20d I felt very uncomfortable knowing that you were leaving. /80d/n Only then did I realize that we have always been so dependent on you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/063: I will never forget your kindness.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/064: Without you, /50d I'm afraid I can't do anything. /40d/nEverything starts with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/065: ...The day I fought side by side with you, /30d I will never forget.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/069: You also helped me a lot.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/071: ...Wait, /15dCyrano? /30d Are you planning to leave us alone?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/072: You shouldn't/30d want to leave me behind, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/073: ...I will embark on a road without a destination. /55d/nThe empire has finally restored peace, and /55d/nit is time for you to enjoy the fruits of your efforts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/074: Thank you for your thoughts, /40d but you don't have to follow me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/075: Cyrano,/30d You won't forget it so quickly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/076: I said I would help you, /40d I will keep this promise to the end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/077: Along the way, /30d I also learned a lot. /60d/nWhen I saw the pain in your heart, /45d/nI made up my mind to heal you, so I went all the way here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/078: However, /30d you stood up again by your own strength. /55d/nLooking at your strong figure, /50d I still want to understand the meaning of living better.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/080: I /15d have never thought about the profound meaning of life. /50d/n just want to follow you because I like Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/081: Anyway, I am no longer a member of the West Wind Falcon. /30d Even if you disagree, I will still follow!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/084: Cyrano,/25d Give up. /35d It seems you can't persuade them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/087: Together, /30d moves towards the new world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/094: We will encounter many difficulties in the future/30d. /45d/nBut you /25d must inherit Frederick's will and /35d protect the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/096: You are not alone. /40d There are people willing to help you. /40d/nYou can definitely do it well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/098: [Christina]/nThe empire will surely prosper. /40d I will definitely make it happen.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/099: [Christina]/nThe father who sacrificed his life to protect this land/15d. /60d/nFor my /30d mother who loves me deeply.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/100: [Christina]/nAnd.../55dYou who laid the foundation for all of this/20d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/102: It's time to set sail. /40d Although reluctant to leave, /30d still has to say goodbye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/103: Cyrano, /40d I wish you.../30d good luck all the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/104: ......It's time for us/20d to say goodbye. /45d Then, /10d Goodbye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/001: Cyrano, /40d It's been a long time coming.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/002: I really want to ask why you betrayed me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/003: Seeing old friends, /30d reminds me of those unpleasant past events. /55d/nHowever, /25d it would be nice to relive the memories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/004:
But Cyrano, /45d, we have to wait until we decide the winner!
The location of
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/005: Come on, Cyrano! /45d Let you see my power!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/006: Do you think you can stop me like this, /15d Iscariot!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/007: Hehe.../60d Sure enough, human power is still not enough.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/008: But if you use the ultimate power I created, that's a different matter! /90d/nSee clearly, /45dCyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/009: Cyrano.../45d You have gained the strongest power. /90d/n is much more powerful than the power I created /30d...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/010: Iscariot... /45d/n Are you so eager for power, /30d that you are even willing to turn into such an ugly monster?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/011: Heh, /30d it's your turn to say something like this.../100d/nThat's right, /60dThat's why I betrayed you.../30d
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/012: But.../30d In the end, you are just like me.../45d is a monster.../60d/nCan't coexist with ordinary people.../60d is an alien rejected by the world...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/014: At least I.../45d can still die in your hands like this.../75d/nAnd poor you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/017: You said the God of Destruction...? !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/007: According to the order of Lord Cesare, /30d comes to take your life!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/010: Tsk, it's so boring that /15d fell down so quickly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/011: Hehehe, /35d endure it for a while longer. /35d/n will set you free immediately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/013: However, /15d's situation is a bit strange, and /40d may not be able to be treated well here.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/001: This is Paro Village. /nAlthough it is not far from Gesir City,/nthe customs and customs are quite different.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/002: There is a lot of commotion outside,/nOur village is peaceful and peaceful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/003: It's so scary. /nHe is the most handsome man in the village, and he has gone insane.../nAnd he also has a fiancee.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/004: This place is quite remote, and few people usually come here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/005: However, a chef moved here from other places not long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/006: I heard that he was looking for fresh ingredients for high-end cuisine. /n felt that the environment here was clean and suited him well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/007: I was invited to Gesil City once before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/008: The roads there are wide and the buildings are beautiful, which is dazzling to see./nThe people who live there are also very decent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/009: Living in the city.../n is definitely much more exciting than living in a rural village like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/010: Our village is too small, and the lords don't even bother to ask.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/011: Hehe... Thanks to this, we can live freely.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/012: Gasir City? Oh, city life is just an illusion. /nThere is only superficial prosperity there, no real freedom at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/013: Let me just say it. /nThat engagement was wrong from the beginning! /nTheir family should not have allowed their children to get married in the first place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/014: Maybe I'm sorry, Mr. Bryone./nBut in the end,/nIsn't it unfortunate on both sides?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/015: That is a cursed family.../nEven if they are the richest family in Paro,/nthey have nothing to do with the peace of our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/016: Our lord here seems to be particularly fond of children. /nThere are many children in his family.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/017: But the strange thing is that they are all girls.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/018: The lord also likes flowers,/nI heard that his courtyard is full of flowers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/019: I saw Sharon's show./nShe's a good dancer, she's beautiful, she's a great sister.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/020: I really wanted her autograph.../nBut those big brothers kept cutting in the queue, so I didn't get it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/021: If you meet Sharon,/ncan you get me an autograph?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/022: [Dan Welling]/nOur family is a cursed family. /15d/nI originally opposed my son's marriage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/023: [Dan Welling]/nWith this series of things happening recently, my son seems to understand/nwhat is in the blood of our family. /10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/024: [Dan Welling] /nIn this way, this cursed family will be extinct.../n/10dHehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/025: [Brian Welling]/nI'm done. I actually did such a terrible thing with my own hands.../20d/nGetting married? /10d I am such a fool for still holding on to such hope! /15d Hahaha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/026: [Brian Waring]/nI don't need any comfort. /nDon't even try to convince me. /20d/nThe only thing left for me is a dead end...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/028: [Diana] /nThere must be something wrong with this matter.../20d/nBrian must have misunderstood something!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/030: [Haisen]/nI am Dan's old friend,/nMy name is Haisen.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/031: [Haisen]/nIn order to prevent my friend's son from falling into misfortune,/nI am trying to persuade Miss Diana...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/033: The strange thing is that I haven't heard anything about/n the singer named Sharon recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/034: She has many fans and is very popular./nHow come there is no news suddenly?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/035: What's even more surprising is that those fragments/n were found in the bag in Mr. Xio's room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/036: Welcome. /nWe dare not say anything else here, the portion must be enough.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/037: Where is Rashid III, the first heir to the Pendragon throne,/n hiding?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/038: However, King Rashid is still in good health,/nIt is not so easy for him to succeed to the throne.../nIf he comes to our store one day,/nI will definitely give him a few more plates of food and drinks...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/039: There is a place called Caracas near here,/nMy brother Kag opens a restaurant there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/040: That guy's craftsmanship is good, but /n is too obsessed with perfection.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/041: Use me to find good ingredients for him whenever I have time. /nHehe...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/044: Although there are rumors that someone has pulled out/nthe Asura Sword that can determine the overlord of the empire.../nBut rumors are just rumors after all, aren't they? Hahaha.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/047: No matter how much money you pay, I won't sell it. /15d/nI want to pass it on to future generations as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/048: Hmm.../nIf you bring something particularly good, I can consider it.../nFor example, Asmodeus's fragments...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/049: Diana is the most beautiful girl in the village,/nall the men in the village admire her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/050: And Brian is the object of admiration for all the women in the village. /nWhen she announced that she was going to marry Brian, /nYou don't know how much gossip there was...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/051: In a sense, no one welcomes this engagement. /nEveryone is jealous of them except themselves.../20d/n
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/052: Welcome. /nWhat do you want to buy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/054: Thank you for your patronage. /nPlease walk slowly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/055: Ah...ah! ! /nThis is Sister Sharon's signature! Yeah! !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/056: This is for me, right? /nThank you so much! I'm so happy! !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/057: Then let me give you something too!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/059: This is the ring I picked up in the forest before! Very beautiful, right? /nThank you for your signature!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/060: It was just a while ago./nLove vanilla found in the forest near Caracas./nIt is said that only a place of true love can produce such flowers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/061: This is a very precious vanilla./nCan you please keep it safe for me and bring it to my brother?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/063: Do you want to stay? Our host/n will entertain the guests who come to our house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/069: I will also prepare something for you next time you come.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/070: Reward wanted: Roberto de Meditch/nCharge: arson, homicide. /nReward amount: 1,000,000 ELD

Really? Then it's settled! Definitely!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/079: Thank you! /nDon't forget to agree to get my autograph for me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/081: Although our days are not gorgeous,/nthey are peaceful and peaceful, which is something we are proud of.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/082: [Brian Welling]/nGet out of the way, go away! /nPlease leave me alone!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/083: Did she quit, or was there another reason...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/084: [Brian Welling]/n The first time he got sick was last fall. /nOn the night of the village celebration, I was very drunk. /10d/n just focused on eating and drinking. When I woke up, I was already at home. /10d/nThe hangover gave me a headache, so I went to the bathroom to sober up, but/nI found blood on my hands...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/085: [Brian Welling]/nI thought I was injured,/nI checked my whole body, but there was not even a single wound. /nBut the next day, I heard that a wolf broke into the farm in the village,/nkilled chickens and livestock and escaped. /n/10d But, but, I know intuitively, /nThat was not done by a wolf.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/086: [Brian Welling]/nAt first I persuaded myself that/nit was just a nightmare. /nHowever, this symptom never stopped.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow, I'm afraid of waking up. /nWhen I woke up, I found that the room was in a mess,/nor my hands were stained with blood,/nAt that moment, I was really, really scared of myself. /n/10d It's so scary.../10d It's so scary.../nNow, I'm even scared to sleep.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/088: [Brian Welling]/nGetting married! Ha ha ha ha! What if I wake up one day,/nI find that I have killed my beloved Diana with my own hands.../nNo, no, it must not be like this! I can't get married. /10d/n As long as the blood of this curse is still flowing in my body, it will never work. /nwu...wuwuwu...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/089: [Dan Waring]/n... Our family has had mental illness for generations. /nThis is the retribution for maintaining the bloodline by getting close to one's own in the past.../nSuch a bloodline should disappear from the world, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/090: [Diana]/nDo you think Brian is crazy? /nThis is impossible! /nJust a year ago, he was fine, nothing abnormal at all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/091: [Diana]/nI met him at Geisir Academy./nI happened to be looking for a quiet country life at that time./nThat's why I moved here./nAbout a year after arriving, we got engaged.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/092: [Haisen]/nBut, Diana. /nMen with mental disorders are not abnormal all the time, /nSometimes they only have sudden attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If he is really,/n really abnormal,/nwhy doesn't he even want to invite a doctor to see him? /nSince it is a disease, can't it be cured?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/094: [Haisen]/nThat is not a disease that can be cured. /nDiana, that is inherited from their family...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/095: [Diana]/nNo, no. /nAbsolutely impossible! /nI, I will definitely cure his disease,/nNo matter what method I use, I will definitely do it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/096: The Wellings? /nThat family has been cursed from the past. /nNo one in the family can die normally.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/097: For example, Mr. Dan's parents disappeared,/nWhile his wife was boating with him,/nEncountered another boat capsizing accident./nJust lost his life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/098: After Mr. Dan's wife died,/nThere was a rumor in the village that/nIt was Mr. Dan who pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/099: Now it's his son's turn? How pitiful...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/100: It seems that that family does have a genetic problem/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/101:
. /nHowever, the real reason, /ncould it be that their family is too rich?
The same can be said for
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/102: You mean, /nYou get mental illness because you have too much money?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/103: Instead of saying that.../nIt would be better to say that their family has been fighting over inheritance and inheritance rights/nsince the past. Maybe it was influenced by these things? /nPeople in the family become so weird.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/104: In this case, no one has doubted before, /n Is Brian the biological son of Mr. Dan?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/106: So in order to reduce disputes, they intermarry,/nwhich eventually led to mental illness inherited in the family.../nIf you think about it, having more money may not be a good thing, really.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/107: [Dan Welling]/nI was opposed to my son's marriage from the beginning. /nAbsolutely not. Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/108: Excuse me./nI'm going to visit Mr. Dan's house./nWanted to buy him something./nWhat do you think is appropriate?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/109: A family full of conspiracies.../nI want to know more about it. /nOthers may be able to tell me more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, you mean Mr. Dan Welling? /nHe recently said that his eyes are not good,/nand has been taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/111: [Pharmacy owner]/nI don't know if I am busy with my son recently,/nIt was obviously time to come to buy medicine, but I never came. /nIt would be nice if you buy some for him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/112: Datura.../nIsn't that a very dangerous poison?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/113: [Pharmacy owner]/nIt's okay. /nHe has been taking it for a long time and /nknows how much it should be.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/115: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWait, wait, where is the medicine?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/117: So...he is the root cause of this matter? /nLet's go to Welin's house and have a look.../nThis matter must be settled.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/118: Excuse me./nDo you know anything about the Waylins?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/119: The Wellings? Needless to say! Their family has been having troubles/n since before. /nI've seen it since Rachel got married. /nMarriages in their family always make people uneasy, /nThis time is the same...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/120: (If you let her continue talking, I'm afraid it won't be over.)/nAh... Madam. Who are you talking about Rachel?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/121: Rachel? That's Mr. Dan's wife./nActually, Mr. Hayson liked her too./nAfter Mr. Dan and Rachel got married, Mr. Hayson broke his heart./nI went on a trip./nHe hasn't been back long./nBut not long after he left,/nSomething happened.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/123: Rachel gave birth to Bulion./nBut the baby was born earlier than expected. Everybody.../nPrivately speaking, it's Mr. Dan's son or not./nBut then he admitted publicly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/124: Everyone suspected that Rachel had something to do with Mr. Hyson,/nBut Mr. Hyson himself was not around,/nIn the end it was settled.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/125: That's not necessarily the case...but it's possible. /nOh, oh, to this person I met for the first time, /nWhy did I say everything... That's it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/126: Interesting. A family full of madness, and the past is still so complicated. /nIt seems that the father is very suspicious.../nLet's investigate further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/127: [Brian Waring]/nWhat do you want from a lunatic like me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/128: Madman.../nLooking at it from another perspective, how many people in this world are truly awake? /nHowever, you are normal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/129: [Brian Waring]/nWhat...what did you say? Am I normal?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/133: I have something to ask you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/134: You look very unfamiliar. /nIs this your first time coming to our village?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/136: What do you want to ask?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/138: [Diana]/nAbout a year ago, he did start to become depressed,/nlater he gradually started to say strange things. /nBut, in my opinion, he is completely normal.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/147: [Pharmacy owner]/n... Do you think we are just a pharmacy in a small village,/ndon't take us seriously? /nThere are rules for opening a store. /nFor a person we have never met before,/nWill we just take out this kind of thing casually?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf you just want to ask this kind of question, get out of here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/150: It's true...I'm so cold just because I'm a foreigner.../nSame, why should I meddle in other people's affairs? /nJust do your own thing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/151: [Mr. Hayson]/nDiana, you can't do this. Go home quickly.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/153: First of all, I must explain that Brian Welling/n is not mentally ill. /nHe is not crazy. /nIt's just that someone wanted him to look like a madman,/nHe fell into that person's trap.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/155: [Dan Welling]/nWhat nonsense are you talking about! /nMy son needs absolute rest!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/157: I heard that Mr. Haisen traveled abroad for a long time./nWhen you travel, you should have heard of/nDatura is a plant, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/158: [Mr. Heisen]/nMandala,/nisn't it a poisonous plant that can cause hallucinations? /nIf you eat too much, you may even die...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/159: [Brian Waring]/nNow, no matter what I eat or drink, I can't taste it. /nI always feel dizzy and my mouth feels bitter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/160: Exactly. Mandrake is bitter./nEven when hallucinating fades, headaches and dizziness persist./nMr. Bryone Weelin hasn't been around lately./nYou say you're in pain and dizzy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/162: Also, Mr. Dan Welling,/nhaven't you been taking medicine made from datura recently?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/166: [Dan Welling]/nWhat are you talking about.../nI have taken medicine made from Datura,/nBut why should I harm my son...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/167: What if he is not your son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/168: [Brian Welling]/nWhat are you talking about...! /nOf course he is my father!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/169: The answer to this question should be clearer to Mr. Heisen. /nIsn't that right, Mr. Heisen?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/173: [Dan Welling]/nWhy, why do you still call me father? /nRachel, when Rachel said she was pregnant,/nWho could understand my shock and anger! /nIt is impossible for me to have descendants...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/175: [Dan Welling]/nYour mother... Your mother is by the lake, it was my own hands.../nNo, that's not right. Not me! /nShe jumped down by herself! Yes, she jumped by herself!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/176: Because of this resentment, you poisoned your son, caused him to hallucinate, and staged a play like that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/177: Mr. Hayson, are you the real father of Breon?/nMr. Dan, out of jealousy, gave it to Bulion./nTake Mandrake, make him hallucinate./nThen set up the scene and pretend he's crazy./nI'm afraid his mother's death was no simple accident./nAm I right, Mr. Dan Weelin?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/178: [Dan Welling]/nDamn, my head hurts! /nI have to go to the drugstore to buy some medicine!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/181: Mr. Dan Welling.../n is off to find his own solution. /nDon't chase...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I want to travel for a while and relax. /nOf course, it will be with my beloved Diana.../nAh, also, can you please come over?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is an heirloom of our family. /nFor us, it carries sad memories,/nBut if it is left to you, it will definitely leave good memories. /nHope you can accept it...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/195: But I heard that that thing was/nBecause the man wanted to take her away by force,/nShe just shook him off./nBut the rumors are getting weirder and weirder.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/198: That thing? /nDiana and Brian have been engaged for about a year. /nBut not long ago, Brian suddenly announced that he was breaking off the engagement.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/199: The reason is that he is mentally ill! /nThis incident caused a big sensation in the village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/200: [Tavern Owner]/nTo be honest, no one except the person involved welcomes this engagement. /nHis father was famous for his madness,/nAnd no one in the village was happy to see the Welin family's property/nfall into the hands of outsiders, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/201: However, is Brian really suffering from mental illness? /nHis recent behavior is indeed strange.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/202: Livestock/n on various farms have been frequently killed recently. This is a fact,/nand it is said that it was all done by Brian. /nIs this what normal people do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/203: [Tavern owner]/nThere is indeed something unreasonable about this matter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/204: So, Brian Welling and Dan Welling, father and son,/n are somewhat abnormal to begin with?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/205: [Brian Waring]/nPerhaps we will meet again on the journey.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/206: What a surprise. /nThe murderer turned out to be Mr. Dan Welling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/207: Come and toast to Miss Diana who has regained her happiness...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/208: Welcome. Following the wishes of our master, Miss Diana,/nGuests may be accommodated free of charge./nWould you like to stay?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/023_3: [Charles Waring]/nWith this series of things happening recently, my son seems to understand/nwhat is in the blood of our family. Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/024_3: [Charles Waring] /nIn this way, this cursed family will be extinct.../nHehehe...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/027_3: [Diana] /nThis is impossible, /nHow could someone who was fine yesterday suddenly say that he was mentally ill and wanted to break off the engagement!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/028_3: [Diana] /nThere must be something wrong with this matter. /nXiu must have misunderstood something!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/032_3: [Frobisher]/nHowever, it is really difficult now. /nWhether she gets married or not, she will probably be unlucky.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/041_3: That guy urges me/n to find good ingredients for him whenever he has time. Haha...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/042_3: Hehehe.../nDo you really think that there will be an overlord in the empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/047_3: No matter how much money you pay, I won't sell it. /nI want to pass it on to future generations as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/048_3: Hmm... If you bring something particularly good, I can consider it.../nFor example, Asmodeus's fragments...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/050_3: And Xiu is the object of admiration for all the women/n in the village. When she announced that she was going to marry Hugh,/nyou don't know how much gossip there was...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/051_3: In a sense, no one welcomes this engagement. /nExcept themselves. Everyone is jealous of them...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/055_3: Ah.../nThis is Sister Sharon's signature! Yeah--!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/056_3: This is for me, right? Wow - that's great.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/059_3: This is the ring I picked up in the forest not long ago! Very beautiful! /nThank you for your signature!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/060_3: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/061_3: It is said that this flower will bloom only where true love sprouts. /nIt is very precious. Please keep it properly and bring it to my brother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx23/000: This is not the direction leading to Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx23/001: << Phoenix Cave >>/nEvery thousand years,/nThe firebird burns itself,/nGive birth to new life./n/nWant to get the most precious thing,/nYou must sacrifice your most precious things.../n/nAdventurer Largo
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/001: This is the entrance to the conference room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/002: There is a strange drawer in the conference room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/003: The conference room is in our Zephyr Falcon base/nThe most gorgeously decorated room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/004: On the left is the entrance to the store and officers' quarters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/005: Our West Wind Falcon has high morale now,/nbut the enemy seems to be getting stronger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/006: Especially the army under Ron's General Frederick, /n is really difficult to deal with.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/008: Sometimes I hear a wall in a tavern./nStrange sounds./nAm I too drunk?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/009: Before joining Zephyr Falcon,/nI did some petty theft in Caracas. /nHowever, I have completely given up now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/010: Hmph... That guy said he was done with it./nEven if he said the sun rises from the east, I wouldn't believe it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/011: The things that have been lost in the barracks recently, /n I can definitely see that guy taking them out and selling them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/012: Our West Wind Falcon has gained a reputation far and wide, and /n our morale is even higher.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/013: Now, we are no longer just Avengers or righteous thieves,/n but an organization that wants to bring changes to this empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/014: Ron's Lord Frederick's troops are the opponents I least want to encounter. /nTheir elite archers aim accurately and shoot steadily, and/ntheir swordsmen are also very skilled.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/015: Seriously, if other lords were like him, /nthere would be no need for us to exist. /nIsn't it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/016: I joined here because my family... were all killed. /nMoreover, it was the lord who took action...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/017: I have always lived only for revenge. /nIf this idea disappears, I will have no reason to live...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/018: As the reputation of the Falcon of the West Wind becomes more and more famous,/nall parties have more and more restrictions on us./nThis can be regarded as the current problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/019: Maybe our reputation,/nIt has exceeded its actual strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/020: Occasionally, strange sounds come from the tavern. /nI obviously didn't drink much...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/021: Sometimes it feels on the other side of the tavern./nIt's like hiding something.../nIsn't that weird?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/022: This is the female soldier dormitory of Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/023: We women are also members of the West Wind./nThere is no distinction between men and women./nThe clearest example is that half of the commanders are women.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/024: If we think about it carefully, we actually know nothing about the /n leader who founded the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/025:
be? /nIs he also a declining noble whose family was destroyed by the church? /nOr are you from a civilian background?
What kind of person would
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/026: When I returned to the barracks yesterday,/nI found that I was missing a few things.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/027: It took me a long time to find out that those things were on the black market in the barracks. Lee./nTo be bought and sold.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/028: Shit, I think I know who stole my stuff./nThere's no proof.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/029: What is written in Mr. Clausewitz's notebook?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/030: He seems to be writing something all the time...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/031: You mean Mr. Clausewitz's famous notebook? /nNo one knows what is written in it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/032: Could he/n be recording the personal information of our female team members?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/033: Huh? /40d There is a special stone tablet here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/034: Looking carefully, /35d turns out to be a monument engraved with the names of companions who made contributions to the Falcon of the West Wind. /n/70d There are so many people with the same ambition...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/000: Oh... Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement. /nMercedes is indeed the perfect bride for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/001: However, even if you get married,/n you won't forget our club, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/002: Hahaha! How about having a nice drink next weekend for your engagement/n?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/003: Hmph! You actually left me and started a family? Really.../nForget it, there is nothing we can do. After all, the other party is Mercedes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/004: Although it is a pity that you have a master,/nbut this way, Mercedes will no longer be able to attract the attention of/nGasil men.../nIt is not too bad.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/005: Hahaha...who will replace Mercedes?/nWhat about becoming the next socialite?/nI heard that a new beauty salon has opened in the city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/001: The exit here seems to be completely blocked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/007: Oops.../40d always feels like I'm always in the same place. /60d/n can't tell the direction at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/008: When the cave collapsed, /30d I escaped here alone... /65d/n Are others okay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/009: No matter what, /40d can only find the exit first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/010: There are many monsters nearby. /40d/n Equip the pickaxe first, so that you can at least deal with them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/007_2: Damn...how many hours has it been? /15d /nCan't tell the direction at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/008_2: The cave collapsed and ended up in a strange place...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/000: [Warden]/nThis is the hell within hell, the labor field of Invernor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/002: [Warden]/nThis is the labor yard of Invernor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/003: [Warden]/nDig more sulfur and come back, I'll let you have a rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/004: [Prisoner]/nHehehehe.../nHow many of them can come back alive today?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/005: [Jailer]/nYou bugs should dig sulfur for the country!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/006: [Prisoner]/nYou can escape from prison if you don't want to work. /15d/nIf you have the ability. Hey hey hey.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/009: 102, where do you want to go!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/010: You want to go out without working?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/011: You guys, did /25d arrive just now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/013: I don't want to end up like those who didn't come back, so /40d/n just be diligent!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/014: You/15d are all traitors to the country. /60d/nHere you are, pay for your sins.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/015: The twelfth group that went out to work yesterday, /45d/n only seven of the twenty people came back alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/017: If you understand, don't wait any longer, /15d hurry up and move! /40d/nYou trash!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/018: Tsk...I have to deal with this kind of guy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/022: You guy! /20d/n Wants to be lazy again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/023: Stop pretending to be sick and get up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/028: If it's dead, drag it away quickly, don't wait for the body to rot.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/032: [Prisoner]/nDon't wait any longer. Climb into the sulfur mine cave quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/000: Clausewitz,/60d There are some things I must say!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/002: Our West Wind Falcon /15d is being manipulated as a puppet by that guy Cyrano, /15d/n I can no longer sit idly by and watch!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/003: What are you talking about, /15dMeditch brother!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/004: Kana,/30d You should also see the reality clearly. /30d/nThat guy just sees us as a tool for his revenge!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/005: Mr. Cyrano/15d does have a personal grudge. /65d/nBut his goal is to defeat Cardinal Cesare. /n/55dThis is consistent with our purpose and has never changed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/006: Damn it, /30d you are all talking for Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/007: You seem to have misunderstood. /50d/nMr. Cyrano does value revenge, /60d but he does not put it above everything else.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/008: Regardless of whether it is a misunderstanding or not, /30d if I continue to let that guy go, /45d I would rather quit the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/009: Me too! /40d/n Either drive away Cyrano, /15d or give up on both of us, /45d your choice!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/011: Meditch is my benefactor. /nBut without the help of the Zephyr Falcon, I might not be able to defeat Cesare. /nWhat to do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/014: I don't want Zephyr Falcon/15d to be divided because of me. /60d/nI exit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/016: Okay, /15d I hope you can figure it out. /30d/nIt seems you are not as stubborn as I thought.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/017: If Cyrano wants to leave, /15d I will go with him! !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/018: Kana,/30d In this case, it would be meaningless for me to quit the Falcon of the West Wind/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/020: Esmeralda, what are you going to do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/021: I also/15d will leave with Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/022: Mr. Cyrano, /15d I'm sorry. /40d didn't expect things to develop to this point...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/023: It's just going back to the way it was before I joined, /45d/nYou don't have to worry too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/024: I wish everyone/30d can realize their ambitions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/025: I can't do what Meditch says. /45d/nI /25d cannot exit the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/027: Indeed, Mr. /30dMeditch's words went too far. /50d/nBut /25d we don't want Mr. Meditch and Mr. Rhidelhard to quit the Zephyr Falcon either.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/028: No, /15d is inappropriate! /20d/nStop talking nonsense, /25d I have long disliked you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/029: Without Brother Meditch, /45d do you think we could be as strong as we are today? !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/030: No need to say more, Rhidelhard. /40d/nThose who choose Cyrano stay, /30dThose who choose me follow me, it's that simple!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/031: This is really the latecomers squeezing out the first comers!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/032: Meditch, /30dAfter you quit... /45dWhere are you going to go?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/035: Isabele,/30d Do you want to come with us too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/038: I want to see it./30dWhat would you have done without us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/039: If Cesare plans to resurrect the God of Destruction, /45d/n we must go to the underwater city as soon as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/040: The underwater city, /40d is probably one of the seven wonders near Cyreps. /55d Is there anything there?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/041: According to the "Secret Records of the Creation War", the seal of the last God of Destruction remains at /45d. /60d/n He must want to break the seal and resurrect the God of Destruction.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/043: Understood, Mr. Cyrano. /40d/nI will move the main force to the vicinity of the underwater city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/045: I want to go back to Gesir City first/45d. /45d/nWhen we get there, we may be able to find the forgotten things.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/046: Go to the Bernstein family mansion...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/049: No matter what you do next.../45d/n When you get there, you will always be able to think of some forgotten things.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/050: Maybe I am a little nosy when I say this/15d...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/054: Tsk, /30d Even you are like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/056: The next choice will change the story and the ending./nYou want to save it here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro04b/000: You have to escape from here quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/000: The free trade zone ends here. /nNo leaving without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/001: The free trade zone ends here. /nNo leaving without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/002: The free trade zone ends here. /nNo leaving without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/003: After living for so long, this is the first time I have seen business so bad. /nFew stores are open now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/004: It's all the fault of policy failure. /nIt's all the fault of those Tuer guys, /nThis business can't be done at all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/005: They are all those stupid officials and nobles in the central government./nWhat could have been accomplished was ruined by them!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/006: The current difficulties are only temporary. /nThere is no need to be so excited.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/007: Where did that little devil go? /nHow dare you slap a lady on the butt and run away?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/008: If I catch him,/nI will have to teach him a lesson so that he will never dare to do such a thing again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/009: Ah! This sister is too fierce! /nHe chased me endlessly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/010: If women all over the world were like this, how would/nhow would we live like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/012: Hmph...Is this really the premier port of Dhaka?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/013: All the shops are closed. We have to look up./nLook at the sky. What is this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/014: Wandering merchants,/nThey all look forward to one day settling down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/015: What's interesting is that once they were able to settle down,/nthey couldn't stay long and set off again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/016: Maybe it's because I was born to wander.../nMy father is the same. /nI don't know where he is now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/017: I heard that King Rashid's grandson, Rashid III,/nhas not returned to the palace yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/018: Looks like he plans to stay out for a long time this time. /nHowever, being entangled in such complicated matters, /neven if you live in a palace, you will be on pins and needles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/019: However, his black hair is so charming...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/020: It is Holy Sabbatical Week. /nThe chapel is closed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/021: Hmph...Is this really the premier port of Dhaka?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/022: It's all the fault of policy failure. /nIt's all the fault of those Tuer guys, /nThis business can't be done at all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/023: The most important thing is to do your best to do what you can do at the moment. /nAfter all, no one knows what the future holds.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/024: Even if there are things that can be done here right now/nvery limited,/nIf you search carefully, you can always find something else, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/025: Welcome to our hotel. /nThe accommodation fee is 100 ELD. /nDo you want accommodation?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/026: Thank you for your patronage. Have a great rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/027: Business is hard enough, but if we only get customers like this, it will be troublesome.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/028: Thank you for your patronage and welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/029: Our boss is a monster old man. /nAt that age, I still get up at four in the morning and work until midnight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/030: The more diligent the boss is, the more tired he is in the end...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/031: ...Really, sometimes I can't help but think, /nIt would be nice if something happened to that old man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/032: I am a scholar from Bifrost. /nI came to Dhakama to investigate information.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/033: I finally found time to investigate,/nIt just so happens that the economy here is in recession...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/034: Although it does not affect the investigation, /nBut people can't live just by eating. /nBesides checking information, there is nothing you can do here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/035: I am Curtis' officer. /nI came here to meet people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/036: The details involve military secrets, so I can't tell you,/nbut this information can be of decisive help in the fight against the Tour Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/037: I plan to stay a few more days, and after getting the pass, /n will go directly to the capital of Pendragon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/038: I am a Tuer magician who was naturalized here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/039: It's almost one year since naturalization. After waiting for one year, /n will be able to obtain a permit to enter Pendragon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/040: Ask me why I left the Tur tribe and became Pendragon nationality? /nFor love. For her,/nI can even give up my life, not to mention my nationality...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/042: This is the best jewelry store in the world!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/043: I have worked here my whole life. /nI have also saved a lot of money, and now I plan to/npass the store to my granddaughter.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/044: However, it is not easy for a woman to run a store alone. /nI have to find a husband for my granddaughter.../nIs there any good young man?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/045: Why is grandpa so anxious to marry off his sister?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/046: The free trade zone ends here. /nNo leaving without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/047: Why does King Rashid send a liaison ship/n to Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/048: Excuse me. /35d/nDo you know Storm Island?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/049: Storm Island? /nWho are you and why are you interested there?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/050: Storm Island? /45d/nWhy are you interested in that kind of place?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/051: I have a reason/30d to go there no matter what.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/052: Decades ago, /30d many people had unrealistic dreams, /30d/n went to that island...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/053: I didn't expect that there would be such people now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/054: I'm not sure, /30d but I heard that the Pendragon royal family /35d occasionally sends a liaison ship /25d/n to that island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/055: It seems that a ship is about to set sail. /40d/nYou should go and find out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/058: Thank you for patronizing our store.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/059: The uncle in the hotel/n knows a lot of stories from the past.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/060: I go to him sometimes./nListen to all his stories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/061: The door here seems to be locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/062: The free trade zone ends here. /nNo leaving without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/063: Looks like he plans to stay out for a long time this time. /nHowever, being entangled in such complicated matters, /neven if you live in a palace, you will be on pins and needles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/064: I heard that he used to be a /n traveling bard.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr98/000: After hearing about the last incident, the basement was sealed off.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr98/001: Okay, hurry up and save Esmeralda.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/001: [Meditch]/nI am very happy to have a capable companion like you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/002: [Clausewitz]/nWe sincerely welcome everyone to join the Falcon of the West Wind. /50d/nI look forward to seeing you show your talents.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/003: [Bols]/nThis is the war conference room of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/004: [Louis]/n Nicosia is a small village south of Geysir.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/005: [Rhidelhard]/nThank you for your help, /20d/nBut don't think that you can put on airs just because you have made a contribution.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/006: [Rhidelhard]/nBut, /20d I still wish you success in completing the mission in Nicosia.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/007: [Kana]/nWith you on my journey,/25d I always feel more at ease! /20d Mr. Newcomer!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/008: [Clausewitz]/nYour first mission is to collect intelligence on the Nicosia area.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/009: [Isabele]/n... The ugly words are ahead, /40d I don't like you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/010: [Isabele]/nIf it has nothing to do with the mission, can you please stop talking to me?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/012: The Falcon of the West Wind, War Conference Room
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/014: Ah, Mr. /15dCyrano. /10dYou are here. /35d/nNow everyone is here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/015: Everyone, there is a situation on /15d. /40d/nCardinal Cesare/15d seems to be planning something in the Nicosia area.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/017: According to our intelligence, they're building a fortress there./30d/nThey seem to be preparing for something.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/018: However, the place was heavily guarded and /35d/nour intelligence officers were unable to infiltrate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/019: The mission this time is to go there with me and /25d/n investigate what they are doing!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/020: Do you know where the Nicosia region is?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/021: Nicosia Region/15d is south of Gesir City. /45d/nThis road is not short.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/023: ? /30d It was the capital of the old empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/024: It is still the largest city in the empire, /40d/n However, recently, Duke Frederick's Ron seems to be more energetic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/025: The Ron region/20d is the territory of Duke Frederick/25d, the strongest force in the empire today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/026: Even the Falcon of the West Wind's intelligence network/35d hasn't reached that far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/028: If the situation changes, /20d/n we will send a messenger to contact you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/033: Anyway! /35dOnly that drawer.../20d must not be opened!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/036: Gasir City.../65d Has it been fifteen years...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/039: [Kana]/nSister Isabele and Rhidelhard/20d seem to be a little dissatisfied with Cyrano/n.../50d Don't take it to heart!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/042: [Clausewitz]/nPlease go to the Nicosia area to find out the war situation there.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/046: [Bols]/nHowever, missing the meeting will affect the operation,/nPlease try your best to attend.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/047: [Silver]/nI haven't spent this long on land in ages.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/049: [Silver]/nI don't regret leaving the ship. /50d/nI'm just not used to life ashore yet.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/013: Go south from Gesir for a while, /n you can enter Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/014: I heard about the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe,/nIt has calmed down recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/015: In Nicosia, the power of the church/n is very strong. This has always been the case.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/024: All that glitters is not gold. /nThis sentence comes from one of my favorite books.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/026: My engagement was broken off not long ago.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/029: The church seems to be making a lot of money by doing nothing. /nWhat exactly have they created?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/030: I have a relative who lives in Caracas,/nI heard that life is very difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/031: No one can really see the truth./nPeople see only the truth in their eyes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/032: Gasir City, the center of the church territory, is peaceful,/nCriticism of the church is relatively free,/nBut is this really the truth?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/037: My son is her fan. /nNot long ago, I saw her near here. /nShe probably went south.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/042: Not long ago, a friend of mine suddenly disappeared.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/044: I heard from my mother./nThe matter of the Archbishop's wife.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/045: It seems that she died unjustly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/046: My mother and Cardinal Cesare/n were once very close.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/047: They seemed to have known each other for a long time,/nbut she never said it in detail.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/048: I did have orders to kill someone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/049: But ever since I injured my head in that accident, /n couldn't remember who to kill.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/052: That strange assassin fell into the river a few days ago,/nI rescued him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/053: For the glory of Gesir's prosperity!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/054: To achieve this, of course Lord Cesare/n must take control of the political power, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/055: However, there is something wrong with Ron's Lord Frederick's attitude...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/056: Wow...my friend actually stole my boyfriend...
