Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/060: Please... don't mention those two women. /nMy head hurts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/061: They all said that I was theirs.../nIt made me upset.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/062: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/063: Bernstein Mansion: This building was once the residence of the Bernstein family, lords of Geysir City. The architecture combines classical style with modern flavor, is gorgeous and grand, and is a typical lord's residence. It is now uninhabited. It would have been eligible to be listed as a historic site, but the Bernstein family was accused of colluding with the devil when it fell, so it was not approved./nHistorical relics are completely unprotected.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/065: The son was tortured for worshiping the devil,/nThe father died in a duel with Lord Frederick.../nThe ending of the Bernstein family is really tragic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/066: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nWhen fighting the enemy, pay special attention to the conflicting relationship between the enemy's attributes. Especially when we use weapons with attributes or cast /n magic, we must carefully observe the enemy's appearance, combine it with past experience, and remember the conflicting relationship between the enemy's attributes before launching an attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/067: [Member of Tactics Society]/nWhen you encounter a monster you have never seen before,/nFirst understand its characteristics,/nIt will help the game progress smoothly.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/002: The people in the church do nothing but point fingers all day long./nThe more I look at it, the more irritated I become.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/003: The mayor has a bad relationship with the captain bound for Dacama. /nDidn't we have a big quarrel not long ago?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/004: Even if you are a wolf, you have to wear sheep's clothing./nThis is the ability to survive in this world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/005: The more people who hold hatred against the church, the more people/n will naturally defect to the Falcon of the West Wind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/006: The mayor's official residence is just after entering the west area of the city./n's first house./nWill that place also become the target of Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/007: Recently? I simply can't live anymore. /nPrice keeps rising, and thieves are everywhere...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/008: It's not making any money in the first place, but/n the church actually has to charge more donations.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/009: Always have a drink in the tavern next to the Granada store. /nAs a politician, he has no airs and is easy to talk to.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/010: Bandits are rampant in the desert recently, /nThis business is becoming increasingly difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/011: The desert is getting more and more sad, and the prices of goods are also rising. /nAs long as you can get through it, you can make a lot of money.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/012: In the mayor's mansion at the west entrance of the city/nMayor Charles, I heard that he was also from the desert caravan.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/013: It's wrong to think it's just desert bandits./nThe pirates who are now at sea,/nMore than ever!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/014: It's not all caused by those damn Tu'er people!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/015: Unless Mayor Charles/n, who lives in the mayor's mansion in the west of the city, tightens security, this will always be the case!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/016: Dhaka? Now the world's pirates./nAren't they all there?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/017: I heard that pirates had to run for their lives when they encountered a Tuer warship. /nHow did Pendragon fight those guys?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/018: Control the pirates of Dacama, and you can rule the entire ocean. /nPirates have been talking about this recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/019: Rashid II, who has the greatest hope of succeeding./nSon Rashid III, leaving the city of Pendragon,/nHow many years has it been?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/020: The Pendragon royal family is known for their love of traveling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/021: Rashid III? /nHe is the only grandson of Robin and King Rashid./nIt is not surprising that he has the full support of the King.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/022: You don't know Robin, do you? /n is the first wife of King Rashid, and /n is said to be the woman he once loved most.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/023: The King of Rashid, despite the identity gap,/nI am not sure what I am saying./nHe insisted on taking Robin as his proper wife.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/024: I heard that Queen Robin and King Rashid met during the adventure that King/n embarked on to rebuild Pendragon/n when he was young, and they fell in love like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/026: It's the best place to do business in the whole of Gahill./nI'm sure it's Dhaka./nWhen the old empire was still here, it was nice here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/027: I really miss the days when the empire was still there. /nAt that time we also had hope, /nwe had ambitions, and everyone was full of energy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/028: Of course, no one would have thought at that time,/nThe power of the church will be as rampant as it is today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/029: Oh, oh? /nYou are really a charming person.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/030: Do you know the legend that the dragon on Huolong Mountain wakes up once every thousand years?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/031: Don't know? /nOf course! Because I just made it up.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/032: There is a lake in the underwater city of Syrapes./nFamous of its legends and beauty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/033: Ah...the place where my man proposed to me,/nIt is also the lakeside where you can see the underwater city.../nI was really happy then...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/034: Now whenever I think of that scene, I still blush, hahaha.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/035: Mom talks about dad all day long.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/036: What's so good about a father who abandons us and runs away!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/037: When I grow up, I will never be like my father!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/038: Oh, is this your first time here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/039: What, did you encounter something good? /nIt's all written on his face. /n reads "I am the happiest person in the world."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/040: Hehehehe! You must have a great lover! /nAh...that's great. If I were still at that age.../nPlease tell me, what kind of person is the other person?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/041: Although she is my wife, she is too talkative...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/042: How the hell did you do that?/nYou keep talking about it?/nI don't get it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/043: Go and look up the Mandarin dictionary.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/044: My sister-in-law spoke a little bit./nThis is recognized by all./nBut she's very kind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/045: Okay, okay. /nI take a step back and admit, /nMy sister-in-law not only talks a lot, but also often makes mistakes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/046: Got it, got it. /nIf I hadn't had to live here to earn a living.../nIf it were me, I wouldn't be able to live with someone like my sister-in-law.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/047: I know that sometimes my mother talks a little too much,/nBut can't you be considerate of this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/048: A woman who runs a house, if she can't even talk,/nAnd how do you de-pressure?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/049: No matter what others say, mother is still mother.../nI can't scold her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/050: Hmph! Who are they and why do they look down on me? /nI think back when the Black Prince was still there,/nI was a well-known figure in the Imperial Army!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/051: If the Black Prince was still alive,/nHow could this place be like this! /nWoooo...His Royal Highness the Black Prince...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/052: Our master is not in his right mind. /nI'm a little confused.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/053: However, working here is quite easy. /nYou can take your time.../nThe most important thing is that the money given is more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/054: The maid in the old man's house nearby doesn't have a good reputation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/055: I heard that the maid had bad conduct./nEspecially when he deceives his master...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/056: Standing here like this, /n will think back to the days he has traveled along the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/057: I have been to a place called Pretoria near Inverno/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/058: In the nearby mountains, /n can feel a strange breath. /nThe same is true in the cave...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/059: Although Cyreps is located on the outskirts of the old empire's territory,/nbut staying here, it is actually easy/nto hear news from various places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/060: Traveling around the territory of the old empire/n is equivalent to walking over mountains and forests all day long.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/061: Although there are no plains, we can still maintain a living, /n relying on those relatively complete trade routes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/062: I don't know who will be elected mayor of Cyreps City this time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/063: Ms. Ruth finally won her fourth election./nOr is Mr. Charles re-elected?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/066: Hmm...The current mayor, Charles, is a nuisance,/nbut Miss Ruth, who is running for office this time, is quite nice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/067: Mayor Charles's mansion is located near the Granada Store. /nHowever, I don't want to see him. Really, not at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/068: Hmm...the two candidates have very different personalities. /nMiss Ruth likes to talk to people in the pub,/nMr. Charles always stays in his home next to Granada.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/072: This house appears to be unoccupied.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/073: Guest, you can't come in from there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/074: Ah! Are you Rashid Pendragon? /nCome here! Let you taste my sword!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/076: I...will leave this world soon. /nNow that you are leaving, what are you still doing with the jewelry?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/078: Take this gem and make good use of it.../nSo, goodbye, handsome sir.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/079: I waited for him to leave for seven years. /nNow, I'm going to die...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/080: I wish the thieves would go to the west entrance./nThe mayor's house in the first house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/081: He betrayed me. He clearly said that I am his only love in this world,/nYesterday I got married to another woman, who used to be my friend./nI...am I still worth living?/nAll that's left for me now is death... I want to take a good rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/083: Advise her to find another man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/085: There is such a person.../nBut, miss, there are still many men in the world. /nHe's not everything to you, right? /nHow can you give up your life just for this kind of thing!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/086: Isn't it revenge for him to live a happier life than him? /nYou should have the courage to continue living...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/096: Swords can be distinguished by size, /ncan also be distinguished by characteristics.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/097: For example, /nattack swords and defensive swords built for specific purposes fall into the latter category. /nThe attack sword completely abandons other properties, /nonly enhances the attack power; /nThe defensive sword does not consider the attack power, /nis specially made for defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/098: The sword of attack is represented by Cassandra and Gramm./nThe sword of defense is with Krysaol Gillian./nAnd half a sword to represent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/099: [Member of Tactics Research Society]/nBattle consists basically of attack and defense. /nBoth are greatly affected by weapons. /nThe attack and defense mechanisms are as follows.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/100: [Member of the Tactics Research Association]/nLet's talk about attack first. /nAttacks depend on the attacker's strength and weapon attack power. The higher the two, the higher the overall attack power will naturally be. Hit judgment is closely related to the hit rate of the attacker's weapon. When using firearms, the hit rate is determined by the "gun" and the attack power is determined by the "ammunition".
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/101: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nDefense is more complicated.../nThere will be others who can explain it to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/102: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nI will explain defense. /nAfter the attack hits and the enemy's attack power is determined, it is necessary to determine whether the defense is successful. The defense rate, which determines the probability of success, is provided by the weapon equipped by the defender. If the defense fails, it will directly bear the enemy's attack; if the defense is successful, it will enter the calculation of weapon defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/103: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nAfter successful defense, first reduce the enemy's attack power by the /3c percentage/5c corresponding to the defender's weapon defense power, and then apply the remaining attack power to the defensive weapon. If this value is lower than the weapon's limit, the defender will not be injured, which means the HP will remain unchanged. For example, if the enemy's attack power is 1000 and the weapon's defense power is 30, 30% will be deducted first, leaving 700 for the weapon. If the weapon limit is 800, you will not take any damage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/104: [Member of the Tactics Research Society]/nHowever, if the attack power applied to the defensive weapon exceeds its limit, the attack will penetrate the weapon. At this time, the durability of the defensive weapon is reduced by 1 point (if the durability drops to 0, the weapon will be damaged and disappear), and the damage suffered by the defender is equal to the attack power of the weapon minus the weapon's limit value.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/105: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nWant to learn about magic? /nMagic attack power depends on the attack power of the magic itself and the caster's intelligence, of which intelligence is particularly important. The same kind of magic will also have a huge power gap due to the different intelligence of the user. Of course, there are also minimum intelligence requirements for using magic. If you lack intelligence, you cannot cast it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/106: [Member of the Magic Research Association]/nAll magic has its own attributes, which are divided into five types: fire, thunder, water, darkness, and light. If the enemy monster also has one of these five attributes, the damage will be calculated differently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/107: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nOf course, you can't cast magic without MP. /nThere are also some people whose MP will not increase no matter what.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/109: ----Celepos City Guide----/nGranada Business Group: West of the City/nMayor's Residence: West of the City
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/110: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHave you clearly understood attack and defense? /nSo, let me briefly introduce the types of swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/111: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nThere are four types of swords, among which the rapier and the heavy sword are particularly important. The rapier has strong attack power, but low defense and is easily damaged, so it is more dangerous to use it at a low level. Although it is easy to defeat enemies, its durability is also consumed quickly and the maintenance cost is high.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/112: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nThe heavy sword has high defense and is not easily damaged. The disadvantage is that the attack power is low. However, if you don't bring a heavy sword with you, you may not be able to continue fighting after all the rapiers are damaged.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/113: ----Swords by type----/n rapier: thin-edged dagger, stabbing sword, saber/n epee: Roman dagger, swordbreaker/n/n Swordsmanship Research Society under the Imperial Academy

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/049: Awen prayed to the sky again. /n "God who gave me the shining gems, if you give me the gems, /n is really because you understand /n my feelings for him, please help me."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/050: So, she heard God's answer in her heart. /n "I understand your wish. However, if you want to save him, /n you must make a sacrifice."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/051: She closed her eyes and replied:/n"God, I am willing to give my voice./nPlease let me rise to where He is."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/052: When she opened her eyes again, she found that she/n had risen into the air. /nThe enemy chasing them was so shocked that/n stood still, and she flew to Al's side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/053: When she came to Al's side, Al said:/n"O merciful one. You seem to come from my country,/nThere is really no need just to save me alone,/nJust take that risk. Give up on me, please save your precious life. "
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/054: She wants to answer, but she has./nNo sound./nShe was just quietly trying to untie his chain./nBut Al's chains are too strong./nShe couldn't get it out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/055: Awen saw the enemy below setting up a ladder and/n began to climb up, feeling increasingly anxious. /nFinally, she put the knife against Al's arm. /nBecause there is no way/nto free him from the chains without cutting off his arms.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/056: Al nodded. /n"Cut it off. It seems like this is the only way."/nAwen cut off Al's arm with tears in her eyes. /nAl then fainted from the severe pain of his broken arm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/057: Although Awen rescued Al, she had no way out. /nAnd the enemy is climbing up the cliff along the ladder. /nShe had to pray to the sky again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/058: "God, merciful God! I want this gem/nLeave it to him. Please grant my wish as you did at first,/nProtect him. I would give my life./nThis time, please let him escape from here. "
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/059: After that, she put the stones in Al's chest./nRun to the cliff and jump down!/nAs soon as she jumped, Al was on her chest./nThe ice cold touch woke up.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/060: At that moment, Al saw her hairband spread out, revealing hair as bright as morning light and skin as white as morning mist./n saw that Awen, whom he missed even in his dreams, was about to give his life for him/n... He shouted: "Awen!"/nBut Awen didn't answer, just fell down again and again,/ndown.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/000: This is Antananarivo. /nA village located on the border between the empire's territory and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/001: People around here, they live all the time./nUnder the threat of war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/002: There is a mountain called Manticoa to the north. /nCrossing that mountain is Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/003: Recently, from the north down,/nThere has been a marked increase in the number of soldiers passing through our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/004: This has been a strategic location since ancient times.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/006: Alas...Celepus is too far away.../nI really want to see Nikacha with my own eyes...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/007: I also know what Nikacha said.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/008: Hello, this is a mountain hotel. /nAccommodation requires 85 ELD. /nWant to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/009: Thank you and have a good sleep.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/010: The next time you come, you must stay one night before leaving.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/012: Hello, this is a hotel. /nWant accommodation?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/013: snort! Who can be like me/nWork hard for this hotel and ask him to come out and take a look!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/014: I work so hard, but/nmy boss is so stingy with me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/015: That is, I am still willing to stay in this hotel,/nOtherwise, who would be willing to guard this kind of mountain village hotel?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/016: This place is very suitable for resting your tired body and mind.../nIt's also quiet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/017: I was a Templar in Astania. /nThe scene of Lord Shuli and Lord Kaza's heroic sacrifice in the war against the Tu'er tribe/n still remains deeply in my heart.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/020: Welcome. /nThis is the only pub in Antananarivo.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/021: Our village is on the edge of the Empire./nThere have been numerous incursions by outsiders.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/022: However, there has not been such a force recently, so it is relatively calm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/024: This village has beautiful natural scenery,/nIt was once a resort for many people to recuperate;/nBut it has also shed countless blood due to years of war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/025: I heard that His Majesty the Black Prince/n also stayed here in the past.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/026: Nothing tastes better than a beer on the job.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/027: What mission? /10d Well, that's a secret.../n/30d Actually, I was fired and now I am unemployed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/028: Is there anyone you want to get rid of? /n/20d I can help you solve it very cheaply.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/029: Heh, I am a traveling nobleman.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/030: I've met all kinds of women, but none quite like Sharon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/032: I am a captain. /10d/nI should have stayed at the beach,/nDo you know why I am in a mountain village like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/033: I was fired. /n had to leave the ship he had driven for decades. /nCurrent ship owners prefer young captains.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/034: You won't understand how I felt when I left that ship that was like my wife...! /15d/nMy heart felt like it was being torn apart, and my throat was full of resentment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/035: [Cole]/nWelcome. /nAlthough we are located on the border, we have a lot of good guns and weapons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/037: The gun is the best weapon. /nI will prepare high-quality goods for you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/038: [Hilde]/nWelcome. /nIs there anything in particular you are looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/040: Thank you for visiting our store. /nWelcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/041: The uncle at the weapons shop in our village has many, many guns.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/042: He once showed me a particularly good gun,/nIt was really beautiful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/044: More and more soldiers are moving from the north to the south, and/nthey are carrying more and more weapons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/045: I used to be a member of the Falcon of the West Wind. /nBut the first time I went to the battlefield, I was so scared...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/046: I ran away like that.../nI am a cowardly coward...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/047: The atmosphere of war in Antananarivo is getting stronger and stronger...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/048: Recently, no matter where people meet, they talk about war. /nEveryone said that Bifrost seemed to be heading south in a big way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/049: Not long ago, I had a friend/n who was standing under a tree and suddenly showed a strange look in his eyes...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/050: "I understand. It's time for me to go on a long journey."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/051: Then, he left the village. /nIt's strange to abandon your family... isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/052: My homeland is on the far side of the sea./nA lot of people who can no longer drive a boat./nAll come here to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/053: People who used to sail to forget about the sea,/nOften, they settle very far from the sea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/054: [Gina]/nOh, so you still think you did the right thing, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/055: [John]/nOh...it's just such a small thing, what are you making a fuss about?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/056: [Gina]/n Such a thing? Such a little thing! /nAre you dating me? /nHow can I go see other women?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/058: [Gina]/nLunch, lunch! ha! Just lunch, right? /nBut my friend Jane said she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/059: [John]/n (guilty)! ! /nSee? /10dWhat did you see? Where is /10d/n? /10dWhere did she see me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/060: [Gina]/nA place like that.../20d I can't even say it, really!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/063: Okay. Love is not a bondage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/064: No. That is a betrayal of the other party.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/069: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away. /10dWhat do you want?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/071: Looks like it's better to avoid it as soon as possible...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/072: If you really like the other person, you can't do that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/076: [Gina]/nOh, oh! What are you doing! /nThat's the gun I finally saved up to buy for you...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/077: [John]/nOh...she gave me other gifts,/nI no longer need this gun...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/078: [Gina]/nHa! /10d Ha! /10d You have to do this, right? /10d/nLet's make it clear today!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/079: Mind your own business and go away!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/083: Maybe. /nAfter all, people are not other people's property.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/086: Goodbye. Good luck with the testing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/087: There are many bad rumors about Miss Jane, the hotel waiter.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/088: [Jackie]/nI have some good stuff here, do you want to see it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/090: Walk slowly, see you next time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/091: It looks like a war is about to begin as the adults said. /nIf the war puts our village in danger,/nI will risk my life to protect it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/092: But there seems to be no escape here/nThe threat of war.../nCould it be that throughout the old empire,/nIs there no place where I can live quietly?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/093: I heard the elders in the village say,/nThere has been no war here for so long,/nIt's the first time./20d/nEven I grew up without seeing war.../15d/nBut I'm still scared.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/094: ...Have you seen that child? /nI have been waiting for him. /nLooking forward to his coming back one day, but...but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/095: It seems that the shadow of war is also hanging over this place,/nIt's time for me to leave.../nBut this time, where can I go...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/096: War, I've had enough. /nOtherwise, why would I want to live in such a far away place.../30d/nBut this little bit of peace may come to an end. /10d Alas... Lord Shuli...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/000: Today is the day when the young master gets engaged, and everyone in the family/n is busy preparing for the engagement ceremony.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/001: The young master has always been steady, /nI believe he can handle it smoothly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/002: Now the young master is also a dignified adult and wants to become/nA man who is responsible for a woman. From now on you must/nLove yourself more than before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/003: Congratulations, brother Cyrano. /nIt is so enviable to be able to marry a wife as beautiful as Sister Mercedes.../n
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/004: When I grow up, I also want to marry Lance. /nAt that time, Lance will be like Sister Mercedes now, /nbecome an outstanding lady.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/005: Oh, Brother Cyrano, I sincerely congratulate you on your engagement.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/006: When Joel reaches his brother's age, can/nbe as outstanding a person as his brother?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/007: Today will be the busiest and happiest day for the Bernstein family/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/008: We are all excited at the thought of welcoming our beautiful hostess. /nAfter Mrs. /n passed away, /nThe Bernstein family has always needed a hostess.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/009: Ms. Mercedes is not only remarkable./nI've had a great lady's education, haven't I?/nIt is also an honour to serve her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/010: Hahaha... Today is such a good day. /20d/nThe young master is finally going to become a real man.

If the level is not high enough,/nIt's hard to survive a battle...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/047: Swords are generally divided into defensive and offensive types. /nThe defensive type is durable, but has weak attack power; /nThe offensive type is just the opposite. Although it is easy to damage,/nthe attack power is very strong.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/049: The half-hand sword is very strong,/nThe advantage is low maintenance cost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/050: Gram has strong attack power, but is not durable. /n must bear high maintenance costs. /nMoreover, our physical strength will be consumed a lot during the battle,/nso we need to prepare a lot of recovery medicine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/051: Have you heard this story? /nNot long ago, an outstanding swordsman entered the dragon's cave/n to explore, but the weapon was damaged on the way,/nAs a result... he never came back alive. /nSure enough, is the most important thing for weapons to be strong?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/056: Although the rapier is a joy to attack, /n it will put a lot of pressure on one's HP. /nYou can say that you are fighting with your life, right...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/057: Moreover, the durability of the rapier is low. If fierce battles/n continue, all of them may be damaged, and in the end you will have to face the enemy with bare hands/n. /nThat would be no different than committing suicide.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/059: Pretoria: A medium-sized village with low prices and the residence of the famous female doctor Esmeralda. /nThe nearby mountainous areas are known for their complex terrain and vast scope. /nThe famous Phoenix Cave is also nearby, but because it is very dangerous, the exact location is not announced. /nIt is said that inside the Phoenix Cave, it is possible to obtain the strongest fire magic. /n----The Imperial Geographical Society under the Geysir Academy----

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/061: Damn, even those who do nothing all day./nI'll be able to eat./nWe have to work hard to make a living...
