Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/023: Cyrano! The God of Destruction is on the move again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/024: So tenacious...! I must finish you off completely this time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/025: With this, the God of Destruction should have lost his power!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/029: The God of Destruction/n started moving again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/030: [Cyrano]/nHow can I forgive/nCesare who made you suffer so much...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/001: Hmph! /25dThe evil lord who oppresses innocent people, /40dDuke Ruben! /25d/nWest Wind Falcon/20d Come to judge you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/003: Ha ha! /35dDo you think there are any guards left?/40d/nWe dealt with them all long ago!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/010: Could it be that.../30d is a fake? !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/011: That's right. /40d/nThis person is just a stand-in.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/012: But, how did you recognize /25d? /30d looks like Ruben no matter how you look at it. /45d/n...Although he seems to be shaking a little.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/013: That is definitely not Ruben./50d/nOthers may be fooled, /25dbut I won't be!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/014: Silver, /35dwe shouldn't stay here. /35d/nLet's go after the real Ruben.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/015: Can you guess where/25d he escaped?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/016: It is impossible for him to abandon his territory and escape too far. /55d/nMust/20d went to ask for help from the nearby lord.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/017: That's right! /15d/n Come, /10d hurry up and catch up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/020: Next, /15d should have nothing to do with the Falcon of the West Wind, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/021: Ruben has abandoned his territory and fled. /50d Hasn't your goal been achieved?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/023: Since there is no reason to continue traveling together, /45d let's stop here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/024: What? /20d/nBut, /15d has already reached this point, /15d why not catch up with the real Ruben together...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/029: Got it. /30d Go wherever you like. /40d/n It has nothing to do with our West Wind Falcon anyway.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/032: Fake uncle, what's wrong with you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/033: [Luban]/nNo.../10d that.../10d that.../20d/nWhat should I do with/15d...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/034: Don't hang around in front of your eyes, /30d/nGo home quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/036: Heh.../30dNothing to do with the Falcons,/20d is that it...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/001: Hehe... /35dCyrano, /45d always take away the things you cherish, I'm so sorry. /110d/nThat woman last time, /35d called Silver? /75d is as stubborn as you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/002: You are not allowed to say Silver's name with that dirty mouth!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/003: You are the same as before, nothing has changed. /75d/nI didn't expect that, /35d you would actually go find Mercedes. /55d Hey hey hey...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/005: I have changed! /60dI am no longer the /55d person who only felt inferior in front of you in the past!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/006: Do you think you can stop me like this, /20d Iscariot!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/007: Hehe... /65d Sure enough, /20d human power is still not enough.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/008: But if /15d uses the ultimate power I created, that will be a different matter! /80d/nSee clearly, /40dCyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/009: Cyrano.../60d You have gained the strongest power. /80d/n is much more powerful than the power I created /60d...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/010: Iscariot.../50d/nAre you so eager for power, /56d that you are even willing to turn into such an ugly monster?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/011: Heh, /35d it's your turn to say something like this.../110d/nThat's right, /45d that's why I betrayed you.../30d
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/012: But... /30d In the end, you are /20d just like me... /25d is a monster... /60d/n cannot coexist with ordinary people /20d... /50d is an alien rejected by the world...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/014: At least I.../45d can still die in your hands like this.../75d/nAnd poor/25d you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/019: He went to the underwater city in order to resurrect the God of Destruction? !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/020: Cesare's lackey, /20d Iscariot.../45d/nI will use your life, /40d to pay homage to Silver's soul.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/021: Cesare.../35d How dare you do this! /50d Chase immediately!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/001: Mom, why is that person /15d in that place?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/002: That person/10d is a terrible person.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/004: From now on /15d will never talk to that kind of person, /20d/n do you understand?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/005: How strange, /30d/nThat brother gave me candy a few days ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/007: That person/10d will take away good children and eat them,/20d/n is a scary person like a devil!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/009: The eldest son of the famous Bernstein family,/n turned out to be a devil worshiper.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/010: There should be a limit to embarrassing the family!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/013: I really don't know, /50d/nyou are such a person.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/000: Then.../30d, isn't that Alondette.../45d, that magical machine...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/001: Pendragon unexpectedly intervened.../55d/nWhat to do about the war with the Tur tribe.../40d actually sent Alondette/10d here,/35d Rashid!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/002: It seems that the recent rumors/30d are true.../35d/nThe Tour Empire and Pendragon/30d have temporarily reached a truce...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/004: No.../35d is too early! /35d/nOur imperial territory/15d has not been unified yet!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/005: Your Excellency Cardinal, /20d Now is not the time to talk about this. /25d/nNow that Pendragon has intervened, /15dYour plan...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/006: We have to get out of here quickly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/008: As long as I am alive, the /30d empire must /20d be unified by my own hands!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/010: Put down your false dreams./35d/nPeople/15dYou should know when to give up.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/012: Sacrificing innocent people for such ambition.../45d/nI can't allow it anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/014: I can't do it. /30dDo you think I will give up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/015: Stop trying to persuade me, /10dChristina! /25d/nThat person is no longer the grandfather you knew /10d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/017: Who dares/35d to call me a devil! /40d say me! !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/022: Grandpa finally/55d got real peace, I am very happy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/023: Now.../60d's father and mother/55d/n can finally rest in peace...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/025: Everyone....../40dChristina,/30dSeeing you so strong,/30dThey will all be very pleased.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/027: Speaking of which, where did /35d Machiavelli go?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/028: That person, /25d I let go, /15d Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/031: His purpose, /35d is just through his own thoughts, /35d leaving his evaluation of Cesare and us /20d to future generations, /25d/n nothing more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/032: No, /40d I don't care what that guy does. /35d/nCompared to this...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/033: Who exactly are you? /55d/nClausewitz, is /35d also a real name?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/034: Actually, I have a lot to say/40d to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/035: However, /40dnow/25dmy grandfather is waiting, /40d/ncan you /30dcome with me first?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma16a/000: There seems to be no road here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/000: How...? /30d/n unexpectedly came to such a strange place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/001: Damn.../35d The smell of sulfur is really pungent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/002: This is the cemetery in Invernor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/003: The prisoners who died in prison, /45d/n will be thrown here casually.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/007: I see.../30d I didn't expect such a monster to live here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/008: It's not just this one. /35d/nThe sulfur cave in Invernor is a paradise for monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/010: You can only go through the Sulfur Cave first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/011: Okay, /15d let's go! /40d/nIt's very dangerous here. Leave the battle to me. Follow closely!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx18/000: Rebel activities are frequent here and civilians are prohibited from passing/n/n Notice from the Lord of Pretoria
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme04/000: No civilians are allowed to enter here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme04/001: Leave while I can still talk!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat02/000: This iron door is completely sealed. /55d/nFind a way to open it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/003: What's wrong, /15d is like this suddenly?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/006: (Is it Deimos' soul reacting?/45d/nThe situation doesn't seem right./40d I have to go to Meditch to have a look.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/007: Silver, /30dgo with the other two and rescue the prisoners.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/009: There are some things I can't let go of.../45d/nI'll meet you later.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/000: Thank you for giving me a ride.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/002: Are you planning to go to the old empire territory from here/10d?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/003: Gasir. /50d/nSo, /20d there is no need for a ship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/004: Did you hear everything? /35d He no longer needs a boat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/005: Then, /35d we can /15d return to the sea?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/006: From now on, you can do whatever you want. /50d/nYou can continue to be a pirate, /30d you can use the money you save to start a business, /40d you can go back to the countryside and farm... /40d/nIt's up to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/007: I am really happy these days. /50d/nI hope everyone is safe and well, /35d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/008: Boss, /10d What are you talking about? /25d/n seems to be saying goodbye...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/009: Please look after/40d that foolish youngest brother of mine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/011: The days spent with the boss.../45d I will never forget it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/012: The boss is leaving... /45d/nIt seems we should quit /15d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/013: Then, let's say goodbye to /30d. /40d/nThere will always be a day when we meet again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/014: Boss, I wish you all happiness in the future /35d, /20d be sure to take care!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/015: Although I had known that such a day would come... /65d/n I really had to leave those stupid guys behind, /30d still couldn't worry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/016: I promised long ago to follow you to the end./50d/nOnce I/25d give my word,/35d I never break it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/017: You don't have to follow me. /45d/n It is enough if you can send me to Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/018: .../50d, right? /50d/n Then, /20d will be left to you from now on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/020: First, pass through the Trixis Desert for /20d, and then go to Gesir City for /30d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/021: It turns out that the person the boss has been waiting for, /35d is that man...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/022: He said he would wait for someone who could defeat him, and /40d finally waited.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/023: With the boss's skills, I thought he would never find /20d...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/024: Then who are those of us who have been following the boss?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/025: What else can I count? /20d is superfluous...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/028: Forget it, /30d has enough capital anyway, /25d just go do business...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/000: West Wind Falcon Supply Line, Rhidelhard Camp
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/001: Rhidelhard,/15dWhat's going on? /30d/nCall me out at such an important time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/002: Brother, /40d, can you please /15d come over?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/005: Brother, don't you think /30d is unfair?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/006: Before, /20d you and I always showed our talents on the front line, /50d but now this is nothing!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/007: The credit goes all to Cyrano and Frederick, but /40d/n we can only guard one road from the rear /25d!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/008: Rhidelhard,/10d I understand how you feel. /30d/nBut the most important thing in the war, /20d is to ensure the supply line, /25d you also know this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/010: For the enemy, the /25d supply line is also important. /35d/nAs long as supplies are cut off, /30d no matter how large their army is, /20d they will fall into chaos!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/011: Now that the enemy's supply line has been cut off, /50d is the perfect time to attack Catalina's army!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/013: Brother, /30d, what are you still hesitating about? /35d/nLet us take action, /30d let's dampen their spirit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/014: The big brother I know, /30d, would never show weakness like this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/017: Yes.../35d can't stay like this forever.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/018: Okay! /40d Let them see our strength!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/019: That's right! /35d This is what big brother said!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/000: After all, Gesir City was once the capital of the old empire./nEven if its former glory is gone,/nthe taxes collected are not a small amount.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family,/nThey were once the top contributors to the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/002: Geisir Cathedral was completed more than ten years ago. /nI remember it was a huge project that took a long time/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/003: Since this place became a church territory, no religious trials have been held.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/005: Miss Sharon's recent performance./nIt's right here in Gacil.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/006: My sister who lives next door is a little weird./nSometimes very gentle,/nSometimes he becomes very irritable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/007: Thieves have been rampant in the desert recently. /nAs a result, I almost died several times during this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/008: People who live in hot places mostly have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/010: The year when the Gasil Cathedral was completed,/nThe Bernsteins who contributed most to the project./nIt's ironic that the door was destroyed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/011: There is a road in the nearby forest,/nleading to the cave where the legendary dragon once lived.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared in this area...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/013: Under the Cathedral of Gesil,/nThere are previously constructed groundwater channels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/014: I heard about the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe,/nIt has calmed down recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/015: However, whether the underground waterway or the dragon's lair, /n are just places in rumors, and /n no one knows whether they exist or not.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/016: I heard that the Tur people's science and technology are far beyond imagination.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/017: That sister seems to have grown up./nThe character is a little strange.../nThat's what my mom said.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/019: The downfall of the Bernstein family, perhaps/nIt was already doomed./nThat family is incompatible with Lord Cesare's ambitions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/021: I heard from several aunts that/nshe became like that after she was treated roughly by her stepfather. /nI asked what was going on, but was scolded severely...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? /nHe is a popular man in Cyreps.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/024: Gasir City is now ruled by Cardinal Cesare,/nof course it also belongs to the church territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/026: Gesir here is a city that can make people feel that it is declining day by day. /nThe most obvious thing is that the population has not increased.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/027: Why? /nCompared with other cities, the /n church power in Gesil City is far less domineering...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/028: People in Gesir City keep moving away./nIs it because the city itself has lost its vitality?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/029: Pendragon and the Tur tribe have been at war for a long time. /nIt is said that those who can block the powerful firepower of the Tu'er tribe,/nis the advantage in numbers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/030: I heard that in the face of Pendragon's numerical offensive, the /nTur tribe's attack also slowed down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/031: General Sander is a retired soldier. /nRecently moved to Gesil City. /n Usually retired soldiers go to Ron, the "City of Soldiers"...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/032: General Sander has four daughters,/nI heard that all of them are beauties.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/033: The general seemed to have a bad temper when he was a soldier. /nI heard that I still retain a bit of the temper I had back then...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/034: General Sand's family has a very well-known reception./nGeneral Sande is certainly in position./nIt suits the people of this ancient city of tradition.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/035: You must also go to General Sander's banquet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/036: There are often many people gathering at his home. /nGeneral Sander seems to have many acquaintances everywhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/037: Well, if you still like adventure,/nIt would also be a good idea to go look for that cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/038: When I was a kid, I used to be everywhere./nFind the dragon's cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/039: A long time passed after that, but /n never heard of her performance again. /nWhy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/040: I really want to watch the idol sister Sharon perform again.../nIs it true that she is quitting the music industry as rumored?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/041: As a member of the garrison of Gesil City, /n's proudest moment is the annual military parade.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/042: As we entered the streets of Gesil,/nI can really imagine when the Black Prince was alive./nWhat's the parade like?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/043: Of course, with this little force now,/nIt is far from comparable to the grand occasion that commanded the whole of Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/044: The security in Gesil City is quite good.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/045: The influence of undesirable forces such as the Falcon of the West Wind/n is still very weak here,/nso you can rest assured about the security of Gesil.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/046: The most volatile period of security./nIt was 10 years ago when the Bernsteins collapsed./nAt that time, the remnants of the Bernstein family were resisting...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/047: I was a soldier wearing the Bernstein family crest. /nWhen the family collapsed ten years ago, I was on vacation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/048: I heard that the young master of the Bernstein family/n was going to undergo a religious trial,/nI rushed back to Gesir City immediately, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/049: By then, it was all over. /nThat was the biggest shame in my military career. /nWhen all my colleagues were wiped out, I was not on the battlefield...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/050: I am a mage who studies magic at Lord Iscariot's academy. /nIn order to search for information, I just came back from Dakama Port in Pendragon territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/051: After going to Da Cama Port, I realized that Pendragon's economy/n was already quite difficult. /nIt seems that the war with the Tuer people is indeed very difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/052: At this time, if the power of our empire can unite.../nAlas...His Royal Highness the Black Prince...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/053: General Sander? My brother likes his third daughter. /nHis daughters are all beautiful. /nBut General Sander is not good-looking...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/054: The mother of those sisters must be a great beauty, right? /nBut to be honest, I don't like General Sander.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/055: My brother is a doctor./nWhen I say this, he laughs at me, "What do kids know?"/nBut I think I'm good at seeing people./nSooner or later, my brother will suffer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/056: [Dustin]/nI am a doctor. /nNot long ago, I fell in love with General Sander's third daughter, /nPriscilla.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/057: [Dustin]/nBut not long ago, I saw that Priscilla/n was arrested on suspicion of taking drugs. /nAlthough she was released with the guarantee of my identity as a doctor...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/058: [Dustin]/nPriscilla must/nbeen seduced by a bad person! /nIs there any way to help her?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/059: If you want to talk about our boss's shortcomings, /n is that he is almost obsessed with desserts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/060: This store was passed down from the owner's family. /nThe current boss doesn't seem to care about the store as much as the previous one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/061: Father's interests/n are actually not suitable for running a weapons store. /nHis favorite thing is cooking.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/062: The person manning the counter now is my father's cousin. /nMy father is temporarily away on business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/063: Oh, my God! It's from our ancestors./nIt's the old word. It doesn't have feelings!/nI've been thinking about eating...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/064: Do you know that Lord Kars slayed the dragon?/nThe sealed Fire Dragon Cave?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/065: I heard that the Fire Dragon Cave is to the south of this city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/066: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome. /nThis hotel provides the cleanest and most attentive services. /nAccommodation fee is 80 ELD. /nWant to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/067: Thank you, please have a good rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/068: Welcome to visit us next time. /nWe always provide the best quality service.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/069: Thank you for staying at our hotel. /nWelcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/070: [Mr. Oldfield] Welcome! Here are the best weapons in the world! /nPlease take your pick!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/072: Good weapons can save lives in critical moments. /nWelcome to visit next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/073: [Mrs. Oldfield]/nWelcome. /nI help my husband run the business and am responsible for selling firearms among the weapons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/075: Thank you for purchasing our products.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/076: [Raymond]/nWelcome, we only deal in the best products! /nYou might as well buy one and try it first!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/079: There is a dragon's cave nearby, and occasionally someone/n will bring out precious ancient treasures from inside.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/080: However, since it is spreading everywhere that /n you can never come back if you go in, /n you'd better not go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/081: [Mr. Durant, Merchant]/nCome, come, come, sell the leftover goods at a cheap price!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/083: Thank you, thank you. /nNext time I go to Dhakama, I will bring back better goods,/nI will repay you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/084: Hmph, Durant is not sold cheaply,/nI have the nerve to say it is a clearance deal!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/085: I am traveling in search of enlightenment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/086: Not long ago, under the Bodhi tree,/nA mysterious light said to me:/n"Let's go."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/087: I will not go back until I have enlightenment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/088: Today's young people have no energy at all! /nFrom this point of view, Lord Frederick of Ron/n is a role model for young people!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/089: Would you delay your own affairs because of other people's affairs? /nThe most important thing in the world is to satisfy yourself. /nPeople must satisfy themselves when they are alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/090: Speaking of this, I live too indulgently.../nI really miss my hometown Pretoria...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/091: Recently, Iscariot's Imperial Academy,/n seems to be studying the limits of magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/092: I know who you really are./nYou think I'm old enough to live?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/093: You are the one looking at the monitor and clicking the mouse. /n is a traveler wandering along time, isn't he...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/094: Do you know the legend of Gesir House?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/095: Ten years ago, the Bernstein family lived in that mansion. /nBut later, that family was wiped out...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/096: No one has lived in it since. The reason is...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/097: The recent movement of traders,/nIsn't it a little out of order?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/098: More and more families are being forced to go bankrupt by local lords./nMany people have to work as dealers to make a living.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/099: But the situation in Gesil City is pretty good.../nI'm really lucky.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/100: I always thought there must be something hidden in the basement, so /n ran down to look for it. This is quite silly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/102: Business has been really hard recently. /nI don't know where all the money in people's hands has gone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/103: Even Gesil City, which is said to be in better condition, is like this.../nHow can other places be so good?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/104: The economy was not like this when the Black Prince was alive. /nLook what it looks like now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/105: The empire must be reunified! /nThe only person who can do this is our Cardinal Cesare!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/106: Hmph... If you want to appreciate my beauty, you can't do it in a bright place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/107: That way you can see my makeup.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/108: In short, you must not believe what the businessman says!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/109: On vacation today, I returned to my hometown/n Gesir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/110: My troops are stationed on the other side of Caracas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/111: I have a friend on duty here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/112: The door to this house is locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/114: [Borse's Ancestor]/nYou broke into a room you shouldn't have entered. /nIf you want to leave, just answer the following questions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/120: [Borse's Ancestor]/nYou don't even know our family's surname,/nYou are not qualified to own a long sword!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/121: [Borse's Ancestor]/nHowever, I will still let you leave here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/122: [Bolse's Ancestor]/nIn the name of our family, you may leave this room. /nPlease take good care of Bors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/123: [Soldier]/nAs a warrior, the most important thing is of course physical strength! /nRun around the city three times and I will give you two breath gems; /nRun ten times and I will give you a diamond gem! /nHowever, once you leave this area, you have to start all over again! Let's go!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/128: [Soldier] Good job! Completed one lap! continue!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/129: [Soldier] All ten laps completed! Come here! Give you a prize!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/130: [Soldier]/nVery good! Finally looking a bit like a soldier! /nThis is for you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/132: [Soldier]/nOkay, you have graduated now! /nDon't forget to continue exercising in the future!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/133: The forests in the old empire are now very dense./nYou must draw a map when traveling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/134: The central square of the great city Gesil City
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/136: [Soldier] Completed three laps! Come here now and I'll give you two breath gems! Keep running and you can get diamond gems!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/137: [Soldier]/n has completed three laps. As promised, this is for you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/140: [Soldier] Completed five laps. Come here now and I will give you the breath gem!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/141: [Soldier]/nThe foundation of a soldier is, after all, physical strength! /nDon't forget to exercise at any time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/142: [Soldier]/nOnce you get out, you have to run all over again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/010_3: The year when the Gasil Cathedral was completed,/nThe Bernsteins who contributed most to the project./nIt can't be said to be ironic that the door was destroyed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/066_3: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome. /nThis hotel provides the cleanest and most attentive services. /nWant to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/112_3: The house appears to be empty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/144: Our purpose is to hunt for treasure. /35d/n You have to go to the Fire Dragon Cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/000: Our lord is a really hot-tempered man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the empire's chief hero/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/002: Our lord is famous for his violence./nIt would be terrible if he accidentally targets us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/003: A relative wrote that he has settled in Libreville,/nI plan to move there too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/005: Not long ago, I saw a beautiful woman/n passing by here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/006: The Lord only hunts once./nThe animals in the forest were almost killed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. /nI almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/010: No one who was captured into the castle came out alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/011: Our Lord of Memphis is very violent./nThe best thing to do is not let him notice...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/013: Our rice wine tastes very good. /nJust look forward to it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/014: I heard about the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe,/nThere has been a stalemate recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/015: When I save some money, I plan/nmove to Ron.../nAlthough I can't bear to leave my familiar hometown,/nI have to live, and this place is really...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/016: I heard that the science and technology of the Tur people are far beyond our imagination.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/019: He has been making trouble in the village since he was a child...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/023: Do you know Mr. Nikacha, a musician? /nHe is very popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/026: No need to go there now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/029: Thank you. Hope to see you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/030: Not long ago, someone proposed to me. /nBut there is one thing that bothers me./nIf you live here, you have to pay wedding tax when you get married...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/031: This used to be a livable village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/032: But since the current lord took over, /n has made everyone miserable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/033: Not long ago, the lord said that he didn't like it./nDrive away the tailor's family.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/034: I heard that he even beat up a tailor./nHe was driven out after being beaten to a disability, really...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/035: Not long ago, my marriage proposal was rejected.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/036: The saddest thing is that she married to Libreville in a blink of an eye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/037: None of the girls in our village want to stay. /nI'm also thinking about whether it's time to leave here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/039: I once dreamed of becoming a scholar.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/040: It's been about ten years since I came here, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/041: I managed to save my life and escaped here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/045: Turn the corner, maybe still waiting there,/nA new road, a secret door. /nEven though I have passed by you again and again,/nOne day in the future,/nI will eventually set foot on that hidden road,/nleading to the west of the moon and the east of the sun.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/047: [Sid]/nIt is indeed you...You are safe and sound, Master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/048: [Sid]/nI will never regret seeing you again like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/049: It is indeed you, Sid... I heard you were kidnapped before... Are you okay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/050: [Sid]/nKidnapping...Due to the shock at the time, I can no longer remember what happened when/n was kidnapped...But, it's okay now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/051: [Sid]/nAh...that's right. Master, there is something that should be returned to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/052: [ Sid ]/nThis is... I kept it for you during the war./nFamily heirloom sword./nNow, it finally meets its owner again...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/054: [ Sid ]/nI hope this sword can be somewhat/nHelp the young master. So......
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/056: [Sid]/nMaster, you must take care of yourself...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/057: [Edros]/nMy wish is to open my own store.../nWhat do you want to buy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/059: Thank you for your patronage. /nWhen I open a store in the future, I will definitely give you a big discount.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/060: [Aunt Linda]/nAre you feeling uncomfortable somewhere? /nThen you have to take medicine!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/062: If you feel uncomfortable, please tell me anytime!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/063: The one who lives in the house on the upper left side of the village/nSid is a somewhat eccentric person.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/064: Always live alone.../nAlways has a sad look on his face.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/065: The forest seems to be getting thicker and denser lately. /nIf most people wouldn't get lost,/nwhy would there be a need to hang up road signs?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/066: If you don't want to get lost in the forest,/nyou must follow the road signs carefully.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/067: [B&B owner] Welcome. /nOur family operates a B&B,/nwhen tourists come, they can rest comfortably. /nOnly 80 ELD! Want to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/069: Hmph...I'm afraid you can't find one cheaper than mine...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/070: Be careful on the road. May peace and good luck be with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/000: It didn't take long for the frog to come to our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the chief hero of the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/002: Hehehe... I've been to Gesir before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/003: If you always bully frogs, you will be punished.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/005: I went to a friend's wedding.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/006: In the nearby forest, strange sounds occasionally come from/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. /nI almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/008: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/009: We're going through the Trixis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/010: Gasir City is indeed the capital of the past and is very beautiful. /nBut the people there always feel repressed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/011: Do you/10d know the sword left by General Kars?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/013: There are people in the forest near our village./nI've seen a strange sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/014: I heard about the war between Pendragon and the Tur tribe,/nThere has been a stalemate recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/015: Since the death of His Majesty the Black Prince, the Imperial Family/nIn fact, the inheritance was discontinued.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/016: I heard that the Tur people's science and technology are beyond imagination.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/017: The sound in the nearby forest was humming.../nIt was also like the sound of the wind passing through the blades of grass.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/019: Remember it was different from Ron./nIt's a weird place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/021: I've been to the forest with my friends and I've been to the place where the sound came from./nBut strangely, there's nothing there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/023: Do you know Mr. Nikacha, a musician? /nHe is very popular in Cyreps.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/024: Most people in our village are devout believers in the Lord's Religion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/026: Hello and welcome to Hotel Bordeaux. /nThe accommodation fee is 100 ELD. /nDo you want accommodation?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/027: Thank you very much, please have a good rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/028: Welcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/029: Thank you very much. /nWelcome to come again next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/030: Miss Lucia? What a weird family. /nHow can a family be so alienated from each other? /20d/nI always feel something is not right...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/031: People have two opinions about Rukia's family. /20d/nOne says that they are just family members who have a bad relationship,/nThe other says that they are not a real family at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/032: I don't think they are a real family. /nThe most obvious thing is that I have never seen/nLucia and his wife holding hands while going out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/033: Does the empire have no power?/nCan it replace the royal family in the past? /nIf this continues, how will the empire rise again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/034: Sorry, I seem to be too excited.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/035: See the talking frog in the corner of the tavern?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/036: When it first arrived, everyone in the village/n gathered around it, trying to drive it away. /30d/n is a monster after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/037: But who would have thought that frogs can actually talk! /nIt described its experience in such a miserable way, so we didn't chase it away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/038: I agree with another view, Rukia's family/n is just slightly abnormal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/039: People have a strange habit of not understanding things they know./nEither ignore it or reject it./nRukia's family is just a little weird.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/040: Legend has it that as long as Lord Kars draws out that sword,/nEven the monster that knows no fear,/nHe would also be trembling with fear from that murderous aura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/041: Just having a good sword does not mean that you are a good swordsman,/nBut Lord Kars's sword will definitely be of great help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/042: He is a man. /nI have been thinking about him,/nBut to him, I am just an ordinary childhood sweetheart.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/045: I am traveling for knight training. /nDuring the journey, I must get General Kars's/nKilling Hell Sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/046: I heard that the sword was nearby,/nI hurried over. /30d/nAlthough the Black Prince's Asura/n on Storm Island was taken away by a weirdo, /10d this one is not good.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/047: How about you come and help me too? /10d/nWhen I get the sword, I will be rewarded heavily.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/048: Have you ever spoken to that kid who lives in there?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/049: Why do you talk like that at such a young age? /20d/nOh.../10d is so arrogant.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/050: I don't know what kind of remarkable family descendant he is.../nHe actually asked me: "Are you a woman who serves others?"/nUgh...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/051: Heh, are you also planning on General Kars'/nkilling Hell Sword?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/052: The sword is waiting for me. /nOnly me, who inherits the blood of General Kars' family, am qualified to own it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/053: Even if you call it, I'm afraid it won't pay attention to you. /20d/nHahaha! /10d Stop dreaming and go look elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/055: The hot topics in the village recently are the newly arrived Lucia family,/nand the sword of General Kars, who is suddenly being sought by many people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/057: Are you also looking for the magic sword?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/058: Quack. There's a curse wrapped around that sword. Gua.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/060: I have been waiting for him for three years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/061: He said he would come back when the snow falls in the spring.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/062: We are the Rukia family that everyone is talking about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/063: We are not as weird as the rumors say. /nJust come from a place with a different culture than here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/064: The people in this village are really strange. /nWhy do you have so much to say about other people's lives?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/065: When we moved to the countryside, we had/nexpected something like this to happen.../nBut this was too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/066: What did our parents do to deserve being scolded like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/067: The people in this village are quite weird.../nTheir devout belief in the Lord's Religion is so abnormal that it makes people care.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/068: Is there any conspiracy hidden here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/069: What does this wine taste like? It's different from other wines!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/070: Is there something wrong with my sense of taste recently? /nIt's really hard to eat anything...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/071: [Grandpa Jack]/nHehehe...Welcome to my store. /nWhat are you looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/073: Hehehe...walk slowly. /nHope to see you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/077: It's so annoying, don't come again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/088: The frog living in our village tavern, /n always feels a little strange.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/091: [Benson]/nAh... I have collected a lot of weapons from various places.../nI am short of money recently, so I will sell some. /nWant to take a look?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/093: These are all fine products that I have spent decades collecting.../nDon't worry about the quality.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/000_3: It didn't take long for the frog to come to our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/001_3: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family, the chief hero of the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/007_3: Bandits have been rampant in the desert recently. /nI almost lost my life several times during this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/008_3: People who live in hot places generally have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/011_3: Do you know the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/012_3: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared near here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/015_3: It can be said that the inheritance of the imperial family has been discontinued since the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/016_3: I heard that the science and technology of the Tur people are far beyond our imagination.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/017_3: Buzzing sound...like the sound of wind passing through blades of grass.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/021_3: My friends and I also went to the place where the sound came from, but the strange thing is that there was nothing there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/026_3: Hello, welcome to the Bordeaux Hotel. Do you want to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/028_3: Really... you don't plan to live there, why are you still talking to me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/030_3: Miss Lucia? What a weird family. How could a family be so alienated from each other? So suspicious...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/031_3: Everyone has an equal opinion. Some people say that Rukia's family just has a bad relationship, while others say that they are not a real family at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/032_3: I don't think they are a real family. The most obvious thing is that I have never seen Lucia and his wife holding hands outside!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/033_3: Does the empire have no power to replace the royal family in the past? How can the empire rise again if this continues!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/035_3: See that strange frog in the corner of the village?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/036_3: When it first arrived, everyone in the village gathered around and tried to drive it away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/037_3: But who would have thought that frogs can actually talk! It made its experience so miserable, so we didn't chase it away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/038_3: I agree with the other view that Rukia's family is just slightly abnormal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/039_3: People have a strange habit of either ignoring or rejecting things that they cannot understand. Rukia's family is just a little weird.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/040_3: It is said that whenever Lord Kars appears with that sword, all enemies will tremble in fear.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/041_3: Just having a good sword does not mean that you are a good warrior, but Lord Kars's sword will definitely be of great help to a swordsman like you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/042_3: He is a man. I kept thinking about him, but to him, I was just an ordinary childhood sweetheart.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/045_3: I am traveling for knight training. During the journey, I must get Lord Kars's hell-killing sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/046_3: I heard that the sword was nearby, so I hurried over. Although the Black Prince's Asura on Storm Island was taken away by a weirdo, this one won't work.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/047_3: How about you come and help me too? When I get the sword, I will be rewarded heavily.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/049_3: Why do you talk like that at such a young age? Ouch...how arrogant.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/050_3: I don't know what kind of remarkable family descendant he is. It's really disgusting... He actually asked me: "Are you a woman who serves people?" Ugh...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/051_3: Heh, are you also thinking about Kars's hell-killing sword?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/052_3: That sword is for me. Only I, who inherits the blood of the Karls family, am qualified to own it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/053_3: Even if you call it, I'm afraid it won't pay attention to you. Hahaha! Stop dreaming and look elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/055_3: The hot topics in the village recently are the new arrival of Lucia's family, and Lord Kars' sword that is suddenly being sought by many people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/057_3: Are you also looking for the magic sword?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/062_3: We are the Rukia family that everyone is talking about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/063_3: We are not as weird as the rumors say. Just coming from a place with a different culture than here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/068_3: Is there any conspiracy hidden here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/069_3: What does this wine taste like? It's no different from other wines!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/001: This is Paro Village. /nAlthough it is geographically close to Gesir City,/nit is culturally very different.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/002: The world outside is noisy,/nOur village is peaceful and quiet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/003: It's really scary. /nThe most handsome man in the village is mentally ill.../nWhat's more, he still has a fiancee.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/004: This village is very remote and few people come here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/005: But not long ago, a chef moved here from another place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/006: He said he wanted to look for fresh high-end ingredients,/nI thought the place was clean, so he came here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/007: Before, I was invited to Gesil City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/008: Wide roads, beautiful buildings, and well-dressed people,/nIt's dazzling to see.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/009: Living in the city.../n must be much better than living in a rural village like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/010: In a small village like ours,/n is more worried about harassment by bandits.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/011: This is all the fault of the /nSilver Arrow that destroyed our Gesir Empire. /nIt would have been nice if they hadn't cut off the royal bloodline back then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/012: Although it is a bit late, we should also establish a country,/nor form an alliance! /nDo we want this chaos to continue?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/013: I knew! I kept saying,/nMr. Dan Weelin is not a normal man!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/014: M. Briand is handsome and rich,/nSmart, good at sports...how could he be so good!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/015: Ah...I really envy Miss Diana. /nThey must be very happy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/016: Our lord seems to like children. /nThe lord has many children at home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/017: However, the strange thing is that they are all girls.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/018: The lord also likes flowers,/nI heard that there are many flowers growing in the garden.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/019: I saw Sharon's show./nShe danced well, she was beautiful and handsome.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/020: I originally wanted an autograph.../nBut those big brothers jumped in the queue, so I didn't get it.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/023: [Dan Waring]/nAfter experiencing these recent events, my son finally seems to understand,/nWhat kind of blood is flowing on my body./10dHey hey hey...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm done. To actually do such a terrible thing with my own hands.../20d/n get married? /10d I'm such a fool for still holding on to that kind of hope! /15d Hahaha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/026: [Brion Weylin]/nNo need to comfort me. /nDon't even try to persuade me. /20d/nAll I have left is death...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/028: [Diana] /nThere must be something wrong with this matter.../20d/nBrian must have misunderstood something!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/030: [Haisen]/nOh, it's Mr. Cyrano. /nI'm having a good time. /nAh, Brian and Diana asked me to say hello to you on their behalf.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/031: [Haisen]/nThat guy Dan.../n wasn't so weird when he was a child. /nAt that time, he was cheerful, smart, and good at all sports...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/032: [Haisen]/nNow that I think about it, it's really a pity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/033: It's time for us to build a unified country, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/034: In this power vacuum situation, /nNo matter what happens, it will not be surprising...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/035: What's even more shocking is that those fragments/n were found in the bag in Mr. Xio's room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/036: Welcome. /nIt's hard to say anything else, but our portion is definitely sufficient.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/038: However, King Rashid is still so healthy,/nHe will not inherit the throne so quickly.../nIf you come to my house one day,/nI would be willing to give you more food and drinks...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/040: That guy's got a good hand./nIt's just too much for perfection.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/042: Hehehe.../nDo you think there will really be/nan overlord who controls the empire in the near future?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/044: Although there are rumors that someone has pulled out/nthe Asura Sword that can determine the overlord of the empire.../nBut rumors are just rumors after all, aren't they? Hahaha.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/046: I got Sharon's autograph at the last show. /nHehehe... I am the only one in our village who has it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/047: No matter how much money you pay, I will not sell it. /15d/nI want it to be a family heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/048: Hmm.../nIf you can exchange it for something particularly good, you can consider it.../nFor example, the fragments of Asmod...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/049: Diana is the most beautiful girl in the village./nThe men of the village admire her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/050: And when she announced that she was going to marry /n Brian, who was also admired by all the women in the village, /n didn't know how much discussion it attracted...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/051: In a sense, no one welcomes this engagement. /nExcept for themselves.../20d/nThey have become the envy of everyone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/054: Thank you for visiting our store. /nWalk slowly.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/010: Lesson 1: Types of Swords and Combat Concepts
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/011: [Eoline]/nSo, starting from today, I will explain the tactics to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/012: [Eoline]/nMy teachings cannot solve all problems,/nbut the theory cannot be ignored.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/013: [Eoline]/n Let me first briefly explain the classification of swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/014: [Eoline]/nSwords can be divided into rapiers, heavy swords, long swords and great swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/015: [Eoline]/nA rapier is a long, light, sharp sword; an epee is a short, sharp sword./nThick; long sword is the most common long sword; large sword,/nAs the name suggests, it is a large sword that is long and wide.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/016: [Eoline]/nThe easiest to use is naturally the ordinary long sword,/nBut from a tactical point of view, the rapier and the heavy sword are more important.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/017: [Eoline]/n As long as the conditions for use are met, the great sword is the strongest sword. /nHowever, it is not easy to get a good big sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/018: [Eoline]/nThe rapier and the epee are tactically important because their characteristics/nare very distinct: the rapier is good at offense, and the epee is good at defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/019: [Eoline]/nThe classification of swords should be understood first. /nRacilard and epee, I will explain them in detail later.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/020: [Eoline]/nNext, let's talk about some things to note in actual combat./nThat's it for today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/021: [Eoline]/nFirst, always pay attention to the distance and direction from the enemy. This doesn't just apply to swordsmanship, but to any fighting style.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/022: [Eoline]/nAlways pay attention to the distance from your opponent and do not expose your back to the enemy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/023: [Eoline]/nIf you can anticipate the opponent's attacks, you can even dodge attacks from behind. But a true swordsman should treat his opponent as someone stronger than himself at every moment and fight seriously.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/024: [Eoline]/nIf you pay attention to the spirit of chivalry, you should not attack the enemy's back cowardly;/nBut if survival is your priority, attacking from behind is also a tactic that cannot be ignored.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/025: [Eoline]/nSecond, you must understand the enemy's strengths and weaknesses. /nIt sounds easy, but it is not easy to actually do it in combat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/026: [Eoline]/nUnderstanding the enemy's strengths, you can adopt corresponding defensive methods,/nincrease the chance of blocking attacks; knowing the enemy's weaknesses, you can increase the chance of a successful attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/027: [Eoline]/nThe most typical example is the mage. They are very resistant to magic,/nIt is difficult to knock it down with ordinary magic./nBut it is very vulnerable to swords and bullets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/028: [Eoline]/nArchers use firearms with long range and high attack power; but their defense power is almost the same as that of mages, and they are even more vulnerable to magic attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/029: [Eoline]/nIn addition, weaknesses will also manifest themselves in various forms./nYou need to accumulate experience in actual combat and study them carefully.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/030: [Eoline]/nDon't forget these two points first. /nIn the next lesson, I will explain combat skills in more detail.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/031: [Eoline]/nGo and accumulate some practical experience before coming back. /nI will teach you magic then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/032: [Eoline]/nDon't be greedy for too much at the beginning,/nSlowly accumulate experience.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/045: [Eoline]/nThen, it shouldn't be difficult to learn my magic. /nI will teach you ice-cold magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/046: [Eoline]/nBefore teaching, let me first explain the/nmagic system in this land.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/047: [Eoline]/nMagic is roughly divided into six systems. Among them, the three elements of fire, ice, and thunder are also called three-element magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/048: [Eoline]/nIn addition, there are dark magic that is said to originate from the power of the Dark God,/nsacred magic that originates from the power of the Lord God,/nand auxiliary magic derived from sacred magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/049: [Ioline]/nThe three elements of magic restrain each other:/nFire is weaker than ice, ice is weaker than thunder and lightning,/nthunder and lightning are weaker than fire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/050: [Eoline]/nDark and holy magic are independent of the three-element system and restrain each other. In other words, the side that attacks first is more advantageous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/051: [Eoline]/nAuxiliary magic can interfere with time and space,/nIt has no incompatible relationship with the other five systems.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/052: [Eoline]/nThese systems not only exist in magic,/nsometimes they also appear as attributes of other substances,/nso you must remember them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/053: [Eoline]/nThe most common thing is the attributes of monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/054: [Eoline]/nFor example, using cold magic or weapons,/nAttacks monsters with fire attributes,/nIt will cause double damage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/055: [Eoline]/nOn the other hand, if you use the same type of fire attack, not only will it not be injured,/nOn the contrary, it will absorb and recover. If you attack with lightning that is restrained by flames, it won't cause much damage, so be careful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/056: [Eoline]/nOkay, now I'll teach you ice-cold magic. /nPlease use it in actual combat. /nThe topic of the next lesson is the rapier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/058: Accepted the guidance of Ioline and obtained <color=#FFDE5A>EXP 20</color>.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/061: [Eoline]/nThis time I will explain the attack of the sword and the rapier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/062: [Eoline]/nLast time I briefly talked about the rapier and the heavy sword. /nDo you still remember the characteristics of the rapier?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/063: You say it's a light sword focused on attack./nBut not very good at defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/064: [Eoline]/nThat's right. It is light and easy to use, with excellent attack power./nIt is also easier to land a fatal blow. But when used for defense, the sword blade is too thin and/nToo light, difficult to withstand damage, and easy to break.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/065: So, it's better not to defend yourself?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/066: [Eoline]/nExtremely speaking, this is indeed the case. However, its attack power is very strong. As long as it strikes first, it is possible to win the battle before the enemy has time to effectively counterattack/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/067: [Eoline]/nAlthough it is a bit risky, the attack power of the rapier is excellent for the price. As long as you have enough money, it is also a good strategy to bring a few more to use as consumables.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/069: [Eoline]/nI will explain the method of changing weapons in detail next time. /nUse this assault sword first, /nPractice the basic combat skills of the rapier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/071: Accepted the guidance of Ioline and obtained <color=#FFDE5A>EXP 30</color>.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/076: [Eoline]/nHow is the rapier used? Is it still easy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/077: The attack power is indeed very strong, but /n is too easy to damage and cannot be used for a long time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/080: [Eoline]/nWhen attacked, a defender will instinctively try to block. Of course, no one can perfectly block all the enemy's attacks./nBut let's make this assumption first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/081: [Eoline]/nThe enemy's attack will first be blocked by the defender's weapon. /nIn other words, weapons play the role of the first line of defense/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/082: [Eoline]/nBut like everything else in the world,/nThe outcome depends on which side is stronger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/083: So, the sword will break,/nIs this also the reason?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/084: [Eoline]/nThat's right. The maximum attack power that a weapon can withstand, /n is called the weapon's upper limit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/085: [Eoline]/nIf you try to block an attack that exceeds the upper limit of the weapon's endurance,/nthe defender will suffer the excess damage and/nthe weapon will also be damaged.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/086: [Eoline]/nLike this, weapons that penetrate defenders deal damage,/nIt's called a "breakthrough."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/087: [Eoline]/nWhen a weapon is breached, its durability will be reduced by 1. If the durability drops to 0, the weapon can no longer be used.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/088: [Eoline]/n The rapier maximizes its attack power, but at the cost of a very low upper limit/n and a durability of only 1 or 2. /nTherefore it is easily damaged in battle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/089: [Eoline]/n Fortunately, even if the weapon is damaged, it can be repaired.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/090: So, the rapier has no use in actual combat?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/091: [EOLYN]/nThis is not the case. /nThe rapier mainly exerts its power in long-distance attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/092: [Eoline]/nEspecially in multi-person combat, as long as the division of labor is properly divided, it will be very/nuseful. On the other hand, /n is not appropriate when one person is facing multiple enemies.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/093: [Eoline]/nDo you understand the concept of defense now? /nGo and experience what you just learned in actual combat. /nNeed to go further this time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/094: [Eoline]/nNext lesson, I'll talk about the opposite of the rapier/nHeavy sword, and higher level defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/095: Accepted the guidance of Ioline and obtained <color=#FFDE5A>EXP 40</color>.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/101: [Eoline]/nYou have mastered swordsmanship above the intermediate level. /nNext, we will comprehensively sort out the theories of epee and defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/102: [Eoline]/nWhen I talked about breakthroughs before, I made the assumption that "the defender perfectly blocks the attacker's attack." /nBut in actual combat, it is impossible to block all the enemy's attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/103: Yeah, I couldn't block all the attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/104: [Eoline]/nHow many attacks it can block is related to the type of weapon/n and the agility of the defender.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/105: [Eoline]/nThe rapier itself is not suitable for defense, and/ncannot block too many attacks; while the characteristics of the heavy sword,/ncan increase the probability of blocking enemy attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/106: [Eoline]/nIn addition, weapons also have the attribute "defense"./nWhen the block is successful, it will be based on the defense of the weapon./nReduce the enemy's attack by a certain proportion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/107: [Eoline]/nThe rapier has low defense and the epee has high defense,/nso when blocking the same attack, the side using the epee will receive less damage/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/108: So, is it wiser to use an epee?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/109: [Eoline]/nSwords are not just rapiers and heavy swords,/nbut that can be said in general.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/110: [Eoline]/nWhen you need to deal with multiple enemies alone, or when fighting in a narrow space/n, it will be more advantageous to use a heavy sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/111: [Eoline]/nNow about defensive posture. When the enemy's attacks are focused on you,/nWhen you need to wait for companion support or attract the enemy's attention,/nTaking a defensive stance can be helpful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/112: [Eoline]/nAfter adopting a defensive posture, the probability/n of blocking enemy attacks will be doubled. If you are holding an epee, /ndefensive stance can further ensure your safety.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/114: [Eoline]/nThe explanation is almost over. Let's go into the cave and have a look this time. /nThink carefully about what you have learned before. /nAs for a sword...use this one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/117: [Eoline]/nAlthough it is the most basic heavy sword, it is enough to block the attacks of those guys in the cave. In the next lesson, I will talk about multi-person combat/nTactics required, and methods for changing weapons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/121: [Eoline]/nIt seems that you have mastered the art of fighting alone. But war is a battle fought by many people, and there will be times in the future when you need to fight side by side with your companions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/122: [Eoline]/nWhen fighting with companions, division of labor is very important.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/123: [Eoline]/nLet the companion with the heavy sword rush into the enemy's formation, and /nblock the attack while attracting the enemy's attention./nOther companions can attack more smoothly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/124: [Eoline]/nAt the same time, companions holding rapiers or swords with high attack power, /nas well as companions using magic and firearms, /ntake advantage of the teammates in front to attract attention and launch attacks from behind, /ncan effectively kill the enemy in one fell swoop.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/125: Isn't it dangerous for the person rushing in front?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/126: [Eoline]/nThe defensive power of the heavy sword is quite high. As long as the enemy is not so strong/noverwhelmingly dominant, it will not be too dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/127: [Eoline]/nHowever, the heavy sword is not easy to cause damage to the enemy. Therefore, if you want to "win" in a battle, you need the strength of your companions/nhelp.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/129: [Eoline]/nNext, let's cover changing equipment. Besides what you have in your hands,/n you can carry two spare pieces. You knew that, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/130: [Eoline]/nDuring battle, handheld weapons and spare equipment can also be exchanged. Usually just to prevent damage to the weapon,/nBut taking advantage of this, even if you fight alone,/nIt can also bring out the effect of multi-person cooperation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/131: That is, using/n more than two weapons with different characteristics at the same time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/132: [Eoline]/nThat's right. I usually carry both a heavy sword and a rapier./nUse a rapier when there are few enemies or the distance is far./nWhen you need to get close to the enemy, switch to a heavy sword/nCombat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/133: [Eoline]/nYou can still move and attack after changing the sword, which is very practical/nmethod. Especially the rapier, which is suitable when the enemy has been defeated to a certain extent./nAfter suppression, it is used to complete the final blow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/134: [Eoline]/nBut don't forget that when using a heavy sword,/nIn some cases, casting magic will be more effective than attacking with a sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/135: [Eoline]/nThe explanation of general attacks ends here./nIn the end, only what can be called the ultimate swordsmanship skill remains./nA surefire move.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/136: [Eoline]/nAs long as you use your special moves appropriately, you will find that/nno matter how strong the enemy is, they are no match for you. /nLet's go deeper into the cave this time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/140: The last lesson: the ultimate move
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/141: [Eoline]/n represents the swordsmanship of Antalya, there are two main /n schools.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/142: [Eoline]/nThe swordsmanship centered on the Pendragon Kingdom, and the Gecil Empire as the/nThe swordsmanship in the center is called Kingdom Swordsmanship and Imperial Swordsmanship respectively./nThe Kingdom's swordsmanship focuses on speed, while the Empire's swordsmanship focuses on strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/143: [Eoline]/nThe special move of the Imperial Sword Technique is to use force to break through the enemy's defense,/npursue a one-hit kill; the special move of the Kingdom Sword Technique is to suppress the enemy with/nunexpected rapid combos.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/144: [Eoline]/nYou were once a scholar. Rather than strength, the kingdom's swordsmanship, which emphasizes skills, would be more suitable for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/145: [Eoline]/n Let's take the basic special move of Kingdom Swordsmanship "Vacuum Shura Blade" as an example.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/146: [Eoline]/nUsing various special moves such as the Vacuum Shura Blade,/n requires corresponding strength (XP).
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/147: [Eoline]/nVigor is similar to the magic power required to cast a spell, but it will increase a little each time you knock down an enemy, and the attack power and defense power will also increase accordingly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/148: [Eoline]/nThe energy will not be reduced by using special moves,/nbut the body cannot withstand abundant energy for a long time,/nso after a certain period of time, the energy will naturally dissipate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/149: [Eoline]/nThe levels of special moves are different, and the energy required is also different. /nOther special skills should be gradually mastered in actual combat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/150: [Eoline]/nAlso...this is the sword I have used before. /nI will help you one day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/152: Accepted the guidance of Ioline and obtained <color=#FFDE5A>EXP 100</color>.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/153: [Eoline]/nAt this point, I have told you everything I can theoretically teach you. All that's left is actual combat training.../nPractice hard and defeat Asura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/155: Do you want to receive swordsmanship training from Eoline? /nEven if you skip training, it will be considered completed and you will be able to obtain rewards such as EXP and props during the training process.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/158: Accepted the guidance of Ioline and obtained <color=#FFDE5A>EXP 300</color>. /nObtained <color=#6EFDFF>Shabby Excalibur</color> from Eoline. /nObtained <color=#6EFDFF>Shabby Excalibur</color> from Eoline. /nObtained <color=#6EFDFF>Shabby Excalibur</color> from Eoline. /nObtained <color=#6EFDFF>Shabby Excalibur</color> from Eoline.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst15/000: I have come all the way here, but I don't know if I have practiced enough. /15d However, before going further, it is better to accept the guidance of the third stage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/000: However, in the past few years,/nno forces have gone to Bifrost,/nso life has been relatively peaceful.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/002: I heard about Geisir's cathedral,/nIt was built more than ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/003: It's just... now it seems that Bifrost himself,/nWant to expand outward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/005: I heard there are some groups outside,/nto address the issues of religious minorities,/nExaggerated into a problem for an entire religious group...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/007: Thieves have been rampant in the desert recently. /nAs a result, I almost died several times during this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/008: People who live in hot places mostly have a laid-back temperament.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/009: This is Libreville. /nIf we talk about the lord with the strongest military power, it is Frederick;/nBut the most suitable place to live is here - Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/010: However, in this chaotic era,/nNowhere seems to be able to get through this unscathed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/011: Have you ever heard of the sword left by Lord Kars?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/012: I heard that Sharn Hoiste also appeared in this area.../nWho is that phantom thief?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/013: I wonder if Sharon Hoiste is like the West Wind./nJust a common thief?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/015: A man with a good weapon./nMaybe it's natural.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/016: I used to be a captive of the Tuer people,/nI have seen their life. /nRelying on developed civilization,/nThey manufacture and use/nall kinds of convenient machines.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/017: I am a devout believer of the Lord God.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/018: Heh, I'm just a laid-back aristocrat enjoying middle-aged romance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/019: In order to achieve the unification of the empire, /nCesare seems to be too obsessed with his own methods.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/020: Doing that requires too many sacrifices...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/021: If my mother is not my biological mother...my biological brothers and sisters, would /n be living somewhere else and not even aware of my existence? /nAh...how romantic...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/023: I heard that you can't buy that mirror with money, /n will only be sold to the person selected by the mirror. /nWhat a strange old man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/024: The lord here is really beautiful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/025: Most monks are not like what is said outside./nFallen./nThe only ones with problems are a few religious people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/026: The hardest things are often the easiest to break. /nThere is not only one way to solve the problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/027: Before, I saw an old man/n selling an interesting mirror...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/028: That mirror can reflect what /n people desire most...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/031: Awen disguised herself as a man, and with the help of the power of gems, /n (gems have mysterious powers to protect her) /n traveled through the battlefield, looking for Al. /nDuring this period, Awen took the name of "Kane", /n experienced countless adventures, and became famous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/032: Later, Awen was on the battlefield/nI found out where Al was on the battlefield./nShe flew away like the wind in the sky.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/033: You can go to Ron to hear the rest of the story./nNow, you have listened to the first part in the pub and the second part to the child,/nI listened to the third paragraph here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/034: Bifrost is really an unattractive country. /nI've been there once before, not to mention how rustic it is! /nIt's simply the countryside!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/035: And the people there are all so old-fashioned,/nIt's really hard to understand...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/038: We have a block of chaos passed on from generation to generation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/039: In this day and age, our family can still live such a life./nIsn't it all thanks to the Chaos Cube?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/041: Although I have also heard that Duke Frederick/n of Ron is very talented...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/042: If it is better at military strength over there,/nit is more suitable to live here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/043: You say I look like Nicole Kidman in "Turbo"? /nOops...thank you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/044: But you're not like Tom Cruise.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/045: Our family used to live in Prevlaka./nThen he fled here because of his lord there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/046: Now life is finally a little more stable,/nBut that memory is really like a nightmare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/047: Not long ago, I met several children who were in the same situation, and /n took them in.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/048: Awen walked into the lake and found a gem with a strange light at the bottom of the lake/n, and picked it up. /nAt this time, the voice of the star sounded again: /n"With that gem, he will be safe."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/049: Thank you very much for last time. /nYou saved our lives...and avenged us.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/051: However, I will absolutely, absolutely/nnot forgive those lords. real.
