Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/053: If this continues, when will we be able to stand out! /nWhy do you, why do you have to be like this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/054: If I had known this, I shouldn't have gotten married!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/055: [Mr. Jones]/nAh... wine is the joy and joy of life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/056: [Mr. Jones]/nWithout wine,/nWhat's the point of living in this world.../nNo matter what my wife says, there is nothing I can do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/057: [Mr. Jones]/nBesides, I don't drink too much.../nI really don't understand why she hates me drinking so much.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/059: To those who saw this letter:/nWhen I was cleaning up the basement,/nFound a road to a strange cave./nIt's a very complicated cave. I'm going to prepare for it this time./nGo inside again.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/062: Is this the arena owner's house that the weapon shop owner mentioned? /nStrange, the door seems to be open.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/064: This... Do you have to go to this point to drink?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/071: [Mr. Jones]/nThank you so much.../nA small gift to express my gratitude.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/074: This key should be able to open the door to the arena.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/075: But Al has already rushed to the battlefield. /nAwen took the gems and only a sword,/nrushed to the place where Al fought.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/084: Even so, this is really a nice place to live! /nThe water in our city is very good!

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/087: What's even more surprising is that the people there don't even know /n "chocolate" or even "chocolate"! /nAlthough it is a new food introduced by the Tuer people, it is not that bad. /nIt really makes me speechless...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/088: My mother never showed it to me once. /nIt is said that if you are underage, you are not qualified to watch it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/089: We have a family rule./nWe're going to hand over that stone to the square of chaos./nAll legends, man./nHave you heard the legend?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/090: Hehehe! /nHowever, you look a bit like Bruce Willis!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/092: Did you see the bridge on the way to our city? /nThat is the "Libreville Bridge" known as the most beautiful bridge in the old empire/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/093: There's a legend about the bridge./nEvery time you want to start, it pours rain./nIn the midst of flooding, the project has been unable to move forward./nThe witch said, "The guardian of this river is not allowed to build a bridge here."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/094: In order to appease the guardian spirit of the river, people/n tried their best, but to no avail. /nFinally, they thought of human sacrifice...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/095: Want to hear the subsequent legend of the bridge? /nSo, people began to look for girls who were willing to sacrifice for building the bridge,/nBut of course no one was willing. /nOne day when the project continued to be delayed,/nA young girl came to the construction site.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/096: The girl said:/n"I can let the project continue./nIn exchange, give me this bridge."/nPeople were confused. /nThey thought the girl was going to dedicate herself to the river god,/nBut in that case, how could she own this bridge?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/097: After discussion, people decided/nto hand over the ownership of the bridge to the girl. /nThe girl laughed loudly,/nthen jumped into the river! /nAsk someone else for the rest of the story!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/098: I particularly like legends. /nIf you know any ancient stories, can you tell them to me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/099: Oh... Do you want to hear the follow-up to Legend of the Bridge?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/100: Then this is what happened:/nThe girl who jumped into the river turned into a dragon,/nstarted a fierce battle with the river god. /nPeople thought she was going to be a sacrifice, /ncould only watch the battle in horror.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/101: The fighting lasted three days and three nights./nAnd the heavens and the earth will be dazzled during that time,/nPeople can't see a light.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/102: Finally, daybreak. People saw/n the girl standing by the river. /nWhen everyone came closer, the girl said: /n"From now on, this river belongs to me. Building a bridge on the river is to break the spell of the original river god. I drove away the river god for you, so that you can build the bridge."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/103: "But you must build this bridge into the strongest and most beautiful bridge in the world. It will symbolize my ownership of the river and my spell. Therefore, if the bridge breaks, I, you who built it, or your descendants, will die."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/104: After saying that, the girl disappeared like a phantom. /nPeople worked hard to build the bridge,/nThe bridge you see was finally built. /nHow about it, is it interesting?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/105: The land is lower than the surrounding area./nThere is a risk of flooding./nGesell Geographic Institute
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/107: You also like to listen to stories? /nThis is for you. /nI picked it up not long ago, but it doesn't fit me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/031_3: I have a friend who lives in Paro./nI heard that strange things happened in the village recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/032_3: A young master from a powerful family wanted to marry a pagan despite the opposition of the church, but/n suddenly announced that he had terminated the engagement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/033_3: Oh my god, the church is against it, so even marriage can't be concluded? /nHow can people in the countryside over there endure such treatment?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/055_3: Ah...wine is the joy and joy of life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/056_3: Without wine, what's the point of living in this world.../nNo matter what my wife says, there is nothing I can do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/057_3: Besides, I don't drink too much.../nI really don't understand why she hates me drinking so much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/000: [Kana]/nCyrano! /35dHow could you do such a thing.../35d/nWhy.../30dWhy did you even kill Christina...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/001: [Esmeralda]/nYou can't forgive Esther,/25dI can still/nunderstand this.../50dBut Christina/30d belongs to the woman you love...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/003: [Silver]/nWe're facing the God of Destruction! /45d/nOne wrong move and we're dead!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/004: [Clausewitz]/nMr. Cyrano,/40d everyone's trust in you is being shaken. /50d/nYou didn't save Christina, /35dEven I was shocked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/008: This is not the case./60dDon't follow me anymore, okay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/010: You have gone too far. /45d Because of you, we lost two captains. /60d/nBut you /30d said such irresponsible words...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/011: I'm warning you. /65d/nWhoever criticizes my actions again, /50dI will get rid of him as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/014: It seems that Esmeralda/50d also thinks I did something wrong.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/015: ...Sorry. /40d It seems that we /15d have pushed you to this point. /45d It was my oversight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/016: However, /30d we have our own righteousness. /50d/nYour current behavior, /30d is inconsistent with the philosophy of the West Wind Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/017: From now on, West Wind Falcon/45d will operate separately from you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/018: Cyrano.../45d Now.../30d I can't believe you anymore...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/019: I never counted on anyone's trust. /75d/nTrust this kind of thing, /30d will only hinder my revenge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/020: Did you hear everything? /40d We don't need dissenters. How about /50d/n? /20d Is anyone still willing to follow us?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/023: That's enough, Silver. /45d There is no reason to delay any longer. /45d/nHurry up and catch up with Cesare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/000: Did you enjoy your meal? /50d/nI don't know if the food tastes good.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/001: You personally entertained me, how could /25d not be good! /30d/nWe were very satisfied with our meal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/002: That's great. /60d/n I am very happy that you are somewhat satisfied.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/003: It seems that now is not the time to relax. /60d I think it's almost time to get down to business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/008: The words were spoken suddenly, /20d seems to have put you in a difficult position, /40d/nBut he also wants to help Miss Esther as soon as possible, /25d please forgive me. /30d/nCome, /30dPlease feel free to tell me your troubles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/009: Okay, /30d what you said made me feel more relaxed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/010: Then, /20d let me explain the /25d/n reason why you are invited to come.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/012: As you all know, /25d our Libreville /20d is within the empire, /30d/n has always been considered one of the few livable places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/013: Of course! /35d/n It is not an exaggeration to say that this is the best place in the empire!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/016: Ancestor lords and residents/30dreclaim the mountains,/30don barren land/nCutting mountains and building roads,/50dfinally/20dlet this be the same as north beefrost/20d/nand the center of the Curtis trade.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/017: This land/25d is the result of our hard work with blood and sweat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/019: The plateau on the north side of the road east of /25d village leading to Curtis, /40d/n was divided into new territory and a village was built.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/020: Are you saying that the division of the /20d territory bothers you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/021: That doesn't matter. /40d The problem is, /20d that road is almost the lifeline of our Libreville, /55d they /15d regard it as their own property, /10d/n forcefully occupy it, and start collecting toll taxes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/022: What a bunch of shameless guys!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/023: However, territorial disputes of this magnitude within the /25d empire can be found everywhere in the /35d empire. /55d/nYou shouldn't/30d ask us for help just for this matter?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/024: Miss Isabele, /30dShe seems to have not finished speaking. /30d/nPlease listen to it again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/025: Yes, /40dIf it was just a matter of toll tax, /40d/n I would have liked to have the lords negotiate to resolve it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/028: The residents of Libreville who went out to work along that road, /50d/nI don't know when, they stopped coming back one after another...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/031: You want to say that they were kidnapped?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/032: I also/30d don't want to think of that step. /45d/nHowever, /25d the villagers have not returned for a long time, /30d/nI cannot stand idly by.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/033: But.../20dWhy don't you fight them directly? /40d/n Libreville has a larger population and is more developed, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/036: They do seem to have quite a bit of firepower.../55d/nbut they/20d are still using monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/037: Monster...? /45d does seem to have a problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/038: One refused to show up,/15dThe lord who drives monsters to kidnap people...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/039: So, /20d what do you want us to do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/040: Of course you want me to use this gun,/20dClean up those guys!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/041: Those who oppress innocent people, /25d we, the Falcons of the West Wind, will never let go! /50d/nEven if there is no entrustment from the lord, /25d/nas long as we know this matter in advance, we will not sit idly by and ignore it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/042: So.../40d are you willing to agree to my request?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/043: Wait, Miss Esther. /30d/nAren't you going to /20d not pay any compensation, /25d just borrow our power?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/044: Of course there will be a reward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/045: What are you talking about? /50d How can the lord spend money...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/046: As the saying goes, /30d It's hard to refuse hospitality. /30d/nMiss Esther, /30d Could you please tell me what you have prepared?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/047: Not only do the lords there/25d never show up in public,/40d/n all the letters we sent have also fallen silent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/048: I am willing to support one million Eld every year, /40d and /15d guarantee the /25d/n legal status of the cadres of the West Wind Falcon. /50dMy mansion, /25deveryone can use it freely/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/050: As expected, /35d has the courage that only the most outstanding lord can have. /45d/nWe gratefully accept this sincerity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/051: I have always /25d admired the /20d active performance of the Zephyr Falcon. /n/45dAs long as I can help, /20deven if it is a small matter, /25d/nI will do my best.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/052: Now /25d pay half a million Aird as a deposit, /35d/n I'll leave everything to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/053: Thank you so much. /40d Miss Esther Dodd!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/056: Although it doesn't count, /45d/n, I hope you will accept it as a little bit of my thoughts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw16/003: [Organization Member] /nHehehe, sorry, we have to take this sword away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw16/004: [Organization Member] /nThat is the magic sword of the legendary swordsman Kars! !
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw16/005: [Organization Member] /n is the sword that "that lord" is looking for.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/000: This is Caracas, a village on the edge of the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/001: Do you know General Kars? /nThe man who was once the strongest swordsman in the empire.../nHe is my idol.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/002: I heard that the sword left by General Kars is still hidden somewhere.../20d/nannihilation.../10dWhat hell.../10d Where is the sword? /15d is a terrible name anyway.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/004: I heard that General Kars can use extremely powerful special moves.../n Even the names of the moves are cool. /20d Heaven and earth...what kind of dance is this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/005: Have you ever met Chef Karg in a tavern? /nAlthough he is a weirdo, his craftsmanship is definitely the best in the old empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/006: We in Caracas border many areas. /nThe road signs nearby are also relatively complete.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/007: This is also a place where many travelers/n who go to other places often stay.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/009: Have you seen Sharon's show? /nEverything is the best, the best! /15d/nI am really her fan.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/010: ...I am no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/011: Hmm... Although it is in line with my ideals, /n is too dangerous... I'm scared.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/012: Ah, you know inside the Zephyr Falcon headquarters,/nIs there a path to a strange cave?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/013: Many people say that the strongest swordsman in the empire is His Majesty the Black Prince,/nBut to simply call His Majesty the Black Prince a swordsman seems.../30d/nIf we only talk about swordsmen, he is General Kars anyway.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/014: One day, I will go to the Magic Sword Forest and pull out the legendary magic sword. /n is the sword that General Kars once used...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/015: Legend has it that the hell-killing sword used by General Kars,/nJust plugged in near Bordeaux/nIn the Magic Sword Forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/016: However, I haven't met/n anyone who has actually seen that sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/017: People often regard Sharon/n as an ordinary idol singer...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/018: Actually, Sharon's singing skills are very good. /nIt's just that compared to her singing skills, her charm/n in other aspects is more dazzling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/019: Sharon has been traveling around.../nI don't know where she is now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/020: There should be no one around here who knows the forest better than I/n, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/021: Not long ago, I found a beautiful mushroom in a deep cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/025: Isn't it beautiful? It's beautiful./nIt's good. I can't eat it./nI don't know what Mr. Cage will do with it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/026: By the way, can you help me give this mushroom to Mr. Karg? /nSuch a precious mushroom will only be happy if it meets a good chef.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/027: Oh...this is my first time meeting a guest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/028: Do you know a plant called Love Herb? /nIt is said that it only blooms where true love sprouts. /nIt has an excellent fragrance and is a very precious ingredient.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/029: Oh...I can feel the breath of the desert from you. /nHave you been through the desert recently?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/030: It's better not to go to the desert as much as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/031: I heard that in the desert, /n it is important to believe that you are on the right path.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/032: If you trust others casually, you will suffer big losses!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/033: When I served in the Imperial Army under the direct control of His Majesty the Black Prince, /n served with General Kars.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/034: The sword once used by the general is buried in the forest near Ron./nThis story is very famous. /30d/nIt's just that I don't know if it's true or not.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/036: Heh, I recently heard from travelers passing by that/nSomeone discovered Love Herb near here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/037: Heh, that man lives in Pretoria,/nI will never tell you about this even if I die. /nChef Mr. Kagg will probably like it, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/038: My grandson is too weak, which is really worrying.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/039: Everything is good, is there anything that is good for my son's health?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/040: Isn't this Higashi? /nHikasi is not only famous for its cooking spices,/nit is also a famous tonic!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/041: Will you sell it to me? /nIt should be good for replenishing your grandson's health. /nI will give you a good price.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/042: Well, since it's for my grandson... I'll give it to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/043: Sorry. /nThis is something someone else asked me to do...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/044: There are many caves in the mountains near Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/045: The cave near Pretoria is no ordinary cave...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/046: The legendary spear buried there is also an open secret.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/048: I don't have a father. There is no memory of him either.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/049: I really want to see my dad...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/051: She said she could no longer live here,/nJust took the children and left.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/052: Although I occasionally send letters back,/nI still miss her and the children like crazy. /nI am also thinking about pursuing him after I finish the matter at hand.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/053: Shh! I am an assassin on a mission. /nCan't tell you who to kill.../nHehehehehe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/054: It's been a hard time lately, and it's hard to do this job.../nThere has to be someone who needs it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/055: Tell you some information? /nRuben's men are all cowards, /nThey only attack the enemies with the lowest physical strength. /nHehehehe.../30d This is how our companions fell into trouble.../nIt should be accurate, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/056: Ah, I heard that Ruben's men will give priority to attacking/nenemies with reduced physical strength... Do you know?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/060: Swords are roughly divided into four categories: rapier, long sword, heavy sword, and broadsword. /nDifferent from the past classification based on "size", /nWe classify swords based on their performance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/061: The characteristics of the rapier are its long and slender blade, extremely powerful attack power, low price, and high critical hit rate; however, its defense power and block rate are low, its endurance limit is extremely low, and its durability is only 1, so it is easily damaged. That said, maintenance costs are high.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/062: Swords of fine swords, swords, swords, armored swords, Cassandra,/nGramm. Those who value their offensive power can use them./nBut when it's lower, it's too low./nIt can also endanger their lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/063: The epee is a large and wide sword. Its attack power and hit rate are low, but its defense power, block rate, durability and endurance limit are very high, /nso it has a great advantage in defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/064: The role of a heavy sword will gain a high level of defense and resistance./nAnd a heavy sword can't be easily damaged./nexpenditure. However, a low level of attack will prolong the fighting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/065: Epee includes Roman dagger, swordbreaker, epee, /n Chrysaor Gilliam, and hybrid sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/066: The long sword is an ordinary sword whose performance is between the heavy sword and the rapier. The balance is very good, but it lacks distinctive features, so /n is not very popular among famous swordsmen. /nThey pursue their own style more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/067: The Great Sword is also known as the "Holy Sword", including the Great Sword, Durandal, /nClaymore, etc., which are all legendary swords.../nThe attack and defense are very high, but the price is also very expensive. /nAnd many of them are simply not available on the market.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/068: Our Sword Research Association collects and trades swords from various places/n. /nWant to pick one? /nAll proceeds will be used for research.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/069: Sword Research Association Shop under Geisir Academy
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/070: Walk slowly. /nIf you have a good sword, please sell it to us...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/071: ----Caracas Branch of the Sword Research Society under Gesil Academy----
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/072: Pretoria has a branch of the Imperial Geographical Society. /nWhen I went there, I learned a lot about geography. /nGo and have a look.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/073: Place the character holding the defensive heavy sword in front, /n forming a barrier; the character holding the offensive rapier /n conducts long-distance attacks; /n the character holding the rear sword provides support with magic and firearms, /n this is the strongest tactic currently known. /n----The Tactical Society under the Geysir Academy----
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/074: Magic is the ultimate form of attack. Those who can do justice,/nTheir skills should be sharpened to the limit./nBecause an attack is the best defense./n- The Magic Research Society of the Gesil Academy attacked the Head of the Magic Branch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/075: Some swords have attributes. /nThe dark sword has dark attributes, the silver sword has light attributes, /nthe flame sword, the thunder sword, and the ice sword have the attributes of fire, /nthunder and water respectively.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/076: Do you know about our new stardust? /nIt is made of 100% diamond and can be called the essence of defensive swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/077: In the final analysis, depending on the type of enemy, these attributes may become the sword's/nA huge advantage, it may also become its weakness...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/078: Especially the so-called "Holy Sword", most of them have their own attributes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/079: Especially the special move "Stardust", which shoots its own fragments, /n is a unique feature of this sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/080: Of course, it's made of diamond rather than metal, so the weapon/n durability is only 1, but it should never break. /nThe legendary member Mr. Paz has been looking for this sword...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/002_3: I heard that the sword left by General Kars is still hidden somewhere...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/004_3: There is an underground sewer connected to the north of the village, but once you enter, there is no way out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/005_3: Have you ever met Chef Kag in a tavern? Although he is a weirdo, his craftsmanship is definitely the best in the old empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/006_3: We in Caracas border many areas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/007_3: This is also a place where many travelers to other places often stop.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/009_3: Have you seen Sharon's show? Everything is the best, the best! I'm really a fan of hers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/010_3: ...I am no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/011_3: Hmm... Although it is in line with my ideals, it is too dangerous... I am scared.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/012_3: Ah, do you know that there is a road leading to a strange cave inside our headquarters?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/013_3: In order to become a person like General Kars, I am also working hard to practice swordsmanship.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/063: Celepus has had a famous thieves guild since ancient times.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/064: Everyone is having a hard time nowadays,/nIt is also difficult for the Thieves Guild to survive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/066: We are on a special mission for the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/067: We are pretending to be a couple in order to perform a special mission.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/069: Our husband and wife knew how to do business long ago./nThis is why it is possible to rent the floor at the Amigo department store.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/070: Hmph... No matter how great they think they are,/nAfter all, this store was still opened with my property.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/071: Hmph. No matter how great they think they are,/nIn the final analysis, this store was still opened with my funding.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/072: We have spent a lot of effort to get to where we are today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/073: On the way, I accidentally met a strange man near the dragon's lair in Gesil Forest/n, and then I earned the capital to do business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/074: What special mission is it, you ask? That's a secret.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/075: After carrying out missions together for so long, I gradually fell in love with him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/076: We are performing a secret mission and cannot tell you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/077: After performing missions together for so long,/nI gradually fell in love with her. /nIn the beginning, we really had no tacit understanding...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/078: We are doing detective work now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/079: If you have any trouble, just leave it to us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/080: You ask how we know so clearly? /nBecause we are private detectives Tommy and Tuppence.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/081: My father and Mr. Tommy had a very good relationship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/082: But to be honest, this hotel/n was almost entirely built by me. /nMy stupid husband also knows how to open and close doors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/083: But he didn't realize it at all, and he still thought he was amazing. /nForget it, I have nothing to lose by letting him think so.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/084: Our boss is really a weirdo. /nThe hotel is actually managed by the landlady,/nIt is the boss who puts on airs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/085: It is also my first time to come to Cyreps,/nBut I have never seen such a beautiful woman.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/086: If you miss this opportunity, you will never have it again, right? /nI will bravely run towards the goddess in my heart and win her love! /nWait for me, my love!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/087: The young man who lives next door is quite likable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/088: I'm going to finish this trip./nI'll never go back to this old empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/089: How can we dampen their pride? /nMoney? reputation? Handsome face?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/090: In the final analysis, what can impress a woman is a little bit of your heart. /nHow can I make my beloved her/n feel my heart?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/091: It would be great if Ms. Ruth over there could become the mayor, /nArrest all those guys who are full of dirty ideas!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/092: The secret to good wine is attentiveness. /nThe heart to sacrifice everything in order to be the best!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/093: For the tranquility of the port,/nNow this kind of unrestricted free trade area,/nmust be restrained.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/094: Excessive freedom can make people stupid.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/095: I am Charles, the current mayor of Cyreps.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/096: I have no intention of giving up the position of mayor to a junior like Ruth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/097: Are you the mayor of Cyreps?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/098: [Mayor Charles]/nIt's me, what's the matter with/15d? /35d/nDid you also come to compare me with someone like Ruth when the mayoral election was about to take place? /30d/n?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/099: I have no interest in the mayoral election. /50d/nI just want to know when the ship sailing to Daqama/25d/n will be lifted.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/100: [Mayor Charles]/nHuh.../45d You ask when the flight ban will be lifted?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/101: Are you planning to completely close the route?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/102: [Mayor Charles]/n Route closed! /40d This is a good idea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/103: [Mayor Charles]/nGo back. /30d/nI have nothing to say about that route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/104: [Ruth]/nFor the revival of the Gesir Empire!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/105: Excuse me, /30d Do you know someone named Ruth?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/106: [Ruth]/nIf it's Ruth Grant you're looking for,/30d/nit's me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/108: [Ruth]/nHehe, /20d are you surprised? /40d/nIt seems that this is your first time coming to Cyreps.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/110: I have to go to the port of Da Cama. /45d/nBut the mayor has blocked the route.../60d/nIs there any way to lift the ban?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/111: [Ruth]/nOops, /65dAlthough I am a mayoral candidate, /30dI am just an ordinary citizen, /25d/nI don't have that kind of power.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/112: No. /35d/nYou can tell from the /nexpectations people in town have for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/113: [Ruth]/nReally.../85d/nBut,/25dWhy are you in such a hurry to go to Da Cama Port?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/118: Actually, I /30d came here for the /10d/n magic sword Asura on Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/120: No. /40d/nI do need the power of that sword, /45d/nbut not for the pursuit of fame.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/121: [Ruth]/nIt is said that many people went to that island to find Asura/15d, but no one came back safely./60d/n
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/123: [Ruth]/nWhat a very interesting story. /45d/nHowever, /25d it doesn't matter if you tell me even this kind of thing?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/124: ...I received news that my mother/40d/n in Dhakama is critically ill...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/125: [Ruth]/nHa ha ha! /55dYour lie is so obvious!/50d/nIt's written all over your face.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/126: [Ruth]/nI don't want to talk to dishonest people/45d/n. /45d/nPlease get out of the way, okay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/127: ...Ms. Ruth, /30d Please forgive my rudeness. /45d/nCan you please help me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/128: [Ruth]/nI have no reason to show kindness to an insincere person/50d/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/129: I think that since I expect kindness from others, /45d/n I should be honest with myself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/130: [Ruth]/nHehe, /35d Okay. /40d/nI feel your sincerity, /40d naturally should respond.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/132: [Ruth]/nI will help you, /30d Let's meet at the dock.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/134: [Ruth]/nI see... /75d/nBut, /25d is it okay if you tell me this kind of thing?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/135: I have already lied once and offended you, /55d/n cannot make the same mistake again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/136: [Ruth]/nHehe, /65dI don't hate people who are willing to admit their mistakes, /70d/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/138: [Ruth]/nI feel your sincerity, and /30d naturally respond sincerely. /45d/nOf course, /20dI am not like a certain young master, /25d who will lie casually/n.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/139: I have to go to the port of Da Cama.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/142: Thank you for your patronage. Thank you so much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/146: This house seems to be unoccupied...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/147: It's too early to give up now. /45d/nLet's talk to Ms. Ruth again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/148: It seems we should go find the person named Ruth...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/149: Is this the mayor's official residence.../60d/n Mayor Charles's reputation doesn't seem to be very good.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/150: Ms. Ruth, who used to stay at the tavern,/nI also mentioned the treasure island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/151: Residence of the Mayor of Cyrepus
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/012_2: A few days ago, I met a very beautiful sister.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/014_2: When I grow up, I want to become such a beauty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/022_2: Although her house is a bit strange.../nIf you go to Libreville, can you help me ask her?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/025_2: Those nobles are obviously so rich,/nDon't they ever think about protecting everyone's safety?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/053_2: I don't live in the hotel, why do I ask?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/091_2: However, with my beauty,/nIt is indeed a pity to stay in a place like this and serve others,/nHehehe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/125_2: Ah hahaha! Your lies are too obvious! /n "I'm lying" is written on your face, how can I believe you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/126_2: [Ruth]/nI don't like dishonest people. /nExcuse me, could you please step aside?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/153: [Ruth]/nSince it is not for fame,/40d/nthen why on earth do you want to take such a risk?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/155: [Ruth]/nPeople who meet me for the first time,/30d/nare often surprised to learn that the/n/25d who is fighting against Mayor Charles is actually a woman,/20d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/156: [Mayor Charles]/nThat route/10d is infested with pirates and is very dangerous,/40d/nso sailing is temporarily prohibited.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/157: [Mayor Charles]/nAnyway, the economic situation of Da Cama Port/15d is terrible./50d/nWe can't get much benefit from trading with them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/159: I believe with your ability,/35d/nThere must be a way to help me, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/161: For this, /30d I had to take a boat from the Port of Da Cama to Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/162: [Ruth]/nHmm.../30d Got it. /50d I will help you. /30d/nLet's meet at the dock.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/165: [Ruth]/nYou are also the kind of person who wants to use the power of the magic sword,/45d/nA person who pursues a false reputation?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/000: Congratulations,/15d General Frederick. /30d/nIf it weren't for your careful planning, /30d wouldn't have today's victory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/001: Ha ha./70dI know very well that the victory of this battle,/45dIt's not just me and Clausewitz's plan./45d/nbrought results.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/002: It is only by working together that we can win this battle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/003: Our strategy, /40d is just a support, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/004: You are right. /40d/nThe victory /20d achieved in this battle, /20d will definitely leave a mark in the history of the empire, /30d/n is certainly worthy of celebration.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/005: Speaking of which, where are the heroes in this battle of /30d? /65d/nI am talking about the gray cloak swordsman. /55d I really want to have a drink with him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/006: You are talking about Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/007: The rear troops made a mistake, causing the front to collapse. /45d Thanks to his quick /15d/n retaking the supply line, /25d we were able to save the situation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/010: Sorry, can you leave me alone for a while?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/012: Let him be, /10dKana. /25d/nCyrano also has /25d what he wants to do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/014: Cyrano,/40d Thank you very much for your hard work today. /65d/nI want to raise a toast to the hero of this battle, /30d.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/015: ...That's not bad either. /55d/nHowever, /35dBefore toasting with you, /30dI have one more thing to do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/017: General Alfred Frederick,/60d I challenge you to a duel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/022: Hahaha, /70d your joke has gone too far. /55d/nWith my swordsmanship, how can /35d fight against the best swordsman in the empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/023: It seems you didn't understand me. /70d/nI don't want to compete with you in swordsmanship. /40d is what I want, /35d is your life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/025: Hmm.../75d This is difficult to handle. /55d/nI don't know what resentment you have against me, /55d/nBut now we are at a banquet celebrating the victory of the coalition.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/026: Even if I want to accept your duel, /70d/n cannot do it here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/027: Before dawn tomorrow, /60d will be on the peak behind this valley. /45d/nOf course, /30d comes alone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/028: I hope you won't be late.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/029: What a rude person! /60d/n Such a unilateral proposal for a duel, /15d I cannot accept it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/030: A unilaterally proposed duel? /70d/nThose who kill innocent people in the name of duel, /40dcan't you accept it when it's your turn?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/034: Your Excellency Frederick/15d is coming this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/036: ...Although I don't know what the reason is, /55d but since you have said it to this point, there is nothing you can do. /55d/nOkay, /40dI accept your duel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/037: However, /20d I accept this duel, /40d/n not because you are right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/038: I accept your duel, /40d just to show that what I have done so far, /55d/n, has no conscience at all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/039: You will naturally know when the time comes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/041: I'm sorry, military advisor. /45d/nMy matter may affect the cooperation of the coalition forces.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/042: Having said that, /35d/n I believe that Mr. Cyrano must have your reasons for doing this. /40d
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/043: There must be some hidden secret that is inconvenient to tell us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/044: We/25d believe in you. /40d/nYou will not disappoint our expectations.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/002: Incredible.../45d/nI've been a pirate for years, but I've never seen this much treasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/003: Hahaha, let's see /30d. /30d/nClausewitz's information is indeed accurate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/004: Good heavens.../30d there's so much of it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/005: Sister, /15d look at this. /25d/n There are such beautiful diamonds in the world...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/006: Really deserves to be Clausewitz. /65d/nWith these, /20d there is no need to worry about military expenditures in the next ten years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/010: It seems.../30d There are others who want to find these treasures.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/011: [Organization Members]/nWho are you? /40d/nPut down the treasure and get out now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/012: Haha, /45d, don't be so fierce. /40d/nShouldn't everyone share good things?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/013: [Organization Member]/nDamn it! /35d Since it doesn't make sense, we have no choice but to take action!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/014: What to do now? /25d/n These guys seem to keep coming...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/015: Hmm.../40d As of now, there is nothing we can do.

Take as much as you can, /20d get out of here quickly!
How many attacks
